verses.textZh: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说："谁要为我们首先去攻打迦南人，与他们作战呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说："谁要为我们首先去攻打迦南人，与他们作战呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚死后，以色列人求问耶和华说：「我们中间谁当首先上去攻击迦南人，与他们争战？」
verses.textEnNiv: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Canaanites?"
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Joshua, the people of Israel inquired of the Lord , "Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites, to fight against them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, "Who shall be first to go up for us against the Canaanites to fight against them?"
verses.textEnNlt: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , "Which tribe should go first to attack the Canaanites?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after the death of Joshua that the sons of Israel inquired of the Lord, saying, "Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites, to fight against them?"
verses.textEn: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Canaanites?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华回答："犹大要先上去，看哪，我已经把那地交在他手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华回答："犹大要先上去，看哪，我已经把那地交在他手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「犹大当先上去，我已将那地交在他手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord answered, "Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said, "Judah shall go up; behold, I have given the land into his hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Judah shall go up. Indeed I have delivered the land into his hand."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord answered, "Judah, for I have given them victory over the land."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said, "Judah shall go up; behold, I have handed the land over to him."
verses.textEn: The Lord answered, "Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands."

verses.textZh: 犹大对自己的兄弟西缅说："请你与我一同上我抽签所得的地业去，我们好与迦南人交战；以后我也与你一同到你抽签所得的地业去。"于是西缅与他一同去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大对自己的兄弟西缅说："请你与我一同上我抽签所得的地业去，我们好与迦南人交战；以后我也与你一同到你抽签所得的地业去。"于是西缅与他一同去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大对他哥哥西缅说：「请你同我到拈阄所得之地去，好与迦南人争战；以后我也同你到你拈阄所得之地去。」于是西缅与他同去。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Judah then said to the Simeonites their fellow Israelites, "Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours." So the Simeonites went with them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, "Come up with me into the territory allotted to me, that we may fight against the Canaanites. And I likewise will go with you into the territory allotted to you." So Simeon went with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Judah said to Simeon his brother, "Come up with me to my allotted territory, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I will likewise go with you to your allotted territory." And Simeon went with him.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Judah said to their relatives from the tribe of Simeon, "Join with us to fight against the Canaanites living in the territory allotted to us. Then we will help you conquer your territory." So the men of Simeon went with Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah said to his brother Simeon, "Go up with me into the territory allotted me, and let’s fight the Canaanites; and I in turn will go with you into the territory allotted you." So Simeon went with him.
verses.textEn: The men of Judah then said to the Simeonites their fellow Israelites, "Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours." So the Simeonites went with them.

verses.textZh: 犹大上去了；耶和华就把迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中；他们在比色击杀了一万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大上去了；耶和华就把迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中；他们在比色击杀了一万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大就上去；耶和华将迦南人和比利洗人交在他们手中。他们在比色击杀了一万人，
verses.textEnNiv: When Judah attacked, the Lord gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah went up and the Lord gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand, and they defeated 10,000 of them at Bezek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah went up, and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand; and they killed ten thousand men at Bezek.
verses.textEnNlt: When the men of Judah attacked, the Lord gave them victory over the Canaanites and Perizzites, and they killed 10,000 enemy warriors at the town of Bezek.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah went up, and the Lord handed over to them the Canaanites and the Perizzites, and they defeated ten thousand men at Bezek.
verses.textEn: When Judah attacked, the Lord gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

verses.textZh: 他们在那里遇见了比色王，就与他交战，击杀了迦南人和比利洗人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那里遇见了比色王，就与他交战，击杀了迦南人和比利洗人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在那里遇见亚多尼‧比色，与他争战，杀败迦南人和比利洗人。
verses.textEnNiv: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.
verses.textEnEsv: They found Adoni-bezek at Bezek and fought against him and defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and fought against him; and they defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.textEnNlt: While at Bezek they encountered King Adoni-bezek and fought against him, and the Canaanites and Perizzites were defeated.
verses.textEnNasb: They found Adoni-bezek in Bezek and fought against him, and they defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.textEn: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.

verses.textZh: 比色王逃跑；他们追赶他，把他捉住，砍去了他手脚的大拇指。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比色王逃跑；他们追赶他，把他捉住，砍去了他手脚的大拇指。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼‧比色逃跑；他们追赶，拿住他，砍断他手脚的大拇指。
verses.textEnNiv: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
verses.textEnEsv: Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him and caught him and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Adoni-Bezek fled, and they pursued him and caught him and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
verses.textEnNlt: Adoni-bezek escaped, but the Israelites soon captured him and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
verses.textEnNasb: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
verses.textEn: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

verses.textZh: 比色王说："从前有七十个王，手脚的大拇指都被我砍去，在我的桌子底下拾取食物；现在神照着我所行的，报应我了。"于是他们把他带到耶路撒冷，后来他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比色王说："从前有七十个王，手脚的大拇指都被我砍去，在我的桌子底下拾取食物；现在神照着我所行的，报应我了。"于是他们把他带到耶路撒冷，后来他就死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼‧比色说：「从前有七十个王，手脚的大拇指都被我砍断，在我桌子底下拾取零碎食物。现在神按着我所行的报应我了。」于是他们将亚多尼‧比色带到耶路撒冷，他就死在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Adoni-bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and their big toes cut off used to pick up scraps under my table. As I have done, so God has repaid me." And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off used to gather scraps under my table; as I have done, so God has repaid me." Then they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Adoni-bezek said, "I once had seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off, eating scraps from under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They took him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.textEnNasb: And Adoni-bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and their big toes cut off used to gather up scraps under my table; as I have done, so God has repaid me." So they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.textEn: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

verses.textZh: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，把城占领，用刀击杀了城中的居民，又放火烧城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，把城占领，用刀击杀了城中的居民，又放火烧城。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人攻打耶路撒冷，将城攻取，用刀杀了城内的人，并且放火烧城。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword and set the city on fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of Judah fought against Jerusalem and took it; they struck it with the edge of the sword and set the city on fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem and captured it, killing all its people and setting the city on fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.textEn: The men of Judah attacked Jerusalem also and took it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.

verses.textZh: 后来，犹大人下去，与住在山地、南地和高原的迦南人交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，犹大人下去，与住在山地、南地和高原的迦南人交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来犹大人下去，与住山地、南地，和高原的迦南人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: After that, Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.
verses.textEnEsv: And afterward the men of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, in the Negeb, and in the lowland.
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who dwelt in the mountains, in the South, and in the lowland.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they went down to fight the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev, and the western foothills.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward, the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, and in the Negev, and in the lowland.
verses.textEn: After that, Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.

verses.textZh: 犹大人又去攻击住在希伯仑的迦南人，杀了示筛、亚希幔和挞买；希伯仑从前名叫基列．亚巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人又去攻击住在希伯仑的迦南人，杀了示筛、亚希幔和挞买；希伯仑从前名叫基列．亚巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人去攻击住希伯仑的迦南人，杀了示筛、亚希幔、挞买。希伯仑从前名叫基列‧亚巴。
verses.textEnNiv: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (now the name of Hebron was formerly Kiriath-arba), and they defeated Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah went against the Canaanites who dwelt in Hebron. (Now the name of Hebron was formerly Kirjath Arba.) And they killed Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah marched against the Canaanites in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath-arba), defeating the forces of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.textEnNasb: So Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron (the name of Hebron was previously Kiriath-arba); and they struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.textEn: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.

verses.textZh: 他们从那里又去攻击底璧的居民；底璧从前名叫基列．西弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从那里又去攻击底璧的居民；底璧从前名叫基列．西弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从那里去攻击底壁的居民；底壁从前名叫基列‧西弗。
verses.textEnNiv: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
verses.textEnEsv: From there they went against the inhabitants of Debir. The name of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher.
verses.textEnNkjv: From there they went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir was formerly Kirjath Sepher.)
verses.textEnNlt: From there they went to fight against the people living in the town of Debir (formerly called Kiriath-sepher).
verses.textEnNasb: Then from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir (the name of Debir was previously Kiriath-sepher).
verses.textEn: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

verses.textZh: 迦勒说："谁能攻打基列．西弗，把城攻取，我就把我的女儿押撒给他作妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒说："谁能攻打基列．西弗，把城攻取，我就把我的女儿押撒给他作妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列‧西弗，将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."
verses.textEnEsv: And Caleb said, "He who attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Caleb said, "Whoever attacks Kirjath Sepher and takes it, to him I will give my daughter Achsah as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the one who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher."
verses.textEnNasb: And Caleb said, "Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as a wife."
verses.textEn: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."

verses.textZh: 迦勒的弟弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂攻取了那城，迦勒就把自己的女儿押撒给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒的弟弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂攻取了那城，迦勒就把自己的女儿押撒给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, captured it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah as wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Othniel, the son of Caleb’s younger brother, Kenaz, was the one who conquered it, so Acsah became Othniel’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, captured it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah as a wife.
verses.textEn: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.

verses.textZh: 押撒出嫁的时候，她劝俄陀聂向她父亲求一块田；押撒一下驴，迦勒就对她说："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押撒出嫁的时候，她劝俄陀聂向她父亲求一块田；押撒一下驴，迦勒就对她说："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田。押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"
verses.textEnEsv: When she came to him, she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when she came tohim, that she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Acsah married Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she got down off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What’s the matter?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then it happened that when she came to him, she incited him to ask her father for a field. Then later, she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"
verses.textEn: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

verses.textZh: 她回答："请你给我一份礼物；你既然把我安置在南地，求你也把水泉赐给我。"迦勒就把上泉和下泉都给了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她回答："请你给我一份礼物；你既然把我安置在南地，求你也把水泉赐给我。"迦勒就把上泉和下泉都给了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」迦勒就把上泉下泉赐给她。
verses.textEnNiv: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
verses.textEnEsv: She said to him, "Give me a blessing. Since you have given me the land of the Negeb, give me also springs of water." And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said to him, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water." And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEnNlt: She said, "Let me have another gift. You have already given me land in the Negev; now please give me springs of water, too." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
verses.textEnNasb: She said to him, "Give me a blessing: since you have given me the land of the Negev, give me springs of water also." So Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEn: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

verses.textZh: 摩西岳父的子孙基尼人，和犹大人一同离开棕树城，上到亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，住在那里的人民中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西岳父的子孙基尼人，和犹大人一同离开棕树城，上到亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，住在那里的人民中。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西的内兄 是基尼人，他的子孙与犹大人一同离了棕树城，往亚拉得以南的犹大旷野去，就住在民中。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the people of Judah to live among the inhabitants of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.
verses.textEnEsv: And the descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up with the people of Judah from the city of palms into the wilderness of Judah, which lies in the Negeb near Arad, and they went and settled with the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms with the children of Judah into the Wilderness of Judah, which lies in the South near Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: When the tribe of Judah left Jericho—the city of palms—the Kenites, who were descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, traveled with them into the wilderness of Judah. They settled among the people there, near the town of Arad in the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the city of palms with the sons of Judah, to the wilderness of Judah which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the people of Judah to live among the inhabitants of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.

verses.textZh: 犹大与他的兄弟西缅同去，击杀了住在洗法的迦南人，把那城完全毁灭。那城的名字就叫何珥玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大与他的兄弟西缅同去，击杀了住在洗法的迦南人，把那城完全毁灭。那城的名字就叫何珥玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大和他哥哥西缅同去，击杀了住洗法的迦南人，将城尽行毁灭，那城的名便叫何珥玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their fellow Israelites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they defeated the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath and devoted it to destruction. So the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they attacked the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. So the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Judah joined with Simeon to fight against the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they completely destroyed the town. So the town was named Hormah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they struck the Canaanites living in Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. So the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.textEn: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their fellow Israelites and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.

verses.textZh: 犹大又攻取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大又攻取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大又取了迦萨和迦萨的四境，亚实基伦和亚实基伦的四境，以革伦和以革伦的四境。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron—each city with its territory.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah also captured Gaza with its territory, and Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, Judah captured the towns of Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron, along with their surrounding territories.
verses.textEnNasb: And Judah took Gaza with its territory, Ashkelon with its territory, and Ekron with its territory.
verses.textEn: Judah also took Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron—each city with its territory.

verses.textZh: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就占领了山地；但不能赶走平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就占领了山地；但不能赶走平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与犹大同在，犹大就赶出山地的居民，只是不能赶出平原的居民，因为他们有铁车。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had chariots fitted with iron.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country, but he could not drive out the inhabitants of the plain because they had chariots of iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord was with Judah. And they drove out the mountaineers, but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the lowland, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was with the people of Judah, and they took possession of the hill country. But they failed to drive out the people living in the plains, who had iron chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had iron chariots.
verses.textEn: The Lord was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had chariots fitted with iron.

verses.textZh: 犹大照着摩西的吩咐，把希伯仑给了迦勒；迦勒就从那里赶走亚衲子孙的三族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大照着摩西的吩咐，把希伯仑给了迦勒；迦勒就从那里赶走亚衲子孙的三族。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人照摩西所说的，将希伯仑给了迦勒；迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长。
verses.textEnNiv: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hebron was given to Caleb, as Moses had said. And he drove out from it the three sons of Anak.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said. Then he expelled from there the three sons of Anak.
verses.textEnNlt: The town of Hebron was given to Caleb as Moses had promised. And Caleb drove out the people living there, who were descendants of the three sons of Anak.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised; and he drove out from there the three sons of Anak.
verses.textEn: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人没有赶走住在耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，所以耶布斯人与便雅悯人一同住在耶路撒冷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人没有赶走住在耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，所以耶布斯人与便雅悯人一同住在耶路撒冷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人没有赶出住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人。耶布斯人仍在耶路撒冷与便雅悯人同住，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: The Benjamites, however, did not drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, so the Jebusites have lived with the people of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem; so the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribe of Benjamin, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live in Jerusalem among the people of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem; so the Jebusites have lived with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEn: The Benjamites, however, did not drive out the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the Benjamites.

verses.textZh: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和华与他们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和华与他们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；耶和华与他们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the Lord was with them.
verses.textEnEsv: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the Lord was with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and the Lordwas with them.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Joseph attacked the town of Bethel, and the Lord was with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Likewise the house of Joseph went up against Bethel, and the Lord was with them.
verses.textEn: Now the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, and the Lord was with them.

verses.textZh: 约瑟家派人去窥探伯特利。那城从前的名字叫路斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟家派人去窥探伯特利。那城从前的名字叫路斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟家打发人去窥探伯特利（那城起先名叫路斯）。
verses.textEnNiv: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),
verses.textEnEsv: And the house of Joseph scouted out Bethel. ( Now the name of the city was formerly Luz.)
verses.textEnNkjv: So the house of Joseph sent men to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city was formerly Luz.)
verses.textEnNlt: They sent men to scout out Bethel (formerly known as Luz).
verses.textEnNasb: The house of Joseph had men spy out Bethel (the name of the city previously was Luz).
verses.textEn: When they sent men to spy out Bethel (formerly called Luz),

verses.textZh: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说："请你把进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说："请你把进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 窥探的人看见一个人从城里出来，就对他说：「求你将进城的路指示我们，我们必恩待你。」
verses.textEnNiv: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, "Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well."
verses.textEnEsv: And the spies saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, "Please show us the way into the city, and we will deal kindly with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, "Please show us the entrance to the city, and we will show you mercy."
verses.textEnNlt: They confronted a man coming out of the town and said to him, "Show us a way into the town, and we will have mercy on you."
verses.textEnNasb: And the spies saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, "Please show us the entrance to the city, and we will treat you kindly."
verses.textEn: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, "Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well."

verses.textZh: 那人把进城的路指示了他们，他们就用刀击杀了那城的居民，却把那人和他的全家都放走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人把进城的路指示了他们，他们就用刀击杀了那城的居民，却把那人和他的全家都放走。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人将进城的路指示他们，他们就用刀击杀了城中的居民，但将那人和他全家放去。
verses.textEnNiv: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.
verses.textEnEsv: And he showed them the way into the city. And they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but they let the man and all his family go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he showed them the entrance to the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
verses.textEnNlt: So he showed them a way in, and they killed everyone in the town except that man and his family.
verses.textEnNasb: So he showed them the entrance to the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but they let the man and all his family go free.
verses.textEn: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.

verses.textZh: 那人到赫人之地去了，筑了一座城，给它起名叫路斯；直到今日那城还叫这名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人到赫人之地去了，筑了一座城，给它起名叫路斯；直到今日那城还叫这名。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人往赫人之地去，筑了一座城，起名叫路斯。那城到如今还叫这名。
verses.textEnNiv: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city and called its name Luz. That is its name to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Later the man moved to the land of the Hittites, where he built a town. He named it Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city, and named it Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.textEn: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西没有赶走伯．善和属于伯．善的乡村的居民，他纳和属于他纳的乡村的居民，多珥和属于多珥的乡村的居民，以伯莲和属于以伯莲的乡村的居民，米吉多和属于米吉多的乡村的居民；迦南人决意住在那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西没有赶走伯．善和属于伯．善的乡村的居民，他纳和属于他纳的乡村的居民，多珥和属于多珥的乡村的居民，以伯莲和属于以伯莲的乡村的居民，米吉多和属于米吉多的乡村的居民；迦南人决意住在那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西没有赶出伯‧善和属伯‧善乡村的居民，他纳和属他纳乡村的居民，多珥和属多珥乡村的居民，以伯莲和属以伯莲乡村的居民，米吉多和属米吉多乡村的居民；迦南人却执意住在那些地方。
verses.textEnNiv: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.
verses.textEnEsv: Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages, for the Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, Manasseh did not drive out theinhabitantsof Beth Shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribe of Manasseh failed to drive out the people living in Beth-shan, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and all their surrounding settlements, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in that region.
verses.textEnNasb: But Manasseh did not take possession of Beth-shean and its villages, or Taanach and its villages, or the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, or the inhabitants of Ibleam and its villages, or the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; so the Canaanites persisted in living in this land.
verses.textEn: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

verses.textZh: 到以色列强盛了，就迫使迦南人作苦工，但没有把他们完全赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到以色列强盛了，就迫使迦南人作苦工，但没有把他们完全赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至以色列强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。
verses.textEnNiv: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.
verses.textEnEsv: When Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not drive them out completely.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites under tribute, but did not completely drive them out.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Israelites grew stronger, they forced the Canaanites to work as slaves, but they never did drive them completely out of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when Israel became strong, that they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they did not drive them out completely.
verses.textEn: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.

verses.textZh: 以法莲也没有把住在基色的迦南人赶走，于是迦南人还住在基色，在以法莲中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲也没有把住在基色的迦南人赶走，于是迦南人还住在基色，在以法莲中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲没有赶出住基色的迦南人。于是迦南人仍住在基色，在以法莲中间。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites who dwelt in Gezer; so the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribe of Ephraim failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, so the Canaanites continued to live there among them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who were living in Gezer; so the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
verses.textEn: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.

verses.textZh: 西布伦没有把基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民赶走；于是迦南人还住在西布伦中间，成了作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦没有把基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民赶走；于是迦南人还住在西布伦中间，成了作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦没有赶出基伦的居民和拿哈拉的居民。于是迦南人仍住在西布伦中间，成了服苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, so these Canaanites lived among them, but Zebulun did subject them to forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, or the inhabitants of Nahalol, so the Canaanites lived among them, but became subject to forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron or the inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites dwelt among them, and were put under tribute.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribe of Zebulun failed to drive out the residents of Kitron and Nahalol, so the Canaanites continued to live among them. But the Canaanites were forced to work as slaves for the people of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, or the inhabitants of Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and became subject to forced labor.
verses.textEn: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, so these Canaanites lived among them, but Zebulun did subject them to forced labor.

verses.textZh: 亚设没有把亚柯的居民和西顿的居民赶走，也没有把亚黑拉、亚革悉、黑巴、亚弗革和利合的居民赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设没有把亚柯的居民和西顿的居民赶走，也没有把亚黑拉、亚革悉、黑巴、亚弗革和利合的居民赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设没有赶出亚柯和西顿的居民，亚黑拉和亚革悉的居民，黑巴、亚弗革与利合的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Akko or Sidon or Ahlab or Akzib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob.
verses.textEnEsv: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, or the inhabitants of Sidon or of Ahlab or of Achzib or of Helbah or of Aphik or of Rehob,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Acco or the inhabitants of Sidon, or of Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or Rehob.
verses.textEnNlt: The tribe of Asher failed to drive out the residents of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Aczib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
verses.textEnNasb: Asher did not drive out the inhabitants of Acco, or the inhabitants of Sidon, or of Ahlab, or of Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or of Rehob.
verses.textEn: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Akko or Sidon or Ahlab or Akzib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob.

verses.textZh: 于是亚设人住在当地的居民迦南人中间，因为他们没有把他们赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚设人住在当地的居民迦南人中间，因为他们没有把他们赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，亚设因为没有赶出那地的迦南人，就住在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: The Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land because they did not drive them out.
verses.textEnEsv: so the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they did not drive them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, the people of Asher moved in among the Canaanites, who controlled the land, for they failed to drive them out.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
verses.textEn: The Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land because they did not drive them out.

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利没有把伯．示麦的居民和伯．亚纳的居民赶走；于是他们就住在当地的居民迦南人中间；伯．示麦和伯．亚纳的居民成了给他们作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利没有把伯．示麦的居民和伯．亚纳的居民赶走；于是他们就住在当地的居民迦南人中间；伯．示麦和伯．亚纳的居民成了给他们作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利没有赶出伯‧示麦和伯‧亚纳的居民，于是拿弗他利就住在那地的迦南人中间；然而伯‧示麦和伯‧亚纳的居民成了服苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, or the inhabitants of Beth-anath, so they lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless, the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became subject to forced labor for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh or the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but they dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath were put under tribute to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Likewise, the tribe of Naphtali failed to drive out the residents of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. Instead, they moved in among the Canaanites, who controlled the land. Nevertheless, the people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath were forced to work as slaves for the people of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: Naphtali did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, or the inhabitants of Beth-anath, but lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; and the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became forced labor for them.
verses.textEn: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.

verses.textZh: 亚摩利人强迫但人退回山地上，不容他们下到平原来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩利人强迫但人退回山地上，不容他们下到平原来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩利人强逼但人住在山地，不容他们下到平原；
verses.textEnNiv: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.
verses.textEnEsv: The Amorites pressed the people of Dan back into the hill country, for they did not allow them to come down to the plain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountains, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
verses.textEnNlt: As for the tribe of Dan, the Amorites forced them back into the hill country and would not let them come down into the plains.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Amorites forced the sons of Dan into the hill country, for they did not allow them to come down to the valley;
verses.textEn: The Amorites confined the Danites to the hill country, not allowing them to come down into the plain.

verses.textZh: 亚摩利人决意住在希烈山、亚雅仑和沙宾；但约瑟家的势力强大以后，他们就成了作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩利人决意住在希烈山、亚雅仑和沙宾；但约瑟家的势力强大以后，他们就成了作苦工的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩利人却执意住在希烈山和亚雅仑并沙宾。然而约瑟家胜了他们，使他们成了服苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the tribes of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: The Amorites persisted in dwelling in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim, but the hand of the house of Joseph rested heavily on them, and they became subject to forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; yet when the strength of the house of Joseph became greater, they were put under tribute.
verses.textEnNlt: The Amorites were determined to stay in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim, but when the descendants of Joseph became stronger, they forced the Amorites to work as slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: yet the Amorites persisted in living on Mount Heres, in Aijalon and Shaalbim; but when the power of the house of Joseph grew strong, they became forced labor.
verses.textEn: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the tribes of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.

verses.textZh: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨山坡，从西拉直上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨山坡，从西拉直上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩利人的境界，是从亚克拉滨坡，从西拉而上。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.
verses.textEnEsv: And the border of the Amorites ran from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the boundary of the Amorites was from the Ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela, and upward.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary of the Amorites ran from Scorpion Pass to Sela and continued upward from there.
verses.textEnNasb: The border of the Amorites ran from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward.
verses.textEn: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金来，说："我曾经把你们从埃及领上来，带你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许的地方；我曾说过：‘我永不废弃我与你们所立的约；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金来，说："我曾经把你们从埃及领上来，带你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许的地方；我曾说过：‘我永不废弃我与你们所立的约；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者从吉甲上到波金，对以色列人说：「我使你们从埃及上来，领你们到我向你们列祖起誓应许之地。我又说：『我永不废弃与你们所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, "I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, "I brought you up from Egypt and brought you into the land that I swore to give to your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said: "I led you up from Egypt and brought you to the land of which I swore to your fathers; and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said to the Israelites, "I brought you out of Egypt into this land that I swore to give your ancestors, and I said I would never break my covenant with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, "I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land which I have sworn to your fathers; and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, "I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you,

verses.textZh: 你们不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。’你们竟没有听从我的话；你们作的是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。’你们竟没有听从我的话；你们作的是甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也不可与这地的居民立约，要拆毁他们的祭坛。你们竟没有听从我的话！为何这样行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.’ Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall break down their altars.’ But you have not obeyed my voice. What is this you have done?
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall tear down their altars.’ But you have not obeyed My voice. Why have you done this?
verses.textEnNlt: For your part, you were not to make any covenants with the people living in this land; instead, you were to destroy their altars. But you disobeyed my command. Why did you do this?
verses.textEnNasb: and as for you, you shall not make a covenant with the inhabitants of this land; you shall tear down their altars.’ But you have not obeyed Me; what is this thing that you have done?
verses.textEn: and you shall not make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall break down their altars.’ Yet you have disobeyed me. Why have you done this?

verses.textZh: 因此我又说：‘我必不把他们从你们面前赶走，他们要作你们的敌人 ，他们的神要作你们的网罗。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我又说：‘我必不把他们从你们面前赶走，他们要作你们的敌人 ，他们的神要作你们的网罗。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我又说：『我必不将他们从你们面前赶出；他们必作你们肋下的荆棘。他们的神必作你们的网罗。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And I have also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; they will become traps for you, and their gods will become snares to you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: So now I say, I will not drive them out before you, but they shall become thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; but they shall be thorns in your side, and their gods shall be a snare to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So now I declare that I will no longer drive out the people living in your land. They will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a constant temptation to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from you; but they will become like thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’ "
verses.textEn: And I have also said, ‘I will not drive them out before you; they will become traps for you, and their gods will become snares to you.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对以色列众人说这些话的时候，众人就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对以色列众人说这些话的时候，众人就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者向以色列众人说这话的时候，百姓就放声而哭；
verses.textEnNiv: When the angel of the Lord had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the people of Israel, the people lifted up their voices and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the Angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voices and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: When the angel of the Lord finished speaking to all the Israelites, the people wept loudly.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, the people raised their voices and wept.
verses.textEn: When the angel of the Lord had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,

verses.textZh: 于是给那地方起名叫波金；他们在那里向耶和华献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是给那地方起名叫波金；他们在那里向耶和华献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是给那地方起名叫波金 。众人在那里向耶和华献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they called the name of that place Bochim. And they sacrificed there to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they called the name of that place Bochim; and they sacrificed there to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So they called the place Bokim (which means "weeping"), and they offered sacrifices there to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they named that place Bochim; and there they sacrificed to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 约书亚遣散了众人，以色列人就各归自己承受的地业，要占有那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚遣散了众人，以色列人就各归自己承受的地业，要占有那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前约书亚打发以色列百姓去的时候，他们各归自己的地业，占据地土。
verses.textEnNiv: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to their own inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joshua dismissed the people, the people of Israel went each to his inheritance to take possession of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Joshua had dismissed the people, the children of Israel went each to his own inheritance to possess the land.
verses.textEnNlt: After Joshua sent the people away, each of the tribes left to take possession of the land allotted to them.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joshua had dismissed the people, the sons of Israel went, each one to his inheritance, to take possession of the land.
verses.textEn: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to their own inheritance.

verses.textZh: 约书亚在世的时候，以及他去世以后，那些见过耶和华为以色列人所行的大事的众长老还在的日子，众人都事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚在世的时候，以及他去世以后，那些见过耶和华为以色列人所行的大事的众长老还在的日子，众人都事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些见耶和华为以色列人所行大事的长老还在的时候，百姓都事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The people served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the Lord had done for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work that the Lord had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Israelites served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and the leaders who outlived him—those who had seen all the great things the Lord had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who survived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEn: The people served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had seen all the great things the Lord had done for Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人，嫩的儿子约书亚，在一百一十岁的时候就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人，嫩的儿子约书亚，在一百一十岁的时候就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的仆人、嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of 110 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died whenhewas one hundred and ten years old.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of 110.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died at the age of 110.
verses.textEn: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

verses.textZh: 以色列人把他埋葬在他地业的境内，就是以法莲山地，在迦实山北面的亭拿．希烈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把他埋葬在他地业的境内，就是以法莲山地，在迦实山北面的亭拿．希烈。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿‧希烈，在迦实山的北边。
verses.textEnNiv: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnEsv: And they buried him within the boundaries of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath Heres, in the mountains of Ephraim, on the north side of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnNlt: They buried him in the land he had been allocated, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnNasb: And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEn: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.textZh: 那一代的人都归到他们的列祖那里以后，有另一代的人兴起来了；他们不认识耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一代的人都归到他们的列祖那里以后，有另一代的人兴起来了；他们不认识耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那世代的人也都归了自己的列祖。后来有别的世代兴起，不知道耶和华，也不知道耶和华为以色列人所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: After that whole generation had been gathered to their ancestors, another generation grew up who knew neither the Lord nor what he had done for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And all that generation also were gathered to their fathers. And there arose another generation after them who did not know the Lord or the work that he had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: When all that generation had been gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who did not know the Lord nor the work which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: After that generation died, another generation grew up who did not acknowledge the Lord or remember the mighty things he had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: All that generation also were gathered to their fathers; and another generation rose up after them who did not know the Lord, nor even the work which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEn: After that whole generation had been gathered to their ancestors, another generation grew up who knew neither the Lord nor what he had done for Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人行了耶和华看为恶的事，去事奉众巴力；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人行了耶和华看为恶的事，去事奉众巴力；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord and served the Baals.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and served the Baals.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served the Baals;
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites did evil in the Lord ’s sight and served the images of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord and served the Baals,
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord and served the Baals.

verses.textZh: 他们离弃了领他们出埃及的耶和华、他们列祖的神，去跟从别的神，就是他们周围各族的神，敬拜他们，惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离弃了领他们出埃及的耶和华、他们列祖的神，去跟从别的神，就是他们周围各族的神，敬拜他们，惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 离弃了领他们出埃及地的耶和华－他们列祖的神，去叩拜别神，就是四围列国的神，惹耶和华发怒；
verses.textEnNiv: They forsook the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They aroused the Lord ’s anger
verses.textEnEsv: And they abandoned the Lord , the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt. They went after other gods, from among the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed down to them. And they provoked the Lord to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt; and they followed other gods from among the gods of the people who were all around them, and they bowed down to them; and they provoked the Lord to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: They abandoned the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They went after other gods, worshiping the gods of the people around them. And they angered the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and they abandoned the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed other gods from the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed down to them; so they provoked the Lord to anger.
verses.textEn: They forsook the Lord , the God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt. They followed and worshiped various gods of the peoples around them. They aroused the Lord ’s anger

verses.textZh: 他们离弃了耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯他录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离弃了耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯他录。
verses.textZhCuv: 并离弃耶和华，去事奉巴力和亚斯她录。
verses.textEnNiv: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
verses.textEnEsv: They abandoned the Lord and served the Baals and the Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They forsook the Lord and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
verses.textEnNlt: They abandoned the Lord to serve Baal and the images of Ashtoreth.
verses.textEnNasb: They abandoned the Lord and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
verses.textEn: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢掠的人手中，他们就抢掠他们；他又把他们完全交在他们四围的仇敌手中，以致他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢掠的人手中，他们就抢掠他们；他又把他们完全交在他们四围的仇敌手中，以致他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，又将他们付与四围仇敌的手中，甚至他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: In his anger against Israel the Lord gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
verses.textEnEsv: So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he gave them over to plunderers, who plundered them. And he sold them into the hand of their surrounding enemies, so that they could no longer withstand their enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel. So He delivered them into the hands of plunderers who despoiled them; and He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: This made the Lord burn with anger against Israel, so he handed them over to raiders who stole their possessions. He turned them over to their enemies all around, and they were no longer able to resist them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and He handed them over to plunderers, and they plundered them; and He sold them into the hands of their enemies around them, so that they could no longer stand against their enemies.
verses.textEn: In his anger against Israel the Lord gave them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

verses.textZh: 他们无论去哪里，耶和华的手总是加害他们，好象耶和华说过的，又像耶和华对他们起誓过的；他们就非常困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们无论去哪里，耶和华的手总是加害他们，好象耶和华说过的，又像耶和华对他们起誓过的；他们就非常困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们无论往何处去，耶和华都以灾祸攻击他们，正如耶和华所说的话，又如耶和华向他们所起的誓；他们便极其困苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the Lord was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever they marched out, the hand of the Lord was against them for harm, as the Lord had warned, and as the Lord had sworn to them. And they were in terrible distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for calamity, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn to them. And they were greatly distressed.
verses.textEnNlt: Every time Israel went out to battle, the Lord fought against them, causing them to be defeated, just as he had warned. And the people were in great distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Wherever they went, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had spoken and just as the Lord had sworn to them, so that they were severely distressed.
verses.textEn: Whenever Israel went out to fight, the hand of the Lord was against them to defeat them, just as he had sworn to them. They were in great distress.

verses.textZh: 耶和华兴起了士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢掠他们的人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华兴起了士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢掠他们的人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华兴起士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢夺他们人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, the Lord raised up judges who delivered them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord raised up judges to rescue the Israelites from their attackers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord raised up judges who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

verses.textZh: 但他们连士师也不听从，竟与别的神行了奸淫，敬拜他们；他们迅速偏离了他们列祖所行、听从耶和华命令的道路，他们没有照样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们连士师也不听从，竟与别的神行了奸淫，敬拜他们；他们迅速偏离了他们列祖所行、听从耶和华命令的道路，他们没有照样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从士师，竟随从叩拜别神，行了邪淫，速速地偏离他们列祖所行的道，不如他们列祖顺从耶和华的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. They quickly turned from the ways of their ancestors, who had been obedient to the Lord ’s commands.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they did not listen to their judges, for they whored after other gods and bowed down to them. They soon turned aside from the way in which their fathers had walked, who had obeyed the commandments of the Lord , and they did not do so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they would not listen to their judges, but they played the harlot with other gods, and bowed down to them. They turned quickly from the way in which their fathers walked, in obeying the commandments of the Lord; they did not do so.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet Israel did not listen to the judges but prostituted themselves by worshiping other gods. How quickly they turned away from the path of their ancestors, who had walked in obedience to the Lord ’s commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they did not listen to their judges, for they committed infidelity with other gods and bowed down to them. They turned aside quickly from the way in which their fathers had walked in obeying the commandments of the Lord; they did not do the same as their fathers.
verses.textEn: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. They quickly turned from the ways of their ancestors, who had been obedient to the Lord ’s commands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华为他们兴起士师的时候，耶和华就与那士师同在；那士师在世的日子，耶和华总是拯救他们脱离仇敌的手；因为他们在压迫和苦害他们的人底下发出哀声，耶和华就怜悯他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为他们兴起士师的时候，耶和华就与那士师同在；那士师在世的日子，耶和华总是拯救他们脱离仇敌的手；因为他们在压迫和苦害他们的人底下发出哀声，耶和华就怜悯他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华为他们兴起士师，就与那士师同在。士师在世的一切日子，耶和华拯救他们脱离仇敌的手。他们因受欺压扰害，就哀声叹气，所以耶和华后悔了。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the Lord relented because of their groaning under those who oppressed and afflicted them.
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge, and he saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge. For the Lord was moved to pity by their groaning because of those who afflicted and oppressed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved to pity by their groaning because of those who oppressed them and harassed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge over Israel, he was with that judge and rescued the people from their enemies throughout the judge’s lifetime. For the Lord took pity on his people, who were burdened by oppression and suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved to pity by their groaning because of those who tormented and oppressed them.
verses.textEn: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge for them, he was with the judge and saved them out of the hands of their enemies as long as the judge lived; for the Lord relented because of their groaning under those who oppressed and afflicted them.

verses.textZh: 可是士师死了以后，他们就转而行恶，比他们的列祖更厉害，去随从别的神，事奉和敬拜他们，总不放弃他们的恶行和顽梗的行径。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是士师死了以后，他们就转而行恶，比他们的列祖更厉害，去随从别的神，事奉和敬拜他们，总不放弃他们的恶行和顽梗的行径。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至士师死后，他们就转去行恶，比他们列祖更甚，去事奉叩拜别神，总不断绝顽梗的恶行。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their ancestors, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
verses.textEnEsv: But whenever the judge died, they turned back and were more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods, serving them and bowing down to them. They did not drop any of their practices or their stubborn ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they reverted and behaved more corruptly than their fathers, by following other gods, to serve them and bow down to them. They did not cease from their own doings nor from their stubborn way.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the judge died, the people returned to their corrupt ways, behaving worse than those who had lived before them. They went after other gods, serving and worshiping them. And they refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about, when the judge died, that they would turn back and act more corruptly than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them and bow down to them; they did not abandon their practices or their obstinate ways.
verses.textEn: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their ancestors, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，说："因为这国的人违背我吩咐他们列祖的约，不听从我的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，说："因为这国的人违背我吩咐他们列祖的约，不听从我的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作。他说：「因这民违背我吩咐他们列祖所守的约，不听从我的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and said, "Because this nation has violated the covenant I ordained for their ancestors and has not listened to me,
verses.textEnEsv: So the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he said, "Because this people have transgressed my covenant that I commanded their fathers and have not obeyed my voice,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and He said, "Because this nation has transgressed My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not heeded My voice,
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord burned with anger against Israel. He said, "Because these people have violated my covenant, which I made with their ancestors, and have ignored my commands,
verses.textEnNasb: So the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and He said, "Because this nation has violated My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to My voice,
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and said, "Because this nation has violated the covenant I ordained for their ancestors and has not listened to me,

verses.textZh: 因此，约书亚死后仍剩下来的列国，我也不再从他们面前赶走，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，约书亚死后仍剩下来的列国，我也不再从他们面前赶走，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以约书亚死的时候所剩下的各族，我必不再从他们面前赶出，
verses.textEnNiv: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
verses.textEnEsv: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations that Joshua left when he died,
verses.textEnNkjv: I also will no longer drive out before them any of the nations which Joshua left when he died,
verses.textEnNlt: I will no longer drive out the nations that Joshua left unconquered when he died.
verses.textEnNasb: I in turn will no longer drive out from them any of the nations which Joshua left when he died,
verses.textEn: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.

verses.textZh: 为要借着他们试验以色列人，看他们肯不肯谨守遵行耶和华的道路，像他们的列祖一样谨守。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要借着他们试验以色列人，看他们肯不肯谨守遵行耶和华的道路，像他们的列祖一样谨守。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为要藉此试验以色列人，看他们肯照他们列祖谨守遵行我的道不肯。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the Lord and walk in it as their ancestors did."
verses.textEnEsv: in order to test Israel by them, whether they will take care to walk in the way of the Lord as their fathers did, or not."
verses.textEnNkjv: so that through them I may test Israel, whether they will keep the ways of the Lord, to walk in them as their fathers kept them, or not."
verses.textEnNlt: I did this to test Israel—to see whether or not they would follow the ways of the Lord as their ancestors did."
verses.textEnNasb: in order to test Israel by them, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk in it as their fathers did, or not."
verses.textEn: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the Lord and walk in it as their ancestors did."

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华留下这些国的民，不迅速把他们赶走，也不把他们交在约书亚手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华留下这些国的民，不迅速把他们赶走，也不把他们交在约书亚手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样耶和华留下各族，不将他们速速赶出，也没有交付约书亚的手。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord left those nations, not driving them out quickly, and he did not give them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out immediately; nor did He deliver them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord left those nations in place. He did not quickly drive them out or allow Joshua to conquer them all.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord allowed those nations to remain, not driving them out quickly; and He did not hand them over to Joshua.
verses.textEn: The Lord had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.

verses.textZh: 这些国的人是耶和华留下的，为要借着他们来试验以色列人，就是所有没有经验过迦南任何战争的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些国的人是耶和华留下的，为要借着他们来试验以色列人，就是所有没有经验过迦南任何战争的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华留下这几族，为要试验那不曾知道与迦南争战之事的以色列人，
verses.textEnNiv: These are the nations the Lord left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the nations that the Lord left, to test Israel by them, that is, all in Israel who had not experienced all the wars in Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, that He might test Israel by them, thatis, all who had not known any of the wars in Canaan
verses.textEnNlt: These are the nations that the Lord left in the land to test those Israelites who had not experienced the wars of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the nations that the Lord left, to test Israel by them (that is, all the Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars of Canaan;
verses.textEn: These are the nations the Lord left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan

verses.textZh: 好使以色列人的后代，那些以前没有经验过这些战争的人，知道学习争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使以色列人的后代，那些以前没有经验过这些战争的人，知道学习争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫以色列的后代又知道又学习未曾晓得的战事。
verses.textEnNiv: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):
verses.textEnEsv: It was only in order that the generations of the people of Israel might know war, to teach war to those who had not known it before.
verses.textEnNkjv: (thiswas only so that the generations of the children of Israel might be taught to know war, at least those who had not formerly known it),
verses.textEnNlt: He did this to teach warfare to generations of Israelites who had no experience in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: only in order that the generations of the sons of Israel might be taught war, those who had not experienced it previously).
verses.textEn: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):

verses.textZh: 他留下的就是非利士人的五个首领，和所有迦南人、西顿人，以及住在黎巴嫩山上的希未人，从巴力．黑门山直到哈马口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他留下的就是非利士人的五个首领，和所有迦南人、西顿人，以及住在黎巴嫩山上的希未人，从巴力．黑门山直到哈马口。
verses.textZhCuv: 所留下的就是非利士的五个首领和一切迦南人、西顿人，并住黎巴嫩山的希未人，从巴力‧黑们山直到哈马口。
verses.textEnNiv: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the nations: the five lords of the Philistines and all the Canaanites and the Sidonians and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEnNkjv: namely, five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who dwelt in Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the nations: the Philistines (those living under the five Philistine rulers), all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEnNasb: These nations are: the five governors of the Philistines and all the Canaanites and the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEn: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

verses.textZh: 他们留在那里，为要借着他们试验以色列人，要知道他们是否听从耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们留在那里，为要借着他们试验以色列人，要知道他们是否听从耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 留下这几族，为要试验以色列人，知道他们肯听从耶和华藉摩西吩咐他们列祖的诫命不肯。
verses.textEnNiv: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the Lord ’s commands, which he had given their ancestors through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: They were for the testing of Israel, to know whether Israel would obey the commandments of the Lord , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were left, that He might test Israel by them, to know whether they would obey the commandments of the Lord, which He had commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: These people were left to test the Israelites—to see whether they would obey the commands the Lord had given to their ancestors through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: They were left to test Israel by them, to find out if they would obey the commandments of the Lord, which He had commanded their fathers through Moses.
verses.textEn: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the Lord ’s commands, which he had given their ancestors through Moses.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就住在迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中间；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就住在迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中间；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人竟住在迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中间，
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.textEnNlt: So the people of Israel lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites;
verses.textEn: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

verses.textZh: 他们娶他们的女儿作妻子，也把自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并且事奉他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们娶他们的女儿作妻子，也把自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并且事奉他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 娶他们的女儿为妻，将自己的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，并事奉他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And their daughters they took to themselves for wives, and their own daughters they gave to their sons, and they served their gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons; and they served their gods.
verses.textEnNlt: and they intermarried with them. Israelite sons married their daughters, and Israelite daughters were given in marriage to their sons. And the Israelites served their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: and they took their daughters for themselves as wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.textEn: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

verses.textZh: 以色列人行了耶和华看为恶的事，忘记了耶和华他们的神，去事奉众巴力和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人行了耶和华看为恶的事，忘记了耶和华他们的神，去事奉众巴力和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，忘记耶和华－他们的神，去事奉诸巴力和亚舍拉，
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; they forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel did what was evil in the sight of the Lord . They forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord. They forgot the Lord their God, and served the Baals and Asherahs.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites did evil in the Lord ’s sight. They forgot about the Lord their God, and they served the images of Baal and the Asherah poles.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel did what was evil in the sight of the Lord, and they forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
verses.textEn: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; they forgot the Lord their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，把他们完全交在两河之间的亚兰王古珊．利萨田的手中；以色列人服事了古珊．利萨田八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，把他们完全交在两河之间的亚兰王古珊．利萨田的手中；以色列人服事了古珊．利萨田八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在美索不达米亚王古珊‧利萨田的手中。以色列人服事古珊‧利萨田八年。
verses.textEnNiv: The anger of the Lord burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia. And the people of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and He sold them into the hand of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan-Rishathaim eight years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord burned with anger against Israel, and he turned them over to King Cushan-rishathaim of Aram-naharaim. And the Israelites served Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, so that He sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia; and the sons of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.
verses.textEn: The anger of the Lord burned against Israel so that he sold them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram Naharaim, to whom the Israelites were subject for eight years.

verses.textZh: 以色列人向耶和华哀求的时候，耶和华就为以色列人兴起一位拯救者拯救他们，就是迦勒的弟弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人向耶和华哀求的时候，耶和华就为以色列人兴起一位拯救者拯救他们，就是迦勒的弟弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者救他们，就是迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they cried out to the Lord , he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, who saved them.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the people of Israel cried out to the Lord , the Lord raised up a deliverer for the people of Israel, who saved them, Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for the children of Israel, who delivered them: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help, the Lord raised up a rescuer to save them. His name was Othniel, the son of Caleb’s younger brother, Kenaz.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, and the Lord raised up a deliverer for the sons of Israel to set them free, Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.textEn: But when they cried out to the Lord , he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, who saved them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵临到他身上，他就治理以色列人；他出去作战，耶和华把亚兰王古珊．利萨田交在他手中，他的能力就胜过了古珊．利萨田。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵临到他身上，他就治理以色列人；他出去作战，耶和华把亚兰王古珊．利萨田交在他手中，他的能力就胜过了古珊．利萨田。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵降在他身上，他就作了以色列的士师，出去争战。耶和华将美索不达米亚王古珊‧利萨田交在他手中，他便胜了古珊‧利萨田。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, so that he became Israel’s judge and went to war. The Lord gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit of the Lord was upon him, and he judged Israel. He went out to war, and the Lord gave Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. And his hand prevailed over Cushan-rishathaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel. He went out to war, and the Lord delivered Cushan-Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed over Cushan-Rishathaim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he became Israel’s judge. He went to war against King Cushan-rishathaim of Aram, and the Lord gave Othniel victory over him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel. When he went to war, the Lord handed over to him Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia, so that he prevailed over Cushan-rishathaim.
verses.textEn: The Spirit of the Lord came on him, so that he became Israel’s judge and went to war. The Lord gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.

verses.textZh: 于是国中太平了四十年。后来基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是国中太平了四十年。后来基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是国中太平四十年。基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂死了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
verses.textEnEsv: So the land had rest for forty years. Then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the land had rest for forty years. Then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.textEnNlt: So there was peace in the land for forty years. Then Othniel son of Kenaz died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the land was at rest for forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.textEn: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛起来，欺压以色列人，因为他们行了耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛起来，欺压以色列人，因为他们行了耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛，攻击以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , and because they did this evil the Lord gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.
