verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord. So the Lord strengthened Eglon king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again the Israelites did evil in the Lord ’s sight, and the Lord gave King Eglon of Moab control over Israel because of their evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord. So the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , and because they did this evil the Lord gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.

verses.textZh: 伊矶伦集合了亚扪人和亚玛力人，前来击败了以色列人，占领了棕树城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伊矶伦集合了亚扪人和亚玛力人，前来击败了以色列人，占领了棕树城。
verses.textZhCuv: 伊矶伦招聚亚扪人和亚玛力人，去攻打以色列人，占据棕树城。
verses.textEnNiv: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.
verses.textEnEsv: He gathered to himself the Ammonites and the Amalekites, and went and defeated Israel. And they took possession of the city of palms.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he gathered to himself the people of Ammon and Amalek, went and defeated Israel, and took possession of the City of Palms.
verses.textEnNlt: Eglon enlisted the Ammonites and Amalekites as allies, and then he went out and defeated Israel, taking possession of Jericho, the city of palms.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gathered to himself the sons of Ammon and Amalek; and he went and defeated Israel, and they took possession of the city of the palm trees.
verses.textEn: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.

verses.textZh: 于是以色列人服事了摩押王伊矶伦十八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列人服事了摩押王伊矶伦十八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列人服事摩押王伊矶伦十八年。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Israelites served Eglon of Moab for eighteen years.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab for eighteen years.
verses.textEn: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

verses.textZh: 以色列人向耶和华哀求的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏，是一个用左手的人。以色列人派他把贡物送给摩押王伊矶伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人向耶和华哀求的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏，是一个用左手的人。以色列人派他把贡物送给摩押王伊矶伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人托他送礼物给摩押王伊矶伦。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he gave them a deliverer—Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel cried out to the Lord , and the Lord raised up for them a deliverer, Ehud, the son of Gera, the Benjaminite, a left-handed man. The people of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. By him the children of Israel sent tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help, the Lord again raised up a rescuer to save them. His name was Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed man of the tribe of Benjamin. The Israelites sent Ehud to deliver their tribute money to King Eglon of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer for them, Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjaminite, a left-handed man. And the sons of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.textEn: Again the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he gave them a deliverer—Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

verses.textZh: 以笏做了一把两刃的剑，长半公尺，缚在右腿上，在衣服底下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏做了一把两刃的剑，长半公尺，缚在右腿上，在衣服底下。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏打了一把两刃的剑，长一肘，带在右腿上衣服里面。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a cubit long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ehud made for himself a sword with two edges, a cubit in length, and he bound it on his right thigh under his clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ehud made himself a dagger (it was double-edged and a cubit in length) and fastened it under his clothes on his right thigh.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ehud made a double-edged dagger that was about a foot long, and he strapped it to his right thigh, keeping it hidden under his clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length, and he strapped it on his right thigh under his cloak.
verses.textEn: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a cubit long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.

verses.textZh: 他把贡物呈献给摩押王伊矶伦；伊矶伦原是个非常肥胖的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把贡物呈献给摩押王伊矶伦；伊矶伦原是个非常肥胖的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将礼物献给摩押王伊矶伦（原来伊矶伦极其肥胖）；
verses.textEnNiv: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.
verses.textEnEsv: And he presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. (Now Eglon was a very fat man.)
verses.textEnNlt: He brought the tribute money to Eglon, who was very fat.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.textEn: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

verses.textZh: 以笏献完了贡物，就把抬贡物的众人打发走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏献完了贡物，就把抬贡物的众人打发走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏献完礼物，便将抬礼物的人打发走了，
verses.textEnNiv: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Ehud had finished presenting the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had finished presenting the tribute, he sent away the people who had carried the tribute.
verses.textEnNlt: After delivering the payment, Ehud started home with those who had helped carry the tribute.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when he had finished presenting the tribute, that Ehud sent away the people who had carried the tribute.
verses.textEn: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.

verses.textZh: 自己却从靠近吉甲的众雕像那里回来，说："王啊，我有一件机密的事要对你说。"王说："暂不要说。"侍立左右的人都离开他出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自己却从靠近吉甲的众雕像那里回来，说："王啊，我有一件机密的事要对你说。"王说："暂不要说。"侍立左右的人都离开他出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 自己却从靠近吉甲凿石之地回来，说：「王啊，我有一件机密事奏告你。」王说：「回避吧！」于是左右侍立的人都退去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But on reaching the stone images near Gilgal he himself went back to Eglon and said, "Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you." The king said to his attendants, "Leave us!" And they all left.
verses.textEnEsv: But he himself turned back at the idols near Gilgal and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." And he commanded, "Silence." And all his attendants went out from his presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he himself turned back from the stone images that were at Gilgal, and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." He said, "Keep silence!" And all who attended him went out from him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Ehud reached the stone idols near Gilgal, he turned back. He came to Eglon and said, "I have a secret message for you." So the king commanded his servants, "Be quiet!" and he sent them all out of the room.
verses.textEnNasb: But he himself turned back from the idols which were at Gilgal, and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." And the king said, "Silence!" And all who were attending him left him.
verses.textEn: But on reaching the stone images near Gilgal he himself went back to Eglon and said, "Your Majesty, I have a secret message for you." The king said to his attendants, "Leave us!" And they all left.

verses.textZh: 以笏来到王那里；王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说："我有神的话要告诉你。"王就从座位上站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏来到王那里；王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说："我有神的话要告诉你。"王就从座位上站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏来到王面前；王独自一人坐在凉楼上。以笏说：「我奉神的命报告你一件事。」王就从座位上站起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his palace and said, "I have a message from God for you." As the king rose from his seat,
verses.textEnEsv: And Ehud came to him as he was sitting alone in his cool roof chamber. And Ehud said, "I have a message from God for you." And he arose from his seat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ehud came to him (now he was sitting upstairs in his cool private chamber). Then Ehud said, "I have a message from God for you." So he arose from his seat.
verses.textEnNlt: Ehud walked over to Eglon, who was sitting alone in a cool upstairs room. And Ehud said, "I have a message from God for you!" As King Eglon rose from his seat,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ehud came to him while he was sitting in his cool roof chamber alone. And Ehud said, "I have a message from God for you." And he got up from his seat.
verses.textEn: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his palace and said, "I have a message from God for you." As the king rose from his seat,

verses.textZh: 以笏就伸出左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的腹中；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏就伸出左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的腹中；
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏便伸左手，从右腿上拔出剑来，刺入王的肚腹，
verses.textEnNiv: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ehud reached with his left hand, took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ehud reached with his left hand, took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.
verses.textEnNlt: Ehud reached with his left hand, pulled out the dagger strapped to his right thigh, and plunged it into the king’s belly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ehud reached out with his left hand and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly.
verses.textEn: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.

verses.textZh: 连剑柄与剑身都刺进去了，肥肉把剑身夹住，因此他没有把剑从王的肚腹里拔出来；接着他就从窗户爬了出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连剑柄与剑身都刺进去了，肥肉把剑身夹住，因此他没有把剑从王的肚腹里拔出来；接着他就从窗户爬了出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 连剑把都刺进去了。剑被肥肉夹住，他没有从王的肚腹拔出来，且穿通了后身。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and his bowels discharged. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the hilt also went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, for he did not pull the sword out of his belly; and the dung came out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even the hilt went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, for he did not draw the dagger out of his belly; and his entrails came out.
verses.textEnNlt: The dagger went so deep that the handle disappeared beneath the king’s fat. So Ehud did not pull out the dagger, and the king’s bowels emptied.
verses.textEnNasb: The hilt of the sword also went in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade because he did not pull the sword out of his belly; and the refuse came out.
verses.textEn: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and his bowels discharged. Ehud did not pull the sword out, and the fat closed in over it.

verses.textZh: 以笏出到走廊，把凉楼上的门关起来，上了锁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏出到走廊，把凉楼上的门关起来，上了锁。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏就出到游廊，将楼门尽都关锁。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ehud went out to the porch ; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ehud went out into the porch and closed the doors of the roof chamber behind him and locked them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ehud went out through the porch and shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ehud closed and locked the doors of the room and escaped down the latrine.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ehud went out into the vestibule, and shut the doors of the roof chamber behind him, and locked them.
verses.textEn: Then Ehud went out to the porch ; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.

verses.textZh: 以笏出来以后，王的仆人才来到；他们看见凉楼上的门锁着，就说："王一定是在凉楼上大解。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏出来以后，王的仆人才来到；他们看见凉楼上的门锁着，就说："王一定是在凉楼上大解。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏出来之后，王的仆人到了，看见楼门关锁，就说：「他必是在楼上大解。」
verses.textEnNiv: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, "He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the palace."
verses.textEnEsv: When he had gone, the servants came, and when they saw that the doors of the roof chamber were locked, they thought, "Surely he is relieving himself in the closet of the cool chamber."
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had gone out, Eglon’s servants came to look, and totheir surprise, the doors of the upper room were locked. So they said, "He is probably attending to his needs in the cool chamber."
verses.textEnNlt: After Ehud was gone, the king’s servants returned and found the doors to the upstairs room locked. They thought he might be using the latrine in the room,
verses.textEnNasb: When he had left, the king’s servants came and looked, and behold, the doors of the roof chamber were locked; and they said, "Undoubtedly he is relieving himself in the cool room."
verses.textEn: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, "He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the palace."

verses.textZh: 他们等到发慌了，见他还不打开凉楼的门，就拿钥匙来开；不料，看见他们的主人早已倒在地上死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们等到发慌了，见他还不打开凉楼的门，就拿钥匙来开；不料，看见他们的主人早已倒在地上死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们等烦了，见仍不开楼门，就拿钥匙开了，不料，他们的主人已死，倒在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And they waited till they were embarrassed. But when he still did not open the doors of the roof chamber, they took the key and opened them, and there lay their lord dead on the floor.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they waited till they were embarrassed, and still he had not opened the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them. And there was their master, fallen dead on the floor.
verses.textEnNlt: so they waited. But when the king didn’t come out after a long delay, they became concerned and got a key. And when they opened the doors, they found their master dead on the floor.
verses.textEnNasb: So they waited until it would have been shameful to wait longer; but behold, he did not open the doors of the roof chamber. So they took the key and opened them, and behold, their master had fallen to the floor dead.
verses.textEn: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.

verses.textZh: 他们耽延的时候，以笏已经逃跑了；他经过众雕像那里，逃到西伊拉去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们耽延的时候，以笏已经逃跑了；他经过众雕像那里，逃到西伊拉去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们耽延的时候，以笏就逃跑了，经过凿石之地，逃到西伊拉；
verses.textEnNiv: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.
verses.textEnEsv: Ehud escaped while they delayed, and he passed beyond the idols and escaped to Seirah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Ehud had escaped while they delayed, and passed beyond the stone images and escaped to Seirah.
verses.textEnNlt: While the servants were waiting, Ehud escaped, passing the stone idols on his way to Seirah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ehud escaped while they were hesitating, and he passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.
verses.textEn: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the stone images and escaped to Seirah.

verses.textZh: 他去到以后，就在以法莲山地吹角；以色列人与他一同从山地上下来，他走在他们前头，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他去到以后，就在以法莲山地吹角；以色列人与他一同从山地上下来，他走在他们前头，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了，就在以法莲山地吹角。以色列人随着他下了山地，他在前头引路，
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.
verses.textEnEsv: When he arrived, he sounded the trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim. Then the people of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he was their leader.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when he arrived, that he blew the trumpet in the mountains of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mountains; and he led them.
verses.textEnNlt: When he arrived in the hill country of Ephraim, Ehud sounded a call to arms. Then he led a band of Israelites down from the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he arrived, he blew the trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the sons of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he was leading them.
verses.textEn: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："你们跟随我，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。"他们就跟随他下去，攻取约旦河的渡口，拦截摩押人，不让一个过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："你们跟随我，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。"他们就跟随他下去，攻取约旦河的渡口，拦截摩押人，不让一个过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们随我来，因为耶和华已经把你们的仇敌摩押人交在你们手中。」于是他们跟着他下去，把守约旦河的渡口，不容摩押一人过去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Follow me," he ordered, "for the Lord has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands." So they followed him down and took possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab; they allowed no one to cross over.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Follow after me, for the Lord has given your enemies the Moabites into your hand." So they went down after him and seized the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites and did not allow anyone to pass over.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "Follow me, for the Lord has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand." So they went down after him, seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab, and did not allow anyone to cross over.
verses.textEnNlt: "Follow me," he said, "for the Lord has given you victory over Moab your enemy." So they followed him. And the Israelites took control of the shallow crossings of the Jordan River across from Moab, preventing anyone from crossing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "Pursue them, for the Lord has handed your enemies the Moabites over to you." So they went down after him and took control of the crossing places of the Jordan opposite Moab, and did not allow anyone to cross.
verses.textEn: "Follow me," he ordered, "for the Lord has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands." So they followed him down and took possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab; they allowed no one to cross over.

verses.textZh: 那时他们击杀了约有一万摩押人，都是强壮的、勇猛的人，没有一人逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时他们击杀了约有一万摩押人，都是强壮的、勇猛的人，没有一人逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时击杀了摩押人约有一万，都是强壮的勇士，没有一人逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.
verses.textEnEsv: And they killed at that time about 10,000 of the Moabites, all strong, able-bodied men; not a man escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at that time they killed about ten thousand men of Moab, all stout men of valor; not a man escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: They attacked the Moabites and killed about 10,000 of their strongest and most able-bodied warriors. Not one of them escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: They struck and killed about ten thousand Moabites at that time, all robust and valiant men; and no one escaped.
verses.textEn: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not one escaped.

verses.textZh: 这样，从那天起，摩押就在以色列人的手下被制伏了，于是国中太平了八十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，从那天起，摩押就在以色列人的手下被制伏了，于是国中太平了八十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，摩押就被以色列人制伏了。国中太平八十年。
verses.textEnNiv: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.
verses.textEnEsv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest for eighty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest for eighty years.
verses.textEnNlt: So Moab was conquered by Israel that day, and there was peace in the land for eighty years.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land was at rest for eighty years.
verses.textEn: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

verses.textZh: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦；他用赶牛棒击杀了六百非利士人；他也拯救了以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦；他用赶牛棒击杀了六百非利士人；他也拯救了以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏之后，有亚拿的儿子珊迦，他用赶牛的棍子打死六百非利士人。他也救了以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed 600 of the Philistines with an oxgoad, and he also saved Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who killed six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad; and he also delivered Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: After Ehud, Shamgar son of Anath rescued Israel. He once killed 600 Philistines with an ox goad.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after him came Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck and killed six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad; and he also saved Israel.
verses.textEn: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.

verses.textZh: 以笏死后，以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以笏死后，以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 以笏死后，以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord after Ehud died.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Ehud was dead, the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: After Ehud’s death, the Israelites again did evil in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, after Ehud died.
verses.textEn: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华把他们交在迦南王耶宾手中，耶宾那时在夏琐作王；他的军长西西拉，住在夏罗设歌印。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华把他们交在迦南王耶宾手中，耶宾那时在夏琐作王；他的军长西西拉，住在夏罗设歌印。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就把他们付与在夏琐作王的迦南王耶宾手中；他的将军是西西拉，住在外邦人的夏罗设。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who dwelt in Harosheth Hagoyim.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord turned them over to King Jabin of Hazor, a Canaanite king. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-haggoyim.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; and the commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
verses.textEn: So the Lord sold them into the hands of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. Sisera, the commander of his army, was based in Harosheth Haggoyim.

verses.textZh: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆，他极力欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就哀求耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆，他极力欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就哀求耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶宾王有铁车九百辆。他大大欺压以色列人二十年，以色列人就呼求耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Because he had nine hundred chariots fitted with iron and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the Lord for help.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help, for he had 900 chariots of iron and he oppressed the people of Israel cruelly for twenty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord; for Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and for twenty years he had harshly oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Sisera, who had 900 iron chariots, ruthlessly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years. Then the people of Israel cried out to the Lord for help.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel cried out to the Lord; for he had nine hundred iron chariots, and he oppressed the sons of Israel severely for twenty years.
verses.textEn: Because he had nine hundred chariots fitted with iron and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the Lord for help.

verses.textZh: 有一位女先知底波拉，是拉比多的妻子，那时正治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位女先知底波拉，是拉比多的妻子，那时正治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，当时作以色列的士师。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
verses.textEnNlt: Deborah, the wife of Lappidoth, was a prophet who was judging Israel at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
verses.textEn: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

verses.textZh: 她常坐在以法莲山地，拉玛和伯特利之间那棵底波拉棕树下；以色列人都上到她那里去听判断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她常坐在以法莲山地，拉玛和伯特利之间那棵底波拉棕树下；以色列人都上到她那里去听判断。
verses.textZhCuv: 她住在以法莲山地拉玛和伯特利中间，在底波拉的棕树下。以色列人都上她那里去听判断。
verses.textEnNiv: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.
verses.textEnEsv: She used to sit under the palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she would sit under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the mountains of Ephraim. And the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: She would sit under the Palm of Deborah, between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites would go to her for judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: She used to sit under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the sons of Israel went up to her for judgment.
verses.textEn: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.

verses.textZh: 底波拉派人去从拿弗他利的基低斯，把亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说："耶和华以色列的神不是曾吩咐你说：‘你去向他泊山进军，从拿弗他利人和西布伦人中率领一万人与你同去吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 底波拉派人去从拿弗他利的基低斯，把亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说："耶和华以色列的神不是曾吩咐你说：‘你去向他泊山进军，从拿弗他利人和西布伦人中率领一万人与你同去吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 她打发人从拿弗他利的基低斯将亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉召了来，对他说：「耶和华－以色列的神吩咐你说：『你率领一万拿弗他利和西布伦人上他泊山去。
verses.textEnNiv: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, "The Lord , the God of Israel, commands you: ‘Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead them up to Mount Tabor.
verses.textEnEsv: She sent and summoned Barak the son of Abinoam from Kedesh-naphtali and said to him, "Has not the Lord , the God of Israel, commanded you, ‘Go, gather your men at Mount Tabor, taking 10,000 from the people of Naphtali and the people of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she sent and called for Barak the son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali, and said to him, "Has not the Lord God of Israel commanded, ‘Go and deploy troops at Mount Tabor; take with you ten thousand men of the sons of Naphtali and of the sons of Zebulun;
verses.textEnNlt: One day she sent for Barak son of Abinoam, who lived in Kedesh in the land of Naphtali. She said to him, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, commands you: Call out 10,000 warriors from the tribes of Naphtali and Zebulun at Mount Tabor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she sent word and summoned Barak the son of Abinoam from Kedesh-naphtali, and said to him, " The Lord, the God of Israel, has indeed commanded, ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men from the sons of Naphtali and from the sons of Zebulun.
verses.textEn: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, "The Lord , the God of Israel, commands you: ‘Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead them up to Mount Tabor.

verses.textZh: 我必引耶宾的军长西西拉，和他的车辆与全军，到基顺河往你那里去；我必把他们交在你手里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必引耶宾的军长西西拉，和他的车辆与全军，到基顺河往你那里去；我必把他们交在你手里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使耶宾的将军西西拉率领他的车辆和全军往基顺河，到你那里去；我必将他交在你手中。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will lead Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will draw out Sisera, the general of Jabin’s army, to meet you by the river Kishon with his chariots and his troops, and I will give him into your hand’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and against you I will deploy Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude at the River Kishon; and I will deliver him into your hand’?"
verses.textEnNlt: And I will call out Sisera, commander of Jabin’s army, along with his chariots and warriors, to the Kishon River. There I will give you victory over him."
verses.textEnNasb: I will draw out to you Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his many troops to the river Kishon, and I will hand him over to you.’ "
verses.textEn: I will lead Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.’ "

verses.textZh: 巴拉对她说："如果你与我同去，我就去；如果你不与我同去，我就不去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拉对她说："如果你与我同去，我就去；如果你不与我同去，我就不去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拉说：「你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I will go; but if you don’t go with me, I won’t go."
verses.textEnEsv: Barak said to her, "If you will go with me, I will go, but if you will not go with me, I will not go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Barak said to her, "If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go!"
verses.textEnNlt: Barak told her, "I will go, but only if you go with me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Barak said to her, "If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go."
verses.textEn: Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I will go; but if you don’t go with me, I won’t go."

verses.textZh: 底波拉回答："我必与你同去，只是你这次行程就没有光荣；因为耶和华要把西西拉交在一个妇人手里。"于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同到基低斯去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底波拉回答："我必与你同去，只是你这次行程就没有光荣；因为耶和华要把西西拉交在一个妇人手里。"于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同到基低斯去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 底波拉说：「我必与你同去，只是你在所行的路上得不着荣耀，因为耶和华要将西西拉交在一个妇人手里。」于是底波拉起来，与巴拉一同往基低斯去了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Certainly I will go with you," said Deborah. "But because of the course you are taking, the honor will not be yours, for the Lord will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman." So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the road on which you are going will not lead to your glory, for the Lord will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman." Then Deborah arose and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "I will surely go with you; nevertheless there will be no glory for you in the journey you are taking, for the Lord will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman." Then Deborah arose and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.textEnNlt: "Very well," she replied, "I will go with you. But you will receive no honor in this venture, for the Lord ’s victory over Sisera will be at the hands of a woman." So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.textEnNasb: She said, "I will certainly go with you; however, the fame shall not be yours on the journey that you are about to take, for the Lord will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman." Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.textEn: "Certainly I will go with you," said Deborah. "But because of the course you are taking, the honor will not be yours, for the Lord will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman." So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.textZh: 巴拉就召集西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯；与他一同步行上去的有一万人，底波拉也与他一同上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拉就召集西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯；与他一同步行上去的有一万人，底波拉也与他一同上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拉就招聚西布伦人和拿弗他利人到基低斯，跟他上去的有一万人。底波拉也同他上去。
verses.textEnNiv: There Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali, and ten thousand men went up under his command. Deborah also went up with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Barak called out Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh. And 10,000 men went up at his heels, and Deborah went up with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; he went up with ten thousand men under his command, and Deborah went up with him.
verses.textEnNlt: At Kedesh, Barak called together the tribes of Zebulun and Naphtali, and 10,000 warriors went up with him. Deborah also went with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh, and ten thousand men went up with him; Deborah also went up with him.
verses.textEn: There Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali, and ten thousand men went up under his command. Deborah also went up with him.

verses.textZh: 摩西的岳父何巴的子孙基尼人希伯，曾经离开基尼族人，到靠近基低斯的撒拿音的橡树旁，支搭帐棚居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西的岳父何巴的子孙基尼人希伯，曾经离开基尼族人，到靠近基低斯的撒拿音的橡树旁，支搭帐棚居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西岳父 何巴的后裔，基尼人希百曾离开基尼族，到靠近基低斯、撒拿音的橡树旁支搭帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent as far away as the oak in Zaanannim, which is near Kedesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Heber the Kenite, of the children of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, had separated himself from the Kenites and pitched his tent near the terebinth tree at Zaanaim, which is beside Kedesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Heber the Kenite, a descendant of Moses’ brother-in-law Hobab, had moved away from the other members of his tribe and pitched his tent by the oak of Zaanannim near Kedesh.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, from the sons of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent as far away as the oak in Zaanannim, which is near Kedesh.
verses.textEn: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉西西拉，亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉已经上了他泊山；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉西西拉，亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉已经上了他泊山；
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉西西拉说：「亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉已经上他泊山了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,
verses.textEnEsv: When Sisera was told that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they reported to Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
verses.textEnNlt: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,
verses.textEnNasb: Then they told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.
verses.textEn: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

verses.textZh: 西西拉就召集他所有的车辆，就是九百辆铁车，和与他在一起的众人，都从夏罗设歌印出来，到基顺河那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉就召集他所有的车辆，就是九百辆铁车，和与他在一起的众人，都从夏罗设歌印出来，到基顺河那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉就聚集所有的铁车九百辆和跟随他的全军，从外邦人的夏罗设出来，到了基顺河。
verses.textEnNiv: Sisera summoned from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River all his men and his nine hundred chariots fitted with iron.
verses.textEnEsv: Sisera called out all his chariots, 900 chariots of iron, and all the men who were with him, from Harosheth-hagoyim to the river Kishon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Sisera gathered together all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth Hagoyim to the River Kishon.
verses.textEnNlt: he called for all 900 of his iron chariots and all of his warriors, and they marched from Harosheth-haggoyim to the Kishon River.
verses.textEnNasb: Sisera summoned all his chariots, nine hundred iron chariots, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth-hagoyim to the river Kishon.
verses.textEn: Sisera summoned from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River all his men and his nine hundred chariots fitted with iron.

verses.textZh: 底波拉对巴拉说："你起来吧，因为今日就是耶和华把西西拉交在你手里的日子；耶和华不是在你前面出战吗？"于是巴拉和跟随他的一万人从他泊山下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底波拉对巴拉说："你起来吧，因为今日就是耶和华把西西拉交在你手里的日子；耶和华不是在你前面出战吗？"于是巴拉和跟随他的一万人从他泊山下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 底波拉对巴拉说：「你起来，今日就是耶和华将西西拉交在你手的日子。耶和华岂不在你前头行吗？」于是巴拉下了他泊山，跟随他有一万人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! This is the day the Lord has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the Lord gone ahead of you?" So Barak went down Mount Tabor, with ten thousand men following him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Deborah said to Barak, "Up! For this is the day in which the Lord has given Sisera into your hand. Does not the Lord go out before you?" So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with 10,000 men following him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Up! For this is the day in which the Lord has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the Lord gone out before you?" So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Get ready! This is the day the Lord will give you victory over Sisera, for the Lord is marching ahead of you." So Barak led his 10,000 warriors down the slopes of Mount Tabor into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Arise! For this is the day on which the Lord has handed Sisera over to you; behold, the Lord has gone out before you." So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
verses.textEn: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! This is the day the Lord has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the Lord gone ahead of you?" So Barak went down Mount Tabor, with ten thousand men following him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华用刀使西西拉和所有的车辆与全军，都在巴拉面前溃乱；西西拉下了车，步行逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华用刀使西西拉和所有的车辆与全军，都在巴拉面前溃乱；西西拉下了车，步行逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使西西拉和他一切车辆全军溃乱，在巴拉面前被刀杀败；西西拉下车步行逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: At Barak’s advance, the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and all his army before Barak by the edge of the sword. And Sisera got down from his chariot and fled away on foot.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and all his army with the edge of the sword before Barak; and Sisera alighted from his chariot and fled away on foot.
verses.textEnNlt: When Barak attacked, the Lord threw Sisera and all his chariots and warriors into a panic. Sisera leaped down from his chariot and escaped on foot.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and all his army with the edge of the sword before Barak; and Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.
verses.textEn: At Barak’s advance, the Lord routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.

verses.textZh: 巴拉追赶西西拉的车辆和军队，直到夏罗设歌印；西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，连一个也没有留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拉追赶西西拉的车辆和军队，直到夏罗设歌印；西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，连一个也没有留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拉追赶车辆、军队，直到外邦人的夏罗设。西西拉的全军都倒在刀下，没有留下一人。
verses.textEnNiv: Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim, and all Sisera’s troops fell by the sword; not a man was left.
verses.textEnEsv: And Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth-hagoyim, and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; not a man was left.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army as far as Harosheth Hagoyim, and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; not a man was left.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Barak chased the chariots and the enemy army all the way to Harosheth-haggoyim, killing all of Sisera’s warriors. Not a single one was left alive.
verses.textEnNasb: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword; not even one was left.
verses.textEn: Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim, and all Sisera’s troops fell by the sword; not a man was left.

verses.textZh: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希伯的妻子雅亿的帐棚那里；因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希伯的家友好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希伯的妻子雅亿的帐棚那里；因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希伯的家友好。
verses.textZhCuv: 只有西西拉步行逃跑，到了基尼人希百之妻雅亿的帐棚，因为夏琐王耶宾与基尼人希百家和好。
verses.textEnNiv: Sisera, meanwhile, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was an alliance between Jabin king of Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.
verses.textEnEsv: But Sisera fled away on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, Sisera had fled away on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite; for therewas peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Sisera ran to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because Heber’s family was on friendly terms with King Jabin of Hazor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Sisera fled on foot to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.textEn: Sisera, meanwhile, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was an alliance between Jabin king of Hazor and the family of Heber the Kenite.

verses.textZh: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说："请我主转过来，到我这里，不要惧怕。"西西拉就转到她那里去，就是转到她的帐棚里去；雅亿就用毛毡遮盖他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说："请我主转过来，到我这里，不要惧怕。"西西拉就转到她那里去，就是转到她的帐棚里去；雅亿就用毛毡遮盖他。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅亿出来迎接西西拉，对他说：「请我主进来，不要惧怕」；西西拉就进了她的帐棚。雅亿用被将他遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come, my lord, come right in. Don’t be afraid." So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jael came out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Turn aside, my lord; turn aside to me; do not be afraid." So he turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, "Turn aside, my lord, turn aside to me; do not fear." And when he had turned aside with her into the tent, she covered him with a blanket.
verses.textEnNlt: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come into my tent, sir. Come in. Don’t be afraid." So he went into her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, "Turn aside, my master, turn aside to me! Do not be afraid." So he turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
verses.textEn: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come, my lord, come right in. Don’t be afraid." So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.

verses.textZh: 西西拉对雅亿说："请给我一点水喝，因为我渴了。"雅亿就打开盛奶的皮袋，给他喝了，再把他盖着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉对雅亿说："请给我一点水喝，因为我渴了。"雅亿就打开盛奶的皮袋，给他喝了，再把他盖着。
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉对雅亿说：「我渴了，求你给我一点水喝。」雅亿就打开皮袋，给他奶子喝，仍旧把他遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: "I’m thirsty," he said. "Please give me some water." She opened a skin of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him up.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty." So she opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink and covered him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to her, "Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty." So she opened a jug of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please give me some water," he said. "I’m thirsty." So she gave him some milk from a leather bag and covered him again.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to her, "Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty." So she opened a leather bottle of milk and gave him a drink; then she covered him.
verses.textEn: "I’m thirsty," he said. "Please give me some water." She opened a skin of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him up.

verses.textZh: 西西拉又对雅亿说："请你站在帐棚门口，如果有人来问你：‘这里有人吗？’你就要回答：‘没有。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉又对雅亿说："请你站在帐棚门口，如果有人来问你：‘这里有人吗？’你就要回答：‘没有。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉又对雅亿说：「请你站在帐棚门口，若有人来问你说：『有人在这里没有？』你就说：『没有。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Stand in the doorway of the tent," he told her. "If someone comes by and asks you, ‘Is anyone in there?’ say ‘No.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Stand at the opening of the tent, and if any man comes and asks you, ‘Is anyone here?’ say, ‘No.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to her, "Stand at the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Stand at the door of the tent," he told her. "If anybody comes and asks you if there is anyone here, say no."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to her, "Stand in the doorway of the tent, and it shall be if anyone comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there anyone here?’ that you shall say, ‘No.’ "
verses.textEn: "Stand in the doorway of the tent," he told her. "If someone comes by and asks you, ‘Is anyone in there?’ say ‘No.’ "

verses.textZh: 希伯的妻子雅亿取了一根帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，静悄悄地走到西西拉那里，把橛子钉在他的太阳穴里，直钉入地里；因为西西拉疲乏熟睡，就这样死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯的妻子雅亿取了一根帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，静悄悄地走到西西拉那里，把橛子钉在他的太阳穴里，直钉入地里；因为西西拉疲乏熟睡，就这样死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉疲乏沉睡。希百的妻雅亿取了帐棚的橛子，手里拿着锤子，轻悄悄地到他旁边，将橛子从他鬓边钉进去，钉入地里。西西拉就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jael, Heber’s wife, picked up a tent peg and a hammer and went quietly to him while he lay fast asleep, exhausted. She drove the peg through his temple into the ground, and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jael the wife of Heber took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand. Then she went softly to him and drove the peg into his temple until it went down into the ground while he was lying fast asleep from weariness. So he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him and drove the peg into his temple, and it went down into the ground; for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Sisera fell asleep from exhaustion, Jael quietly crept up to him with a hammer and tent peg in her hand. Then she drove the tent peg through his temple and into the ground, and so he died.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg and a hammer in her hand, and went secretly to him and drove the peg into his temple, and it went through into the ground; for he was sound asleep and exhausted. So he died.
verses.textEn: But Jael, Heber’s wife, picked up a tent peg and a hammer and went quietly to him while he lay fast asleep, exhausted. She drove the peg through his temple into the ground, and he died.

verses.textZh: 那时，巴拉追赶西西拉，雅亿出来迎接他，对他说："来吧，我给你看你寻找的人。"他就进到她那里去；看见西西拉已经仆倒，死了；橛子还在他的太阳穴里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴拉追赶西西拉，雅亿出来迎接他，对他说："来吧，我给你看你寻找的人。"他就进到她那里去；看见西西拉已经仆倒，死了；橛子还在他的太阳穴里。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拉追赶西西拉的时候，雅亿出来迎接他说：「来吧，我将你所寻找的人给你看。」他就进入帐棚，看见西西拉已经死了，倒在地上，橛子还在他鬓中。
verses.textEnNiv: Just then Barak came by in pursuit of Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. "Come," she said, "I will show you the man you’re looking for." So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera with the tent peg through his temple—dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, as Barak was pursuing Sisera, Jael went out to meet him and said to him, "Come, and I will show you the man whom you are seeking." So he went in to her tent, and there lay Sisera dead, with the tent peg in his temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And then, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, "Come, I will show you the man whom you seek." And when he went into her tent, there lay Sisera, dead with the peg in his temple.
verses.textEnNlt: When Barak came looking for Sisera, Jael went out to meet him. She said, "Come, and I will show you the man you are looking for." So he followed her into the tent and found Sisera lying there dead, with the tent peg through his temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, while Barak was pursuing Sisera, Jael came out to meet him and said to him, "Come, and I will show you the man whom you are seeking." So he entered with her, and behold, Sisera was lying dead with the tent peg in his temple.
verses.textEn: Just then Barak came by in pursuit of Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. "Come," she said, "I will show you the man you’re looking for." So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera with the tent peg through his temple—dead.

verses.textZh: 这样，神就在那一天，在以色列人面前，制伏了迦南王耶宾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，神就在那一天，在以色列人面前，制伏了迦南王耶宾。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，神使迦南王耶宾被以色列人制伏了。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: So on that day God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So on that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan in the presence of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So on that day Israel saw God defeat Jabin, the Canaanite king.
verses.textEnNasb: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan on that day before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 以色列人的势力日渐强盛，胜过迦南王耶宾，终于把迦南王耶宾除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人的势力日渐强盛，胜过迦南王耶宾，终于把迦南王耶宾除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此以色列人的手越发有力，胜了迦南王耶宾，直到将他灭绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the hand of the Israelites pressed harder and harder against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the hand of the people of Israel pressed harder and harder against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the hand of the children of Israel grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: And from that time on Israel became stronger and stronger against King Jabin until they finally destroyed him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the hand of the sons of Israel pressed harder and harder upon Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had eliminated Jabin the king of Canaan.
verses.textEn: And the hand of the Israelites pressed harder and harder against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.

verses.textZh: 那一天，底波拉和亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉唱起歌来说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，底波拉和亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉唱起歌来说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，底波拉和亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉作歌，说：
verses.textEnNiv: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:
verses.textEnEsv: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
verses.textEn: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

verses.textZh: "你们要称颂耶和华， 因为以色列中有勇士， 因为有人民自愿从军。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要称颂耶和华， 因为以色列中有勇士， 因为有人民自愿从军。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列中有军长率领， 百姓也甘心牺牲自己， 你们应当颂赞耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: "When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves— praise the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: "That the leaders took the lead in Israel, that the people offered themselves willingly, bless the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: "When leaders lead in Israel, When the people willingly offer themselves, Bless the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel’s leaders took charge, and the people gladly followed. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "For the leaders leading in Israel, For the people volunteering, Bless the Lord!
verses.textEn: "When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves— praise the Lord !

verses.textZh: 君王啊，你们要听；官长啊，你们要侧耳倾听； 至于我，我要向耶和华歌唱； 我要歌颂耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王啊，你们要听；官长啊，你们要侧耳倾听； 至于我，我要向耶和华歌唱； 我要歌颂耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王啊，要听！ 王子啊，要侧耳而听！ 我要向耶和华歌唱； 我要歌颂耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I, even I, will sing to the Lord ; I will praise the Lord , the God of Israel, in song.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear, O kings; give ear, O princes; to the Lord I will sing; I will make melody to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, O kings! Give ear, O princes! I, even I, will sing to the Lord; I will sing praise to the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, you kings! Pay attention, you mighty rulers! For I will sing to the Lord . I will make music to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, you kings; listen, you dignitaries! I myself—to the Lord, I myself will sing, I will sing praise to the Lord, the God of Israel!
verses.textEn: "Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I, even I, will sing to the Lord ; I will praise the Lord , the God of Israel, in song.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，你从西珥出发的时候， 你从以东地行走的日子， 地震天漏， 密云也滴下雨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，你从西珥出发的时候， 你从以东地行走的日子， 地震天漏， 密云也滴下雨。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你从西珥出来， 由以东地行走。 那时地震天漏， 云也落雨。
verses.textEnNiv: "When you, Lord , went out from Seir, when you marched from the land of Edom, the earth shook, the heavens poured, the clouds poured down water.
verses.textEnEsv: " Lord , when you went out from Seir, when you marched from the region of Edom, the earth trembled and the heavens dropped, yes, the clouds dropped water.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lord, when You went out from Seir, When You marched from the field of Edom, The earth trembled and the heavens poured, The clouds also poured water;
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , when you set out from Seir and marched across the fields of Edom, the earth trembled, and the cloudy skies poured down rain.
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord, when You went out from Seir, When You marched from the field of Edom, The earth quaked, the heavens also dripped, The clouds also dripped water.
verses.textEn: "When you, Lord , went out from Seir, when you marched from the land of Edom, the earth shook, the heavens poured, the clouds poured down water.

verses.textZh: 群山在耶和华面前震动； 这西奈山在耶和华以色列的神面前也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群山在耶和华面前震动； 这西奈山在耶和华以色列的神面前也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 山见耶和华的面就震动， 西奈山见耶和华－以色列神的面也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The mountains quaked before the Lord , the One of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains quaked before the Lord , even Sinai before the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains gushed before the Lord, This Sinai, before the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains quaked in the presence of the Lord , the God of Mount Sinai— in the presence of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "The mountains flowed with water at the presence of the Lord, This Sinai, at the presence of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: The mountains quaked before the Lord , the One of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 在亚拿的儿子珊迦的时候， 在雅亿的日子，大道无人行走， 行路的人绕道而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在亚拿的儿子珊迦的时候， 在雅亿的日子，大道无人行走， 行路的人绕道而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚拿之子珊迦的时候， 又在雅亿的日子， 大道无人行走， 都是绕道而行。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were abandoned; travelers took to winding paths.
verses.textEnEsv: "In the days of Shamgar, son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were abandoned, and travelers kept to the byways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In the days of Shamgar, son of Anath, In the days of Jael, The highways were deserted, And the travelers walked along the byways.
verses.textEnNlt: "In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, and in the days of Jael, people avoided the main roads, and travelers stayed on winding pathways.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the roads were deserted, And travelers went by roundabout ways.
verses.textEn: "In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were abandoned; travelers took to winding paths.

verses.textZh: 以色列中的农村消失了，消失了， 直到我底波拉兴起， 直到我以色列的母亲兴起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列中的农村消失了，消失了， 直到我底波拉兴起， 直到我以色列的母亲兴起。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列中的官长停职， 直到我底波拉兴起， 等我兴起作以色列的母。
verses.textEnNiv: Villagers in Israel would not fight; they held back until I, Deborah, arose, until I arose, a mother in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The villagers ceased in Israel; they ceased to be until I arose; I, Deborah, arose as a mother in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Village life ceased, it ceased in Israel, Until I, Deborah, arose, Arose a mother in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There were few people left in the villages of Israel — until Deborah arose as a mother for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "The peasantry came to an end, they came to an end in Israel, Until I, Deborah, arose, Until I arose, a mother in Israel.
verses.textEn: Villagers in Israel would not fight; they held back until I, Deborah, arose, until I arose, a mother in Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人选择了新的神， 战争就临近城门； 那时四万以色列人中， 竟不见有一面盾牌、一枝长矛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人选择了新的神， 战争就临近城门； 那时四万以色列人中， 竟不见有一面盾牌、一枝长矛。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人选择新神， 争战的事就临到城门。 那时，以色列四万人中 岂能见盾牌枪矛呢？
verses.textEnNiv: God chose new leaders when war came to the city gates, but not a shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: When new gods were chosen, then war was in the gates. Was shield or spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: They chose new gods; Then therewas war in the gates; Not a shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When Israel chose new gods, war erupted at the city gates. Yet not a shield or spear could be seen among forty thousand warriors in Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: "New gods were chosen; Then war was in the gates. Not a shield or a spear was seen Among forty thousand in Israel.
verses.textEn: God chose new leaders when war came to the city gates, but not a shield or spear was seen among forty thousand in Israel.

verses.textZh: 我的心倾向以色列的官长， 他们在民中甘愿牺牲自己； 你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心倾向以色列的官长， 他们在民中甘愿牺牲自己； 你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心倾向以色列的首领， 他们在民中甘心牺牲自己。 你们应当颂赞耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is with Israel’s princes, with the willing volunteers among the people. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: My heart goes out to the commanders of Israel who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart is with the rulers of Israel Who offered themselves willingly with the people. Bless the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is with the commanders of Israel, with those who volunteered for war. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "My heart goes out to the commanders of Israel, The volunteers among the people; Bless the Lord!
verses.textEn: My heart is with Israel’s princes, with the willing volunteers among the people. Praise the Lord !

verses.textZh: 骑白驴的， 坐锦垫的， 和路上的行人， 你们都要歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骑白驴的， 坐锦垫的， 和路上的行人， 你们都要歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 骑白驴的、坐绣花毯子的、行路的， 你们都当传扬！
verses.textEnNiv: "You who ride on white donkeys, sitting on your saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road, consider
verses.textEnEsv: "Tell of it, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets and you who walk by the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, Who sit in judges’ attire, And who walk along the road.
verses.textEnNlt: "Consider this, you who ride on fine donkeys, you who sit on fancy saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road.
verses.textEnNasb: "You who ride on white donkeys, You who sit on rich carpets, And you who travel on the road—shout in praise!
verses.textEn: "You who ride on white donkeys, sitting on your saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road, consider

verses.textZh: 在打水的地方分开羊群的人发声， 在那里人必歌颂耶和华公义的作为， 就是他在以色列中的农村所行公义的作为； 那时，耶和华的子民下到城门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在打水的地方分开羊群的人发声， 在那里人必歌颂耶和华公义的作为， 就是他在以色列中的农村所行公义的作为； 那时，耶和华的子民下到城门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 在远离弓箭响声打水之处， 人必述说耶和华公义的作为， 就是他治理以色列公义的作为。 那时耶和华的民下到城门。
verses.textEnNiv: the voice of the singers at the watering places. They recite the victories of the Lord , the victories of his villagers in Israel. "Then the people of the Lord went down to the city gates.
verses.textEnEsv: To the sound of musicians at the watering places, there they repeat the righteous triumphs of the Lord , the righteous triumphs of his villagers in Israel. "Then down to the gates marched the people of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Far from the noise of the archers, among the watering places, There they shall recount the righteous acts of the Lord, The righteous acts for His villagers in Israel; Then the people of the Lord shall go down to the gates.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the village musicians gathered at the watering holes. They recount the righteous victories of the Lord and the victories of his villagers in Israel. Then the people of the Lord marched down to the city gates.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the sound of those who distribute water among the watering places, There they will recount the righteous deeds of the Lord, The righteous deeds for His peasantry in Israel. Then the people of the Lord went down to the gates.
verses.textEn: the voice of the singers at the watering places. They recite the victories of the Lord , the victories of his villagers in Israel. "Then the people of the Lord went down to the city gates.

verses.textZh: 兴起，兴起，底波拉！ 兴起，兴起，唱歌吧！ 兴起，巴拉！ 亚比挪庵的儿子，掳掠你的俘虏吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 兴起，兴起，底波拉！ 兴起，兴起，唱歌吧！ 兴起，巴拉！ 亚比挪庵的儿子，掳掠你的俘虏吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 底波拉啊，兴起！兴起！ 你当兴起，兴起，唱歌。 亚比挪庵的儿子巴拉啊，你当奋兴， 掳掠你的敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song! Arise, Barak! Take captive your captives, son of Abinoam.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, break out in a song! Arise, Barak, lead away your captives, O son of Abinoam.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, Barak, and lead your captives away, O son of Abinoam!
verses.textEnNlt: "Wake up, Deborah, wake up! Wake up, wake up, and sing a song! Arise, Barak! Lead your captives away, son of Abinoam!
verses.textEnNasb: "Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, son of Abinoam.
verses.textEn: ‘Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song! Arise, Barak! Take captive your captives, son of Abinoam.’

verses.textZh: 那时余剩的贵胄下来； 耶和华带着勇士下到我这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时余剩的贵胄下来； 耶和华带着勇士下到我这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时有余剩的贵胄和百姓一同下来； 耶和华降临，为我攻击勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: "The remnant of the nobles came down; the people of the Lord came down to me against the mighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Then down marched the remnant of the noble; the people of the Lord marched down for me against the mighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the survivors came down, the people against the nobles; The Lord came down for me against the mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: "Down from Tabor marched the few against the nobles. The people of the Lord marched down against mighty warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then survivors came down to the nobles; The people of the Lord came down to me as warriors.
verses.textEn: "The remnant of the nobles came down; the people of the Lord came down to me against the mighty.

verses.textZh: 他们出自以法莲，他们的根在亚玛力人之地； 有便雅悯在你的族人中跟随你， 有官长从玛吉下来； 有持着数点民数之权杖的 ，从西布伦出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们出自以法莲，他们的根在亚玛力人之地； 有便雅悯在你的族人中跟随你， 有官长从玛吉下来； 有持着数点民数之权杖的 ，从西布伦出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 有根本在亚玛力人的地， 从以法莲下来的； 便雅悯在民中跟随你。 有掌权的从玛吉下来； 有持杖检点民数的从西布伦下来；
verses.textEnNiv: Some came from Ephraim, whose roots were in Amalek; Benjamin was with the people who followed you. From Makir captains came down, from Zebulun those who bear a commander’s staff.
verses.textEnEsv: From Ephraim their root they marched down into the valley, following you, Benjamin, with your kinsmen; from Machir marched down the commanders, and from Zebulun those who bear the lieutenant’s staff;
verses.textEnNkjv: From Ephraim were those whose roots were in Amalek. After you, Benjamin, with your peoples, From Machir rulers came down, And from Zebulun those who bear the recruiter’s staff.
verses.textEnNlt: They came down from Ephraim— a land that once belonged to the Amalekites; they followed you, Benjamin, with your troops. From Makir the commanders marched down; from Zebulun came those who carry a commander’s staff.
verses.textEnNasb: "From Ephraim those whose root is in Amalek came down, Following you, Benjamin, with your peoples; From Machir commanders came down, And from Zebulun those who wield the staff of office.
verses.textEn: Some came from Ephraim, whose roots were in Amalek; Benjamin was with the people who followed you. From Makir captains came down, from Zebulun those who bear a commander’s staff.

verses.textZh: 以萨迦的领袖与底波拉在一起； 以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样； 他们都步行下到山谷去。 在流本的众溪旁，有心怀大志的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦的领袖与底波拉在一起； 以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样； 他们都步行下到山谷去。 在流本的众溪旁，有心怀大志的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦的首领与底波拉同来； 以萨迦怎样，巴拉也怎样。 众人都跟随巴拉冲下平原； 在吕便的溪水旁有心中定大志的。
verses.textEnNiv: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah; yes, Issachar was with Barak, sent under his command into the valley. In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.
verses.textEnEsv: the princes of Issachar came with Deborah, and Issachar faithful to Barak; into the valley they rushed at his heels. Among the clans of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As Issachar, so was Barak Sent into the valley under his command; Among the divisions of Reuben Therewere great resolves of heart.
verses.textEnNlt: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah and Barak. They followed Barak, rushing into the valley. But in the tribe of Reuben there was great indecision.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; As was Issachar, so was Barak; Into the valley they rushed at his heels; Among the divisions of Reuben There were great determinations of heart.
verses.textEn: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah; yes, Issachar was with Barak, sent under his command into the valley. In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么坐在羊圈之中， 听呼唤群畜的笛声呢？ 在流本的众溪旁，有心怀大志的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么坐在羊圈之中， 听呼唤群畜的笛声呢？ 在流本的众溪旁，有心怀大志的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何坐在羊圈内 听群中吹笛的声音呢？ 在吕便的溪水旁有心中设大谋的。
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you stay among the sheep pens to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Why did you sit still among the sheepfolds, to hear the whistling for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds, To hear the pipings for the flocks? The divisions of Reuben have great searchings of heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Why did you sit at home among the sheepfolds— to hear the shepherds whistle for their flocks? Yes, in the tribe of Reuben there was great indecision.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why did you sit among the sheepfolds, To hear the piping for the flocks? Among the divisions of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.
verses.textEn: Why did you stay among the sheep pens to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.

verses.textZh: 基列人在约旦河东边居住； 但人为甚么居留在船上呢？ 亚设人在海岸坐着， 在港湾居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列人在约旦河东边居住； 但人为甚么居留在船上呢？ 亚设人在海岸坐着， 在港湾居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列人安居在约旦河外。 但人为何等在船上？ 亚设人在海口静坐， 在港口安居。
verses.textEnNiv: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan. And Dan, why did he linger by the ships? Asher remained on the coast and stayed in his coves.
verses.textEnEsv: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan; and Dan, why did he stay with the ships? Asher sat still at the coast of the sea, staying by his landings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan, And why did Dan remain on ships? Asher continued at the seashore, And stayed by his inlets.
verses.textEnNlt: Gilead remained east of the Jordan. And why did Dan stay home? Asher sat unmoved at the seashore, remaining in his harbors.
verses.textEnNasb: "Gilead remained across the Jordan; And why did Dan stay on ships? Asher sat at the seashore, And remained by its landings.
verses.textEn: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan. And Dan, why did he linger by the ships? Asher remained on the coast and stayed in his coves.

verses.textZh: 西布伦人是敢死的民族； 拿弗他利人在田野的高处，奋不顾身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦人是敢死的民族； 拿弗他利人在田野的高处，奋不顾身。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦人是拚命敢死的； 拿弗他利人在田野的高处也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Zebulun risked their very lives; so did Naphtali on the terraced fields.
verses.textEnEsv: Zebulun is a people who risked their lives to the death; Naphtali, too, on the heights of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zebulun is a people who jeopardized their lives to the point of death, Naphtali also, on the heights of the battlefield.
verses.textEnNlt: But Zebulun risked his life, as did Naphtali, on the heights of the battlefield.
verses.textEnNasb: "Zebulun was a people who risked their lives, And Naphtali too, on the high places of the field.
verses.textEn: The people of Zebulun risked their very lives; so did Naphtali on the terraced fields.

verses.textZh: 众王都来争战； 那时迦南众王争战， 在米吉多水亭的他纳争战， 却没有取得银钱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众王都来争战； 那时迦南众王争战， 在米吉多水亭的他纳争战， 却没有取得银钱。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王都来争战。 那时迦南诸王在米吉多水旁的他纳争战， 却未得掳掠银钱。
verses.textEnNiv: "Kings came, they fought, the kings of Canaan fought. At Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo, they took no plunder of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: "The kings came, they fought; then fought the kings of Canaan, at Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo; they got no spoils of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The kings came and fought, Then the kings of Canaan fought In Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo; They took no spoils of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: "The kings of Canaan came and fought, at Taanach near Megiddo’s springs, but they carried off no silver treasures.
verses.textEnNasb: "The kings came and fought; Then the kings of Canaan fought At Taanach near the waters of Megiddo; They took no plunder in silver.
verses.textEn: "Kings came, they fought, the kings of Canaan fought. At Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo, they took no plunder of silver.

verses.textZh: 众星从天上争战， 从它们的轨道与西西拉交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众星从天上争战， 从它们的轨道与西西拉交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 星宿从天上争战， 从其轨道攻击西西拉。
verses.textEnNiv: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.
verses.textEnEsv: From heaven the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.
verses.textEnNkjv: They fought from the heavens; The stars from their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.textEnNlt: The stars fought from heaven. The stars in their orbits fought against Sisera.
verses.textEnNasb: "The stars fought from heaven, From their paths they fought against Sisera.
verses.textEn: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

verses.textZh: 基顺河的急流把他们冲没， 古河的急流、基顺河的急流， 我的心哪，你要努力践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基顺河的急流把他们冲没， 古河的急流、基顺河的急流， 我的心哪，你要努力践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 基顺古河把敌人冲没； 我的灵啊，应当努力前行。
verses.textEnNiv: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!
verses.textEnEsv: The torrent Kishon swept them away, the ancient torrent, the torrent Kishon. March on, my soul, with might!
verses.textEnNkjv: The torrent of Kishon swept them away, That ancient torrent, the torrent of Kishon. O my soul, march on in strength!
verses.textEnNlt: The Kishon River swept them away— that ancient torrent, the Kishon. March on with courage, my soul!
verses.textEnNasb: "The torrent of Kishon swept them away, The ancient torrent, the torrent Kishon. My soul, march on with strength!
verses.textEn: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!

verses.textZh: 那时马蹄沓沓， 勇士急奔飞驰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时马蹄沓沓， 勇士急奔飞驰。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时壮马驰驱， 踢跳，奔腾。
verses.textEnNiv: Then thundered the horses’ hooves— galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then loud beat the horses’ hoofs with the galloping, galloping of his steeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the horses’ hooves pounded, The galloping, galloping of his steeds.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the horses’ hooves hammered the ground, the galloping, galloping of Sisera’s mighty steeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the horses’ hoofs beat From the galloping, the galloping of his mighty stallions.
verses.textEn: Then thundered the horses’ hooves— galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者说：‘你们要咒诅米罗斯， 大大咒诅其中的居民； 因为他们不来帮助耶和华， 不带领勇士帮助耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者说：‘你们要咒诅米罗斯， 大大咒诅其中的居民； 因为他们不来帮助耶和华， 不带领勇士帮助耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者说： 应当咒诅米罗斯， 大大咒诅其中的居民； 因为他们不来帮助耶和华， 不来帮助耶和华攻击勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the angel of the Lord . ‘Curse its people bitterly, because they did not come to help the Lord , to help the Lord against the mighty.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Curse Meroz, says the angel of the Lord , curse its inhabitants thoroughly, because they did not come to the help of the Lord , to the help of the Lord against the mighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the angel of the Lord, ‘Curse its inhabitants bitterly, Because they did not come to the help of the Lord, To the help of the Lord against the mighty.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Let the people of Meroz be cursed,’ said the angel of the Lord . ‘Let them be utterly cursed, because they did not come to help the Lord — to help the Lord against the mighty warriors.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the angel of the Lord, ‘Utterly curse its inhabitants, Because they did not come to the help of the Lord, To the help of the Lord against the warriors.’
verses.textEn: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said the angel of the Lord . ‘Curse its people bitterly, because they did not come to help the Lord , to help the Lord against the mighty.’

verses.textZh: 愿基尼人希伯的妻子雅亿， 比众妇女更有福气， 比住在帐棚的妇女更有福气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿基尼人希伯的妻子雅亿， 比众妇女更有福气， 比住在帐棚的妇女更有福气。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿基尼人希百的妻雅亿比众妇人多得福气， 比住帐棚的妇人更蒙福祉。
verses.textEnNiv: "Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.
verses.textEnEsv: "Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, of tent-dwelling women most blessed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Most blessed among women is Jael, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Blessed is she among women in tents.
verses.textEnNlt: "Most blessed among women is Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite. May she be blessed above all women who live in tents.
verses.textEnNasb: "Most blessed of women is Jael, The wife of Heber the Kenite; Most blessed is she of women in the tent.
verses.textEn: "Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.

verses.textZh: 西西拉求水，雅亿给了奶； 用珍贵的盘子奉上乳酪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉求水，雅亿给了奶； 用珍贵的盘子奉上乳酪。
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉求水， 雅亿给他奶子， 用宝贵的盘子给他奶油。
verses.textEnNiv: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.
verses.textEnEsv: He asked for water and she gave him milk; she brought him curds in a noble’s bowl.
verses.textEnNkjv: He asked for water, she gave milk; She brought out cream in a lordly bowl.
verses.textEnNlt: Sisera asked for water, and she gave him milk. In a bowl fit for nobles, she brought him yogurt.
verses.textEnNasb: "He asked for water, she gave him milk; In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
verses.textEn: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.

verses.textZh: 她伸手拿着帐棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的锤子， 击打西西拉，打破他的头， 粉碎他的头颅，贯穿他的鬓角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她伸手拿着帐棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的锤子， 击打西西拉，打破他的头， 粉碎他的头颅，贯穿他的鬓角。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅亿左手拿着帐棚的橛子， 右手拿着匠人的锤子， 击打西西拉， 打伤他的头， 把他的鬓角打破穿通。
verses.textEnNiv: Her hand reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera, she crushed his head, she shattered and pierced his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: She sent her hand to the tent peg and her right hand to the workmen’s mallet; she struck Sisera; she crushed his head; she shattered and pierced his temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: She stretched her hand to the tent peg, Her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; She pounded Sisera, she pierced his head, She split and struck through his temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Then with her left hand she reached for a tent peg, and with her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera with the hammer, crushing his head. With a shattering blow, she pierced his temples.
verses.textEnNasb: "She reached out her hand for the tent peg, And her right hand for the workmen’s hammer. Then she struck Sisera, she smashed his head; And she shattered and pierced his temple.
verses.textEn: Her hand reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera, she crushed his head, she shattered and pierced his temple.

verses.textZh: 西西拉在雅亿脚前屈身、仆倒、躺卧， 在雅亿脚前屈身、仆倒； 他在那里屈身，就在那里仆倒死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉在雅亿脚前屈身、仆倒、躺卧， 在雅亿脚前屈身、仆倒； 他在那里屈身，就在那里仆倒死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉在她脚前曲身仆倒， 在她脚前曲身倒卧； 在那里曲身，就在那里死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: At her feet he sank, he fell; there he lay. At her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.
verses.textEnEsv: Between her feet he sank, he fell, he lay still; between her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: At her feet he sank, he fell, he lay still; At her feet he sank, he fell; Where he sank, there he fell dead.
verses.textEnNlt: He sank, he fell, he lay still at her feet. And where he sank, there he died.
verses.textEnNasb: "Between her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay; Between her feet he bowed, he fell; Where he bowed, there he fell dead.
verses.textEn: At her feet he sank, he fell; there he lay. At her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.

verses.textZh: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里向外观望， 从窗棂中呼叫说： ‘他的战车为甚么迟迟不来呢？ 车轮为甚么行得缓慢呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里向外观望， 从窗棂中呼叫说： ‘他的战车为甚么迟迟不来呢？ 车轮为甚么行得缓慢呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 西西拉的母亲从窗户里往外观看， 从窗棂中呼叫说： 他的战车为何耽延不来呢？ 他的车轮为何行得慢呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Through the window peered Sisera’s mother; behind the lattice she cried out, ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why is the clatter of his chariots delayed?’
verses.textEnEsv: "Out of the window she peered, the mother of Sisera wailed through the lattice: ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarry the hoofbeats of his chariots?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "The mother of Sisera looked through the window, And cried out through the lattice, ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why tarries the clatter of his chariots?’
verses.textEnNlt: "From the window Sisera’s mother looked out. Through the window she watched for his return, saying, ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why don’t we hear the sound of chariot wheels?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Out of the window she looked and wailed, The mother of Sisera through the lattice, ‘Why does his chariot delay in coming? Why do the hoofbeats of his chariots delay?’
verses.textEn: "Through the window peered Sisera’s mother; behind the lattice she cried out, ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why is the clatter of his chariots delayed?’

verses.textZh: 聪明的宫女回答她； 她也自己回答说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 聪明的宫女回答她； 她也自己回答说：
verses.textZhCuv: 聪明的宫女安慰她 ， 她也自言自语地说：
verses.textEnNiv: The wisest of her ladies answer her; indeed, she keeps saying to herself,
verses.textEnEsv: Her wisest princesses answer, indeed, she answers herself,
verses.textEnNkjv: Her wisest ladies answered her, Yes, she answered herself,
verses.textEnNlt: "Her wise women answer, and she repeats these words to herself:
verses.textEnNasb: "Her wise princesses would answer her, Indeed she repeats her words to herself,
verses.textEn: The wisest of her ladies answer her; indeed, she keeps saying to herself,

verses.textZh: ‘莫非他们正在分战利品？ 每个勇士分得一两个女子； 西西拉得了彩衣作战利品， 得了一两件绣花的彩衣作战利品， 为我的颈项，得着绣花的彩衣作战利品吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘莫非他们正在分战利品？ 每个勇士分得一两个女子； 西西拉得了彩衣作战利品， 得了一两件绣花的彩衣作战利品， 为我的颈项，得着绣花的彩衣作战利品吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们莫非得财而分？ 每人得了一两个女子？ 西西拉得了彩衣为掳物， 得绣花的彩衣为掠物。 这彩衣两面绣花， 乃是披在被掳之人颈项上的。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Are they not finding and dividing the spoils: a woman or two for each man, colorful garments as plunder for Sisera, colorful garments embroidered, highly embroidered garments for my neck— all this as plunder?’
