verses.textEn: While each man held his position around the camp, all the Midianites ran, crying out as they fled.

verses.textZh: 三百人吹那三百枝角的时候，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，然后他们向着西利拉逃到伯．哈示他，直到靠近他巴的亚伯．米何拉河边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三百人吹那三百枝角的时候，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，然后他们向着西利拉逃到伯．哈示他，直到靠近他巴的亚伯．米何拉河边。
verses.textZhCuv: 三百人就吹角，耶和华使全营的人用刀互相击杀，逃到西利拉的伯‧哈示他，直逃到靠近他巴的亚伯‧米何拉。
verses.textEnNiv: When the three hundred trumpets sounded, the Lord caused the men throughout the camp to turn on each other with their swords. The army fled to Beth Shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel Meholah near Tabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: When they blew the 300 trumpets, the Lord set every man’s sword against his comrade and against all the army. And the army fled as far as Beth-shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel-meholah, by Tabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the three hundred blew the trumpets, the Lord set every man’s sword against his companion throughout the whole camp; and the army fled to Beth Acacia, toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: When the 300 Israelites blew their rams’ horns, the Lord caused the warriors in the camp to fight against each other with their swords. Those who were not killed fled to places as far away as Beth-shittah near Zererah and to the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they blew the three hundred trumpets, the Lord set the sword of one against another even throughout the entire army; and the army fled as far as Beth-shittah toward Zererah, as far as the edge of Abel-meholah, by Tabbath.
verses.textEn: When the three hundred trumpets sounded, the Lord caused the men throughout the camp to turn on each other with their swords. The army fled to Beth Shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel Meholah near Tabbath.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就从拿弗他利、亚设和玛拿西全地被召来，追赶米甸人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就从拿弗他利、亚设和玛拿西全地被召来，追赶米甸人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就从拿弗他利、亚设，和玛拿西全地聚集来追赶米甸人。
verses.textEnNiv: Israelites from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali and from Asher and from all Manasseh, and they pursued after Midian.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Israel gathered together from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and pursued the Midianites.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Gideon sent for the warriors of Naphtali, Asher, and Manasseh, who joined in chasing the army of Midian.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Israel were summoned from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued Midian.
verses.textEn: Israelites from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.

verses.textZh: 基甸派遣了使者走遍以法莲山地，说："你们要下来迎战米甸人，在他们前面把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯．巴拉。"于是以法莲的人都被召来，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯．巴拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸派遣了使者走遍以法莲山地，说："你们要下来迎战米甸人，在他们前面把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯．巴拉。"于是以法莲的人都被召来，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯．巴拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸打发人走遍以法莲山地，说：「你们下来攻击米甸人，争先把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉。」于是以法莲的众人聚集，把守约旦河的渡口，直到伯‧巴拉，
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth Barah." So all the men of Ephraim were called out and they seized the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth Barah.
verses.textEnEsv: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against the Midianites and capture the waters against them, as far as Beth-barah, and also the Jordan." So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters as far as Beth-barah, and also the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gideon sent messengers throughout all the mountains of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against the Midianites, and seize from them the watering places as far as Beth Barah and the Jordan." Then all the men of Ephraim gathered together and seized the watering places as far as Beth Barah and the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon also sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down to attack the Midianites. Cut them off at the shallow crossings of the Jordan River at Beth-barah." So all the men of Ephraim did as they were told.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against Midian and take control of the waters ahead of them, as far as Beth-barah and the Jordan." So all the men of Ephraim were summoned, and they took control of the waters as far as Beth-barah and the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth Barah." So all the men of Ephraim were called out and they seized the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth Barah.

verses.textZh: 他们捉住了米甸人的两个首领：俄立和西伊伯；把俄立杀在俄立盘石上，把西伊伯杀在西伊伯榨酒池那里；然后追赶米甸人，又把俄立和西伊伯的人头带到约旦河对岸，基甸那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们捉住了米甸人的两个首领：俄立和西伊伯；把俄立杀在俄立盘石上，把西伊伯杀在西伊伯榨酒池那里；然后追赶米甸人，又把俄立和西伊伯的人头带到约旦河对岸，基甸那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 捉住了米甸人的两个首领：一名俄立，一名西伊伯；将俄立杀在俄立磐石上，将西伊伯杀在西伊伯酒榨那里；又追赶米甸人，将俄立和西伊伯的首级带过约旦河，到基甸那里。
verses.textEnNiv: They also captured two of the Midianite leaders, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. They pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon, who was by the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And they captured the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they killed at the winepress of Zeeb. Then they pursued Midian, and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon across the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they captured two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they killed at the winepress of Zeeb. They pursued Midian and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two Midianite commanders, killing Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. And they continued to chase the Midianites. Afterward the Israelites brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon, who was by the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: And they captured the two leaders of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb, and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and they killed Zeeb at the wine press of Zeeb, while they pursued Midian; and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon from across the Jordan.
verses.textEn: They also captured two of the Midianite leaders, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. They pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon, who was by the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 以法莲人对基甸说："你去与米甸人争战的时候，没有召我们同去，你为甚么这样待我们呢？"他们就与他激烈地争辩起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲人对基甸说："你去与米甸人争战的时候，没有召我们同去，你为甚么这样待我们呢？"他们就与他激烈地争辩起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲人对基甸说：「你去与米甸人争战，没有招我们同去，为什么这样待我们呢？」他们就与基甸大大地争吵。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Ephraimites asked Gideon, "Why have you treated us like this? Why didn’t you call us when you went to fight Midian?" And they challenged him vigorously.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men of Ephraim said to him, "What is this that you have done to us, not to call us when you went to fight against Midian?" And they accused him fiercely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men of Ephraim said to him, "Why have you done this to us by not calling us when you went to fight with the Midianites?" And they reprimanded him sharply.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Ephraim asked Gideon, "Why have you treated us this way? Why didn’t you send for us when you first went out to fight the Midianites?" And they argued heatedly with Gideon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, "What is this thing that you have done to us, not calling upon us when you went to fight against Midian?" And they quarreled with him vehemently.
verses.textEn: Now the Ephraimites asked Gideon, "Why have you treated us like this? Why didn’t you call us when you went to fight Midian?" And they challenged him vigorously.

verses.textZh: 基甸对他们说："我所行的怎能比得上你们呢？在以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄，不是比在亚比以谢收摘的葡萄更好吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸对他们说："我所行的怎能比得上你们呢？在以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄，不是比在亚比以谢收摘的葡萄更好吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸对他们说：「我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？以法莲拾取剩下的葡萄不强过亚比以谢所摘的葡萄吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But he answered them, "What have I accomplished compared to you? Aren’t the gleanings of Ephraim’s grapes better than the full grape harvest of Abiezer?
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "What have I done now in comparison with you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "What have I done now in comparison with you? Is not the gleaning ofthegrapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.textEnNlt: But Gideon replied, "What have I accomplished compared to you? Aren’t even the leftover grapes of Ephraim’s harvest better than the entire crop of my little clan of Abiezer?
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to them, "What have I done now in comparison with you? Is the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim not better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.textEn: But he answered them, "What have I accomplished compared to you? Aren’t the gleanings of Ephraim’s grapes better than the full grape harvest of Abiezer?

verses.textZh: 神已经把米甸人的两个首领：俄立和西伊伯，交在你们的手里了；我所行的怎能与你们相比呢？"基甸说了这话，他们的怒气就平息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神已经把米甸人的两个首领：俄立和西伊伯，交在你们的手里了；我所行的怎能与你们相比呢？"基甸说了这话，他们的怒气就平息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神已将米甸人的两个首领俄立和西伊伯交在你们手中；我所行的岂能比你们所行的呢？」基甸说了这话，以法莲人的怒气就消了。
verses.textEnNiv: God gave Oreb and Zeeb, the Midianite leaders, into your hands. What was I able to do compared to you?" At this, their resentment against him subsided.
verses.textEnEsv: God has given into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. What have I been able to do in comparison with you?" Then their anger against him subsided when he said this.
verses.textEnNkjv: God has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. And what was I able to do in comparison with you?" Then their anger toward him subsided when he said that.
verses.textEnNlt: God gave you victory over Oreb and Zeeb, the commanders of the Midianite army. What have I accomplished compared to that?" When the men of Ephraim heard Gideon’s answer, their anger subsided.
verses.textEnNasb: God has handed over to you the leaders of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; and what was I able to do in comparison with you?" Then their anger toward him subsided when he said that.
verses.textEn: God gave Oreb and Zeeb, the Midianite leaders, into your hands. What was I able to do compared to you?" At this, their resentment against him subsided.

verses.textZh: 基甸来到约旦河，就过了河；他和与他在一起的三百人虽然都很疲乏，仍然追赶敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸来到约旦河，就过了河；他和与他在一起的三百人虽然都很疲乏，仍然追赶敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸和跟随他的三百人到约旦河过渡，虽然疲乏，还是追赶。
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gideon came to the Jordan and crossed over, he and the 300 men who were with him, exhausted yet pursuing.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Gideon came to the Jordan, he and the three hundred men who were with him crossed over, exhausted but still in pursuit.
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon then crossed the Jordan River with his 300 men, and though exhausted, they continued to chase the enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Gideon and the three hundred men who were with him came to the Jordan and crossed over, exhausted yet still pursuing.
verses.textEn: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.

verses.textZh: 基甸对疏割人说："求你们把几个饼给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了，我还要继续追赶米甸人和两个王西巴和撒慕拿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸对疏割人说："求你们把几个饼给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了，我还要继续追赶米甸人和两个王西巴和撒慕拿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸对疏割人说：「求你们拿饼来给跟随我的人吃，因为他们疲乏了；我们追赶米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the men of Sukkoth, "Give my troops some bread; they are worn out, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."
verses.textEnEsv: So he said to the men of Succoth, "Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me, for they are exhausted, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to the men of Succoth, "Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me, for they are exhausted, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian."
verses.textEnNlt: When they reached Succoth, Gideon asked the leaders of the town, "Please give my warriors some food. They are very tired. I am chasing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to the men of Succoth, "Please give loaves of bread to the people who are following me, for they are exhausted, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."
verses.textEn: He said to the men of Sukkoth, "Give my troops some bread; they are worn out, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."

verses.textZh: 疏割人的首领回答："西巴和撒慕拿现在不是已经在你的手里吗？我们应该把饼送给你的军队吃吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 疏割人的首领回答："西巴和撒慕拿现在不是已经在你的手里吗？我们应该把饼送给你的军队吃吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 疏割人的首领回答说：「西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给你的军兵吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the officials of Sukkoth said, "Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the officials of Succoth said, "Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the leaders of Succoth said, "Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the officials of Succoth replied, "Catch Zebah and Zalmunna first, and then we will feed your army."
verses.textEnNasb: But the leaders of Succoth said, " Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?"
verses.textEn: But the officials of Sukkoth said, "Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?"

verses.textZh: 基甸说："好吧，耶和华把西巴和撒慕拿交在我手里的时候，我就必用野地的荆棘鞭打你们的身体。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸说："好吧，耶和华把西巴和撒慕拿交在我手里的时候，我就必用野地的荆棘鞭打你们的身体。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸说：「耶和华将西巴和撒慕拿交在我手之后，我就用野地的荆条和枳棘打伤你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Gideon replied, "Just for that, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with desert thorns and briers."
verses.textEnEsv: So Gideon said, "Well then, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will flail your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gideon said, "For this cause, when the Lord has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers!"
verses.textEnNlt: So Gideon said, "After the Lord gives me victory over Zebah and Zalmunna, I will return and tear your flesh with the thorns and briers from the wilderness."
verses.textEnNasb: So Gideon said, "For this answer, when the Lord has handed over to me Zebah and Zalmunna, I will thrash your bodies with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers."
verses.textEn: Then Gideon replied, "Just for that, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with desert thorns and briers."

verses.textZh: 基甸从那里上到毘努伊勒，也向他们说了同样的话；毘努伊勒人回答他也像疏割人回答的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸从那里上到毘努伊勒，也向他们说了同样的话；毘努伊勒人回答他也像疏割人回答的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸从那里上到毗努伊勒，对那里的人也是这样说；毗努伊勒人也与疏割人回答他的话一样。
verses.textEnNiv: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Sukkoth had.
verses.textEnEsv: And from there he went up to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way, and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went up from there to Penuel and spoke to them in the same way. And the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
verses.textEnNlt: From there Gideon went up to Peniel and again asked for food, but he got the same answer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went up from there to Penuel and spoke similarly to them; and the men of Penuel answered him just as the men of Succoth had answered.
verses.textEn: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Sukkoth had.

verses.textZh: 他亦对毘努伊勒人说："我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这座望楼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他亦对毘努伊勒人说："我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这座望楼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他向毗努伊勒人说：「我平平安安回来的时候，我必拆毁这楼。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he said to the men of Peniel, "When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the men of Penuel, "When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he also spoke to the men of Penuel, saying, "When I come back in peace, I will tear down this tower!"
verses.textEnNlt: So he said to the people of Peniel, "After I return in victory, I will tear down this tower."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said also to the men of Penuel, "When I return safely, I will tear down this tower."
verses.textEn: So he said to the men of Peniel, "When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower."

verses.textZh: 那时，西巴和撒慕拿正在加各，与他们在一起的军队约有一万五千人，就是东方人全营剩下的，因为有十二万持刀的已经倒下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，西巴和撒慕拿正在加各，与他们在一起的军队约有一万五千人，就是东方人全营剩下的，因为有十二万持刀的已经倒下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时西巴和撒慕拿，并跟随他们的军队都在加各，约有一万五千人，就是东方人全军所剩下的；已经被杀约有十二万拿刀的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with a force of about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of the armies of the eastern peoples; a hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had fallen.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army, about 15,000 men, all who were left of all the army of the people of the East, for there had fallen 120,000 men who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were at Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand, all who were left of all the army of the people of the East; for one hundred and twenty thousand men who drew the sword had fallen.
verses.textEnNlt: By this time Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with about 15,000 warriors—all that remained of the allied armies of the east, for 120,000 had already been killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of the entire army of the people of the east; for the fallen were 120,000 swordsmen.
verses.textEn: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with a force of about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of the armies of the eastern peoples; a hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had fallen.

verses.textZh: 基甸就从挪巴和约比哈东面，顺着住帐棚的人的路上去；在敌军以为安全而不戒备的时候，击败了敌军。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸就从挪巴和约比哈东面，顺着住帐棚的人的路上去；在敌军以为安全而不戒备的时候，击败了敌军。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸就由挪巴和约比哈东边，从住帐棚人的路上去，杀败了米甸人的军兵，因为他们坦然无惧。
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the unsuspecting army.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gideon went up by the way of the tent dwellers east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the army, for the army felt secure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gideon went up by the road of those who dwell in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah; and he attacked the army while the camp felt secure.
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon circled around by the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, taking the Midianite army by surprise.
verses.textEnNasb: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents to the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked the camp when the camp was unsuspecting.
verses.textEn: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the unsuspecting army.

verses.textZh: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追赶他们，捉住了米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿，使全军都惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追赶他们，捉住了米甸人的两个王西巴和撒慕拿，使全军都惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 西巴和撒慕拿逃跑；基甸追赶他们，捉住米甸的二王西巴和撒慕拿，惊散全军。
verses.textEnNiv: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.
verses.textEnEsv: And Zebah and Zalmunna fled, and he pursued them and captured the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and he threw all the army into a panic.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them; and he took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and routed the whole army.
verses.textEnNlt: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two Midianite kings, fled, but Gideon chased them down and captured all their warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them and captured the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and routed the entire army.
verses.textEn: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.

verses.textZh: 约阿施的儿子基甸从战场沿着希列斯的山坡回来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施的儿子基甸从战场沿着希列斯的山坡回来，
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施的儿子基甸由希列斯坡从阵上回来，
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle by the ascent of Heres.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle, from the Ascent of Heres.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, Gideon returned from the battle by way of Heres Pass.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle by the ascent of Heres.
verses.textEn: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.

verses.textZh: 捉住了疏割人中的一个青年人，查问他；他就把疏割的首领和长老的名字写给他，共七十七人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 捉住了疏割人中的一个青年人，查问他；他就把疏割的首领和长老的名字写给他，共七十七人。
verses.textZhCuv: 捉住疏割的一个少年人，问他：「疏割的首领长老是谁？」他就将首领长老七十七个人的名字写出来。
verses.textEnNiv: He caught a young man of Sukkoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Sukkoth, the elders of the town.
verses.textEnEsv: And he captured a young man of Succoth and questioned him. And he wrote down for him the officials and elders of Succoth, seventy-seven men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he caught a young man of the men of Succoth and interrogated him; and he wrote down for him the leaders of Succoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.
verses.textEnNlt: There he captured a young man from Succoth and demanded that he write down the names of all the seventy-seven officials and elders in the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And he captured a youth from Succoth and questioned him. Then the youth wrote down for him the leaders of Succoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.
verses.textEn: He caught a young man of Sukkoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Sukkoth, the elders of the town.

verses.textZh: 基甸到了疏割人那里，就说："你看，西巴和撒慕拿，你们为了他们曾经讥笑我说：‘西巴和撒慕拿现在不是在你的手里吗？我们应该把饼送给你那些疲乏的人吃吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸到了疏割人那里，就说："你看，西巴和撒慕拿，你们为了他们曾经讥笑我说：‘西巴和撒慕拿现在不是在你的手里吗？我们应该把饼送给你那些疲乏的人吃吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸到了疏割，对那里的人说：「你们从前讥诮我说：『西巴和撒慕拿已经在你手里，你使我们将饼给跟随你的疲乏人吗？』现在西巴和撒慕拿在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Gideon came and said to the men of Sukkoth, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me by saying, ‘Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he came to the men of Succoth and said, "Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are exhausted?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to the men of Succoth and said, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you ridiculed me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your weary men?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon then returned to Succoth and said to the leaders, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna. When we were here before, you taunted me, saying, ‘Catch Zebah and Zalmunna first, and then we will feed your exhausted army.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And he came to the men of Succoth and said, "Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘ Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’ "
verses.textEn: Then Gideon came and said to the men of Sukkoth, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me by saying, ‘Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?’ "

verses.textZh: 于是拿住那城的长老，又拿起野地的荆棘，用荆棘把疏割人教训了一顿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拿住那城的长老，又拿起野地的荆棘，用荆棘把疏割人教训了一顿；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是捉住那城内的长老，用野地的荆条和枳棘责打 疏割人；
verses.textEnNiv: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Sukkoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took the elders of the city, and he took thorns of the wilderness and briers and with them taught the men of Succoth a lesson.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Gideon took the elders of the town and taught them a lesson, punishing them with thorns and briers from the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and he disciplined the men of Succoth with them.
verses.textEn: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Sukkoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.

verses.textZh: 又拆毁了毘努伊勒的望楼，杀死了那城里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又拆毁了毘努伊勒的望楼，杀死了那城里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又拆了毗努伊勒的楼，杀了那城里的人。
verses.textEnNiv: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.
verses.textEnEsv: And he broke down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he tore down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: He also tore down the tower of Peniel and killed all the men in the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And he tore down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
verses.textEn: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.

verses.textZh: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿："你们在他泊山上所杀的人，是甚么模样的人？"他们回答："他们像你一样，每一个都像王子的模样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿："你们在他泊山上所杀的人，是甚么模样的人？"他们回答："他们像你一样，每一个都像王子的模样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸问西巴和撒慕拿说：「你们在他泊山所杀的人是什么样式？」回答说：「他们好像你，各人都有王子的样式。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?" "Men like you," they answered, "each one with the bearing of a prince."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, "Where are the men whom you killed at Tabor?" They answered, "As you are, so were they. Every one of them resembled the son of a king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men werethey whom you killed at Tabor?" So they answered, "As you are, so were they; each one resembled the son of a king."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, "The men you killed at Tabor—what were they like?" "Like you," they replied. "They all had the look of a king’s son."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, "Where were the men whom you killed at Tabor?" But they said, "You and they were alike, each one resembling the son of a king."
verses.textEn: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?" "Men like you," they answered, "each one with the bearing of a prince."

verses.textZh: 基甸说："他们是我的兄弟，是我母亲的儿子；我指着永活的耶和华起誓，如果你们从前让他们存活，我现在就不杀你们了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸说："他们是我的兄弟，是我母亲的儿子；我指着永活的耶和华起誓，如果你们从前让他们存活，我现在就不杀你们了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸说：「他们是我同母的弟兄，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，你们从前若存留他们的性命，我如今就不杀你们了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the Lord lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you."
verses.textEnNlt: "They were my brothers, the sons of my own mother!" Gideon exclaimed. "As surely as the Lord lives, I wouldn’t kill you if you hadn’t killed them."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As the Lord lives, if only you had let them live, I would not kill you."
verses.textEn: Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the Lord lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you."

verses.textZh: 于是对他的长子益帖说："起来，把他们杀了吧。"但是那孩子不敢拔刀，只是害怕，因为他还是个孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是对他的长子益帖说："起来，把他们杀了吧。"但是那孩子不敢拔刀，只是害怕，因为他还是个孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是对他的长子益帖说：「你起来杀他们。」但益帖因为是童子，害怕，不敢拔刀。
verses.textEnNiv: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, "Kill them!" But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: So he said to Jether his firstborn, "Rise and kill them!" But the young man did not draw his sword, for he was afraid, because he was still a young man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Jether his firstborn, "Rise, kill them!" But the youth would not draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was still a youth.
verses.textEnNlt: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, "Kill them!" But Jether did not draw his sword, for he was only a boy and was afraid.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to Jether his firstborn, "Rise, kill them." But the youth did not draw his sword, for he was afraid, because he was still a youth.
verses.textEn: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, "Kill them!" But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.

verses.textZh: 西巴和撒慕拿说："你亲自起来杀我们吧；因为人怎样，他的力量也怎样。"于是基甸起来，把西巴和撒慕拿杀了，拿了他们骆驼颈项上的月牙圈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西巴和撒慕拿说："你亲自起来杀我们吧；因为人怎样，他的力量也怎样。"于是基甸起来，把西巴和撒慕拿杀了，拿了他们骆驼颈项上的月牙圈。
verses.textZhCuv: 西巴和撒慕拿说：「你自己起来杀我们吧！因为人如何，力量也是如何。」基甸就起来，杀了西巴和撒慕拿，夺获他们骆驼项上戴的月牙圈。
verses.textEnNiv: Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Come, do it yourself. ‘As is the man, so is his strength.’ " So Gideon stepped forward and killed them, and took the ornaments off their camels’ necks.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Rise yourself and fall upon us, for as the man is, so is his strength." And Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments that were on the necks of their camels.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Rise yourself, and kill us; for as a man is, so is his strength." So Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescent ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said to Gideon, "Be a man! Kill us yourself!" So Gideon killed them both and took the royal ornaments from the necks of their camels.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Rise up yourself, and attack us; for as the man, so is his strength." So Gideon arose and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescent amulets which were on their camels’ necks.
verses.textEn: Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Come, do it yourself. ‘As is the man, so is his strength.’ " So Gideon stepped forward and killed them, and took the ornaments off their camels’ necks.

verses.textZh: 以色列人对基甸说："你既然拯救我们脱离了米甸人的手，求你和你的子孙统治我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对基甸说："你既然拯救我们脱离了米甸人的手，求你和你的子孙统治我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人对基甸说：「你既救我们脱离米甸人的手，愿你和你的儿孙管理我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites said to Gideon, "Rule over us—you, your son and your grandson—because you have saved us from the hand of Midian."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, "Rule over us, you and your son and your grandson also, for you have saved us from the hand of Midian."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, "Rule over us, both you and your son, and your grandson also; for you have delivered us from the hand of Midian."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, "Be our ruler! You and your son and your grandson will be our rulers, for you have rescued us from Midian."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, "Rule over us, both you and your son, your son’s son as well, for you have saved us from the hand of Midian!"
verses.textEn: The Israelites said to Gideon, "Rule over us—you, your son and your grandson—because you have saved us from the hand of Midian."

verses.textZh: 基甸回答他们："我不统治你们，我的子孙也不统治你们，唯有耶和华统治你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸回答他们："我不统治你们，我的子孙也不统治你们，唯有耶和华统治你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸说：「我不管理你们，我的儿子也不管理你们，惟有耶和华管理你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Gideon told them, "I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The Lord will rule over you."
verses.textEnEsv: Gideon said to them, "I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the Lord will rule over you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Gideon said to them, "I will not rule over you, nor shall my son rule over you; the Lord shall rule over you."
verses.textEnNlt: But Gideon replied, "I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The Lord will rule over you!
verses.textEnNasb: But Gideon said to them, "I will not rule over you, nor shall my son rule over you; the Lord shall rule over you."
verses.textEn: But Gideon told them, "I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The Lord will rule over you."

verses.textZh: 基甸又对他们说："我有一个要求：请把你们各人夺得的耳环给我。"原来敌人都戴金耳环，因为他们是以实玛利人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸又对他们说："我有一个要求：请把你们各人夺得的耳环给我。"原来敌人都戴金耳环，因为他们是以实玛利人。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸又对他们说：「我有一件事求你们：请你们各人将所夺的耳环给我。」（原来仇敌是以实玛利人，都是戴金耳环的。）
verses.textEnNiv: And he said, "I do have one request, that each of you give me an earring from your share of the plunder." (It was the custom of the Ishmaelites to wear gold earrings.)
verses.textEnEsv: And Gideon said to them, "Let me make a request of you: every one of you give me the earrings from his spoil." (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gideon said to them, "I would like to make a request of you, that each of you would give me the earrings from his plunder." For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.
verses.textEnNlt: However, I do have one request—that each of you give me an earring from the plunder you collected from your fallen enemies." (The enemies, being Ishmaelites, all wore gold earrings.)
verses.textEnNasb: Yet Gideon said to them, "I would request of you, that each of you give me an earring from his plunder." (For they had gold earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.textEn: And he said, "I do have one request, that each of you give me an earring from your share of the plunder." (It was the custom of the Ishmaelites to wear gold earrings.)

verses.textZh: 他们回答："我们愿意给你。"于是铺开一件外衣，各人把夺得的耳环丢在上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："我们愿意给你。"于是铺开一件外衣，各人把夺得的耳环丢在上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「我们情愿给你」，就铺开一件外衣，各人将所夺的耳环丢在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: They answered, "We’ll be glad to give them." So they spread out a garment, and each of them threw a ring from his plunder onto it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they answered, "We will willingly give them." And they spread a cloak, and every man threw in it the earrings of his spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered, "We will gladly give them." And they spread out a garment, and each man threw into it the earrings from his plunder.
verses.textEnNlt: "Gladly!" they replied. They spread out a cloak, and each one threw in a gold earring he had gathered from the plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "We will certainly give them to you." So they spread out a garment, and every one of them tossed an earring there from his plunder.
verses.textEn: They answered, "We’ll be glad to give them." So they spread out a garment, and each of them threw a ring from his plunder onto it.

verses.textZh: 基甸所要的金耳环，共重约二十公斤金子，此外还有米甸王身上的月牙圈、耳坠和紫红色的衣服，另外还有骆驼颈项上的链子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸所要的金耳环，共重约二十公斤金子，此外还有米甸王身上的月牙圈、耳坠和紫红色的衣服，另外还有骆驼颈项上的链子。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸所要出来的金耳环重一千七百舍客勒金子。此外还有米甸王所戴的月环、耳坠，和所穿的紫色衣服，并骆驼项上的金链子。
verses.textEnNiv: The weight of the gold rings he asked for came to seventeen hundred shekels, not counting the ornaments, the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian or the chains that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.textEnEsv: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was 1,700 shekels of gold, besides the crescent ornaments and the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian, and besides the collars that were around the necks of their camels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the weight of the gold earrings that he requested was one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold, besides the crescent ornaments, pendants, and purple robes which were on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains that were around their camels’ necks.
verses.textEnNlt: The weight of the gold earrings was forty-three pounds, not including the royal ornaments and pendants, the purple clothing worn by the kings of Midian, or the chains around the necks of their camels.
verses.textEnNasb: The weight of the gold earrings that he requested was 1,700 shekels of gold, apart from the crescent amulets, the ear pendants, and the purple robes which were on the kings of Midian, and apart from the neck chains that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.textEn: The weight of the gold rings he asked for came to seventeen hundred shekels, not counting the ornaments, the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian or the chains that were on their camels’ necks.

verses.textZh: 基甸用这些金子做了一个以弗得，安置在他的城俄弗拉；后来以色列众人都在那里随从以弗得行了邪淫，因此这就成了基甸和他全家的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸用这些金子做了一个以弗得，安置在他的城俄弗拉；后来以色列众人都在那里随从以弗得行了邪淫，因此这就成了基甸和他全家的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸以此制造了一个以弗得，设立在本城俄弗拉。后来以色列人拜那以弗得行了邪淫；这就作了基甸和他全家的网罗。
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon made the gold into an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his town. All Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his family.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gideon made an ephod of it and put it in his city, in Ophrah. And all Israel whored after it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and to his family.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gideon made it into an ephod and set it up in his city, Ophrah. And all Israel played the harlot with it there. It became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon made a sacred ephod from the gold and put it in Ophrah, his hometown. But soon all the Israelites prostituted themselves by worshiping it, and it became a trap for Gideon and his family.
verses.textEnNasb: Gideon made it into an ephod, and placed it in his city, Ophrah; but all Israel committed infidelity with it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.
verses.textEn: Gideon made the gold into an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his town. All Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his family.

verses.textZh: 这样，米甸人在以色列人面前就被制伏了，不能再抬起头来；基甸在世的日子，国中太平了四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，米甸人在以色列人面前就被制伏了，不能再抬起头来；基甸在世的日子，国中太平了四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，米甸人被以色列人制伏了，不敢再抬头。基甸还在的日子，国中太平四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon’s lifetime, the land had peace forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: So Midian was subdued before the people of Israel, and they raised their heads no more. And the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted their heads no more. And the country was quiet for forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.textEnNlt: That is the story of how the people of Israel defeated Midian, which never recovered. Throughout the rest of Gideon’s lifetime—about forty years—there was peace in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So Midian was subdued before the sons of Israel, and they did not lift up their heads anymore. And the land was undisturbed for forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.textEn: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon’s lifetime, the land had peace forty years.

verses.textZh: 约阿施的儿子耶路．巴力回去，住在自己家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施的儿子耶路．巴力回去，住在自己家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施的儿子耶路‧巴力回去，住在自己家里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.
verses.textEnEsv: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Gideon son of Joash returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.
verses.textEn: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.

verses.textZh: 基甸有七十个儿子，都是他亲生的，因为他有很多妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸有七十个儿子，都是他亲生的，因为他有很多妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸有七十个亲生的儿子，因为他有许多的妻。
verses.textEnNiv: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Gideon had seventy sons, his own offspring, for he had many wives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gideon had seventy sons who were his own offspring, for he had many wives.
verses.textEnNlt: He had seventy sons born to him, for he had many wives.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Gideon had seventy sons who were his direct descendants, for he had many wives.
verses.textEn: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.

verses.textZh: 他在示剑的妾，也给他生了一个儿子，他给他起名叫亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在示剑的妾，也给他生了一个儿子，他给他起名叫亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的妾住在示剑，也给他生了一个儿子。基甸与他起名叫亚比米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: His concubine, who lived in Shechem, also bore him a son, whom he named Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he called his name Abimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: He also had a concubine in Shechem, who gave birth to a son, whom he named Abimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: And his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
verses.textEn: His concubine, who lived in Shechem, also bore him a son, whom he named Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 约阿施的儿子基甸寿数满足而死，埋葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约阿施的儿子基甸寿数满足而死，埋葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约阿施的儿子基甸，年纪老迈而死，葬在亚比以谢族的俄弗拉，在他父亲约阿施的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Gideon the son of Joash died at a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.textEnNlt: Gideon died when he was very old, and he was buried in the grave of his father, Joash, at Ophrah in the land of the clan of Abiezer.
verses.textEnNasb: And Gideon the son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.textEn: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.textZh: 基甸死了以后，以色列人又转去随从众巴力，行邪淫，并且以巴力．比利土作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基甸死了以后，以色列人又转去随从众巴力，行邪淫，并且以巴力．比利土作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 基甸死后，以色列人又去随从诸巴力行邪淫，以巴力‧比利土为他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Gideon died, the people of Israel turned again and whored after the Baals and made Baal-berith their god.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel again played the harlot with the Baals, and made Baal-Berith their god.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Gideon died, the Israelites prostituted themselves by worshiping the images of Baal, making Baal-berith their god.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the sons of Israel again committed infidelity with the Baals, and made Baal-berith their god.
verses.textEn: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god

verses.textZh: 以色列人忘记了耶和华他们的神，就是曾经拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的那位；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人忘记了耶和华他们的神，就是曾经拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的那位；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人不记念耶和华－他们的神，就是拯救他们脱离四围仇敌之手的，
verses.textEnNiv: and did not remember the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel did not remember the Lord their God, who had delivered them from the hand of all their enemies on every side,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the children of Israel did not remember the Lord their God, who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side;
verses.textEnNlt: They forgot the Lord their God, who had rescued them from all their enemies surrounding them.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel did not remember the Lord their God, who had saved them from the hands of all their enemies on every side;
verses.textEn: and did not remember the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.

verses.textZh: 也没有照着基甸向以色列人所施的一切恩惠，恩待耶路．巴力，就是基甸的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也没有照着基甸向以色列人所施的一切恩惠，恩待耶路．巴力，就是基甸的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不照着耶路‧巴力，就是基甸向他们所施的恩惠厚待他的家。
verses.textEnNiv: They also failed to show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) in spite of all the good things he had done for them.
verses.textEnEsv: and they did not show steadfast love to the family of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) in return for all the good that he had done to Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (Gideon) in accordance with the good he had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Nor did they show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-baal (that is, Gideon), despite all the good he had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: nor did they show kindness to the household of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) in accordance with all the good that he had done for Israel.
verses.textEn: They also failed to show any loyalty to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) in spite of all the good things he had done for them.

verses.textZh: 耶路．巴力的儿子亚比米勒，到示剑去见他的众母舅，对他们和他母亲的全体族人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路．巴力的儿子亚比米勒，到示剑去见他的众母舅，对他们和他母亲的全体族人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路‧巴力的儿子亚比米勒到了示剑见他的众母舅，对他们和他外祖全家的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother’s brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother’s clan,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s relatives and said to them and to the whole clan of his mother’s family,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem, to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: One day Gideon’s son Abimelech went to Shechem to visit his uncles—his mother’s brothers. He said to them and to the rest of his mother’s family,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem, to his mother’s relatives, and spoke to them and to the entire family of the household of his mother’s father, saying,
verses.textEn: Abimelek son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother’s brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother’s clan,

verses.textZh: "请你们给示剑的众人说：‘是耶路．巴力的众子七十人都统治你们好呢？还是一个人统治你们好呢？’你们也要记得我是你们的骨肉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "请你们给示剑的众人说：‘是耶路．巴力的众子七十人都统治你们好呢？还是一个人统治你们好呢？’你们也要记得我是你们的骨肉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「请你们问示剑的众人说，是耶路‧巴力的众子七十人都管理你们好呢？还是一人管理你们好呢？你们又要记念我是你们的骨肉。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Ask all the citizens of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you: to have all seventy of Jerub-Baal’s sons rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember, I am your flesh and blood."
verses.textEnEsv: "Say in the ears of all the leaders of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you, that all seventy of the sons of Jerubbaal rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Please speak in the hearing of all the men of Shechem: ‘Which is better for you, that all seventy of the sons of Jerubbaal reign over you, or that one reign over you?’ Remember that I am your own flesh and bone."
verses.textEnNlt: "Ask the leading citizens of Shechem whether they want to be ruled by all seventy of Gideon’s sons or by one man. And remember that I am your own flesh and blood!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak, now, in the hearing of all the leaders of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you: for seventy men, all the sons of Jerubbaal, to rule over you, or for one man to rule over you?’ Also, remember that I am your bone and your flesh."
verses.textEn: "Ask all the citizens of Shechem, ‘Which is better for you: to have all seventy of Jerub-Baal’s sons rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember, I am your flesh and blood."

verses.textZh: 他的众母舅就把这一切话为他说给示剑的众人听；他们的心都倾向亚比米勒，因为他们说："他本是我们的亲族。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的众母舅就把这一切话为他说给示剑的众人听；他们的心都倾向亚比米勒，因为他们说："他本是我们的亲族。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的众母舅便将这一切话为他说给示剑人听，示剑人的心就归向亚比米勒。他们说：「他原是我们的弟兄」；
verses.textEnNiv: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, "He is related to us."
verses.textEnEsv: And his mother’s relatives spoke all these words on his behalf in the ears of all the leaders of Shechem, and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."
verses.textEnNkjv: And his mother’s brothers spoke all these words concerning him in the hearing of all the men of Shechem; and their heart was inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."
verses.textEnNlt: So Abimelech’s uncles gave his message to all the citizens of Shechem on his behalf. And after listening to this proposal, the people of Shechem decided in favor of Abimelech because he was their relative.
verses.textEnNasb: So his mother’s relatives spoke all these words on his behalf in the hearing of all the leaders of Shechem; and they were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our relative."
verses.textEn: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, "He is related to us."

verses.textZh: 他们就从巴力．比利土的庙里，取了八百克银子给亚比米勒，亚比米勒用这些银子雇了一些无赖流氓，那些人就跟随了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就从巴力．比利土的庙里，取了八百克银子给亚比米勒，亚比米勒用这些银子雇了一些无赖流氓，那些人就跟随了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 就从巴力‧比利土的庙中取了七十舍客勒银子给亚比米勒；亚比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟随他。
verses.textEnNiv: They gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, and Abimelek used it to hire reckless scoundrels, who became his followers.
verses.textEnEsv: And they gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless fellows, who followed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless men; and they followed him.
verses.textEnNlt: They gave him seventy silver coins from the temple of Baal-berith, which he used to hire some reckless troublemakers who agreed to follow him.
verses.textEnNasb: And they gave him seventy pieces of silver from the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless men, and they followed him.
verses.textEn: They gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-Berith, and Abimelek used it to hire reckless scoundrels, who became his followers.

verses.textZh: 他回到俄弗拉他父亲的家，把自己的兄弟，耶路．巴力的众子七十人，都杀在一块石头上；只剩下耶路．巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他藏了起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回到俄弗拉他父亲的家，把自己的兄弟，耶路．巴力的众子七十人，都杀在一块石头上；只剩下耶路．巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他藏了起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他往俄弗拉到他父亲的家，将他弟兄、耶路‧巴力的众子七十人都杀在一块磐石上；只剩下耶路‧巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他躲藏了。
verses.textEnNiv: He went to his father’s home in Ophrah and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerub-Baal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerub-Baal, escaped by hiding.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went to his father’s house at Ophrah and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men, on one stone. But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went to his father’s house at Ophrah and killed his brothers, the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, on one stone. But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, because he hid himself.
verses.textEnNlt: He went to his father’s home at Ophrah, and there, on one stone, they killed all seventy of his half brothers, the sons of Gideon. But the youngest brother, Jotham, escaped and hid.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went to his father’s house in Ophrah and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men, on one stone. But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, because he hid himself.
verses.textEn: He went to his father’s home in Ophrah and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerub-Baal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerub-Baal, escaped by hiding.

verses.textZh: 示剑的众人和伯特米罗人都聚集起来，到示剑橡树旁的望楼那里，立亚比米勒为王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑的众人和伯特米罗人都聚集起来，到示剑橡树旁的望楼那里，立亚比米勒为王。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑人和米罗人都一同聚集，往示剑橡树旁的柱子那里，立亚比米勒为王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelek king.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the leaders of Shechem came together, and all Beth-millo, and they went and made Abimelech king, by the oak of the pillar at Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, all of Beth Millo, and they went and made Abimelech king beside the terebinth tree at the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the leading citizens of Shechem and Beth-millo called a meeting under the oak beside the pillar at Shechem and made Abimelech their king.
verses.textEnNasb: All the leaders of Shechem and all Beth-millo assembled together, and they went and made Abimelech king, by the oak of the memorial stone which was in Shechem.
verses.textEn: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelek king.

verses.textZh: 有人把这事告诉了约坦，约坦就去，站在基利心山顶上，高声向他们呼喊，说："示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，神也就听你们的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把这事告诉了约坦，约坦就去，站在基利心山顶上，高声向他们呼喊，说："示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，神也就听你们的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人将这事告诉约坦，他就去站在基利心山顶上，向众人大声喊叫说：「示剑人哪，你们要听我的话，神也就听你们的话。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jotham was told about this, he climbed up on the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted to them, "Listen to me, citizens of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.
verses.textEnEsv: When it was told to Jotham, he went and stood on top of Mount Gerizim and cried aloud and said to them, "Listen to me, you leaders of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they told Jotham, he went and stood on top of Mount Gerizim, and lifted his voice and cried out. And he said to them: "Listen to me, you men of Shechem, That God may listen to you!
verses.textEnNlt: When Jotham heard about this, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted, "Listen to me, citizens of Shechem! Listen to me if you want God to listen to you!
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they told Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim, and raised his voice and called out. And he said to them, "Listen to me, you leaders of Shechem, that God may listen to you.
verses.textEn: When Jotham was told about this, he climbed up on the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted to them, "Listen to me, citizens of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.

verses.textZh: 有一次，众树要去膏立一个王统治它们，就对橄榄树说：‘请你作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，众树要去膏立一个王统治它们，就对橄榄树说：‘请你作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 有一时，树木要膏一树为王，管理他们，就去对橄榄树说：『请你作我们的王。』
verses.textEnNiv: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king.’
verses.textEnEsv: The trees once went out to anoint a king over them, and they said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "The trees once went forth to anoint a king over them. And they said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us!’
verses.textEnNlt: Once upon a time the trees decided to choose a king. First they said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king!’
verses.textEnNasb: Once the trees went to anoint a king over them, and they said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us!’
verses.textEn: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Be our king.’

verses.textZh: 橄榄树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃生产人用来荣耀神和尊崇人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 橄榄树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃生产人用来荣耀神和尊崇人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 橄榄树回答说：『我岂肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "But the olive tree answered, ‘Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and humans are honored, to hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnEsv: But the olive tree said to them, ‘Shall I leave my abundance, by which gods and men are honored, and go hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I cease giving my oil, With which they honor God and men, And go to sway over trees?’
verses.textEnNlt: But the olive tree refused, saying, ‘Should I quit producing the olive oil that blesses both God and people, just to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.textEnNasb: But the olive tree said to them, ‘Shall I give up my fatness with which God and mankind are honored, and go to wave over the trees?’
verses.textEn: "But the olive tree answered, ‘Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and humans are honored, to hold sway over the trees?’

verses.textZh: 众树对无花果树说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 众树对无花果树说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 树木对无花果树说：『请你来作我们的王。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and reign over us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You come and reign over us!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then they said to the fig tree, ‘You be our king!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You, come, reign over us!’
verses.textEn: "Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’

verses.textZh: 无花果树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃结出我的甜美果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 无花果树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃结出我的甜美果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 无花果树回答说：『我岂肯止住所结甜美的果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnEsv: But the fig tree said to them, ‘Shall I leave my sweetness and my good fruit and go hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I cease my sweetness and my good fruit, And go to sway over trees?’
verses.textEnNlt: But the fig tree also refused, saying, ‘Should I quit producing my sweet fruit just to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.textEnNasb: But the fig tree said to them, ‘Shall I give up my sweetness and my good fruit, and go to wave over the trees?’
verses.textEn: "But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?’

verses.textZh: 众树对葡萄树说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 众树对葡萄树说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 树木对葡萄树说：『请你来作我们的王。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the trees said to the vine, ‘You come and reign over us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the trees said to the vine, ‘You come and reign over us!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then they said to the grapevine, ‘You be our king!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the trees said to the vine, ‘You, come, reign over us!’
verses.textEn: "Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’

verses.textZh: 葡萄树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃生产那使神和世人都喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 葡萄树对它们说：‘我怎可以放弃生产那使神和世人都喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 葡萄树回答说：『我岂肯止住使神和人喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "But the vine answered, ‘Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and humans, to hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnEsv: But the vine said to them, ‘Shall I leave my wine that cheers God and men and go hold sway over the trees?’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the vine said to them, ‘Should I cease my new wine, Which cheers both God and men, And go to sway over trees?’
verses.textEnNlt: But the grapevine also refused, saying, ‘Should I quit producing the wine that cheers both God and people, just to wave back and forth over the trees?’
verses.textEnNasb: But the vine said to them, ‘Shall I give up my new wine, which cheers God and mankind, and go to wave over the trees?’
verses.textEn: "But the vine answered, ‘Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and humans, to hold sway over the trees?’

verses.textZh: 于是众树都对荆棘说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众树都对荆棘说：‘请你来作王统治我们吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 众树对荆棘说：『请你来作我们的王。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘You come and reign over us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘You come and reign over us!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Then all the trees finally turned to the thornbush and said, ‘Come, you be our king!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘You, come, reign over us!’
verses.textEn: "Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’

verses.textZh: 荆棘对众树说：‘如果你们真诚地膏立我作王统治你们，就要来，投靠在我的荫下；否则，火必从荆棘里出来，吞灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 荆棘对众树说：‘如果你们真诚地膏立我作王统治你们，就要来，投靠在我的荫下；否则，火必从荆棘里出来，吞灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。’
verses.textZhCuv: 荆棘回答说：『你们若诚诚实实地膏我为王，就要投在我的荫下；不然，愿火从荆棘里出来，烧灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。』
verses.textEnNiv: "The thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you really want to anoint me king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!’
verses.textEnEsv: And the bramble said to the trees, ‘If in good faith you are anointing me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade, but if not, let fire come out of the bramble and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me as king over you, Then come and take shelter in my shade; But if not, let fire come out of the bramble And devour the cedars of Lebanon!’
verses.textEnNlt: And the thornbush replied to the trees, ‘If you truly want to make me your king, come and take shelter in my shade. If not, let fire come out from me and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And the bramble said to the trees, ‘If you really are anointing me as king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, may fire come out of the bramble and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
verses.textEn: "The thornbush said to the trees, ‘If you really want to anoint me king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!’

verses.textZh: "现在你们立亚比米勒为王，你们若是诚实和正直，如果你们善待耶路．巴力和他的家，照着他手所作的待他；
verses.textZhCnvs: "现在你们立亚比米勒为王，你们若是诚实和正直，如果你们善待耶路．巴力和他的家，照着他手所作的待他；
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在你们立亚比米勒为王，若按诚实正直善待耶路‧巴力和他的全家，这就是酬他的劳。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you acted honorably and in good faith by making Abimelek king? Have you been fair to Jerub-Baal and his family? Have you treated him as he deserves?
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore, if you acted in good faith and integrity when you made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house and have done to him as his deeds deserved—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, if you have acted in truth and sincerity in making Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him as he deserves—
verses.textEnNlt: Jotham continued, "Now make sure you have acted honorably and in good faith by making Abimelech your king, and that you have done right by Gideon and all of his descendants. Have you treated him with the honor he deserves for all he accomplished?
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, if you have acted with honesty and integrity in making Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have dealt with him as he deserved—
verses.textEn: "Have you acted honorably and in good faith by making Abimelek king? Have you been fair to Jerub-Baal and his family? Have you treated him as he deserves?

verses.textZh: 我父亲从前冒死为你们争战，把你们从米甸人手中救了出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父亲从前冒死为你们争战，把你们从米甸人手中救了出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 从前我父冒死为你们争战，救了你们脱离米甸人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember that my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from the hand of Midian.
verses.textEnEsv: for my father fought for you and risked his life and delivered you from the hand of Midian,
verses.textEnNkjv: for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;
verses.textEnNlt: For he fought for you and risked his life when he rescued you from the Midianites.
verses.textEnNasb: for my father fought for you, and risked his life and saved you from the hand of Midian;
verses.textEn: Remember that my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from the hand of Midian.

verses.textZh: 今日你们竟起来攻击我的父家，在一块石头上杀了他七十个儿子，又立了他的婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒作示剑人的王，因为他原是你们的亲族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今日你们竟起来攻击我的父家，在一块石头上杀了他七十个儿子，又立了他的婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒作示剑人的王，因为他原是你们的亲族。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们如今起来攻击我的父家，将他众子七十人杀在一块磐石上，又立他婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒为示剑人的王；他原是你们的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: But today you have revolted against my father’s family. You have murdered his seventy sons on a single stone and have made Abimelek, the son of his female slave, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is related to you.
verses.textEnEsv: and you have risen up against my father’s house this day and have killed his sons, seventy men on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the leaders of Shechem, because he is your relative—
verses.textEnNkjv: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day, and killed his seventy sons on one stone, and made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother—
verses.textEnNlt: But today you have revolted against my father and his descendants, killing his seventy sons on one stone. And you have chosen his slave woman’s son, Abimelech, to be your king just because he is your relative.
verses.textEnNasb: but in fact you have risen against my father’s house today and have killed his sons, seventy men, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female slave, king over the leaders of Shechem, because he is your relative—
verses.textEn: But today you have revolted against my father’s family. You have murdered his seventy sons on a single stone and have made Abimelek, the son of his female slave, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is related to you.

verses.textZh: 今日你们若是按着诚实和正直待耶路．巴力和他的家，你们就可以因亚比米勒得喜乐，亚比米勒也可以因你们得喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今日你们若是按着诚实和正直待耶路．巴力和他的家，你们就可以因亚比米勒得喜乐，亚比米勒也可以因你们得喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们如今若按诚实正直待耶路‧巴力和他的家，就可因亚比米勒得欢乐，他也可因你们得欢乐；
verses.textEnNiv: So have you acted honorably and in good faith toward Jerub-Baal and his family today? If you have, may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!
verses.textEnEsv: if you then have acted in good faith and integrity with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: if then you have acted in truth and sincerity with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.
verses.textEnNlt: "If you have acted honorably and in good faith toward Gideon and his descendants today, then may you find joy in Abimelech, and may he find joy in you.
verses.textEnNasb: so if you have acted with honesty and integrity toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, be joyful about Abimelech, and may he also be joyful about you.
verses.textEn: So have you acted honorably and in good faith toward Jerub-Baal and his family today? If you have, may Abimelek be your joy, and may you be his, too!

verses.textZh: 若不是这样，愿火从亚比米勒出来，吞灭示剑人和伯特米罗人；又愿火从示剑人和伯特米罗人出来，吞灭亚比米勒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 若不是这样，愿火从亚比米勒出来，吞灭示剑人和伯特米罗人；又愿火从示剑人和伯特米罗人出来，吞灭亚比米勒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不然，愿火从亚比米勒发出，烧灭示剑人和米罗众人，又愿火从示剑人和米罗人中出来，烧灭亚比米勒。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you have not, let fire come out from Abimelek and consume you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelek!"
verses.textEnEsv: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo; and let fire come out from the leaders of Shechem and from Beth-millo and devour Abimelech."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if not, let fire come from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and Beth Millo; and let fire come from the men of Shechem and from Beth Millo and devour Abimelech!"
verses.textEnNlt: But if you have not acted in good faith, then may fire come out from Abimelech and devour the leading citizens of Shechem and Beth-millo; and may fire come out from the citizens of Shechem and Beth-millo and devour Abimelech!"
verses.textEnNasb: But if not, may fire come out of Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo; and may fire come out of the leaders of Shechem and from Beth-millo, and consume Abimelech."
verses.textEn: But if you have not, let fire come out from Abimelek and consume you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelek!"

verses.textZh: 接着约坦就逃跑了；他逃到比珥去，住在那里，躲避他的兄弟亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着约坦就逃跑了；他逃到比珥去，住在那里，躲避他的兄弟亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 约坦因怕他弟兄亚比米勒，就逃跑，来到比珥，住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jotham ran away and fled and went to Beer and lived there, because of Abimelech his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jotham ran away and fled; and he went to Beer and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jotham escaped and lived in Beer because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jotham escaped and fled, and went to Beer; and he stayed there because of his brother Abimelech.
verses.textEn: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒治理以色列人三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒治理以色列人三年。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒管理以色列人三年。
verses.textEnNiv: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,
verses.textEnEsv: Abimelech ruled over Israel three years.
verses.textEnNkjv: After Abimelech had reigned over Israel three years,
verses.textEnNlt: After Abimelech had ruled over Israel for three years,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abimelech ruled over Israel for three years.
verses.textEn: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,

verses.textZh: 神差派邪恶的灵来到亚比米勒与示剑人中间，示剑人就背弃了亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神差派邪恶的灵来到亚比米勒与示剑人中间，示剑人就背弃了亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使恶魔降在亚比米勒和示剑人中间，示剑人就以诡诈待亚比米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: God stirred up animosity between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
verses.textEnNkjv: God sent a spirit of ill will between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
verses.textEnNlt: God sent a spirit that stirred up trouble between Abimelech and the leading citizens of Shechem, and they revolted.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem; and the leaders of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,
verses.textEn: God stirred up animosity between Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem so that they acted treacherously against Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 这是要报复对耶路．巴力七十个儿子的暴行，把流他们血的罪归到他们的兄弟亚比米勒身上，就是那杀害他们的；也归到示剑人身上，就是那些帮助亚比米勒去杀他自己的兄弟的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是要报复对耶路．巴力七十个儿子的暴行，把流他们血的罪归到他们的兄弟亚比米勒身上，就是那杀害他们的；也归到示剑人身上，就是那些帮助亚比米勒去杀他自己的兄弟的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是要叫耶路‧巴力七十个儿子所受的残害归与他们的哥哥亚比米勒，又叫那流他们血的罪归与帮助他杀弟兄的示剑人。
verses.textEnNiv: God did this in order that the crime against Jerub-Baal’s seventy sons, the shedding of their blood, might be avenged on their brother Abimelek and on the citizens of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid on Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and on the men of Shechem, who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the crime done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might be settled and their blood be laid on Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and on the men of Shechem, who aided him in the killing of his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: God was punishing Abimelech for murdering Gideon’s seventy sons, and the citizens of Shechem for supporting him in this treachery of murdering his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal would come, and the responsibility for their blood would be placed on their brother Abimelech, who killed them, and on the leaders of Shechem, who encouraged him to kill his brothers.
verses.textEn: God did this in order that the crime against Jerub-Baal’s seventy sons, the shedding of their blood, might be avenged on their brother Abimelek and on the citizens of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.

verses.textZh: 示剑人在山顶上设下埋伏，路过他们那里的，他们都劫掠；有人把这事告诉亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑人在山顶上设下埋伏，路过他们那里的，他们都劫掠；有人把这事告诉亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑人在山顶上设埋伏，等候亚比米勒。凡从他们那里经过的人，他们就抢夺。有人将这事告诉亚比米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: In opposition to him these citizens of Shechem set men on the hilltops to ambush and rob everyone who passed by, and this was reported to Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And the leaders of Shechem put men in ambush against him on the mountaintops, and they robbed all who passed by them along that way. And it was told to Abimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Shechem set men in ambush against him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who passed by them along that way; and it was told Abimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: The citizens of Shechem set an ambush for Abimelech on the hilltops and robbed everyone who passed that way. But someone warned Abimelech about their plot.
verses.textEnNasb: The leaders of Shechem set up men in ambush against him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed everyone who would pass by them on the road; and it was reported to Abimelech.
verses.textEn: In opposition to him these citizens of Shechem set men on the hilltops to ambush and rob everyone who passed by, and this was reported to Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 那时，以别的儿子迦勒与他的兄弟都来了，到示剑去，示剑人竟信任他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以别的儿子迦勒与他的兄弟都来了，到示剑去，示剑人竟信任他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄来到示剑，示剑人都信靠他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gaal the son of Ebed moved into Shechem with his relatives, and the leaders of Shechem put confidence in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Gaal son of Ebed moved to Shechem with his brothers and gained the confidence of the leading citizens of Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Gaal the son of Ebed came with his relatives, and crossed over into Shechem; and the leaders of Shechem trusted him.
verses.textEn: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.

verses.textZh: 他们出到田间去，收取葡萄，榨酒，举行庆祝会，进入他们的神庙吃喝，并且咒诅亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们出到田间去，收取葡萄，榨酒，举行庆祝会，进入他们的神庙吃喝，并且咒诅亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑人出城到田间去，摘下葡萄，踹酒，设摆筵宴，进他们神的庙中吃喝，咒诅亚比米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had gone out into the fields and gathered the grapes and trodden them, they held a festival in the temple of their god. While they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went out into the field and gathered the grapes from their vineyards and trod them and held a festival; and they went into the house of their god and ate and drank and reviled Abimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out into the fields, and gathered grapes from their vineyards and trod them, and made merry. And they went into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: During the annual harvest festival at Shechem, held in the temple of the local god, the wine flowed freely, and everyone began cursing Abimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went out to the field and gathered the grapes of their vineyards and trampled them, and held a festival; and they went into the house of their god, and ate and drank and cursed Abimelech.
verses.textEn: After they had gone out into the fields and gathered the grapes and trodden them, they held a festival in the temple of their god. While they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 以别的儿子迦勒说："亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？竟要我们服事他呢？他不是耶路．巴力的儿子吗？他的副官不是西布勒吗？你们要服事示剑的始祖哈抹的后人啊；我们为甚么要服事亚比米勒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以别的儿子迦勒说："亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？竟要我们服事他呢？他不是耶路．巴力的儿子吗？他的副官不是西布勒吗？你们要服事示剑的始祖哈抹的后人啊；我们为甚么要服事亚比米勒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以别的儿子迦勒说：「亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？使我们服事他呢？他不是耶路‧巴力的儿子吗？他的帮手不是西布勒吗？你们可以服事示剑的父亲哈抹的后裔。我们为何服事亚比米勒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelek, and why should we Shechemites be subject to him? Isn’t he Jerub-Baal’s son, and isn’t Zebul his deputy? Serve the family of Hamor, Shechem’s father! Why should we serve Abimelek?
verses.textEnEsv: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who are we of Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is not Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem; but why should we serve him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Gaal the son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Ishe not the son of Jerubbaal, and isnot Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem; but why should we serve him?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is Abimelech?" Gaal shouted. "He’s not a true son of Shechem, so why should we be his servants? He’s merely the son of Gideon, and this Zebul is merely his deputy. Serve the true sons of Hamor, the founder of Shechem. Why should we serve Abimelech?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Gaal the son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is Zebul not his governor? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem; but why should we serve him?
verses.textEn: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelek, and why should we Shechemites be subject to him? Isn’t he Jerub-Baal’s son, and isn’t Zebul his deputy? Serve the family of Hamor, Shechem’s father! Why should we serve Abimelek?

verses.textZh: 但愿这些人民都归在我手下，我好把亚比米勒除掉。"迦勒又对亚比米勒说："增添你的军队出来吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿这些人民都归在我手下，我好把亚比米勒除掉。"迦勒又对亚比米勒说："增添你的军队出来吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿这民归我的手下，我就除掉亚比米勒。」迦勒又对亚比米勒说：「增添你的军兵出来吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: If only this people were under my command! Then I would get rid of him. I would say to Abimelek, ‘Call out your whole army!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Would that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech. I would say to Abimelech, ‘Increase your army, and come out.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: If only this people were under my authority! Then I would remove Abimelech." So he said to Abimelech, "Increase your army and come out!"
verses.textEnNlt: If I were in charge here, I would get rid of Abimelech. I would say to him, ‘Get some soldiers, and come out and fight!’"
verses.textEnNasb: If only this people were under my authority! Then I would do away with Abimelech." And he said to Abimelech, "Enlarge your army and come out!"
verses.textEn: If only this people were under my command! Then I would get rid of him. I would say to Abimelek, ‘Call out your whole army!’ "

verses.textZh: 那城的首长西布勒听了以别的儿子迦勒的话，他的怒气就发作，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那城的首长西布勒听了以别的儿子迦勒的话，他的怒气就发作，
verses.textZhCuv: 邑宰西布勒听见以别的儿子迦勒的话，就发怒，
verses.textEnNiv: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.
verses.textEnEsv: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Zebul, the ruler of the city, heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was aroused.
