verses.textEnNlt: But when Zebul, the leader of the city, heard what Gaal was saying, he was furious.
verses.textEnNasb: When Zebul the leader of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.
verses.textEn: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.

verses.textZh: 秘密差派使者去见亚比米勒，说："以别的儿子迦勒和他的兄弟已经到了示剑，他们正在煽动 那城的人反叛你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 秘密差派使者去见亚比米勒，说："以别的儿子迦勒和他的兄弟已经到了示剑，他们正在煽动 那城的人反叛你。
verses.textZhCuv: 悄悄地打发人去见亚比米勒，说：「以别的儿子迦勒和他的弟兄到了示剑，煽惑城中的民攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: Under cover he sent messengers to Abimelek, saying, "Gaal son of Ebed and his clan have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, "Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his relatives have come to Shechem, and they are stirring up the city against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sent messengers to Abimelech secretly, saying, "Take note! Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and here they are, fortifying the city against you.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent messengers to Abimelech in Arumah, telling him, "Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to live in Shechem, and now they are inciting the city to rebel against you.
verses.textEnNasb: So using deception, he successfully sent messengers to Abimelech, saying, "Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his relatives have come to Shechem; and behold, they are stirring up the city against you.
verses.textEn: Under cover he sent messengers to Abimelek, saying, "Gaal son of Ebed and his clan have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.

verses.textZh: 现在，你和与你在一起的人，要在夜间起来，在野地埋伏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你和与你在一起的人，要在夜间起来，在野地埋伏。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你和跟随你的人今夜起来，在田间埋伏。
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, go by night, you and the people who are with you, and set an ambush in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, get up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: Come by night with an army and hide out in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, arise by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.
verses.textEn: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，太阳出来的时候，你就要起来攻城；你要注意，迦勒和与他在一起的人出来对抗你的时候，你就把握机会对付他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，太阳出来的时候，你就要起来攻城；你要注意，迦勒和与他在一起的人出来对抗你的时候，你就把握机会对付他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到早晨太阳一出，你就起来闯城。迦勒和跟随他的人出来攻击你的时候，你便向他们见机而做。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning at sunrise, advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, seize the opportunity to attack them."
verses.textEnEsv: Then in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, rise early and rush upon the city. And when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may do to them as your hand finds to do."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, as soon as the sun is up in the morning, that you shall rise early and rush upon the city; and when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may then do to them as you find opportunity."
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning, as soon as it is daylight, attack the city. When Gaal and those who are with him come out against you, you can do with them as you wish."
verses.textEnNasb: Then in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and attack the city; and behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you shall do to them whatever you can."
verses.textEn: In the morning at sunrise, advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, seize the opportunity to attack them."

verses.textZh: 于是亚比米勒和与他在一起的人，都在夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏着等候示剑人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚比米勒和与他在一起的人，都在夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏着等候示剑人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，亚比米勒和跟随他的众人夜间起来，分作四队，埋伏等候示剑人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abimelek and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abimelech and all the men who were with him rose up by night and set an ambush against Shechem in four companies.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abimelech and all the people who were with him rose by night, and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abimelech and all his men went by night and split into four groups, stationing themselves around Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abimelech and all the people who were with him got up at night, and lay in wait against Shechem, in four units.
verses.textEn: So Abimelek and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.

verses.textZh: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口；亚比米勒和与他在一起的人，从埋伏的地方起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口；亚比米勒和与他在一起的人，从埋伏的地方起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以别的儿子迦勒出去，站在城门口。亚比米勒和跟随他的人从埋伏之处起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelek and his troops came out from their hiding place.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city, and Abimelech and the people who were with him rose from the ambush.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood in the entrance to the city gate, Abimelech and the people who were with him rose from lying in wait.
verses.textEnNlt: Gaal was standing at the city gates when Abimelech and his army came out of hiding.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood at the entrance of the city gate; and Abimelech and the people who were with him arose from the ambush.
verses.textEn: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelek and his troops came out from their hiding place.

verses.textZh: 迦勒看见了那些人，就对西布勒说："你看，有人从山顶上下来。"西布勒说："你看见山的影子以为是人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒看见了那些人，就对西布勒说："你看，有人从山顶上下来。"西布勒说："你看见山的影子以为是人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒看见那些人，就对西布勒说：「看哪，有人从山顶上下来了。」西布勒说：「你看见山的影子，以为是人。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" Zebul replied, "You mistake the shadows of the mountains for men."
verses.textEnEsv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the mountaintops!" And Zebul said to him, "You mistake the shadow of the mountains for men."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" But Zebul said to him, "You see the shadows of the mountains as iftheywere men."
verses.textEnNlt: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, "Look, there are people coming down from the hilltops!" Zebul replied, "It’s just the shadows on the hills that look like men."
verses.textEnNasb: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, " Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains." But Zebul said to him, "You are seeing the shadow of the mountains as if they were people."
verses.textEn: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" Zebul replied, "You mistake the shadows of the mountains for men."

verses.textZh: 迦勒又说："看哪，有人从高地下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路径而来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒又说："看哪，有人从高地下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路径而来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒又说：「看哪，有人从高处下来，又有一队从米恶尼尼橡树的路上而来。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Gaal spoke up again: "Look, people are coming down from the central hill, and a company is coming from the direction of the diviners’ tree."
verses.textEnEsv: Gaal spoke again and said, "Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and one company is coming from the direction of the Diviners’ Oak."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gaal spoke again and said, "See, people are coming down from the center of the land, and another company is coming from the Diviners’ Terebinth Tree."
verses.textEnNlt: But again Gaal said, "No, people are coming down from the hills. And another group is coming down the road past the Diviners’ Oak. "
verses.textEnNasb: And Gaal spoke yet again and said, "Look, people are coming down from the highest part of the land, and one unit is coming by way of the diviners’ oak."
verses.textEn: But Gaal spoke up again: "Look, people are coming down from the central hill, and a company is coming from the direction of the diviners’ tree."

verses.textZh: 西布勒对他说："你曾经说过：‘亚比米勒是谁，竟要我们服事他呢？’现在你说这话的嘴在哪里呢？这不是你轻视的人吗？现在请你出去与他们交战吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布勒对他说："你曾经说过：‘亚比米勒是谁，竟要我们服事他呢？’现在你说这话的嘴在哪里呢？这不是你轻视的人吗？现在请你出去与他们交战吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西布勒对他说：「你曾说，亚比米勒是谁，叫我们服事他？你所夸的口在哪里呢？这不是你所藐视的民吗？你现在出去，与他们交战吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your big talk now, you who said, ‘Who is Abimelek that we should be subject to him?’ Aren’t these the men you ridiculed? Go out and fight them!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your mouth now, you who said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Are not these the people whom you despised? Go out now and fight with them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zebul said to him, "Where indeed is your mouth now, with which you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Are not these the people whom you despised? Go out, if you will, and fight with them now."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zebul turned on him and asked, "Now where is that big mouth of yours? Wasn’t it you that said, ‘Who is Abimelech, and why should we be his servants?’ The men you mocked are right outside the city! Go out and fight them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zebul said to him, "Where then is your boasting with which you said, ‘Who is Abimelech that we should serve him?’ Is this not the people whom you rejected? Go out now and fight them!"
verses.textEn: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your big talk now, you who said, ‘Who is Abimelek that we should be subject to him?’ Aren’t these the men you ridiculed? Go out and fight them!"

verses.textZh: 于是迦勒在示剑人面前出去，与亚比米勒争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是迦勒在示剑人面前出去，与亚比米勒争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是迦勒率领示剑人出去，与亚比米勒交战。
verses.textEnNiv: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: And Gaal went out at the head of the leaders of Shechem and fought with Abimelech.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Gaal went out, leading the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: So Gaal led the leading citizens of Shechem into battle against Abimelech.
verses.textEnNasb: So Gaal went out in the sight of the leaders of Shechem and fought Abimelech.
verses.textEn: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒，迦勒在他面前逃跑，直到城门口，有很多受伤的人仆倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒，迦勒在他面前逃跑，直到城门口，有很多受伤的人仆倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒追赶迦勒；迦勒在他面前逃跑，有许多受伤仆倒的，直到城门。
verses.textEnNiv: Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate, and many were killed as they fled.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him. And many fell wounded, up to the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled from him; and many fell wounded, to the very entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: But Abimelech chased him, and many of Shechem’s men were wounded and fell along the road as they retreated to the city gate.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abimelech chased him, and he fled from him; and many fell wounded up to the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEn: Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate, and many were killed as they fled.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛；西布勒把迦勒和他的兄弟赶走，不许他们住在示剑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛；西布勒把迦勒和他的兄弟赶走，不许他们住在示剑。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒住在亚鲁玛。西布勒赶出迦勒和他弟兄，不准他们住在示剑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abimelek stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his clan out of Shechem.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech lived at Arumah, and Zebul drove out Gaal and his relatives, so that they could not dwell at Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech dwelt at Arumah, and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, so that they would not dwell in Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: Abimelech returned to Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech stayed in Arumah, but Zebul drove out Gaal and his relatives so that they could not stay in Shechem.
verses.textEn: Then Abimelek stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his clan out of Shechem.

verses.textZh: 次日，城中众人出到田间去，有人把这事告诉亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，城中众人出到田间去，有人把这事告诉亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，民出到田间，有人告诉亚比米勒；
verses.textEnNiv: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.
verses.textEnEsv: On the following day, the people went out into the field, and Abimelech was told.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came about on the next day that the people went out into the field, and they told Abimelech.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day the people of Shechem went out into the fields to battle. When Abimelech heard about it,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about the next day, that the people went out to the field, and it was reported to Abimelech.
verses.textEn: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间；他在那里观看，见有人从城里出来，就起来攻击他们，把他们击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间；他在那里观看，见有人从城里出来，就起来攻击他们，把他们击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就把他的人分作三队，埋伏在田间，看见示剑人从城里出来，就起来击杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose to attack them.
verses.textEnEsv: He took his people and divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. And he looked and saw the people coming out of the city. So he rose against them and killed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he took his people, divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the field. And he looked, and there were the people, coming out of the city; and he rose against them and attacked them.
verses.textEnNlt: he divided his men into three groups and set an ambush in the fields. When Abimelech saw the people coming out of the city, he and his men jumped up from their hiding places and attacked them.
verses.textEnNasb: So he took his people and divided them into three units, and lay in wait in the field; when he looked and saw the people coming out from the city, he attacked them and killed them.
verses.textEn: So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose to attack them.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒和与他在一起的一队人忽然冲过去，站在城门口；其他两队人也冲出来攻打所有在田间的人，把他们击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒和与他在一起的一队人忽然冲过去，站在城门口；其他两队人也冲出来攻打所有在田间的人，把他们击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒和跟随他的一队向前闯去，站在城门口；那两队直闯到田间，击杀了众人。
verses.textEnNiv: Abimelek and the companies with him rushed forward to a position at the entrance of the city gate. Then two companies attacked those in the fields and struck them down.
verses.textEnEsv: Abimelech and the company that was with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the gate of the city, while the two companies rushed upon all who were in the field and killed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech and the company that was with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the gate of the city; and the other two companies rushed upon all who were in the fields and killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: Abimelech and his group stormed the city gate to keep the men of Shechem from getting back in, while Abimelech’s other two groups cut them down in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech and the company who was with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the city gate; the other two companies then attacked all who were in the field and killed them.
verses.textEn: Abimelek and the companies with him rushed forward to a position at the entrance of the city gate. Then two companies attacked those in the fields and struck them down.

verses.textZh: 那一天，亚比米勒整天攻打那城，把城攻下了，杀了城中的众人；把城拆毁，又撒上盐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，亚比米勒整天攻打那城，把城攻下了，杀了城中的众人；把城拆毁，又撒上盐。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒整天攻打城，将城夺取，杀了其中的居民，将城拆毁，撒上了盐。
verses.textEnNiv: All that day Abimelek pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day. He captured the city and killed the people who were in it, and he razed the city and sowed it with salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abimelech fought against the city all that day; he took the city and killed the people who were in it; and he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
verses.textEnNlt: The battle went on all day before Abimelech finally captured the city. He killed the people, leveled the city, and scattered salt all over the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Abimelech fought against the city that whole day, and he captured the city and killed the people who were in it; then he tore down the city and sowed it with salt.
verses.textEn: All that day Abimelek pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.

verses.textZh: 示剑楼的众人听见了这事，就逃入伊勒．比利土庙的地穴里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑楼的众人听见了这事，就逃入伊勒．比利土庙的地穴里。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑楼的人听见了，就躲入巴力‧比利土庙的卫所。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.
verses.textEnEsv: When all the leaders of the Tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered the stronghold of the house of El-berith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all the men of the tower of Shechem had heard that, they entered the stronghold of the temple of the god Berith.
verses.textEnNlt: When the leading citizens who lived in the tower of Shechem heard what had happened, they ran and hid in the temple of Baal-berith.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the leaders of the tower of Shechem heard about it, they entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
verses.textEn: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉亚比米勒，说："示剑楼所有的人都聚集在一起。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉亚比米勒，说："示剑楼所有的人都聚集在一起。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉亚比米勒说：「示剑楼的人都聚在一处。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,
verses.textEnEsv: Abimelech was told that all the leaders of the Tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.textEnNlt: Someone reported to Abimelech that the citizens had gathered in the temple,
verses.textEnNasb: And it was reported to Abimelech that all the leaders of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.textEn: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒和与他在一起的人都上了撒们山；亚比米勒手里拿着斧子，砍下一根树枝，拿起来放在自己的肩头上，然后对与他在一起的人说："你们看我作甚么，你们也要赶快照样作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒和与他在一起的人都上了撒们山；亚比米勒手里拿着斧子，砍下一根树枝，拿起来放在自己的肩头上，然后对与他在一起的人说："你们看我作甚么，你们也要赶快照样作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒和跟随他的人就都上撒们山。亚比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根树枝，扛在肩上，对跟随他的人说：「你们看我所行的，也当赶紧照样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, "Quick! Do what you have seen me do!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him. And Abimelech took an axe in his hand and cut down a bundle of brushwood and took it up and laid it on his shoulder. And he said to the men who were with him, "What you have seen me do, hurry and do as I have done."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him. And Abimelech took an ax in his hand and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it and laid it on his shoulder; then he said to the people who were with him, "What you have seen me do, make haste and do as I havedone."
verses.textEnNlt: so he led his forces to Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and chopped some branches from a tree, then put them on his shoulder. "Quick, do as I have done!" he told his men.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand and cut down a branch from the trees, and lifted it and put it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, "What you saw me do, hurry and do likewise."
verses.textEn: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, "Quick! Do what you have seen me do!"

verses.textZh: 于是众人也各自砍下一根树枝，跟随着亚比米勒，把树枝放在地穴上，放火烧了地穴，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众人也各自砍下一根树枝，跟随着亚比米勒，把树枝放在地穴上，放火烧了地穴，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就各砍一枝，跟随亚比米勒，把树枝堆在卫所的四围，放火烧了卫所，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千。
verses.textEnNiv: So all the men cut branches and followed Abimelek. They piled them against the stronghold and set it on fire with the people still inside. So all the people in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, also died.
verses.textEnEsv: So every one of the people cut down his bundle and following Abimelech put it against the stronghold, and they set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the Tower of Shechem also died, about 1,000 men and women.
verses.textEnNkjv: So each of the people likewise cut down his own bough and followed Abimelech, put them against the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire above them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died, about a thousand men and women.
verses.textEnNlt: So each of them cut down some branches, following Abimelech’s example. They piled the branches against the walls of the temple and set them on fire. So all the people who had lived in the tower of Shechem died—about 1,000 men and women.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people also cut down, each one, his branch and followed Abimelech, and put them on top of the inner chamber and set the inner chamber on fire over those inside, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem also died, about a thousand men and women.
verses.textEn: So all the men cut branches and followed Abimelek. They piled them against the stronghold and set it on fire with the people still inside. So all the people in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, also died.

verses.textZh: 后来亚比米勒到提备斯去，安营攻打提备斯，攻取了那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来亚比米勒到提备斯去，安营攻打提备斯，攻取了那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒到提备斯，向提备斯安营，就攻取了那城。
verses.textEnNiv: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez and captured it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, and he encamped against Thebez and took it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abimelech attacked the town of Thebez and captured it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, and he camped against Thebez and captured it.
verses.textEn: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.

verses.textZh: 城中有一座坚固的城楼；那城所有的人，无论男女，都逃到那里去，关上门，上了楼顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中有一座坚固的城楼；那城所有的人，无论男女，都逃到那里去，关上门，上了楼顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 城中有一座坚固的楼；城里的众人，无论男女，都逃进楼去，关上门，上了楼顶。
verses.textEnNiv: Inside the city, however, was a strong tower, to which all the men and women—all the people of the city—had fled. They had locked themselves in and climbed up on the tower roof.
verses.textEnEsv: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women and all the leaders of the city fled to it and shut themselves in, and they went up to the roof of the tower.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there was a strong tower in the city, and all the men and women—all the people of the city—fled there and shut themselves in; then they went up to the top of the tower.
verses.textEnNlt: But there was a strong tower inside the town, and all the men and women—the entire population—fled to it. They barricaded themselves in and climbed up to the roof of the tower.
verses.textEnNasb: But there was a strong tower in the center of the city, and all the men and women with all the leaders of the city fled there and shut themselves in; and they went up on the roof of the tower.
verses.textEn: Inside the city, however, was a strong tower, to which all the men and women—all the people of the city—had fled. They had locked themselves in and climbed up on the tower roof.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒到了城楼前，攻打城楼；他走近城楼门口，要用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒到了城楼前，攻打城楼；他走近城楼门口，要用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒到了楼前攻打，挨近楼门，要用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it and drew near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abimelech came as far as the tower and fought against it; and he drew near the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Abimelech followed them to attack the tower. But as he prepared to set fire to the entrance,
verses.textEnNasb: So Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and approached the entrance of the tower to burn it down with fire.
verses.textEn: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,

verses.textZh: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石拋在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的头盖骨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石拋在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的头盖骨。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石抛在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的脑骨。
verses.textEnNiv: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.
verses.textEnEsv: And a certain woman threw an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head and crushed his skull.
verses.textEnNkjv: But a certain woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head and crushed his skull.
verses.textEnNlt: a woman on the roof dropped a millstone that landed on Abimelech’s head and crushed his skull.
verses.textEnNasb: But a woman threw an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
verses.textEn: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.

verses.textZh: 他急忙呼喊替他拿兵器的少年人，对他说："拔出你的刀来，把我杀死吧。免得人讲论我说：‘他被一个妇人所杀。’"于是那少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他急忙呼喊替他拿兵器的少年人，对他说："拔出你的刀来，把我杀死吧。免得人讲论我说：‘他被一个妇人所杀。’"于是那少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，对他说：「拔出你的刀来，杀了我吧！免得人议论我说，他为一个妇人所杀。」于是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Hurriedly he called to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me, so that they can’t say, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So his servant ran him through, and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he called quickly to the young man his armor-bearer and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’" And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called quickly to the young man, his armorbearer, and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, lest men say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: He quickly said to his young armor bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me! Don’t let it be said that a woman killed Abimelech!" So the young man ran him through with his sword, and he died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he called quickly to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, so that it will not be said of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So the young man pierced him through, and he died.
verses.textEn: Hurriedly he called to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me, so that they can’t say, ‘A woman killed him.’ " So his servant ran him through, and he died.

verses.textZh: 以色列人看见亚比米勒死了，就各回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人看见亚比米勒死了，就各回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人见亚比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites saw that Abimelek was dead, they went home.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, everyone departed to his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed, every man to his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abimelech’s men saw that he was dead, they disbanded and returned to their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, each left for his home.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites saw that Abimelek was dead, they went home.

verses.textZh: 这样，神报应了亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶事，就是他杀了自己的兄弟七十个人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，神报应了亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶事，就是他杀了自己的兄弟七十个人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，神报应亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶，就是杀了弟兄七十个人的恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelek had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus God returned the evil of Abimelech, which he committed against his father in killing his seventy brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he had done to his father by killing his seventy brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, God punished Abimelech for the evil he had done against his father by murdering his seventy brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: So God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he had done to his father in killing his seventy brothers.
verses.textEn: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelek had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.

verses.textZh: 神也把示剑人的一切恶事，都报应在他们的头上；耶路．巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅，也归到他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神也把示剑人的一切恶事，都报应在他们的头上；耶路．巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅，也归到他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑人的一切恶，神也都报应在他们头上；耶路‧巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅归到他们身上了。
verses.textEnNiv: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And God also made all the evil of the men of Shechem return on their heads, and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem God returned on their own heads, and on them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.textEnNlt: God also punished the men of Shechem for all their evil. So the curse of Jotham son of Gideon was fulfilled.
verses.textEnNasb: God also returned all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads, and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came upon them.
verses.textEn: God also made the people of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒之后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子，普瓦的儿子陀拉，兴起拯救以色列人；他住在以法莲山地的沙密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒之后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子，普瓦的儿子陀拉，兴起拯救以色列人；他住在以法莲山地的沙密。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子、普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。
verses.textEnNiv: After the time of Abimelek, a man of Issachar named Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: After Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, and he lived at Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: After Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in the mountains of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: After Abimelech died, Tola son of Puah, son of Dodo, was the next person to rescue Israel. He was from the tribe of Issachar but lived in the town of Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after Abimelech died, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, rose up to save Israel; and he lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: After the time of Abimelek, a man of Issachar named Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 陀拉治理以色列人二十三年，就死了，埋葬在沙密。
verses.textZhCnvs: 陀拉治理以色列人二十三年，就死了，埋葬在沙密。
verses.textZhCuv: 陀拉作以色列的士师二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。
verses.textEnNiv: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.textEnEsv: And he judged Israel twenty-three years. Then he died and was buried at Shamir.
verses.textEnNkjv: He judged Israel twenty-three years; and he died and was buried in Shamir.
verses.textEnNlt: He judged Israel for twenty-three years. When he died, he was buried in Shamir.
verses.textEnNasb: He judged Israel for twenty-three years. Then he died and was buried in Shamir.
verses.textEn: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.textZh: 在他之后，有基列人睚珥兴起治理以色列人二十二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他之后，有基列人睚珥兴起治理以色列人二十二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。
verses.textEnNiv: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.
verses.textEnEsv: After him arose Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him arose Jair, a Gileadite; and he judged Israel twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNlt: After Tola died, Jair from Gilead judged Israel for twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNasb: After him, Jair the Gileadite rose up and judged Israel for twenty-two years.
verses.textEn: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.

verses.textZh: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十头驴驹；他们有三十座城，叫作哈倭特．睚珥，直到今日都是在基列地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十头驴驹；他们有三十座城，叫作哈倭特．睚珥，直到今日都是在基列地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹。他们有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特‧睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。
verses.textEnNiv: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.
verses.textEnEsv: And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys, and they had thirty cities, called Havvoth-jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys; they also had thirty towns, which are called "Havoth Jair" to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: His thirty sons rode around on thirty donkeys, and they owned thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which are still called the Towns of Jair.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys, and they had thirty cities in the land of Gilead that are called Havvoth-jair to this day.
verses.textEn: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.

verses.textZh: 睚珥死了以后，就埋葬在加们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 睚珥死了以后，就埋葬在加们。
verses.textZhCuv: 睚珥死了，就葬在加们。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jair died and was buried in Kamon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jair died and was buried in Camon.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jair died and was buried in Kamon.
verses.textEn: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，服事众巴力和亚斯他录，以及亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神；他们离弃了耶和华，不再服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，服事众巴力和亚斯他录，以及亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神；他们离弃了耶和华，不再服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯她录，并亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord . They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the Lord and no longer served him,
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and served the Baals and the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites, and the gods of the Philistines. And they forsook the Lord and did not serve him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the people of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook the Lord and did not serve Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Again the Israelites did evil in the Lord ’s sight. They served the images of Baal and Ashtoreth, and the gods of Aram, Sidon, Moab, Ammon, and Philistia. They abandoned the Lord and no longer served him at all.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they served the Baals and the Ashtaroth, the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the sons of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; so they abandoned the Lord and did not serve Him.
verses.textEn: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord . They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the Lord and no longer served him,

verses.textZh: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人的手中和亚扪人的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人的手中和亚扪人的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人和亚扪人的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: he became angry with them. He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites,

verses.textEnNkjv: So the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord burned with anger against Israel, and he turned them over to the Philistines and the Ammonites,
verses.textEnNasb: And the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the sons of Ammon.

verses.textZh: 从那一年起，他们就迫害欺压以色列人，就是所有在约旦河东边，住在亚摩利人之地的以色列人，共十八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那一年起，他们就迫害欺压以色列人，就是所有在约旦河东边，住在亚摩利人之地的以色列人，共十八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那年起，他们扰害欺压约旦河那边、住亚摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。
verses.textEnNiv: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: and they crushed and oppressed the people of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the people of Israel who were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: From that year they harassed and oppressed the children of Israel for eighteen years—all the children of Israel who were on the other side of the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, in Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: who began to oppress them that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites east of the Jordan River in the land of the Amorites (that is, in Gilead).
verses.textEnNasb: And they afflicted and oppressed the sons of Israel that year; for eighteen years they oppressed all the sons of Israel who were beyond the Jordan, in Gilead in the land of the Amorites.
verses.textEn: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.

verses.textZh: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大、便雅悯和以法莲家，以色列人就非常困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大、便雅悯和以法莲家，以色列人就非常困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大和便雅悯，并以法莲族。以色列人就甚觉窘迫。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim; Israel was in great distress.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight also against Judah and against Benjamin and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was severely distressed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the people of Ammon crossed over the Jordan to fight against Judah also, against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was severely distressed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Ammonites also crossed to the west side of the Jordan and attacked Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim. The Israelites were in great distress.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Ammon crossed the Jordan to fight also against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was in great difficulty.
verses.textEn: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin and Ephraim; Israel was in great distress.

verses.textZh: 以色列人向耶和华哀求，说："我们得罪了你，因为我们离弃了我们的神，服事众巴力。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人向耶和华哀求，说："我们得罪了你，因为我们离弃了我们的神，服事众巴力。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哀求耶和华说：「我们得罪了你；因为离弃了我们神，去事奉诸巴力。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , "We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel cried out to the Lord , saying, "We have sinned against you, because we have forsaken our God and have served the Baals."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel cried out to the Lord, saying, "We have sinned against You, because we have both forsaken our God and served the Baals!"
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, they cried out to the Lord for help, saying, "We have sinned against you because we have abandoned you as our God and have served the images of Baal."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, saying, "We have sinned against You, for indeed, we have abandoned our God and served the Baals."
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , "We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对以色列人说："我不是曾经拯救你们脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人和非利士人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对以色列人说："我不是曾经拯救你们脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人和非利士人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对以色列人说：「我岂没有救过你们脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人，和非利士人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord replied, "When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to the people of Israel, "Did I not save you from the Egyptians and from the Amorites, from the Ammonites and from the Philistines?
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to the children of Israel, "DidI not deliveryou from the Egyptians and from the Amorites and from the people of Ammon and from the Philistines?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "Did I not rescue you from the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to the sons of Israel, "Did I not save you from the Egyptians, the Amorites, the sons of Ammon, and the Philistines?
verses.textEn: The Lord replied, "When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,

verses.textZh: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都压迫你们；你们向我哀求，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都压迫你们；你们向我哀求，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都欺压你们；你们哀求我，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。
verses.textEnNiv: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?
verses.textEnEsv: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you, and you cried out to me, and I saved you out of their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the Sidonians and Amalekites and Maonites oppressed you; and you cried out to Me, and I delivered you from their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: the Sidonians, the Amalekites, and the Maonites? When they oppressed you, you cried out to me for help, and I rescued you.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the Sidonians, the Amalekites, and the Maonites oppressed you, you cried out to Me, and I saved you from their hands.
verses.textEn: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?

verses.textZh: 你们竟离弃了我，服事别的神，因此我不再拯救你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们竟离弃了我，服事别的神，因此我不再拯救你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们竟离弃我，事奉别神！所以我不再救你们了。
verses.textEnNiv: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods; therefore I will save you no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you have forsaken Me and served other gods. Therefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you have abandoned me and served other gods. So I will not rescue you anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you abandoned Me and served other gods; therefore I will no longer save you.
verses.textEn: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.

verses.textZh: 你们去向你们拣选的神呼求吧！让他们在你们遭遇患难的时候拯救你们吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们去向你们拣选的神呼求吧！让他们在你们遭遇患难的时候拯救你们吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们去哀求所选择的神；你们遭遇急难的时候，让他救你们吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!"
verses.textEnEsv: Go and cry out to the gods whom you have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and cry out to the gods which you have chosen; let them deliver you in your time of distress."
verses.textEnNlt: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen! Let them rescue you in your hour of distress!"
verses.textEnNasb: Go and cry out to the gods which you have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress."
verses.textEn: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!"

verses.textZh: 以色列人对耶和华说："我们犯了罪了，你任意对待我们吧；只求你今日拯救我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对耶和华说："我们犯了罪了，你任意对待我们吧；只求你今日拯救我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人对耶和华说：「我们犯罪了，任凭你随意待我们吧！只求你今日拯救我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites said to the Lord , "We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel said to the Lord , "We have sinned; do to us whatever seems good to you. Only please deliver us this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, "We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems best to You; only deliver us this day, we pray."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites pleaded with the Lord and said, "We have sinned. Punish us as you see fit, only rescue us today from our enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel said to the Lord, "We have sinned, do to us whatever seems good to You; only please save us this day."
verses.textEn: But the Israelites said to the Lord , "We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now."

verses.textZh: 以色列人就从他们中间除去外族人的神，事奉耶和华；耶和华的心因以色列人所受的患难，就很着急。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就从他们中间除去外族人的神，事奉耶和华；耶和华的心因以色列人所受的患难，就很着急。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就除掉他们中间的外邦神，事奉耶和华。耶和华因以色列人受的苦难，就心中担忧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the Lord . And he could bear Israel’s misery no longer.
verses.textEnEsv: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord , and he became impatient over the misery of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord. And His soul could no longer endure the misery of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelites put aside their foreign gods and served the Lord . And he was grieved by their misery.
verses.textEnNasb: So they removed the foreign gods from among them and served the Lord; and He could no longer endure the misery of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the Lord . And he could bear Israel’s misery no longer.

verses.textZh: 当时亚扪人聚集起来，在基列安营；以色列人也聚集，在米斯巴安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时亚扪人聚集起来，在基列安营；以色列人也聚集，在米斯巴安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时亚扪人聚集，安营在基列。以色列人也聚集，安营在米斯巴。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Ammonites were called to arms, and they encamped in Gilead. And the people of Israel came together, and they encamped at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people of Ammon gathered together and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled together and encamped in Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the armies of Ammon had gathered for war and were camped in Gilead, and the people of Israel assembled and camped at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Ammon were summoned, and they camped in Gilead. And the sons of Israel gathered together and camped in Mizpah.
verses.textEn: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 基列的人民和众领袖彼此说："谁先去攻打亚扪人，谁就可以作基列所有居民的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列的人民和众领袖彼此说："谁先去攻打亚扪人，谁就可以作基列所有居民的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的民和众首领彼此商议说：「谁能先去攻打亚扪人，谁必作基列一切居民的领袖。」
verses.textEnNiv: The leaders of the people of Gilead said to each other, "Whoever will take the lead in attacking the Ammonites will be head over all who live in Gilead."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people, the leaders of Gilead, said one to another, "Who is the man who will begin to fight against the Ammonites? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people, the leaders of Gilead, said to one another, "Who is the man who will begin the fight against the people of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of Gilead said to each other, "Whoever attacks the Ammonites first will become ruler over all the people of Gilead."
verses.textEnNasb: And the people, the leaders of Gilead, said to one another, "Who is the man who will begin to fight against the sons of Ammon? He shall become head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEn: The leaders of the people of Gilead said to each other, "Whoever will take the lead in attacking the Ammonites will be head over all who live in Gilead."

verses.textZh: 基列人耶弗他是个英勇的战士；他是个妓女的儿子；耶弗他是基列所生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列人耶弗他是个英勇的战士；他是个妓女的儿子；耶弗他是基列所生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列人耶弗他是个大能的勇士，是妓女的儿子。耶弗他是基列所生的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior, but he was the son of a prostitute. Gilead was the father of Jephthah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor, but he was the son of a harlot; and Gilead begot Jephthah.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Jephthah of Gilead was a great warrior. He was the son of Gilead, but his mother was a prostitute.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a valiant warrior, but he was the son of a prostitute. And Gilead had fathered Jephthah.
verses.textEn: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.

verses.textZh: 基列的妻子也给他生了几个儿子。他妻子的儿子长大了，就把耶弗他赶出去，对他说："你不可以在我们的父家继承产业，因为你是另一个妇人的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列的妻子也给他生了几个儿子。他妻子的儿子长大了，就把耶弗他赶出去，对他说："你不可以在我们的父家继承产业，因为你是另一个妇人的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的妻也生了几个儿子：他妻所生的儿子长大了，就赶逐耶弗他，说：「你不可在我们父家承受产业，因为你是妓女的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Gilead’s wife also bore him sons, and when they were grown up, they drove Jephthah away. "You are not going to get any inheritance in our family," they said, "because you are the son of another woman."
verses.textEnEsv: And Gilead’s wife also bore him sons. And when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, "You shall not have an inheritance in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman."
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead’s wife bore sons; and when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out, and said to him, "You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman."
verses.textEnNlt: Gilead’s wife also had several sons, and when these half brothers grew up, they chased Jephthah off the land. "You will not get any of our father’s inheritance," they said, "for you are the son of a prostitute."
verses.textEnNasb: Gilead’s wife bore him sons; and when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to him, "You shall not have an inheritance in our father’s house, for you are the son of another woman."
verses.textEn: Gilead’s wife also bore him sons, and when they were grown up, they drove Jephthah away. "You are not going to get any inheritance in our family," they said, "because you are the son of another woman."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他就从他的兄弟面前逃跑，住在陀伯地；有些无赖聚集到他那里，与他一起出入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他就从他的兄弟面前逃跑，住在陀伯地；有些无赖聚集到他那里，与他一起出入。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他就逃避他的弟兄，去住在陀伯地，有些匪徒到他那里聚集，与他一同出入。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where a gang of scoundrels gathered around him and followed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob, and worthless fellows collected around Jephthah and went out with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and dwelt in the land of Tob; and worthless men banded together with Jephthah and went out raiding with him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Soon he had a band of worthless rebels following him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob; and worthless men gathered around Jephthah, and they went wherever he did.
verses.textEn: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where a gang of scoundrels gathered around him and followed him.

verses.textZh: 过了些日子，亚扪人与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了些日子，亚扪人与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了些日子，亚扪人攻打以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: After a time the Ammonites made war against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass after a time that the people of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: At about this time, the Ammonites began their war against Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, after a while, that the sons of Ammon fought against Israel.
verses.textEn: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,

verses.textZh: 亚扪人与以色列人争战的时候，基列的众长老就去，把耶弗他从陀伯请回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人与以色列人争战的时候，基列的众长老就去，把耶弗他从陀伯请回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人攻打以色列的时候，基列的长老到陀伯地去，要叫耶弗他回来；
verses.textEnNiv: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Ammonites made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah from the land of Tob.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when the people of Ammon made war against Israel, that the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Ammonites attacked, the elders of Gilead sent for Jephthah in the land of Tob.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Ammon fought against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob;
verses.textEn: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.

verses.textZh: 他们对耶弗他说："请你来作我们的统帅，我们好攻打亚扪人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对耶弗他说："请你来作我们的统帅，我们好攻打亚扪人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对耶弗他说：「请你来作我们的元帅，我们好与亚扪人争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come," they said, "be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to Jephthah, "Come and be our leader, that we may fight against the Ammonites."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to Jephthah, "Come and be our commander, that we may fight against the people of Ammon."
verses.textEnNlt: The elders said, "Come and be our commander! Help us fight the Ammonites!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they said to Jephthah, "Come and be our leader, that we may fight against the sons of Ammon."
verses.textEn: "Come," they said, "be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他对基列的长老说："从前你们不是恨我，赶逐我离开我的父家吗？现在你们遭遇患难的时候，为甚么到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他对基列的长老说："从前你们不是恨我，赶逐我离开我的父家吗？现在你们遭遇患难的时候，为甚么到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他回答基列的长老说：「从前你们不是恨我、赶逐我出离父家吗？现在你们遭遇急难为何到我这里来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah said to them, "Didn’t you hate me and drive me from my father’s house? Why do you come to me now, when you’re in trouble?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Did you not hate me and drive me out of my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Did you not hate me, and expel me from my father’s house? Why have you come to me now when you are in distress?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jephthah said to them, "Aren’t you the ones who hated me and drove me from my father’s house? Why do you come to me now when you’re in trouble?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Did you not hate me and drive me from my father’s house? So why have you come to me now when you are in trouble?"
verses.textEn: Jephthah said to them, "Didn’t you hate me and drive me from my father’s house? Why do you come to me now, when you’re in trouble?"

verses.textZh: 基列的长老对耶弗他说："现在我们回到你这里来，是要你与我们一同回去，与亚扪人争战，你要作我们基列所有居民的首领。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列的长老对耶弗他说："现在我们回到你这里来，是要你与我们一同回去，与亚扪人争战，你要作我们基列所有居民的首领。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「现在我们到你这里来，是要你同我们去，与亚扪人争战；你可以作基列一切居民的领袖。」
verses.textEnNiv: The elders of Gilead said to him, "Nevertheless, we are turning to you now; come with us to fight the Ammonites, and you will be head over all of us who live in Gilead."
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "That is why we have turned to you now, that you may go with us and fight against the Ammonites and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "That is why we have turned again to you now, that you may go with us and fight against the people of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEnNlt: "Because we need you," the elders replied. "If you lead us in battle against the Ammonites, we will make you ruler over all the people of Gilead."
verses.textEnNasb: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "For this reason we have now returned to you, that you may go with us and fight the sons of Ammon, and become our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."
verses.textEn: The elders of Gilead said to him, "Nevertheless, we are turning to you now; come with us to fight the Ammonites, and you will be head over all of us who live in Gilead."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他对基列的长老说："如果你们带我回去，攻打亚扪人，耶和华把他们交在我面前，那么我就可以作你们的首领吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他对基列的长老说："如果你们带我回去，攻打亚扪人，耶和华把他们交在我面前，那么我就可以作你们的首领吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他对基列的长老说：「你们叫我回去，与亚扪人争战，耶和华把他交给我，我可以作你们的领袖吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah answered, "Suppose you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the Lord gives them to me—will I really be your head?"
verses.textEnEsv: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "If you bring me home again to fight against the Ammonites, and the Lord gives them over to me, I will be your head."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "If you take me back home to fight against the people of Ammon, and the Lord delivers them to me, shall I be your head?"
verses.textEnNlt: Jephthah said to the elders, "Let me get this straight. If I come with you and if the Lord gives me victory over the Ammonites, will you really make me ruler over all the people?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "If you bring me back to fight against the sons of Ammon and the Lord gives them up to me, will I become your head?"
verses.textEn: Jephthah answered, "Suppose you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the Lord gives them to me—will I really be your head?"

verses.textZh: 基列的长老对耶弗他说："有耶和华在我们中间作证，我们必定照着你的话行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列的长老对耶弗他说："有耶和华在我们中间作证，我们必定照着你的话行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的长老回答耶弗他说：「有耶和华在你我中间作见证，我们必定照你的话行。」
verses.textEnNiv: The elders of Gilead replied, "The Lord is our witness; we will certainly do as you say."
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "The Lord will be witness between us, if we do not do as you say."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "The Lord will be a witness between us, if we do not do according to your words."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord is our witness," the elders replied. "We promise to do whatever you say."
verses.textEnNasb: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "The Lord is witness between us; be assured we will do as you have said."
verses.textEn: The elders of Gilead replied, "The Lord is our witness; we will certainly do as you say."

verses.textZh: 于是耶弗他与基列的长老一同回去了，众人就立耶弗他作他们的首领，作他们的统帅；耶弗他在米斯巴，在耶和华面前，把自己的一切话都说了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶弗他与基列的长老一同回去了，众人就立耶弗他作他们的首领，作他们的统帅；耶弗他在米斯巴，在耶和华面前，把自己的一切话都说了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶弗他同基列的长老回去，百姓就立耶弗他作领袖、作元帅。耶弗他在米斯巴将自己的一切话陈明在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And he repeated all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and leader over them. And Jephthah spoke all his words before the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them; and Jephthah spoke all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him their ruler and commander of the army. At Mizpah, in the presence of the Lord , Jephthah repeated what he had said to the elders.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and leader over them; and Jephthah spoke all his words before the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEn: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and commander over them. And he repeated all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他派遣使者去见亚扪人的王，说："我跟你有甚么关系呢？你竟到我这里来攻打我的土地呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他派遣使者去见亚扪人的王，说："我跟你有甚么关系呢？你竟到我这里来攻打我的土地呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他打发使者去见亚扪人的王，说：「你与我有什么相干，竟来到我国中攻打我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: "What do you have against me that you have attacked my country?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites and said, "What do you have against me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the people of Ammon, saying, "What do you have against me, that you have come to fight against me in my land?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of Ammon, asking, "Why have you come out to fight against my land?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the sons of Ammon, saying, "What conflict do you and I have, that you have come to me to fight against my land?"
verses.textEn: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: "What do you have against me that you have attacked my country?"

verses.textZh: 亚扪人的王对耶弗他的使者说："因以色列人从埃及上来的时候，夺了我的土地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河；现在你要把它和和平平地交还。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚扪人的王对耶弗他的使者说："因以色列人从埃及上来的时候，夺了我的土地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河；现在你要把它和和平平地交还。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚扪人的王回答耶弗他的使者说：「因为以色列人从埃及上来的时候占据我的地，从亚嫩河到雅博河，直到约旦河。现在你要好好地将这地归还吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, "When Israel came up out of Egypt, they took away my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, all the way to the Jordan. Now give it back peaceably."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of the Ammonites answered the messengers of Jephthah, "Because Israel on coming up from Egypt took away my land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and to the Jordan; now therefore restore it peaceably."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of the people of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, "Because Israel took away my land when they came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore, restore those lands peaceably."
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Ammon answered Jephthah’s messengers, "When the Israelites came out of Egypt, they stole my land from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River and all the way to the Jordan. Now then, give back the land peaceably."
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of the sons of Ammon said to the messengers of Jephthah, "It is because Israel took my land when they came up from Egypt, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok and the Jordan; so return them peaceably now."
verses.textEn: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, "When Israel came up out of Egypt, they took away my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, all the way to the Jordan. Now give it back peaceably."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他又再派使者去见亚扪人的王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他又再派使者去见亚扪人的王，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他又打发使者去见亚扪人的王，
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,
verses.textEnEsv: Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the people of Ammon,
verses.textEnNlt: Jephthah sent this message back to the Ammonite king:
verses.textEnNasb: But Jephthah sent messengers once again to the king of the sons of Ammon,
verses.textEn: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,

verses.textZh: 对他说："耶弗他这样说：‘以色列人并没有夺取过摩押地和亚扪人的土地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："耶弗他这样说：‘以色列人并没有夺取过摩押地和亚扪人的土地。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「耶弗他如此说，以色列人并没有占据摩押地和亚扪人的地。
verses.textEnNiv: saying: "This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, "Thus says Jephthah: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites,
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to him, "Thus says Jephthah: ‘Israel did not take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the people of Ammon;
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not steal any land from Moab or Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: and they said to him, "This is what Jephthah says: ‘Israel did not take the land of Moab nor the land of the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: saying: "This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从埃及上来的时候，是走过旷野到红海，到了加低斯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从埃及上来的时候，是走过旷野到红海，到了加低斯；
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从埃及上来乃是经过旷野到红海，来到加低斯，
verses.textEnNiv: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.
verses.textEnEsv: but when they came up from Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: for when Israel came up from Egypt, they walked through the wilderness as far as the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Israel arrived at Kadesh on their journey from Egypt after crossing the Red Sea,
verses.textEnNasb: For when they came up from Egypt, and Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh,
verses.textEn: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the wilderness to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.

verses.textZh: 就派遣使者去见以东王，说：求你让我们经过你的领土。以东王却不答应；又派遣使者去见摩押王，摩押王也不肯；以色列人就住在加低斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就派遣使者去见以东王，说：求你让我们经过你的领土。以东王却不答应；又派遣使者去见摩押王，摩押王也不肯；以色列人就住在加低斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 就打发使者去见以东王，说：『求你容我从你的地经过。』以东王却不应允。又照样打发使者去见摩押王，他也不允准。以色列人就住在加低斯。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Give us permission to go through your country,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They sent also to the king of Moab, and he refused. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel then sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let us pass through your land,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. And they sent also to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel remained at Kadesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, "Please let me pass through your land." But the king of Edom would not heed. And in like manner they sent to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel remained in Kadesh.
verses.textEnNlt: they sent messengers to the king of Edom asking for permission to pass through his land. But their request was denied. Then they asked the king of Moab for similar permission, but he wouldn’t let them pass through either. So the people of Israel stayed in Kadesh.
verses.textEnNasb: then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, "Please let us pass through your land"; but the king of Edom would not listen. And they also sent messengers to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel remained at Kadesh.
verses.textEn: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Give us permission to go through your country,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They sent also to the king of Moab, and he refused. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.

verses.textZh: 以后，他们走过旷野，绕过以东地和摩押地，到了摩押地的东边，在亚嫩河那边安营；他们并没有进入摩押境内，因为亚嫩河是摩押的边界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，他们走过旷野，绕过以东地和摩押地，到了摩押地的东边，在亚嫩河那边安营；他们并没有进入摩押境内，因为亚嫩河是摩押的边界。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又经过旷野，绕着以东和摩押地，从摩押地的东边过来，在亚嫩河边安营，并没有入摩押的境内，因为亚嫩河是摩押的边界。
verses.textEnNiv: "Next they traveled through the wilderness, skirted the lands of Edom and Moab, passed along the eastern side of the country of Moab, and camped on the other side of the Arnon. They did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was its border.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then they journeyed through the wilderness and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab and arrived on the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was the boundary of Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went along through the wilderness and bypassed the land of Edom and the land of Moab, came to the east side of the land of Moab, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: "Finally, they went around Edom and Moab through the wilderness. They traveled along Moab’s eastern border and camped on the other side of the Arnon River. But they never once crossed the Arnon River into Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they went through the wilderness and around the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came to the east side of the land of Moab, and they camped beyond the Arnon; but they did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.textEn: "Next they traveled through the wilderness, skirted the lands of Edom and Moab, passed along the eastern side of the country of Moab, and camped on the other side of the Arnon. They did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was its border.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又派遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，就是希实本王，对他说：求你让我们经过你的领土，到我们自己的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又派遣使者去见亚摩利人的王西宏，就是希实本王，对他说：求你让我们经过你的领土，到我们自己的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人打发使者去见亚摩利王西宏，就是希实本的王，对他说：『求你容我们从你的地经过，往我们自己的地方去。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Let us pass through your country to our own place.’
verses.textEnEsv: Israel then sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon, and Israel said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land to our country,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, "Please let us pass through your land into our place."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then Israel sent messengers to King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled from Heshbon, asking for permission to cross through his land to get to their destination.
verses.textEnNasb: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, "Please let us pass through your land to our place."
verses.textEn: "Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Let us pass through your country to our own place.’

verses.textZh: 西宏却不信任以色列人，不让他们经过他的境界；西宏聚集了他所有的人民，在雅杂安营，与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西宏却不信任以色列人，不让他们经过他的境界；西宏聚集了他所有的人民，在雅杂安营，与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 西宏却不信服以色列人，不容他们经过他的境界，乃招聚他的众民在雅杂安营，与以色列人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: Sihon, however, did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. He mustered all his troops and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: but Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his territory, so Sihon gathered all his people together and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So Sihon gathered all his people together, encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But King Sihon didn’t trust Israel to pass through his land. Instead, he mobilized his army at Jahaz and attacked them.
verses.textEnNasb: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his territory; so Sihon gathered all his people and camped in Jahaz, and fought with Israel.
verses.textEn: Sihon, however, did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. He mustered all his troops and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神，把西宏和他所有的人民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人击杀了他们，夺取了住在那地的亚摩利人的全地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神，把西宏和他所有的人民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人击杀了他们，夺取了住在那地的亚摩利人的全地，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神将西宏和他的众民都交在以色列人手中，以色列人就击杀他们，得了亚摩利人的全地：
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the Lord , the God of Israel, gave Sihon and his whole army into Israel’s hands, and they defeated them. Israel took over all the land of the Amorites who lived in that country,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord , the God of Israel, gave Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they defeated them. So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites, who inhabited that country.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they defeated them. Thus Israel gained possession of all the land of the Amorites, who inhabited that country.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord , the God of Israel, gave his people victory over King Sihon. So Israel took control of all the land of the Amorites, who lived in that region,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord, the God of Israel, handed Sihon and all his people over to Israel, and they defeated them; so Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.textEn: "Then the Lord , the God of Israel, gave Sihon and his whole army into Israel’s hands, and they defeated them. Israel took over all the land of the Amorites who lived in that country,

verses.textZh: 占领了亚摩利人四周的境界，从亚嫩河到雅博河，从旷野直到约旦河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 占领了亚摩利人四周的境界，从亚嫩河到雅博河，从旷野直到约旦河。
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚嫩河到雅博河，从旷野直到约旦河。
verses.textEnNiv: capturing all of it from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the desert to the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took possession of all the territory of the Amorites from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: They took possession of all the territory of the Amorites, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River, and from the eastern wilderness to the Jordan.
verses.textEnNasb: So they possessed all the territory of the Amorites, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok, and from the wilderness as far as the Jordan.
verses.textEn: capturing all of it from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the desert to the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 现在耶和华以色列的神，已经把亚摩利人从他的子民以色列人面前赶走了，你竟要占有这地吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在耶和华以色列的神，已经把亚摩利人从他的子民以色列人面前赶走了，你竟要占有这地吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神在他百姓以色列面前赶出亚摩利人，你竟要得他们的地吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Now since the Lord , the God of Israel, has driven the Amorites out before his people Israel, what right have you to take it over?
verses.textEnEsv: So then the Lord , the God of Israel, dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel; and are you to take possession of them?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And now the Lord God of Israel has dispossessed the Amorites from before His people Israel; should you then possess it?
verses.textEnNlt: "So you see, it was the Lord , the God of Israel, who took away the land from the Amorites and gave it to Israel. Why, then, should we give it back to you?
verses.textEnNasb: And now the Lord, the God of Israel, has driven out the Amorites from His people Israel; so should you possess it?
verses.textEn: "Now since the Lord , the God of Israel, has driven the Amorites out before his people Israel, what right have you to take it over?

verses.textZh: 你不是应占有你的神基抹要你占有的地吗？我们不是应占有耶和华我们的神，从我们面前赶走的人的一切地吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不是应占有你的神基抹要你占有的地吗？我们不是应占有耶和华我们的神，从我们面前赶走的人的一切地吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的神基抹所赐你的地你不是得为业吗？耶和华－我们的神在我们面前所赶出的人，我们就得他的地。
verses.textEnNiv: Will you not take what your god Chemosh gives you? Likewise, whatever the Lord our God has given us, we will possess.
verses.textEnEsv: Will you not possess what Chemosh your god gives you to possess? And all that the Lord our God has dispossessed before us, we will possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you not possess whatever Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whatever the Lord our God takes possession of before us, we will possess.
verses.textEnNlt: You keep whatever your god Chemosh gives you, and we will keep whatever the Lord our God gives us.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not possess what Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whatever the Lord our God has dispossessed before us, we will possess it.
verses.textEn: Will you not take what your god Chemosh gives you? Likewise, whatever the Lord our God has given us, we will possess.

verses.textZh: 现在难道你比摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒还强吗？他曾经与以色列人争竞吗？或是与以色列人交战过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在难道你比摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒还强吗？他曾经与以色列人争竞吗？或是与以色列人交战过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道你比摩押王西拨的儿子巴勒还强吗？他曾与以色列人争竞，或是与他们争战吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever quarrel with Israel or fight with them?
verses.textEnEsv: Now are you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend against Israel, or did he ever go to war with them?
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, are you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel? Did he ever fight against them?
verses.textEnNlt: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he try to make a case against Israel for disputed land? Did he go to war against them?
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, are you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend with Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
verses.textEn: Are you any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever quarrel with Israel or fight with them?

verses.textZh: 以色列人住在希实本和属希实本的村镇，亚罗珥和亚罗珥的村镇，以及亚嫩河沿岸的一切城市，已经有三百年了；在这时期内，你们为甚么没有夺回这些地方呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人住在希实本和属希实本的村镇，亚罗珥和亚罗珥的村镇，以及亚嫩河沿岸的一切城市，已经有三百年了；在这时期内，你们为甚么没有夺回这些地方呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人住希实本和属希实本的乡村，亚罗珥和属亚罗珥的乡村，并沿亚嫩河的一切城邑，已经有三百年了；在这三百年之内，你们为什么没有取回这些地方呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For three hundred years Israel occupied Heshbon, Aroer, the surrounding settlements and all the towns along the Arnon. Why didn’t you retake them during that time?
verses.textEnEsv: While Israel lived in Heshbon and its villages, and in Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities that are on the banks of the Arnon, 300 years, why did you not deliver them within that time?
verses.textEnNkjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and its villages, in Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities along the banks of the Arnon, for three hundred years, why did you not recover them within that time?
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel has been living here for 300 years, inhabiting Heshbon and its surrounding settlements, all the way to Aroer and its settlements, and in all the towns along the Arnon River. Why have you made no effort to recover it before now?
verses.textEnNasb: While Israel was living in Heshbon and its villages, and in Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities that are on the banks of the Arnon, three hundred years, why did you not recover them within that time?
verses.textEn: For three hundred years Israel occupied Heshbon, Aroer, the surrounding settlements and all the towns along the Arnon. Why didn’t you retake them during that time?

verses.textZh: 我没有得罪你，你竟恶待我，攻打我；愿审判者耶和华今日在以色列人和亚扪人中间，判断是非。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有得罪你，你竟恶待我，攻打我；愿审判者耶和华今日在以色列人和亚扪人中间，判断是非。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 原来我没有得罪你，你却攻打我，恶待我。愿审判人的耶和华今日在以色列人和亚扪人中间判断是非。」
verses.textEnNiv: I have not wronged you, but you are doing me wrong by waging war against me. Let the Lord , the Judge, decide the dispute this day between the Israelites and the Ammonites."
verses.textEnEsv: I therefore have not sinned against you, and you do me wrong by making war on me. The Lord , the Judge, decide this day between the people of Israel and the people of Ammon."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you wronged me by fighting against me. May the Lord, the Judge, render judgment this day between the children of Israel and the people of Ammon.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I have not sinned against you. Rather, you have wronged me by attacking me. Let the Lord , who is judge, decide today which of us is right—Israel or Ammon."
verses.textEnNasb: So I have not sinned against you, but you are doing me wrong by making war against me. May the Lord, the Judge, judge today between the sons of Israel and the sons of Ammon.’ "
