verses.textEn: I have not wronged you, but you are doing me wrong by waging war against me. Let the Lord , the Judge, decide the dispute this day between the Israelites and the Ammonites."

verses.textZh: 但亚扪人的王不听从耶弗他差派人去对他所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但亚扪人的王不听从耶弗他差派人去对他所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 但亚扪人的王不肯听耶弗他打发人说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king of the Ammonites did not listen to the words of Jephthah that he sent to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, the king of the people of Ammon did not heed the words which Jephthah sent him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king of Ammon paid no attention to Jephthah’s message.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king of the sons of Ammon disregarded the message which Jephthah sent him.
verses.textEn: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.

verses.textZh: 那时耶和华的灵临到耶弗他身上，他就经过基列和玛拿西，经过基列的米斯巴，又从基列的米斯巴去到亚扪人那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时耶和华的灵临到耶弗他身上，他就经过基列和玛拿西，经过基列的米斯巴，又从基列的米斯巴去到亚扪人那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵降在耶弗他身上，他就经过基列和玛拿西，来到基列的米斯巴，又从米斯巴来到亚扪人那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah. He crossed Gilead and Manasseh, passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from there he advanced against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Spirit of the Lord was upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh and passed on to Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he passed on to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh, and passed through Mizpah of Gilead; and from Mizpah of Gilead he advanced toward the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he went throughout the land of Gilead and Manasseh, including Mizpah in Gilead, and from there he led an army against the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh; then he passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead he went on to the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah. He crossed Gilead and Manasseh, passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from there he advanced against the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他向耶和华许愿，说："如果你真的把亚扪人交在我手里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他向耶和华许愿，说："如果你真的把亚扪人交在我手里，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他就向耶和华许愿，说：「你若将亚扪人交在我手中，
verses.textEnNiv: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord : "If you give the Ammonites into my hands,
verses.textEnEsv: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord and said, "If you will give the Ammonites into my hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord, and said, "If You will indeed deliver the people of Ammon into my hands,
verses.textEnNlt: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord . He said, "If you give me victory over the Ammonites,
verses.textEnNasb: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord and said, "If You will indeed hand over to me the sons of Ammon,
verses.textEn: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord : "If you give the Ammonites into my hands,

verses.textZh: 我从亚扪人那里平平安安回来的时候，无论谁先从我的家门出来迎接我，他就必归耶和华，我也必把他当作燔祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从亚扪人那里平平安安回来的时候，无论谁先从我的家门出来迎接我，他就必归耶和华，我也必把他当作燔祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我从亚扪人那里平平安安回来的时候，无论什么人，先从我家门出来迎接我，就必归你，我也必将他献上为燔祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: whatever comes out of the door of my house to meet me when I return in triumph from the Ammonites will be the Lord ’s, and I will sacrifice it as a burnt offering."
verses.textEnEsv: then whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the Ammonites shall be the Lord ’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering."
verses.textEnNkjv: then it will be that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the people of Ammon, shall surely be the Lord’s, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering."
verses.textEnNlt: I will give to the Lord whatever comes out of my house to meet me when I return in triumph. I will sacrifice it as a burnt offering."
verses.textEnNasb: then whatever comes out the doors of my house to meet me when I return safely from the sons of Ammon, it shall be the Lord’s, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering."
verses.textEn: whatever comes out of the door of my house to meet me when I return in triumph from the Ammonites will be the Lord ’s, and I will sacrifice it as a burnt offering."

verses.textZh: 于是耶弗他去到亚扪人那里攻打他们，耶和华把他们交在他手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶弗他去到亚扪人那里攻打他们，耶和华把他们交在他手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶弗他往亚扪人那里去，与他们争战；耶和华将他们交在他手中，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites to fight against them, and the Lord gave them into his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jephthah advanced toward the people of Ammon to fight against them, and the Lord delivered them into his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jephthah led his army against the Ammonites, and the Lord gave him victory.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jephthah crossed over to the sons of Ammon to fight against them; and the Lord handed them over to him.
verses.textEn: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into his hands.

verses.textZh: 于是他从亚罗珥开始击杀他们，去到米匿，直到亚备勒．基拉明，共二十座城，是一场大击杀；这样，亚扪人就在以色列人面前被制伏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他从亚罗珥开始击杀他们，去到米匿，直到亚备勒．基拉明，共二十座城，是一场大击杀；这样，亚扪人就在以色列人面前被制伏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就大大杀败他们，从亚罗珥到米匿，直到亚备勒‧基拉明，攻取了二十座城。这样亚扪人就被以色列人制伏了。
verses.textEnNiv: He devastated twenty towns from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel Keramim. Thus Israel subdued Ammon.
verses.textEnEsv: And he struck them from Aroer to the neighborhood of Minnith, twenty cities, and as far as Abel-keramim, with a great blow. So the Ammonites were subdued before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he defeated them from Aroer as far as Minnith—twenty cities—and to Abel Keramim, with a very great slaughter. Thus the people of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He crushed the Ammonites, devastating about twenty towns from Aroer to an area near Minnith and as far away as Abel-keramim. In this way Israel defeated the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: He inflicted a very great defeat on them from Aroer to the entrance of Minnith, twenty cities, and as far as Abel-keramim. So the sons of Ammon were subdued before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He devastated twenty towns from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel Keramim. Thus Israel subdued Ammon.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他回米斯巴去，到了自己的家，不料，他的女儿拿着鼓、跳着舞，出来迎接他；她是耶弗他的独生女，除她以外，耶弗他没有其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他回米斯巴去，到了自己的家，不料，他的女儿拿着鼓、跳着舞，出来迎接他；她是耶弗他的独生女，除她以外，耶弗他没有其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他回米斯巴到了自己的家，不料，他女儿拿着鼓跳舞出来迎接他，是他独生的，此外无儿无女。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jephthah returned to his home in Mizpah, who should come out to meet him but his daughter, dancing to the sound of timbrels! She was an only child. Except for her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jephthah came to his home at Mizpah. And behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child; besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jephthah came to his house at Mizpah, there was his daughter, coming out to meet him with timbrels and dancing; and she washis only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jephthah returned home to Mizpah, his daughter came out to meet him, playing on a tambourine and dancing for joy. She was his one and only child; he had no other sons or daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jephthah came to his house at Mizpah, and behold, his daughter was coming out to meet him with tambourines and with dancing. And she was his one and only child; besides her he had no son or daughter.
verses.textEn: When Jephthah returned to his home in Mizpah, who should come out to meet him but his daughter, dancing to the sound of timbrels! She was an only child. Except for her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他看见了她，就撕裂自己的衣服，说："啊！我的女儿啊，你真使我忧愁，你叫我太作难了；因为我已经向耶和华开过口许愿，我不能收回。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他看见了她，就撕裂自己的衣服，说："啊！我的女儿啊，你真使我忧愁，你叫我太作难了；因为我已经向耶和华开过口许愿，我不能收回。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他看见她，就撕裂衣服，说：「哀哉！我的女儿啊，你使我甚是愁苦，叫我作难了；因为我已经向耶和华开口许愿，不能挽回。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and cried, "Oh no, my daughter! You have brought me down and I am devastated. I have made a vow to the Lord that I cannot break."
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, "Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and you have become the cause of great trouble to me. For I have opened my mouth to the Lord , and I cannot take back my vow."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he tore his clothes, and said, "Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low! You are among those who trouble me! For I have given my word to the Lord, and I cannot go back on it."
verses.textEnNlt: When he saw her, he tore his clothes in anguish. "Oh, my daughter!" he cried out. "You have completely destroyed me! You’ve brought disaster on me! For I have made a vow to the Lord , and I cannot take it back."
verses.textEnNasb: So when he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, "Oh, my daughter! You have brought me disaster, and you are among those who trouble me; for I have given my word to the Lord, and I cannot take it back."
verses.textEn: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and cried, "Oh no, my daughter! You have brought me down and I am devastated. I have made a vow to the Lord that I cannot break."

verses.textZh: 她对他说："我的父亲啊，你既然向耶和华开过口许了愿，就照着你口里所说的向我行吧！因为耶和华已经在你的仇敌亚扪人身上，为你报了仇。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她对他说："我的父亲啊，你既然向耶和华开过口许了愿，就照着你口里所说的向我行吧！因为耶和华已经在你的仇敌亚扪人身上，为你报了仇。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他女儿回答说：「父啊，你既向耶和华开口，就当照你口中所说的向我行，因耶和华已经在仇敌亚扪人身上为你报仇」；
verses.textEnNiv: "My father," she replied, "you have given your word to the Lord . Do to me just as you promised, now that the Lord has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to him, "My father, you have opened your mouth to the Lord ; do to me according to what has gone out of your mouth, now that the Lord has avenged you on your enemies, on the Ammonites."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said to him, "My father, if you have given your word to the Lord, do to me according to what has gone out of your mouth, because the Lord has avenged you of your enemies, the people of Ammon."
verses.textEnNlt: And she said, "Father, if you have made a vow to the Lord , you must do to me what you have vowed, for the Lord has given you a great victory over your enemies, the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: So she said to him, "My father, you have given your word to the Lord; do to me just as you have said, since the Lord has brought you vengeance on your enemies, the sons of Ammon."
verses.textEn: "My father," she replied, "you have given your word to the Lord . Do to me just as you promised, now that the Lord has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 她又对自己的父亲说："请你准我这件事吧：给我两个月时间，让我和我的同伴去漫游山间，为我的童贞哀哭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又对自己的父亲说："请你准我这件事吧：给我两个月时间，让我和我的同伴去漫游山间，为我的童贞哀哭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对父亲说：「有一件事求你允准：容我去两个月，与同伴在山上，好哀哭我终为处女。」
verses.textEnNiv: But grant me this one request," she said. "Give me two months to roam the hills and weep with my friends, because I will never marry."
verses.textEnEsv: So she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me: leave me alone two months, that I may go up and down on the mountains and weep for my virginity, I and my companions."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me: let me alone for two months, that I may go and wander on the mountains and bewail my virginity, my friends and I."
verses.textEnNlt: But first let me do this one thing: Let me go up and roam in the hills and weep with my friends for two months, because I will die a virgin."
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me; allow me two months, so that I may go to the mountains and weep because of my virginity, I and my friends."
verses.textEn: But grant me this one request," she said. "Give me two months to roam the hills and weep with my friends, because I will never marry."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他说："你去吧！"就让她离去两个月；她就带着她的同伴去了，在山上为她的童贞哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他说："你去吧！"就让她离去两个月；她就带着她的同伴去了，在山上为她的童贞哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他说：「你去吧！」就容她去两个月。她便和同伴去了，在山上为她终为处女哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: "You may go," he said. And he let her go for two months. She and her friends went into the hills and wept because she would never marry.
verses.textEnEsv: So he said, "Go." Then he sent her away for two months, and she departed, she and her companions, and wept for her virginity on the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "Go." And he sent her away for two months; and she went with her friends, and bewailed her virginity on the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: "You may go," Jephthah said. And he sent her away for two months. She and her friends went into the hills and wept because she would never have children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Go." So he let her go for two months; and she left with her friends, and wept on the mountains because of her virginity.
verses.textEn: "You may go," he said. And he let her go for two months. She and her friends went into the hills and wept because she would never marry.

verses.textZh: 两个月后，她回到她的父亲那里，她父亲就照他所许的愿向她行了。她没有与男人同过房。以后，在以色列中有个惯例：
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个月后，她回到她的父亲那里，她父亲就照他所许的愿向她行了。她没有与男人同过房。以后，在以色列中有个惯例：
verses.textZhCuv: 两月已满，她回到父亲那里，父亲就照所许的愿向她行了。女儿终身没有亲近男子。
verses.textEnNiv: After the two months, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed. And she was a virgin. From this comes the Israelite tradition
verses.textEnEsv: And at the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to his vow that he had made. She had never known a man, and it became a custom in Israel
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was so at the end of two months that she returned to her father, and he carried out his vow with her which he had vowed. She knew no man. And it became a custom in Israel
verses.textEnNlt: When she returned home, her father kept the vow he had made, and she died a virgin. So it has become a custom in Israel
verses.textEnNasb: And at the end of two months she returned to her father, who did to her what he had vowed; and she had no relations with a man. And it became a custom in Israel,
verses.textEn: After the two months, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed. And she was a virgin. From this comes the Israelite tradition

verses.textZh: 以色列的女子年年都去哀悼基列人耶弗他的女儿，每年四日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的女子年年都去哀悼基列人耶弗他的女儿，每年四日。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后以色列中有个规矩，每年以色列的女子去为基列人耶弗他的女儿哀哭四天。
verses.textEnNiv: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
verses.textEnEsv: that the daughters of Israel went year by year to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the daughters of Israel went four days each year to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
verses.textEnNlt: for young Israelite women to go away for four days each year to lament the fate of Jephthah’s daughter.
verses.textEnNasb: that the daughters of Israel went annually to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite for four days in the year.
verses.textEn: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.

verses.textZh: 以法莲人聚集起来，过河到了撒分，对耶弗他说："你过去攻打亚扪人的时候，为甚么没有召我们与你同去呢？我们要用火烧掉你和你的房屋。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲人聚集起来，过河到了撒分，对耶弗他说："你过去攻打亚扪人的时候，为甚么没有召我们与你同去呢？我们要用火烧掉你和你的房屋。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲人聚集，到了北方，对耶弗他说：「你去与亚扪人争战，为什么没有招我们同去呢？我们必用火烧你和你的房屋。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Ephraimite forces were called out, and they crossed over to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, "Why did you go to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We’re going to burn down your house over your head."
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Ephraim were called to arms, and they crossed to Zaphon and said to Jephthah, "Why did you cross over to fight against the Ammonites and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house over you with fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Ephraim gathered together, crossed over toward Zaphon, and said to Jephthah, "Why did you cross over to fight against the people of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house down on you with fire!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Ephraim mobilized an army and crossed over the Jordan River to Zaphon. They sent this message to Jephthah: "Why didn’t you call for us to help you fight against the Ammonites? We are going to burn down your house with you in it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men of Ephraim were summoned, and they crossed to Zaphon; and they said to Jephthah, "Why did you cross over to fight against the sons of Ammon without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down on you!"
verses.textEn: The Ephraimite forces were called out, and they crossed over to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, "Why did you go to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We’re going to burn down your house over your head."

verses.textZh: 耶弗他对他们说："我和我的人民跟亚扪人激烈争战的时候，我曾经呼求你们，你们却没有来救我们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他对他们说："我和我的人民跟亚扪人激烈争战的时候，我曾经呼求你们，你们却没有来救我们脱离他们的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他对他们说：「我和我的民与亚扪人大大争战；我招你们来，你们竟没有来救我脱离他们的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah answered, "I and my people were engaged in a great struggle with the Ammonites, and although I called, you didn’t save me out of their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jephthah said to them, "I and my people had a great dispute with the Ammonites, and when I called you, you did not save me from their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jephthah said to them, "My people and I were in a great struggle with the people of Ammon; and when I called you, you did not deliver me out of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Jephthah replied, "I summoned you at the beginning of the dispute, but you refused to come! You failed to help us in our struggle against Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jephthah said to them, "I and my people were in a major dispute with the sons of Ammon; and I did call you, but you did not save me from their hand.
verses.textEn: Jephthah answered, "I and my people were engaged in a great struggle with the Ammonites, and although I called, you didn’t save me out of their hands.

verses.textZh: 我见你们不来拯救我，我就拚命上去攻击亚扪人，耶和华就把他们交在我的手里。你们今日为甚么上我这里来攻打我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我见你们不来拯救我，我就拚命上去攻击亚扪人，耶和华就把他们交在我的手里。你们今日为甚么上我这里来攻打我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我见你们不来救我，我就拚命前去攻击亚扪人，耶和华将他们交在我手中。你们今日为什么上我这里来攻打我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When I saw that you wouldn’t help, I took my life in my hands and crossed over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave me the victory over them. Now why have you come up today to fight me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when I saw that you would not save me, I took my life in my hand and crossed over against the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me this day to fight against me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So when I saw that you would not deliver me, I took my life in my hands and crossed over against the people of Ammon; and the Lord delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come up to me this day to fight against me?"
verses.textEnNlt: So when I realized you weren’t coming, I risked my life and went to battle without you, and the Lord gave me victory over the Ammonites. So why have you now come to fight me?"
verses.textEnNasb: When I saw that you were no deliverer, I took my life in my hands and crossed over against the sons of Ammon, and the Lord handed them over to me. Why then have you come up to me this day to fight against me?"
verses.textEn: When I saw that you wouldn’t help, I took my life in my hands and crossed over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave me the victory over them. Now why have you come up today to fight me?"

verses.textZh: 于是耶弗他召集了基列所有的人，与以法莲人争战；基列人击杀了以法莲人，因为以法莲人曾经说过："你们基列人在以法莲和玛拿西中间，不过是以法莲逃亡的人罢了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶弗他召集了基列所有的人，与以法莲人争战；基列人击杀了以法莲人，因为以法莲人曾经说过："你们基列人在以法莲和玛拿西中间，不过是以法莲逃亡的人罢了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶弗他招聚基列人，与以法莲人争战。基列人击杀以法莲人，是因他们说：「你们基列人在以法莲、玛拿西中间，不过是以法莲逃亡的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah then called together the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. The Gileadites struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, "You Gileadites are renegades from Ephraim and Manasseh."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought with Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, "You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the midst of Ephraim and Manasseh."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead defeated Ephraim, because they said, "You Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites."
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Ephraim responded, "You men of Gilead are nothing more than fugitives from Ephraim and Manasseh." So Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and attacked the men of Ephraim and defeated them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought Ephraim; and the men of Gilead defeated Ephraim, because they said, "You are survivors of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the midst of Ephraim and in the midst of Manasseh."
verses.textEn: Jephthah then called together the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. The Gileadites struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, "You Gileadites are renegades from Ephraim and Manasseh."

verses.textZh: 基列人占领约旦河的各渡口，不容以法莲人过去。如果以法莲逃亡的人说："让我过去吧。"基列人就问他："你是以法莲人吗？"如果他说："不是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列人占领约旦河的各渡口，不容以法莲人过去。如果以法莲逃亡的人说："让我过去吧。"基列人就问他："你是以法莲人吗？"如果他说："不是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基列人把守约旦河的渡口，不容以法莲人过去。以法莲逃走的人若说：「容我过去。」基列人就问他说：「你是以法莲人不是？」他若说：「不是」，
verses.textEnNiv: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a survivor of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead asked him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he replied, "No,"
verses.textEnEsv: And the Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. And when any of the fugitives of Ephraim said, "Let me go over," the men of Gilead said to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" When he said, "No,"
verses.textEnNkjv: The Gileadites seized the fords of the Jordan before the Ephraimites arrived. And when any Ephraimite who escaped said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead would say to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he said, "No,"
verses.textEnNlt: Jephthah captured the shallow crossings of the Jordan River, and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim tried to go back across, the men of Gilead would challenge him. "Are you a member of the tribe of Ephraim?" they would ask. If the man said, "No, I’m not,"
verses.textEnNasb: And the Gileadites took control of the crossing places of the Jordan opposite Ephraim. And it happened whenever any of the survivors of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," that the men of Gilead would say to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he said, "No,"
verses.textEn: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a survivor of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead asked him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he replied, "No,"

verses.textZh: 基列人就对他说："请说‘示播列’。"以法莲人因为发不出准确的字音，就说成"西播列"；基列人就把他捉住，在约旦河的渡口那里杀了；那时以法莲人死了四万二千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列人就对他说："请说‘示播列’。"以法莲人因为发不出准确的字音，就说成"西播列"；基列人就把他捉住，在约旦河的渡口那里杀了；那时以法莲人死了四万二千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对他说：「你说『示播列』。」以法莲人因为咬不真字音，便说「西播列」。基列人就将他拿住，杀在约旦河的渡口。那时以法莲人被杀的有四万二千人。
verses.textEnNiv: they said, "All right, say ‘Shibboleth.’ " If he said, "Sibboleth," because he could not pronounce the word correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites were killed at that time.
verses.textEnEsv: they said to him, "Then say Shibboleth," and he said, "Sibboleth," for he could not pronounce it right. Then they seized him and slaughtered him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time 42,000 of the Ephraimites fell.
verses.textEnNkjv: then they would say to him, "Then say, ‘Shibboleth’!" And he would say, "Sibboleth," for he could not pronounce it right. Then they would take him and kill him at the fords of the Jordan. There fell at that time forty-two thousand Ephraimites.
verses.textEnNlt: they would tell him to say "Shibboleth." If he was from Ephraim, he would say "Sibboleth," because people from Ephraim cannot pronounce the word correctly. Then they would take him and kill him at the shallow crossings of the Jordan. In all, 42,000 Ephraimites were killed at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: then they would say to him, "Just say, ‘Shibboleth.’ " But he said, "Sibboleth," for he was not prepared to pronounce it correctly. Then they seized him and slaughtered him at the crossing places of the Jordan. So at that time forty-two thousand from Ephraim fell.
verses.textEn: they said, "All right, say ‘Shibboleth.’ " If he said, "Sibboleth," because he could not pronounce the word correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites were killed at that time.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他治理以色列人共六年；基列人耶弗他死了以后，埋葬在基列其中的一座城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他治理以色列人共六年；基列人耶弗他死了以后，埋葬在基列其中的一座城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他作以色列的士师六年。基列人耶弗他死了，葬在基列的一座城里。
verses.textEnNiv: Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in a town in Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in his city in Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in among the cities of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Jephthah judged Israel for six years. When he died, he was buried in one of the towns of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Jephthah judged Israel for six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.textEn: Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in a town in Gilead.

verses.textZh: 耶弗他之后，有伯利恒人以比赞治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶弗他之后，有伯利恒人以比赞治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶弗他以后，有伯利恒人以比赞作以色列的士师。
verses.textEnNiv: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: After Jephthah died, Ibzan from Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel after him.
verses.textEn: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

verses.textZh: 他有三十个儿子，三十个女儿；女儿都嫁到外面去，又给他的儿子从外面娶了三十个女子作妻子。他治理以色列人共七年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有三十个儿子，三十个女儿；女儿都嫁到外面去，又给他的儿子从外面娶了三十个女子作妻子。他治理以色列人共七年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有三十个儿子，三十个女儿；女儿都嫁出去了。他给众子从外乡娶了三十个媳妇。他作以色列的士师七年。
verses.textEnNiv: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He gave his daughters away in marriage to those outside his clan, and for his sons he brought in thirty young women as wives from outside his clan. Ibzan led Israel seven years.
verses.textEnEsv: He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters he gave in marriage outside his clan, and thirty daughters he brought in from outside for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.textEnNkjv: He had thirty sons. And he gave away thirty daughters in marriage, and brought in thirty daughters from elsewhere for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.
verses.textEnNlt: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He sent his daughters to marry men outside his clan, and he brought in thirty young women from outside his clan to marry his sons. Ibzan judged Israel for seven years.
verses.textEnNasb: He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage outside the family, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside for his sons. And he judged Israel for seven years.
verses.textEn: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He gave his daughters away in marriage to those outside his clan, and for his sons he brought in thirty young women as wives from outside his clan. Ibzan led Israel seven years.

verses.textZh: 以比赞死了，就埋葬在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以比赞死了，就埋葬在伯利恒。
verses.textZhCuv: 以比赞死了，葬在伯利恒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ibzan died and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ibzan died and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.
verses.textEn: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

verses.textZh: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，治理以色列人共十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，治理以色列人共十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，作以色列的士师十年。
verses.textEnNiv: After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel ten years.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel, and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel. He judged Israel ten years.
verses.textEnNlt: After Ibzan died, Elon from the tribe of Zebulun judged Israel for ten years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel after him; he judged Israel for ten years.
verses.textEn: After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel ten years.

verses.textZh: 西布伦人以伦死了以后，就埋葬在西布伦地的亚雅仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦人以伦死了以后，就埋葬在西布伦地的亚雅仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦人以伦死了，葬在西布伦地的亚雅仑。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elon died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried at Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried at Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he was buried at Aijalon in Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried at Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
verses.textEn: Then Elon died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿治理以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿作以色列的士师。
verses.textEnNiv: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: After him, Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: After Elon died, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, judged Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel after him.
verses.textEn: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.

verses.textZh: 他有四十个儿子，三十个孙子，骑着七十头驴驹；押顿治理以色列人共八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有四十个儿子，三十个孙子，骑着七十头驴驹；押顿治理以色列人共八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有四十个儿子，三十个孙子，骑着七十匹驴驹。押顿作以色列的士师八年。
verses.textEnNiv: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He led Israel eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys, and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.textEnNkjv: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy young donkeys. He judged Israel eight years.
verses.textEnNlt: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He judged Israel for eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons who rode on seventy donkeys; and he judged Israel for eight years.
verses.textEn: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He led Israel eight years.

verses.textZh: 比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿死了，埋葬在以法莲地，就是在亚玛力人的山地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿死了，埋葬在以法莲地，就是在亚玛力人的山地。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿死了，葬在以法莲地的比拉顿，在亚玛力人的山地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried at Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mountains of the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried at Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
verses.textEn: Then Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在非利士人手中四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又行了耶和华看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在非利士人手中四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华将他们交在非利士人手中四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , so the Lord delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , so the Lord gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Again the Israelites did evil in the Lord ’s sight, so the Lord handed them over to the Philistines, who oppressed them for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord handed them over to the Philistines for forty years.
verses.textEn: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , so the Lord delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

verses.textZh: 那时有一个琐拉人，是属于但支派的，名叫玛挪亚；他的妻子不能生育，没有孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时有一个琐拉人，是属于但支派的，名叫玛挪亚；他的妻子不能生育，没有孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有一个琐拉人，是属但族的，名叫玛挪亚。他的妻不怀孕，不生育。
verses.textEnNiv: A certain man of Zorah, named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, had a wife who was childless, unable to give birth.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the tribe of the Danites, whose name was Manoah. And his wife was barren and had no children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a certain man from Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren and had no children.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days a man named Manoah from the tribe of Dan lived in the town of Zorah. His wife was unable to become pregnant, and they had no children.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was infertile and had not given birth to any children.
verses.textEn: A certain man of Zorah, named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, had a wife who was childless, unable to give birth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者向那妇人显现，对她说："你向来不能生育，没有孩子，现在你必要怀孕，生一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者向那妇人显现，对她说："你向来不能生育，没有孩子，现在你必要怀孕，生一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者向那妇人显现，对她说：「向来你不怀孕，不生育，如今你必怀孕生一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord appeared to her and said, "You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, "Behold, you are barren and have not borne children, but you shall conceive and bear a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, "Indeed now, you are barren and have borne no children, but you shall conceive and bear a son.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel of the Lord appeared to Manoah’s wife and said, "Even though you have been unable to have children, you will soon become pregnant and give birth to a son.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of the Lord appeared to the woman and said to her, "Behold now, you are infertile and have not given birth; but you will conceive and give birth to a son.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord appeared to her and said, "You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.

verses.textZh: 现在你要谨慎，清酒或烈酒都不可喝，各样不洁的东西也不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要谨慎，清酒或烈酒都不可喝，各样不洁的东西也不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当谨慎，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore be careful and drink no wine or strong drink, and eat nothing unclean,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please be careful not to drink wine or similar drink, and not to eat anything unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: So be careful; you must not drink wine or any other alcoholic drink nor eat any forbidden food.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing.
verses.textEn: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你必怀孕，生一个儿子；不可用剃刀剃他的头，这孩子从在母腹开始就归神作拿细耳人；他必拯救以色列人脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你必怀孕，生一个儿子；不可用剃刀剃他的头，这孩子从在母腹开始就归神作拿细耳人；他必拯救以色列人脱离非利士人的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必怀孕生一个儿子，不可用剃头刀剃他的头，因为这孩子一出胎就归神作拿细耳人。他必起首拯救以色列人脱离非利士人的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will become pregnant and have a son whose head is never to be touched by a razor because the boy is to be a Nazirite, dedicated to God from the womb. He will take the lead in delivering Israel from the hands of the Philistines."
verses.textEnEsv: for behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. No razor shall come upon his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb, and he shall begin to save Israel from the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. And no razor shall come upon his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb; and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines."
verses.textEnNlt: You will become pregnant and give birth to a son, and his hair must never be cut. For he will be dedicated to God as a Nazirite from birth. He will begin to rescue Israel from the Philistines."
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and no razor shall come upon his head, for the boy shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb; and he will begin to save Israel from the hands of the Philistines."
verses.textEn: You will become pregnant and have a son whose head is never to be touched by a razor because the boy is to be a Nazirite, dedicated to God from the womb. He will take the lead in delivering Israel from the hands of the Philistines."

verses.textZh: 妇人就回去，告诉她的丈夫说："有一位神人到我这里来，他的容貌像神使者的容貌，非常可畏，我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有告诉我他的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人就回去，告诉她的丈夫说："有一位神人到我这里来，他的容貌像神使者的容貌，非常可畏，我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有告诉我他的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就回去对丈夫说：「有一个神人到我面前来，他的相貌如神使者的相貌，甚是可畏。我没有问他从哪里来，他也没有将他的名告诉我，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman went to her husband and told him, "A man of God came to me. He looked like an angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he came from, and he didn’t tell me his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the woman came and told her husband, "A man of God came to me, and his appearance was like the appearance of the angel of God, very awesome. I did not ask him where he was from, and he did not tell me his name,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the woman came and told her husband, saying, "A Man of God came to me, and His countenance was like the countenance of the Angel of God, very awesome; but I did not ask Him where He was from, and He did not tell me His name.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman ran and told her husband, "A man of God appeared to me! He looked like one of God’s angels, terrifying to see. I didn’t ask where he was from, and he didn’t tell me his name.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, "A man of God came to me, and his appearance was like the appearance of the angel of God, very awesome. So I did not ask him where he came from, nor did he tell me his name.
verses.textEn: Then the woman went to her husband and told him, "A man of God came to me. He looked like an angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he came from, and he didn’t tell me his name.

verses.textZh: 他对我说：‘你必要怀孕，生一个儿子；现在清酒或烈酒你都不可喝，各样不洁的东西你也不可吃，因为这孩子从在母腹开始，一直到死，都必归耶和华作拿细耳人。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说：‘你必要怀孕，生一个儿子；现在清酒或烈酒你都不可喝，各样不洁的东西你也不可吃，因为这孩子从在母腹开始，一直到死，都必归耶和华作拿细耳人。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 却对我说：『你要怀孕生一个儿子，所以清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃；因为这孩子从出胎一直到死，必归神作拿细耳人。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said to me, ‘You will become pregnant and have a son. Now then, drink no wine or other fermented drink and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite of God from the womb until the day of his death.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. So then drink no wine or strong drink, and eat nothing unclean, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son. Now drink no wine or similar drink, nor eat anything unclean, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But he told me, ‘You will become pregnant and give birth to a son. You must not drink wine or any other alcoholic drink nor eat any forbidden food. For your son will be dedicated to God as a Nazirite from the moment of his birth until the day of his death.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son, and now you shall not drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing, for the boy shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’ "
verses.textEn: But he said to me, ‘You will become pregnant and have a son. Now then, drink no wine or other fermented drink and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite of God from the womb until the day of his death.’ "

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚就恳求耶和华，说："啊，主啊，求你叫你派来的神人再到我们这里吧！好指教我们要怎样对待将要生下来的孩子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚就恳求耶和华，说："啊，主啊，求你叫你派来的神人再到我们这里吧！好指教我们要怎样对待将要生下来的孩子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚就祈求耶和华说：「主啊，求你再差遣那神人到我们这里来，好指教我们怎样待这将要生的孩子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord : "Pardon your servant, Lord. I beg you to let the man of God you sent to us come again to teach us how to bring up the boy who is to be born."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord and said, "O Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us and teach us what we are to do with the child who will be born."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord, and said, "O my Lord, please let the Man of God whom You sent come to us again and teach us what we shall do for the child who will be born."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord , saying, "Lord, please let the man of God come back to us again and give us more instructions about this son who is to be born."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Manoah pleaded with the Lord and said, "Lord, please let the man of God whom You have sent come to us again so that he may teach us what we are to do for the boy who is to be born."
verses.textEn: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord : "Pardon your servant, Lord. I beg you to let the man of God you sent to us come again to teach us how to bring up the boy who is to be born."

verses.textZh: 神听了玛挪亚的声音。妇人正坐在田间的时候，神的使者又来到她那里，她的丈夫玛挪亚却没有与她在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神听了玛挪亚的声音。妇人正坐在田间的时候，神的使者又来到她那里，她的丈夫玛挪亚却没有与她在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 神应允玛挪亚的话；妇人正坐在田间的时候，神的使者又到她那里，她丈夫玛挪亚却没有同她在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
verses.textEnEsv: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field. But Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the Angel of God came to the woman again as she was sitting in the field; but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.textEnNlt: God answered Manoah’s prayer, and the angel of God appeared once again to his wife as she was sitting in the field. But her husband, Manoah, was not with her.
verses.textEnNasb: And God listened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again to the woman as she was sitting in the field, but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.textEn: God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.

verses.textZh: 妇人急忙跑去告诉丈夫，对他说："那天到我这里来的那人，又向我显现了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人急忙跑去告诉丈夫，对他说："那天到我这里来的那人，又向我显现了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人急忙跑去告诉丈夫说：「那日到我面前来的人，又向我显现。」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman hurried to tell her husband, "He’s here! The man who appeared to me the other day!"
verses.textEnEsv: So the woman ran quickly and told her husband, "Behold, the man who came to me the other day has appeared to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman ran in haste and told her husband, and said to him, "Look, the Man who came to me the other day has just now appeared to me!"
verses.textEnNlt: So she quickly ran and told her husband, "The man who appeared to me the other day is here again!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, "Behold, the man who came the other day has appeared to me!"
verses.textEn: The woman hurried to tell her husband, "He’s here! The man who appeared to me the other day!"

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚起来，跟着他的妻子出去，来到那人跟前，问他："你就是向这个妇人说过话的人吗？"他回答："我就是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚起来，跟着他的妻子出去，来到那人跟前，问他："你就是向这个妇人说过话的人吗？"他回答："我就是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚起来跟随他的妻来到那人面前，对他说：「与这妇人说话的就是你吗？」他说：「是我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he said, "Are you the man who talked to my wife?" "I am," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And Manoah arose and went after his wife and came to the man and said to him, "Are you the man who spoke to this woman?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Manoah arose and followed his wife. When he came to the Man, he said to Him, "Are You the Man who spoke to this woman?" And He said, "I am."
verses.textEnNlt: Manoah ran back with his wife and asked, "Are you the man who spoke to my wife the other day?" "Yes," he replied, "I am."
verses.textEnNasb: So Manoah got up and followed his wife, and when he came to the man he said to him, "Are you the man who spoke to the woman?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEn: Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he said, "Are you the man who talked to my wife?" "I am," he said.

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚说："你的话应验的时候，这孩子的生活方式怎样？他要作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚说："你的话应验的时候，这孩子的生活方式怎样？他要作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚说：「愿你的话应验！我们当怎样待这孩子，他后来当怎样呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Manoah asked him, "When your words are fulfilled, what is to be the rule that governs the boy’s life and work?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Manoah said, "Now when your words come true, what is to be the child’s manner of life, and what is his mission?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Manoah said, "Now let Your words come topass! What will be the boy’s rule of life, and his work?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Manoah asked him, "When your words come true, what kind of rules should govern the boy’s life and work?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Manoah said, "Now when your words are fulfilled, what shall be the boy’s way of life and his vocation?"
verses.textEn: So Manoah asked him, "When your words are fulfilled, what is to be the rule that governs the boy’s life and work?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说："我对妇人所说的一切话，她都要谨守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说："我对妇人所说的一切话，她都要谨守。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「我告诉妇人的一切事，她都当谨慎。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord answered, "Your wife must do all that I have told her.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel of the Lord replied, "Be sure your wife follows the instructions I gave her.
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "The woman shall pay attention to all that I said.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord answered, "Your wife must do all that I have told her.

verses.textZh: 从葡萄树所产的，她都不可吃；清酒或烈酒，她都不可喝；各样不洁的东西，她也不可吃；我吩咐她的，她都要谨守。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从葡萄树所产的，她都不可吃；清酒或烈酒，她都不可喝；各样不洁的东西，她也不可吃；我吩咐她的，她都要谨守。"
verses.textZhCuv: 葡萄树所结的都不可吃，清酒浓酒都不可喝，一切不洁之物也不可吃。凡我所吩咐的，她都当遵守。」
verses.textEnNiv: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, nor drink any wine or other fermented drink nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her."
verses.textEnEsv: She may not eat of anything that comes from the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, or eat any unclean thing. All that I commanded her let her observe."
verses.textEnNkjv: She may not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor may she drink wine or similar drink, nor eat anything unclean. All that I commanded her let her observe."
verses.textEnNlt: She must not eat grapes or raisins, drink wine or any other alcoholic drink, or eat any forbidden food."
verses.textEnNasb: She shall not eat anything that comes from the vine nor drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing; she shall keep all that I commanded."
verses.textEn: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, nor drink any wine or other fermented drink nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her."

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说："请留下，好让我为你预备一只山羊羔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说："请留下，好让我为你预备一只山羊羔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「求你容我们款留你，好为你预备一只山羊羔。」
verses.textEnNiv: Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "We would like you to stay until we prepare a young goat for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "Please let us detain you and prepare a young goat for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Manoah said to the Angel of the Lord, "Please let us detain You, and we will prepare a young goat for You."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "Please stay here until we can prepare a young goat for you to eat."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, "Please let us detain you so that we may prepare a young goat for you."
verses.textEn: Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "We would like you to stay until we prepare a young goat for you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说："你虽然要我留下，我却不吃你的食物；如果你预备燔祭，就当献给耶和华。"原来玛挪亚还不知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说："你虽然要我留下，我却不吃你的食物；如果你预备燔祭，就当献给耶和华。"原来玛挪亚还不知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对玛挪亚说：「你虽然款留我，我却不吃你的食物，你若预备燔祭就当献与耶和华。」原来玛挪亚不知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord replied, "Even though you detain me, I will not eat any of your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the Lord ." (Manoah did not realize that it was the angel of the Lord .)
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "If you detain me, I will not eat of your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, then offer it to the Lord ." (For Manoah did not know that he was the angel of the Lord .)
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Though you detain Me, I will not eat your food. But if you offer a burnt offering, you must offer it to the Lord." (For Manoah did not know He was the Angel of the Lord.)
verses.textEnNlt: "I will stay," the angel of the Lord replied, "but I will not eat anything. However, you may prepare a burnt offering as a sacrifice to the Lord ." (Manoah didn’t realize it was the angel of the Lord .)
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, "Though you detain me, I will not eat your food, but if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the Lord." For Manoah did not know that he was the angel of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord replied, "Even though you detain me, I will not eat any of your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the Lord ." (Manoah did not realize that it was the angel of the Lord .)

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚问耶和华的使者："你叫甚么名字？到你的话应验的时候，我们好把尊荣归你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚问耶和华的使者："你叫甚么名字？到你的话应验的时候，我们好把尊荣归你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚对耶和华的使者说：「请将你的名告诉我，到你话应验的时候，我们好尊敬你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Manoah inquired of the angel of the Lord , "What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes true?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord , "What is your name, so that, when your words come true, we may honor you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Manoah said to the Angel of the Lord, "What is Your name, that when Your words come topass we may honor You?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Manoah asked the angel of the Lord , "What is your name? For when all this comes true, we want to honor you."
verses.textEnNasb: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, "What is your name, so that when your words are fulfilled, we may honor you?"
verses.textEn: Then Manoah inquired of the angel of the Lord , "What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes true?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对他说："你为甚么问我的名字呢？我的名是奇妙的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对他说："你为甚么问我的名字呢？我的名是奇妙的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对他说：「你何必问我的名，我名是奇妙的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding. "
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to him, "Why do you ask my name, seeing it is wonderful?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to him, "Why do you ask My name, seeing it is wonderful?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do you ask my name?" the angel of the Lord replied. "It is too wonderful for you to understand."
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord said to him, "Why do you ask my name, for it is wonderful?"
verses.textEn: He replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding. "

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚取了一只山羊羔和素祭，在盘石上献与那行奇事的耶和华 ；玛挪亚和他的妻子一直在观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚取了一只山羊羔和素祭，在盘石上献与那行奇事的耶和华 ；玛挪亚和他的妻子一直在观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚将一只山羊羔和素祭在磐石上献与耶和华，使者行奇妙的事；玛挪亚和他的妻观看，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Manoah took a young goat, together with the grain offering, and sacrificed it on a rock to the Lord . And the Lord did an amazing thing while Manoah and his wife watched:
verses.textEnEsv: So Manoah took the young goat with the grain offering, and offered it on the rock to the Lord , to the one who works wonders, and Manoah and his wife were watching.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Manoah took the young goat with the grain offering, and offered it upon the rock to the Lord. And He did a wondrous thing while Manoah and his wife looked on—
verses.textEnNlt: Then Manoah took a young goat and a grain offering and offered it on a rock as a sacrifice to the Lord . And as Manoah and his wife watched, the Lord did an amazing thing.
verses.textEnNasb: So Manoah took the young goat along with the grain offering and offered it on the rock to the Lord; and He performed wonders while Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.textEn: Then Manoah took a young goat, together with the grain offering, and sacrificed it on a rock to the Lord . And the Lord did an amazing thing while Manoah and his wife watched:

verses.textZh: 火焰从祭坛上往天升起的时候，耶和华的使者在祭坛上的火焰中也升上去了；玛挪亚和他的妻子看见了，就俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 火焰从祭坛上往天升起的时候，耶和华的使者在祭坛上的火焰中也升上去了；玛挪亚和他的妻子看见了，就俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 见火焰从坛上往上升，耶和华的使者在坛上的火焰中也升上去了。玛挪亚和他的妻看见，就俯伏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: As the flame blazed up from the altar toward heaven, the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame. Seeing this, Manoah and his wife fell with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the flame went up toward heaven from the altar, the angel of the Lord went up in the flame of the altar. Now Manoah and his wife were watching, and they fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: it happened as the flame went up toward heaven from the altar—the Angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar! When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: As the flames from the altar shot up toward the sky, the angel of the Lord ascended in the fire. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: For it came about when the flame went up from the altar toward heaven, that the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.textEn: As the flame blazed up from the altar toward heaven, the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame. Seeing this, Manoah and his wife fell with their faces to the ground.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者没有再向玛挪亚和他的妻子显现，那时玛挪亚才知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者没有再向玛挪亚和他的妻子显现，那时玛挪亚才知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者不再向玛挪亚和他的妻显现，玛挪亚才知道他是耶和华的使者。
verses.textEnNiv: When the angel of the Lord did not show himself again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it was the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The angel of the Lord appeared no more to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Angel of the Lord appeared no more to Manoah and his wife, then Manoah knew that He was the Angel of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel did not appear again to Manoah and his wife. Manoah finally realized it was the angel of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the angel of the Lord did not appear to Manoah or his wife again. Then Manoah knew that he was the angel of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When the angel of the Lord did not show himself again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it was the angel of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 玛挪亚对他的妻子说："我们必定要死，因为我们看见了神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛挪亚对他的妻子说："我们必定要死，因为我们看见了神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 玛挪亚对他的妻说：「我们必要死，因为看见了神。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We are doomed to die!" he said to his wife. "We have seen God!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, for we have seen God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, because we have seen God!"
verses.textEnNlt: and he said to his wife, "We will certainly die, for we have seen God!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Manoah said to his wife, "We will certainly die, for we have seen God."
verses.textEn: "We are doomed to die!" he said to his wife. "We have seen God!"

verses.textZh: 他的妻子却对他说："如果耶和华有意要杀我们，就必不从我们的手里接纳燔祭和素祭，也必不会把这一切事指示我们，更不会在这个时候向我们宣布这些事啊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的妻子却对他说："如果耶和华有意要杀我们，就必不从我们的手里接纳燔祭和素祭，也必不会把这一切事指示我们，更不会在这个时候向我们宣布这些事啊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的妻却对他说：「耶和华若要杀我们，必不从我们手里收纳燔祭和素祭，并不将这一切事指示我们，今日也不将这些话告诉我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: But his wife answered, "If the Lord had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and grain offering from our hands, nor shown us all these things or now told us this."
verses.textEnEsv: But his wife said to him, "If the Lord had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering at our hands, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such things as these."
verses.textEnNkjv: But his wife said to him, "If the Lord had desired to kill us, He would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things, nor would He have told us suchthings as these at this time."
verses.textEnNlt: But his wife said, "If the Lord were going to kill us, he wouldn’t have accepted our burnt offering and grain offering. He wouldn’t have appeared to us and told us this wonderful thing and done these miracles."
verses.textEnNasb: But his wife said to him, "If the Lord had desired to kill us, He would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things, nor would He have let us hear things like this at this time."
verses.textEn: But his wife answered, "If the Lord had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and grain offering from our hands, nor shown us all these things or now told us this."

verses.textZh: 后来那妇人生了一个儿子，她就给他起名叫参孙；孩子渐渐长大了，耶和华赐福给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来那妇人生了一个儿子，她就给他起名叫参孙；孩子渐渐长大了，耶和华赐福给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来妇人生了一个儿子，给他起名叫参孙。孩子长大，耶和华赐福与他。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman gave birth to a boy and named him Samson. He grew and the Lord blessed him,
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman bore a son and called his name Samson. And the young man grew, and the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the woman bore a son and called his name Samson; and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: When her son was born, she named him Samson. And the Lord blessed him as he grew up.
verses.textEnNasb: So the woman gave birth to a son, and named him Samson; and the child grew up and the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEn: The woman gave birth to a boy and named him Samson. He grew and the Lord blessed him,

verses.textZh: 在玛哈尼．但 ，就是在琐拉和以实陶中间，耶和华的灵开始感动参孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在玛哈尼．但 ，就是在琐拉和以实陶中间，耶和华的灵开始感动参孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 在玛哈尼‧但，就是琐拉和以实陶中间，耶和华的灵才感动他。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him while he was in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move upon him at Mahaneh Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him while he lived in Mahaneh-dan, which is located between the towns of Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him when he was in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEn: and the Spirit of the Lord began to stir him while he was in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.textZh: 参孙下到亭拿，在亭拿看见了一个女子，是一个非利士人的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙下到亭拿，在亭拿看见了一个女子，是一个非利士人的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙下到亭拿，在那里看见一个女子，是非利士人的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.
verses.textEnEsv: Samson went down to Timnah, and at Timnah he saw one of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: One day when Samson was in Timnah, one of the Philistine women caught his eye.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samson went down to Timnah, and he saw a woman in Timnah, one of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.

verses.textZh: 参孙上来告诉他的父母，说："我在亭拿看见一个女子，是一个非利士人的女儿；现在请你们把她娶来给我作妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙上来告诉他的父母，说："我在亭拿看见一个女子，是一个非利士人的女儿；现在请你们把她娶来给我作妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙上来禀告他父母说：「我在亭拿看见一个女子，是非利士人的女儿，愿你们给我娶来为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he returned, he said to his father and mother, "I have seen a Philistine woman in Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he came up and told his father and mother, "I saw one of the daughters of the Philistines at Timnah. Now get her for me as my wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went up and told his father and mother, saying, "I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines; now therefore, get her for me as a wife."
verses.textEnNlt: When he returned home, he told his father and mother, "A young Philistine woman in Timnah caught my eye. I want to marry her. Get her for me."
verses.textEnNasb: So he came back and told his father and mother, "I saw a woman in Timnah, one of the daughters of the Philistines; so now, get her for me as a wife."
verses.textEn: When he returned, he said to his father and mother, "I have seen a Philistine woman in Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."

verses.textZh: 他的父母对他说："在你兄弟的女儿中，或是在你所有的族人中，难道没有一个女子，以致你要去从那些未受割礼的非利士人中娶妻呢？"参孙对他的父亲说："请你把她娶来给我，因为我看中她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母对他说："在你兄弟的女儿中，或是在你所有的族人中，难道没有一个女子，以致你要去从那些未受割礼的非利士人中娶妻呢？"参孙对他的父亲说："请你把她娶来给我，因为我看中她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他父母说：「在你弟兄的女儿中，或在本国的民中，岂没有一个女子，何至你去在未受割礼的非利士人中娶妻呢？」参孙对他父亲说：「愿你给我娶那女子，因我喜悦她。」
verses.textEnNiv: His father and mother replied, "Isn’t there an acceptable woman among your relatives or among all our people? Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife?" But Samson said to his father, "Get her for me. She’s the right one for me."
verses.textEnEsv: But his father and mother said to him, "Is there not a woman among the daughters of your relatives, or among all our people, that you must go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?" But Samson said to his father, "Get her for me, for she is right in my eyes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his father and mother said to him, "Isthere no woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that you must go and get a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?" And Samson said to his father, "Get her for me, for she pleases me well."
verses.textEnNlt: His father and mother objected. "Isn’t there even one woman in our tribe or among all the Israelites you could marry?" they asked. "Why must you go to the pagan Philistines to find a wife?" But Samson told his father, "Get her for me! She looks good to me."
verses.textEnNasb: But his father and his mother said to him, "Is there no woman among the daughters of your relatives, or among all our people, that you go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?" Yet Samson said to his father, "Get her for me, because she is right for me."
verses.textEn: His father and mother replied, "Isn’t there an acceptable woman among your relatives or among all our people? Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife?" But Samson said to his father, "Get her for me. She’s the right one for me."

verses.textZh: 他的父母却不知道这事是出于耶和华，因为他正在找机会攻击非利士人。那时非利士人正统治着以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父母却不知道这事是出于耶和华，因为他正在找机会攻击非利士人。那时非利士人正统治着以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的父母却不知道这事是出于耶和华，因为他找机会攻击非利士人。那时，非利士人辖制以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: (His parents did not know that this was from the Lord , who was seeking an occasion to confront the Philistines; for at that time they were ruling over Israel.)
verses.textEnEsv: His father and mother did not know that it was from the Lord , for he was seeking an opportunity against the Philistines. At that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But his father and mother did not know that it was of the Lord—that He was seeking an occasion to move against the Philistines. For at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: His father and mother didn’t realize the Lord was at work in this, creating an opportunity to work against the Philistines, who ruled over Israel at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: However, his father and mother did not know that this was of the Lord, for He was seeking an occasion against the Philistines. And at that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel.
verses.textEn: (His parents did not know that this was from the Lord , who was seeking an occasion to confront the Philistines; for at that time they were ruling over Israel.)

verses.textZh: 参孙跟他的父母下到亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄园；忽然见一只少壮狮子向他吼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙跟他的父母下到亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄园；忽然见一只少壮狮子向他吼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙跟他父母下亭拿去，到了亭拿的葡萄园，见有一只少壮狮子向他吼叫。
verses.textEnNiv: Samson went down to Timnah together with his father and mother. As they approached the vineyards of Timnah, suddenly a young lion came roaring toward him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Samson went down with his father and mother to Timnah, and they came to the vineyards of Timnah. And behold, a young lion came toward him roaring.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah. Now tohis surprise, a young lion came roaring against him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Samson and his parents were going down to Timnah, a young lion suddenly attacked Samson near the vineyards of Timnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother, and came as far as the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion came roaring toward him.
verses.textEn: Samson went down to Timnah together with his father and mother. As they approached the vineyards of Timnah, suddenly a young lion came roaring toward him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他虽然手里没有武器，竟把狮子撕裂，像人撕裂山羊羔一样；他没有把他所作的这事告诉他的父母。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他虽然手里没有武器，竟把狮子撕裂，像人撕裂山羊羔一样；他没有把他所作的这事告诉他的父母。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他虽然手无器械，却将狮子撕裂，如同撕裂山羊羔一样。他行这事并没有告诉父母。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him so that he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as he might have torn a young goat. But he told neither his father nor his mother what he had done.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and although he had nothing in his hand, he tore the lion in pieces as one tears a young goat. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and he tore the lion apart as one would have torn apart a young goat, though hehad nothing in his hand. But he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.textEnNlt: At that moment the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him, and he ripped the lion’s jaws apart with his bare hands. He did it as easily as if it were a young goat. But he didn’t tell his father or mother about it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, so that he tore it apart as one tears apart a young goat, though he had nothing in his hand; but he did not tell his father or mother what he had done.
verses.textEn: The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him so that he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as he might have torn a young goat. But he told neither his father nor his mother what he had done.

verses.textZh: 参孙下去，和那女子说话，就看中了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙下去，和那女子说话，就看中了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙下去与女子说话，就喜悦她；
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and she was right in Samson’s eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went down and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
verses.textEnNlt: When Samson arrived in Timnah, he talked with the woman and was very pleased with her.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went down and talked to the woman; and she looked pleasing to Samson.
verses.textEn: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.

verses.textZh: 过了些日子，参孙回去迎娶那女子，他转向一旁去看看那只死了的狮子；看见有一群蜂子和一些蜂蜜在狮子的尸体内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了些日子，参孙回去迎娶那女子，他转向一旁去看看那只死了的狮子；看见有一群蜂子和一些蜂蜜在狮子的尸体内。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了些日子，再下去要娶那女子，转向道旁要看死狮，见有一群蜂子和蜜在死狮之内，
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, when he went back to marry her, he turned aside to look at the lion’s carcass, and in it he saw a swarm of bees and some honey.
verses.textEnEsv: After some days he returned to take her. And he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion, and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: After some time, when he returned to get her, he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion. And behold, a swarm of bees and honey were in the carcass of the lion.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when he returned to Timnah for the wedding, he turned off the path to look at the carcass of the lion. And he found that a swarm of bees had made some honey in the carcass.
verses.textEnNasb: When he returned later to take her, he turned aside to look at the carcass of the lion; and behold, a swarm of bees and honey were in the body of the lion.
verses.textEn: Some time later, when he went back to marry her, he turned aside to look at the lion’s carcass, and in it he saw a swarm of bees and some honey.

verses.textZh: 他刮了些蜂蜜，放在手里，就走了；他一面走，一面吃，直走到他的父母那里去；他又把蜂蜜给了他们，他们也吃了；但是他没有告诉他们这蜂蜜是从狮子的尸体内刮下来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他刮了些蜂蜜，放在手里，就走了；他一面走，一面吃，直走到他的父母那里去；他又把蜂蜜给了他们，他们也吃了；但是他没有告诉他们这蜂蜜是从狮子的尸体内刮下来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就用手取蜜，且吃且走；到了父母那里，给他父母，他们也吃了；只是没有告诉这蜜是从死狮之内取来的。
verses.textEnNiv: He scooped out the honey with his hands and ate as he went along. When he rejoined his parents, he gave them some, and they too ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass.
verses.textEnEsv: He scraped it out into his hands and went on, eating as he went. And he came to his father and mother and gave some to them, and they ate. But he did not tell them that he had scraped the honey from the carcass of the lion.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took some of it in his hands and went along, eating. When he came to his father and mother, he gave some to them, and they also ate. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the carcass of the lion.
verses.textEnNlt: He scooped some of the honey into his hands and ate it along the way. He also gave some to his father and mother, and they ate it. But he didn’t tell them he had taken the honey from the carcass of the lion.
verses.textEnNasb: So he took out the honey on his hands and went on, eating as he went. When he came to his father and mother, he gave some to them and they ate it; but he did not tell them that he had taken the honey out of the body of the lion.
verses.textEn: He scooped out the honey with his hands and ate as he went along. When he rejoined his parents, he gave them some, and they too ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass.

verses.textZh: 参孙的父亲下去见那女子，参孙在那里摆设了筵席，因为青年人都惯常这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙的父亲下去见那女子，参孙在那里摆设了筵席，因为青年人都惯常这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲下去见女子。参孙在那里设摆筵宴，因为向来少年人都有这个规矩。
verses.textEnNiv: Now his father went down to see the woman. And there Samson held a feast, as was customary for young men.
verses.textEnEsv: His father went down to the woman, and Samson prepared a feast there, for so the young men used to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: So his father went down to the woman. And Samson gave a feast there, for young men used to do so.
verses.textEnNlt: As his father was making final arrangements for the marriage, Samson threw a party at Timnah, as was the custom for elite young men.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his father went down to the woman; and Samson held a feast there, for the young men customarily did this.
verses.textEn: Now his father went down to see the woman. And there Samson held a feast, as was customary for young men.

verses.textZh: 众人看见参孙，就请了三十个人陪伴他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见参孙，就请了三十个人陪伴他。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见参孙，就请了三十个人陪伴他。
verses.textEnNiv: When the people saw him, they chose thirty men to be his companions.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as the people saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the bride’s parents saw him, they selected thirty young men from the town to be his companions.
verses.textEnNasb: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.textEn: When the people saw him, they chose thirty men to be his companions.

verses.textZh: 参孙对他们说："现在让我给你们出一个谜语，你们在七天婚宴之内，如果能猜出来，把它的意思清楚告诉我，我就给你们三十件内衣、三十套衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对他们说："现在让我给你们出一个谜语，你们在七天婚宴之内，如果能猜出来，把它的意思清楚告诉我，我就给你们三十件内衣、三十套衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙对他们说：「我给你们出一个谜语，你们在七日筵宴之内，若能猜出意思告诉我，我就给你们三十件里衣，三十套衣裳；
verses.textEnNiv: "Let me tell you a riddle," Samson said to them. "If you can give me the answer within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: And Samson said to them, "Let me now put a riddle to you. If you can tell me what it is, within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samson said to them, "Let me pose a riddle to you. If you can correctly solve and explain it to me within the seven days of the feast, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Samson said to them, "Let me tell you a riddle. If you solve my riddle during these seven days of the celebration, I will give you thirty fine linen robes and thirty sets of festive clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samson said to them, "Let me now propose a riddle for you; if you actually tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and solve it, then I will give you thirty linen wraps and thirty outfits of clothes.
verses.textEn: "Let me tell you a riddle," Samson said to them. "If you can give me the answer within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.

verses.textZh: 如果你们不能告诉我，你们就要给我三十件内衣、三十套衣服。"他们对他说："请你把谜语说给我们听。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不能告诉我，你们就要给我三十件内衣、三十套衣服。"他们对他说："请你把谜语说给我们听。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不能猜出意思告诉我，你们就给我三十件里衣，三十套衣裳。」他们说：「请将谜语说给我们听。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you can’t tell me the answer, you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes." "Tell us your riddle," they said. "Let’s hear it."
verses.textEnEsv: but if you cannot tell me what it is, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes." And they said to him, "Put your riddle, that we may hear it."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you cannot explain it to me, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing." And they said to him, "Pose your riddle, that we may hear it."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you can’t solve it, then you must give me thirty fine linen robes and thirty sets of festive clothing." "All right," they agreed, "let’s hear your riddle."
verses.textEnNasb: But if you are unable to tell me, then you shall give me thirty linen wraps and thirty outfits of clothes." And they said to him, "Propose your riddle, so that we may hear it."
verses.textEn: If you can’t tell me the answer, you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes." "Tell us your riddle," they said. "Let’s hear it."

verses.textZh: 参孙对他们说： "可吃的从吃者出来； 甜的从强者出来。" 他们过了三日都不能说出谜语的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对他们说： "可吃的从吃者出来； 甜的从强者出来。" 他们过了三日都不能说出谜语的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙对他们说： 吃的从吃者出来； 甜的从强者出来。 他们三日不能猜出谜语的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet." For three days they could not give the answer.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet." And in three days they could not solve the riddle.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them: "Out of the eater came something to eat, And out of the strong came something sweet." Now for three days they could not explain the riddle.
verses.textEnNlt: So he said: "Out of the one who eats came something to eat; out of the strong came something sweet." Three days later they were still trying to figure it out.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to them, "Out of the eater came something to eat, And out of the strong came something sweet." But they could not tell the answer to the riddle in three days.
verses.textEn: He replied, "Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet." For three days they could not give the answer.

verses.textZh: 到了第四天 ，他们对参孙的妻子说："你要引诱你的丈夫，使他把谜语的意思告诉我们，否则我们用火烧你和你的父家。难道你们请了我们来，是要夺取我们所有的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第四天 ，他们对参孙的妻子说："你要引诱你的丈夫，使他把谜语的意思告诉我们，否则我们用火烧你和你的父家。难道你们请了我们来，是要夺取我们所有的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 到第七天，他们对参孙的妻说：「你诓哄你丈夫，探出谜语的意思告诉我们，免得我们用火烧你和你父家。你们请了我们来，是要夺我们所有的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: On the fourth day, they said to Samson’s wife, "Coax your husband into explaining the riddle for us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to steal our property?"
verses.textEnEsv: On the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife, "Entice your husband to tell us what the riddle is, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you invited us here to impoverish us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But it came to pass on the seventh day that they said to Samson’s wife, "Entice your husband, that he may explain the riddle to us, or else we will burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you invited us in order to take what is ours? Isthat not so?"
verses.textEnNlt: On the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife, "Entice your husband to explain the riddle for us, or we will burn down your father’s house with you in it. Did you invite us to this party just to make us poor?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about on the fourth day that they said to Samson’s wife, "Entice your husband, so that he will tell us the riddle, or we will burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you invited us to impoverish us? Is this not so?"
