verses.textEn: On the fourth day, they said to Samson’s wife, "Coax your husband into explaining the riddle for us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to steal our property?"

verses.textZh: 参孙的妻子在丈夫面前哭哭啼啼，说："你只是恨我，不是爱我；你给我的族人设谜语，却没有把谜语的意思告诉我。"参孙对她说："连我父母我都没有告诉，怎能告诉你呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙的妻子在丈夫面前哭哭啼啼，说："你只是恨我，不是爱我；你给我的族人设谜语，却没有把谜语的意思告诉我。"参孙对她说："连我父母我都没有告诉，怎能告诉你呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙的妻在丈夫面前啼哭说：「你是恨我，不是爱我，你给我本国的人出谜语，却没有将意思告诉我。」参孙回答说：「连我父母我都没有告诉，岂可告诉你呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samson’s wife threw herself on him, sobbing, "You hate me! You don’t really love me. You’ve given my people a riddle, but you haven’t told me the answer." "I haven’t even explained it to my father or mother," he replied, "so why should I explain it to you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Samson’s wife wept over him and said, "You only hate me; you do not love me. You have put a riddle to my people, and you have not told me what it is." And he said to her, "Behold, I have not told my father nor my mother, and shall I tell you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samson’s wife wept on him, and said, "You only hate me! You do not love me! You have posed a riddle to the sons of my people, but you have not explained it to me." And he said to her, "Look, I have not explained it to my father or my mother; so should I explain it to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Samson’s wife came to him in tears and said, "You don’t love me; you hate me! You have given my people a riddle, but you haven’t told me the answer." "I haven’t even given the answer to my father or mother," he replied. "Why should I tell you?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Samson’s wife wept in front of him and said, "You only hate me, and you do not love me; you have proposed a riddle to the sons of my people, and have not told it to me." And he said to her, "Behold, I have not told it to my father or mother; so should I tell you?"
verses.textEn: Then Samson’s wife threw herself on him, sobbing, "You hate me! You don’t really love me. You’ve given my people a riddle, but you haven’t told me the answer." "I haven’t even explained it to my father or mother," he replied, "so why should I explain it to you?"

verses.textZh: 在那七天婚宴期内，她在丈夫跟前常常哭哭啼啼；到了第七天，因为她催逼着参孙，参孙才告诉她；于是她把谜语的意思告诉她的族人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那七天婚宴期内，她在丈夫跟前常常哭哭啼啼；到了第七天，因为她催逼着参孙，参孙才告诉她；于是她把谜语的意思告诉她的族人。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日筵宴之内，她在丈夫面前啼哭，到第七天逼着他，他才将谜语的意思告诉他妻，他妻就告诉本国的人。
verses.textEnNiv: She cried the whole seven days of the feast. So on the seventh day he finally told her, because she continued to press him. She in turn explained the riddle to her people.
verses.textEnEsv: She wept before him the seven days that their feast lasted, and on the seventh day he told her, because she pressed him hard. Then she told the riddle to her people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now she had wept on him the seven days while their feast lasted. And it happened on the seventh day that he told her, because she pressed him so much. Then she explained the riddle to the sons of her people.
verses.textEnNlt: So she cried whenever she was with him and kept it up for the rest of the celebration. At last, on the seventh day he told her the answer because she was tormenting him with her nagging. Then she explained the riddle to the young men.
verses.textEnNasb: However she wept before him for seven days while their feast lasted. And on the seventh day he told her because she pressed him so hard. She then told the riddle to the sons of her people.
verses.textEn: She cried the whole seven days of the feast. So on the seventh day he finally told her, because she continued to press him. She in turn explained the riddle to her people.

verses.textZh: 到了第七天太阳未落以前，城里的人就对参孙说： "有甚么比蜂蜜还甜呢？ 有甚么比狮子还强呢？" 参孙对他们说："你们若不是用我的母牛犊耕田，你们就不会猜出我的谜语的意思来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七天太阳未落以前，城里的人就对参孙说： "有甚么比蜂蜜还甜呢？ 有甚么比狮子还强呢？" 参孙对他们说："你们若不是用我的母牛犊耕田，你们就不会猜出我的谜语的意思来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到第七天，日头未落以前，那城里的人对参孙说： 有什么比蜜还甜呢？ 有什么比狮子还强呢？ 参孙对他们说： 你们若非用我的母牛犊耕地， 就猜不出我谜语的意思来。
verses.textEnNiv: Before sunset on the seventh day the men of the town said to him, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" Samson said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" And he said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down: "What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?" And he said to them: "If you had not plowed with my heifer, You would not have solved my riddle!"
verses.textEnNlt: So before sunset of the seventh day, the men of the town came to Samson with their answer: "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" Samson replied, "If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have solved my riddle!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, "What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?" And he said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, You would not have found out my riddle."
verses.textEn: Before sunset on the seventh day the men of the town said to him, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" Samson said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，参孙就下到亚实基伦，击杀了他们中间三十个人，拿了剥下来的衣服，把三十套衣服给了那些把谜语的意思说出来的人；参孙怒气冲冲地上自己的父家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，参孙就下到亚实基伦，击杀了他们中间三十个人，拿了剥下来的衣服，把三十套衣服给了那些把谜语的意思说出来的人；参孙怒气冲冲地上自己的父家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他就下到亚实基伦，击杀了三十个人，夺了他们的衣裳，将衣裳给了猜出谜语的人。参孙发怒，就上父家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. He went down to Ashkelon, struck down thirty of their men, stripped them of everything and gave their clothes to those who had explained the riddle. Burning with anger, he returned to his father’s home.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck down thirty men of the town and took their spoil and gave the garments to those who had told the riddle. In hot anger he went back to his father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon him mightily, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty of their men, took their apparel, and gave the changes ofclothing to those who had explained the riddle. So his anger was aroused, and he went back up to his father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. He went down to the town of Ashkelon, killed thirty men, took their belongings, and gave their clothing to the men who had solved his riddle. But Samson was furious about what had happened, and he went back home to live with his father and mother.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and killed thirty men of them and took what they were wearing and gave the outfits of clothes to those who told the riddle. And his anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. He went down to Ashkelon, struck down thirty of their men, stripped them of everything and gave their clothes to those who had explained the riddle. Burning with anger, he returned to his father’s home.

verses.textEnEsv: And Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man.
verses.textEnNlt: So his wife was given in marriage to the man who had been Samson’s best man at the wedding.
verses.textEnNasb: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion who had been his friend.
verses.textEn: And Samson’s wife was given to one of his companions who had attended him at the feast.

verses.textZh: 过了些日子，到收割麦子的时候，参孙带着一只山羊羔去看他的妻子；他心里说："我要进内室去见我的妻子。"但是他妻子的父亲不让他进去。

verses.textEnNiv: Later on, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. He said, "I’m going to my wife’s room." But her father would not let him go in.
verses.textEnEsv: After some days, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife with a young goat. And he said, "I will go in to my wife in the chamber." But her father would not allow him to go in.
verses.textEnNkjv: After a while, in the time of wheat harvest, it happened that Samson visited his wife with a young goat. And he said, "Let me go in to my wife, into her room." But her father would not permit him to go in.
verses.textEnNlt: Later on, during the wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat as a present to his wife. He said, "I’m going into my wife’s room to sleep with her," but her father wouldn’t let him in.
verses.textEnNasb: But after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, Samson visited his wife with a young goat, and said, "I will go in to my wife in her room." But her father did not let him enter.

verses.textZh: 她父亲说："我以为你非常恨她，所以我把她给了你的一个同伴；她的妹妹不是比她更美丽吗？你可以娶来代替她啊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她父亲说："我以为你非常恨她，所以我把她给了你的一个同伴；她的妹妹不是比她更美丽吗？你可以娶来代替她啊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我估定你是极其恨她，因此我将她给了你的陪伴。她的妹子不是比她还美丽吗？你可以娶来代替她吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "I was so sure you hated her," he said, "that I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more attractive? Take her instead."
verses.textEnEsv: And her father said, "I really thought that you utterly hated her, so I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please take her instead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Her father said, "I really thought that you thoroughly hated her; therefore I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister better than she? Please, take her instead."
verses.textEnNlt: "I truly thought you must hate her," her father explained, "so I gave her in marriage to your best man. But look, her younger sister is even more beautiful than she is. Marry her instead."
verses.textEnNasb: Her father said, "I really thought that you hated her intensely; so I gave her to your companion. Is her younger sister not more beautiful than she? Please let her be yours instead."
verses.textEn: "I was so sure you hated her," he said, "that I gave her to your companion. Isn’t her younger sister more attractive? Take her instead."

verses.textZh: 参孙对他们说："这次如果我加害非利士人，就可以不必负责了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对他们说："这次如果我加害非利士人，就可以不必负责了。"

verses.textEnNiv: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samson said to them, "This time I shall be innocent in regard to the Philistines, when I do them harm."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samson said to them, "This time I shall be blameless regarding the Philistines if I harm them!"
verses.textEnNlt: Samson said, "This time I cannot be blamed for everything I am going to do to you Philistines."
verses.textEnNasb: Samson then said to them, "This time I will have been blameless regarding the Philistines when I do them harm."
verses.textEn: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."

verses.textEnNasb: And Samson went and caught three hundred jackals, and took torches, and turned the jackals tail to tail and put one torch in the middle between two tails.

verses.textEnNkjv: When he had set the torches on fire, he let thefoxes go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burned up both the shocks and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he lit the torches and let the foxes run through the grain fields of the Philistines. He burned all their grain to the ground, including the sheaves and the uncut grain. He also destroyed their vineyards and olive groves.

verses.textZh: 非利士人问："这是谁作的呢？"有人回答："是亭拿人的女婿参孙作的，因为他岳父把他的妻子给了他的同伴。"于是非利士人上去，放火烧了那女子和她的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人问："这是谁作的呢？"有人回答："是亭拿人的女婿参孙作的，因为他岳父把他的妻子给了他的同伴。"于是非利士人上去，放火烧了那女子和她的父亲。

verses.textEnNiv: When the Philistines asked, "Who did this?" they were told, "Samson, the Timnite’s son-in-law, because his wife was given to his companion." So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Philistines said, "Who has done this?" And they said, "Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion." And the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Philistines said, "Who has done this?" And they answered, "Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion." So the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: "Who did this?" the Philistines demanded. "Samson," was the reply, "because his father-in-law from Timnah gave Samson’s wife to be married to his best man." So the Philistines went and got the woman and her father and burned them to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistines said, "Who did this?" And some said, "Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he took his wife and gave her to his companion." So the Philistines came up and burned her and her father to death with fire.
verses.textEn: When the Philistines asked, "Who did this?" they were told, "Samson, the Timnite’s son-in-law, because his wife was given to his companion." So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.

verses.textZh: 参孙对他们说："你们既然这样行，我必在你们身上报仇，然后才肯罢休。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对他们说："你们既然这样行，我必在你们身上报仇，然后才肯罢休。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙对非利士人说：「你们既然这样行，我必向你们报仇才肯罢休。」
verses.textEnNiv: Samson said to them, "Since you’ve acted like this, I swear that I won’t stop until I get my revenge on you."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samson said to them, "If this is what you do, I swear I will be avenged on you, and after that I will quit."
verses.textEnNkjv: Samson said to them, "Since you would do a thing like this, I will surely take revenge on you, and after that I will cease."
verses.textEnNlt: "Because you did this," Samson vowed, "I won’t rest until I take my revenge on you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samson said to them, "If this is how you act, I will certainly take revenge on you, and only after that will I stop."
verses.textEn: Samson said to them, "Since you’ve acted like this, I swear that I won’t stop until I get my revenge on you."

verses.textZh: 参孙击打他们，连腿带腰都砍断了，那是一场极大的杀戮；然后他下去，住在以坦盘石的穴中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙击打他们，连腿带腰都砍断了，那是一场极大的杀戮；然后他下去，住在以坦盘石的穴中。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙就大大击杀他们，连腿带腰都砍断了。他便下去，住在以坦磐的穴内。
verses.textEnNiv: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.
verses.textEnEsv: And he struck them hip and thigh with a great blow, and he went down and stayed in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he attacked them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; then he went down and dwelt in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
verses.textEnNlt: So he attacked the Philistines with great fury and killed many of them. Then he went to live in a cave in the rock of Etam.
verses.textEnNasb: So he struck them ruthlessly with a great slaughter; and afterward he went down and lived in the cleft of the rock of Etam.
verses.textEn: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.

verses.textZh: 非利士人上去，在犹大安营，在利希散开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人上去，在犹大安营，在利希散开。
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人上去安营在犹大，布散在利希。
verses.textEnNiv: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Philistines came up and encamped in Judah and made a raid on Lehi.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and deployed themselves against Lehi.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistines retaliated by setting up camp in Judah and spreading out near the town of Lehi.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Philistines went up and camped in Judah, and spread out in Lehi.
verses.textEn: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.

verses.textZh: 犹大人说："你们为甚么上来攻打我们呢？"他们说："我们上来是要捆绑参孙，要报复他向我们所行的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人说："你们为甚么上来攻打我们呢？"他们说："我们上来是要捆绑参孙，要报复他向我们所行的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人说：「你们为何上来攻击我们呢？」他们说：「我们上来是要捆绑参孙；他向我们怎样行，我们也要向他怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Judah asked, "Why have you come to fight us?" "We have come to take Samson prisoner," they answered, "to do to him as he did to us."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Judah said, "Why have you come up against us?" They said, "We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he did to us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Judah said, "Why have you come up against us?" So they answered, "We have come up to arrest Samson, to do to him as he has done to us."
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Judah asked the Philistines, "Why are you attacking us?" The Philistines replied, "We’ve come to capture Samson. We’ve come to pay him back for what he did to us."
verses.textEnNasb: So the men of Judah said, "Why have you come up against us?" And they said, "We have come up to bind Samson in order to do to him as he did to us."
verses.textEn: The people of Judah asked, "Why have you come to fight us?" "We have come to take Samson prisoner," they answered, "to do to him as he did to us."

verses.textZh: 于是有三千犹大人下到以坦盘石的穴中去，对参孙说："非利士人统治我们，你不知道吗？你为甚么向我们行这事呢？"参孙对他们说："他们怎样待我，我也怎样待他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有三千犹大人下到以坦盘石的穴中去，对参孙说："非利士人统治我们，你不知道吗？你为甚么向我们行这事呢？"参孙对他们说："他们怎样待我，我也怎样待他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是有三千犹大人下到以坦磐的穴内，对参孙说：「非利士人辖制我们，你不知道吗？你向我们行的是什么事呢？」他回答说：「他们向我怎样行，我也要向他们怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave in the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Don’t you realize that the Philistines are rulers over us? What have you done to us?" He answered, "I merely did to them what they did to me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then 3,000 men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, "Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?" And he said to them, "As they did to me, so have I done to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, "Do you not know that the Philistines rule over us? What is this you have done to us?" And he said to them, "As they did to me, so I have done to them."
verses.textEnNlt: So 3,000 men of Judah went down to get Samson at the cave in the rock of Etam. They said to Samson, "Don’t you realize the Philistines rule over us? What are you doing to us?" But Samson replied, "I only did to them what they did to me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then three thousand men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?" And he said to them, "Just as they did to me, so I have done to them."
verses.textEn: Then three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave in the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Don’t you realize that the Philistines are rulers over us? What have you done to us?" He answered, "I merely did to them what they did to me."

verses.textZh: 犹大人对他说："我们下来要捆绑你，把你交在非利士人手里。"参孙对他们说："你们要向我发誓，你们不亲自杀害我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人对他说："我们下来要捆绑你，把你交在非利士人手里。"参孙对他们说："你们要向我发誓，你们不亲自杀害我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人对他说：「我们下来是要捆绑你，将你交在非利士人手中。」参孙说：「你们要向我起誓，应承你们自己不害死我。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to him, "We’ve come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." Samson said, "Swear to me that you won’t kill me yourselves."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "We have come down to bind you, that we may give you into the hands of the Philistines." And Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said to him, "We have come down to arrest you, that we may deliver you into the hand of the Philistines." Then Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not kill me yourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: But the men of Judah told him, "We have come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." "All right," Samson said. "But promise that you won’t kill me yourselves."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "We have come down to bind you so that we may hand you over to the Philistines." And Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not kill me."
verses.textEn: They said to him, "We’ve come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." Samson said, "Swear to me that you won’t kill me yourselves."

verses.textZh: 他们告诉他说："我们不会杀害你，我们只要把你捆绑住，交在非利士人手里，我们决不杀死你。"于是他们用两条新绳子把参孙捆绑起来，从盘石的穴里把他带上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们告诉他说："我们不会杀害你，我们只要把你捆绑住，交在非利士人手里，我们决不杀死你。"于是他们用两条新绳子把参孙捆绑起来，从盘石的穴里把他带上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「我们断不杀你，只要将你捆绑交在非利士人手中。」于是用两条新绳捆绑参孙，将他从以坦磐带上去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "No; we will only bind you and give you into their hands. We will surely not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they spoke to him, saying, "No, but we will tie you securely and deliver you into their hand; but we will surely not kill you." And they bound him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.
verses.textEnNlt: "We will only tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines," they replied. "We won’t kill you." So they tied him up with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to him, "No, but we will bind you tightly and give you into their hands; but we certainly will not kill you." Then they bound him with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.
verses.textEn: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.

verses.textZh: 参孙来到利希，非利士人就吶喊着出来迎接他，耶和华的灵大大临到参孙身上，他臂上的绳子就像被火烧的麻一样，他的捆绑都从他的手上落下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙来到利希，非利士人就吶喊着出来迎接他，耶和华的灵大大临到参孙身上，他臂上的绳子就像被火烧的麻一样，他的捆绑都从他的手上落下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙到了利希，非利士人都迎着喧嚷。耶和华的灵大大感动参孙，他臂上的绳就像火烧的麻一样，他的绑绳都从他手上脱落下来。
verses.textEnNiv: As he approached Lehi, the Philistines came toward him shouting. The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax, and the bindings dropped from his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet him. Then the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that has caught fire, and his bonds melted off his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting against him. Then the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him; and the ropes that were on his arms became like flax that is burned with fire, and his bonds broke loose from his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: As Samson arrived at Lehi, the Philistines came shouting in triumph. But the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon Samson, and he snapped the ropes on his arms as if they were burnt strands of flax, and they fell from his wrists.
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. And the Spirit of the Lord rushed upon him so that the ropes that were on his arms were like flax that has burned with fire, and his restraints dropped from his hands.
verses.textEn: As he approached Lehi, the Philistines came toward him shouting. The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax, and the bindings dropped from his hands.

verses.textZh: 他找着一块新鲜的驴腮骨，就伸手拾起来，击杀了一千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他找着一块新鲜的驴腮骨，就伸手拾起来，击杀了一千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他见一块未干的驴腮骨，就伸手拾起来，用以击杀一千人。
verses.textEnNiv: Finding a fresh jawbone of a donkey, he grabbed it and struck down a thousand men.
verses.textEnEsv: And he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, and put out his hand and took it, and with it he struck 1,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and killed a thousand men with it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he found the jawbone of a recently killed donkey. He picked it up and killed 1,000 Philistines with it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, so he reached out with his hand and took it, and killed a thousand men with it.
verses.textEn: Finding a fresh jawbone of a donkey, he grabbed it and struck down a thousand men.

verses.textZh: 参孙说： "我用驴腮骨杀人成堆； 我用驴腮骨击杀了一千人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙说： "我用驴腮骨杀人成堆； 我用驴腮骨击杀了一千人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙说： 我用驴腮骨杀人成堆， 用驴腮骨杀了一千人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Samson said, "With a donkey’s jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey’s jawbone I have killed a thousand men."
verses.textEnEsv: And Samson said, "With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps upon heaps, with the jawbone of a donkey have I struck down a thousand men."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Samson said: "With the jawbone of a donkey, Heaps upon heaps, With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Samson said, "With the jawbone of a donkey, I’ve piled them in heaps! With the jawbone of a donkey, I’ve killed a thousand men!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Samson said, "With the jawbone of a donkey, Heaps upon heaps, With the jawbone of a donkey I have killed a thousand men."
verses.textEn: Then Samson said, "With a donkey’s jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey’s jawbone I have killed a thousand men."

verses.textZh: 说完了，就把那腮骨从手里拋出去，因此那地方就叫拉末．利希 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说完了，就把那腮骨从手里拋出去，因此那地方就叫拉末．利希 。
verses.textZhCuv: 说完这话，就把那腮骨从手里抛出去了。那地便叫拉末‧利希。
verses.textEnNiv: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as he had finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone out of his hand. And that place was called Ramath-lehi.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when he had finished speaking, that he threw the jawbone from his hand, and called that place Ramath Lehi.
verses.textEnNlt: When he finished his boasting, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was named Jawbone Hill.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone from his hand; and he named that place Ramath-lehi.
verses.textEn: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.

verses.textZh: 参孙非常口渴，就呼求耶和华说："你既然借着你仆人的手施行这么大的拯救，现在我怎可以渴死，落在未受割礼的人手中呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙非常口渴，就呼求耶和华说："你既然借着你仆人的手施行这么大的拯救，现在我怎可以渴死，落在未受割礼的人手中呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙甚觉口渴，就求告耶和华说：「你既藉仆人的手施行这么大的拯救，岂可任我渴死、落在未受割礼的人手中呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Because he was very thirsty, he cried out to the Lord , "You have given your servant this great victory. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he was very thirsty, and he called upon the Lord and said, "You have granted this great salvation by the hand of your servant, and shall I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he became very thirsty; so he cried out to the Lord and said, "You have given this great deliverance by the hand of Your servant; and now shall I die of thirst and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?"
verses.textEnNlt: Samson was now very thirsty, and he cried out to the Lord , "You have accomplished this great victory by the strength of your servant. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of these pagans?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he became very thirsty, and he called to the Lord and said, "You have handed this great victory over to Your servant, and now am I to die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"
verses.textEn: Because he was very thirsty, he cried out to the Lord , "You have given your servant this great victory. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"

verses.textZh: 于是神在利希使一洼地裂开，就有水从那里涌出来；参孙喝了，就恢复精神，活力充足；因此那泉名叫隐．哈歌利 ，那泉直到今日还在利希。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是神在利希使一洼地裂开，就有水从那里涌出来；参孙喝了，就恢复精神，活力充足；因此那泉名叫隐．哈歌利 ，那泉直到今日还在利希。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就使利希的洼处裂开，有水从其中涌出来。参孙喝了，精神复原；因此那泉名叫隐‧哈歌利，那泉直到今日还在利希。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned and he revived. So the spring was called En Hakkore, and it is still there in Lehi.
verses.textEnEsv: And God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came out from it. And when he drank, his spirit returned, and he revived. Therefore the name of it was called En-hakkore; it is at Lehi to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out, and he drank; and his spirit returned, and he revived. Therefore he called its name En Hakkore, which is in Lehi to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So God caused water to gush out of a hollow in the ground at Lehi, and Samson was revived as he drank. Then he named that place "The Spring of the One Who Cried Out," and it is still in Lehi to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi so that water came out of it. When he drank, his strength returned and he revived. Therefore he named it En-hakkore, which is in Lehi to this day.
verses.textEn: Then God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned and he revived. So the spring was called En Hakkore, and it is still there in Lehi.

verses.textZh: 在非利士人统治的日子，参孙治理以色列人二十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在非利士人统治的日子，参孙治理以色列人二十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 当非利士人辖制以色列人的时候，参孙作以色列的士师二十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Samson judged Israel for twenty years during the period when the Philistines dominated the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So he judged Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 参孙往迦萨去，在那里看见一个妓女，就进去与她亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙往迦萨去，在那里看见一个妓女，就进去与她亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙到了迦萨，在那里看见一个妓女，就与她亲近。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.
verses.textEnEsv: Samson went to Gaza, and there he saw a prostitute, and he went in to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Samson went to Gaza and saw a harlot there, and went in to her.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Samson went to the Philistine town of Gaza and spent the night with a prostitute.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samson went to Gaza and saw a prostitute there, and had relations with her.
verses.textEn: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉迦萨人说："参孙到这里来了。"他们就把他围住，整夜在城门口埋伏着，整夜默不作声，心里说："等到早晨天亮，我们才杀他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉迦萨人说："参孙到这里来了。"他们就把他围住，整夜在城门口埋伏着，整夜默不作声，心里说："等到早晨天亮，我们才杀他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉迦萨人说：「参孙到这里来了！」他们就把他团团围住，终夜在城门悄悄埋伏，说：「等到天亮我们便杀他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Gaza were told, "Samson is here!" So they surrounded the place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate. They made no move during the night, saying, "At dawn we’ll kill him."
verses.textEnEsv: The Gazites were told, "Samson has come here." And they surrounded the place and set an ambush for him all night at the gate of the city. They kept quiet all night, saying, "Let us wait till the light of the morning; then we will kill him."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Gazites weretold, "Samson has come here!" they surrounded theplace and lay in wait for him all night at the gate of the city. They were quiet all night, saying, "In the morning, when it is daylight, we will kill him."
verses.textEnNlt: Word soon spread that Samson was there, so the men of Gaza gathered together and waited all night at the town gates. They kept quiet during the night, saying to themselves, "When the light of morning comes, we will kill him."
verses.textEnNasb: When it was reported to the Gazites, saying, "Samson has come here," they surrounded the place and lay in wait for him all night at the gate of the city. And they kept silent all night, saying, "Let’s wait until the morning light, then we will kill him."
verses.textEn: The people of Gaza were told, "Samson is here!" So they surrounded the place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate. They made no move during the night, saying, "At dawn we’ll kill him."

verses.textZh: 参孙睡到半夜，就在半夜起来，抓紧城门的门扇和两边门柱，把它们与门闩一起拔起来，放在自己的肩头上，扛到希伯仑对面的山顶去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙睡到半夜，就在半夜起来，抓紧城门的门扇和两边门柱，把它们与门闩一起拔起来，放在自己的肩头上，扛到希伯仑对面的山顶去。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙睡到半夜，起来，将城门的门扇、门框、门闩，一齐拆下来，扛在肩上，扛到希伯仑前的山顶上。
verses.textEnNiv: But Samson lay there only until the middle of the night. Then he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate, together with the two posts, and tore them loose, bar and all. He lifted them to his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.
verses.textEnEsv: But Samson lay till midnight, and at midnight he arose and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city and the two posts, and pulled them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that is in front of Hebron.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samson lay low till midnight; then he arose at midnight, took hold of the doors of the gate of the city and the two gateposts, pulled them up, bar and all, put them on his shoulders, and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.
verses.textEnNlt: But Samson stayed in bed only until midnight. Then he got up, took hold of the doors of the town gate, including the two posts, and lifted them up, bar and all. He put them on his shoulders and carried them all the way to the top of the hill across from Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Samson lay asleep until midnight, and at midnight he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate and the two doorposts, and pulled them up along with the bars; then he put them on his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of the mountain which is opposite Hebron.
verses.textEn: But Samson lay there only until the middle of the night. Then he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate, together with the two posts, and tore them loose, bar and all. He lifted them to his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.

verses.textZh: 后来参孙在梭烈谷又爱上了一个妇人，名叫大利拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来参孙在梭烈谷又爱上了一个妇人，名叫大利拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，参孙在梭烈谷喜爱一个妇人，名叫大利拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.
verses.textEnEsv: After this he loved a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward it happened that he loved a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later Samson fell in love with a woman named Delilah, who lived in the valley of Sorek.
verses.textEnNasb: After this it came about that he was in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
verses.textEn: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.

verses.textZh: 非利士人的领袖上到妇人那里去，对她说："请你引诱他，看看他因甚么缘故有这样大的力气，我们用甚么方法才能胜过他，把他捆绑，好制伏他；我们每人就给你十二公斤银子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 非利士人的领袖上到妇人那里去，对她说："请你引诱他，看看他因甚么缘故有这样大的力气，我们用甚么方法才能胜过他，把他捆绑，好制伏他；我们每人就给你十二公斤银子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 非利士人的首领上去见那妇人，对她说：「求你诓哄参孙，探探他因何有这么大的力气，我们用何法能胜他，捆绑克制他。我们就每人给你一千一百舍客勒银子。」
verses.textEnNiv: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "See if you can lure him into showing you the secret of his great strength and how we can overpower him so we may tie him up and subdue him. Each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver."
verses.textEnEsv: And the lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, "Seduce him, and see where his great strength lies, and by what means we may overpower him, that we may bind him to humble him. And we will each give you 1,100 pieces of silver."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, "Entice him, and find out where his great strength lies, and by what means we may overpower him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and every one of us will give you eleven hundred pieces of silver."
verses.textEnNlt: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "Entice Samson to tell you what makes him so strong and how he can be overpowered and tied up securely. Then each of us will give you 1,100 pieces of silver."
verses.textEnNasb: So the governors of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, "Entice him, and see where his great strength lies and how we can overpower him so that we may bind him to humble him. Then we will each give you 1,100 pieces of silver."
verses.textEn: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "See if you can lure him into showing you the secret of his great strength and how we can overpower him so we may tie him up and subdue him. Each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver."

verses.textZh: 大利拉对参孙说："求你告诉我，你因甚么缘故有这样大的力气，要用甚么方法才能捆绑你，好把你制伏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉对参孙说："求你告诉我，你因甚么缘故有这样大的力气，要用甚么方法才能捆绑你，好把你制伏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉对参孙说：「求你告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气，当用何法捆绑克制你。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Delilah said to Samson, "Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued."
verses.textEnEsv: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me where your great strength lies, and how you might be bound, that one could subdue you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me where your great strength lies, and with what you may be bound to afflict you."
verses.textEnNlt: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me what makes you so strong and what it would take to tie you up securely."
verses.textEnNasb: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me where your great strength lies, and how you can be bound to humble you."
verses.textEn: So Delilah said to Samson, "Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued."

verses.textZh: 参孙对她说："如果人用七条未干的青绳子捆绑我，我就会软弱无力，像平常人一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对她说："如果人用七条未干的青绳子捆绑我，我就会软弱无力，像平常人一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙回答说：「人若用七条未干的青绳子捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: Samson answered her, "If anyone ties me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, I’ll become as weak as any other man."
verses.textEnEsv: Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings, not yet dried, then I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNlt: Samson replied, "If I were tied up with seven new bowstrings that have not yet been dried, I would become as weak as anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: And Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh animal tendons that have not been dried, then I will become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEn: Samson answered her, "If anyone ties me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, I’ll become as weak as any other man."

verses.textZh: 于是非利士人的领袖把七条未干的青绳子，带上来给那妇人，她就用那些绳子把参孙捆绑起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是非利士人的领袖把七条未干的青绳子，带上来给那妇人，她就用那些绳子把参孙捆绑起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是非利士人的首领拿了七条未干的青绳子来，交给妇人，她就用绳子捆绑参孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh bowstrings, not yet dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Philistine rulers brought Delilah seven new bowstrings, and she tied Samson up with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the governors of the Philistines brought up to her seven fresh animal tendons that had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.textEn: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.

verses.textZh: 有人埋伏在她的内室里等候着；她对参孙说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"参孙就挣断绳子，像麻线被火烧断一样。这样，他力气的由来，还是没有人知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人埋伏在她的内室里等候着；她对参孙说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"参孙就挣断绳子，像麻线被火烧断一样。这样，他力气的由来，还是没有人知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人预先埋伏在妇人的内室里。妇人说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」参孙就挣断绳子，如挣断经火的麻线一般。这样，他力气的根由人还是不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: With men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the bowstrings as easily as a piece of string snaps when it comes close to a flame. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.
verses.textEnEsv: Now she had men lying in ambush in an inner chamber. And she said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he snapped the bowstrings, as a thread of flax snaps when it touches the fire. So the secret of his strength was not known.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now menwere lying in wait, staying with her in the room. And she said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he broke the bowstrings as a strand of yarn breaks when it touches fire. So the secret of his strength was not known.
verses.textEnNlt: She had hidden some men in one of the inner rooms of her house, and she cried out, "Samson! The Philistines have come to capture you!" But Samson snapped the bowstrings as a piece of string snaps when it is burned by a fire. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she had men prepared for an ambush in an inner room. And she said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he tore the tendons to pieces just like a thread of flax is torn apart when it comes too close to fire. So his strength was not discovered.
verses.textEn: With men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the bowstrings as easily as a piece of string snaps when it comes close to a flame. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.

verses.textZh: 大利拉对参孙说："你作弄我，向我说谎；现在求你告诉我，用甚么东西才能把你捆绑。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉对参孙说："你作弄我，向我说谎；现在求你告诉我，用甚么东西才能把你捆绑。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉对参孙说：「你欺哄我，向我说谎言。现在求你告诉我当用何法捆绑你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Behold, you have mocked me and told me lies. Please tell me how you might be bound."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Look, you have mocked me and told me lies. Now, please tell me what you may be bound with."
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Delilah said to him, "You’ve been making fun of me and telling me lies! Now please tell me how you can be tied up securely."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Behold, you have toyed with me and told me lies; now please tell me how you may be bound."
verses.textEn: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied."

verses.textZh: 参孙对她说："如果人用从未使用过的新绳子把我紧紧地捆绑起来，我就软弱无力，像平常人一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙对她说："如果人用从未使用过的新绳子把我紧紧地捆绑起来，我就软弱无力，像平常人一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙回答说：「人若用没有使过的新绳捆绑我，我就软弱像别人一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I’ll become as weak as any other man."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "If they bind me with new ropes that have not been used, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to her, "If they bind me securely with new ropes that have never been used, then I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNlt: Samson replied, "If I were tied up with brand-new ropes that had never been used, I would become as weak as anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to her, "If they bind me tightly with new ropes which have not been used, then I will become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEn: He said, "If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I’ll become as weak as any other man."

verses.textZh: 于是大利拉把新绳子拿了来，把参孙捆绑了，对他说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"当时有人埋伏在她的内室里等候着。参孙把绳子从手臂上挣断下来，像挣断一根线一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大利拉把新绳子拿了来，把参孙捆绑了，对他说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"当时有人埋伏在她的内室里等候着。参孙把绳子从手臂上挣断下来，像挣断一根线一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉就用新绳捆绑他，对他说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」有人预先埋伏在内室里。参孙将臂上的绳挣断了，如挣断一条线一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him with them. Then, with men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the ropes off his arms as if they were threads.
verses.textEnEsv: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" And the men lying in ambush were in an inner chamber. But he snapped the ropes off his arms like a thread.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" And menwere lying in wait, staying in the room. But he broke them off his arms like a thread.
verses.textEnNlt: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him up with them. The men were hiding in the inner room as before, and again Delilah cried out, "Samson! The Philistines have come to capture you!" But again Samson snapped the ropes from his arms as if they were thread.
verses.textEnNasb: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" For the men in the ambush were waiting in the inner room. But he tore the ropes from his arms like thread.
verses.textEn: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him with them. Then, with men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the ropes off his arms as if they were threads.

verses.textZh: 大利拉对参孙说："到现在你还是作弄我，向我说谎；求你告诉我，人怎样才能捆绑你。"参孙对她说："如果你把我头上的七条发辫与织布机上的纬线编织在一起就可以了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉对参孙说："到现在你还是作弄我，向我说谎；求你告诉我，人怎样才能捆绑你。"参孙对她说："如果你把我头上的七条发辫与织布机上的纬线编织在一起就可以了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉对参孙说：「你到如今还是欺哄我，向我说谎言。求你告诉我，当用何法捆绑你。」参孙回答说：「你若将我头上的七条发绺，与纬线同织就可以了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Delilah then said to Samson, "All this time you have been making a fool of me and lying to me. Tell me how you can be tied." He replied, "If you weave the seven braids of my head into the fabric on the loom and tighten it with the pin, I’ll become as weak as any other man." So while he was sleeping, Delilah took the seven braids of his head, wove them into the fabric
verses.textEnEsv: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Until now you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me how you might be bound." And he said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web and fasten it tight with the pin, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNkjv: Delilah said to Samson, "Until now you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me what you may be bound with." And he said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my head into the web of the loom"—
verses.textEnNlt: Then Delilah said, "You’ve been making fun of me and telling me lies! Now tell me how you can be tied up securely." Samson replied, "If you were to weave the seven braids of my hair into the fabric on your loom and tighten it with the loom shuttle, I would become as weak as anyone else." So while he slept, Delilah wove the seven braids of his hair into the fabric.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Up to now you have toyed with me and told me lies; tell me how you may be bound." And he said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my hair with the web [and fasten it with the pin, then I will be weak like any other man."
verses.textEn: Delilah then said to Samson, "All this time you have been making a fool of me and lying to me. Tell me how you can be tied." He replied, "If you weave the seven braids of my head into the fabric on the loom and tighten it with the pin, I’ll become as weak as any other man." So while he was sleeping, Delilah took the seven braids of his head, wove them into the fabric

verses.textZh: 于是大利拉把他的发辫与织布机上的纬线同织在一起，再用木橛钉紧，对参孙说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"参孙从睡梦中醒来，竟把织布机上的木橛，和纬线都拔了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大利拉把他的发辫与织布机上的纬线同织在一起，再用木橛钉紧，对参孙说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"参孙从睡梦中醒来，竟把织布机上的木橛，和纬线都拔了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大利拉将他的发绺与纬线同织，用橛子钉住，对他说：「参孙哪，非利士人拿你来了！」参孙从睡中醒来，将机上的橛子和纬线一齐都拔出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: and tightened it with the pin. Again she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and pulled up the pin and the loom, with the fabric.
verses.textEnEsv: So while he slept, Delilah took the seven locks of his head and wove them into the web. And she made them tight with the pin and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he awoke from his sleep and pulled away the pin, the loom, and the web.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she wove it tightly with the batten of the loom, and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he awoke from his sleep, and pulled out the batten and the web from the loom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she tightened it with the loom shuttle. Again she cried out, "Samson! The Philistines have come to capture you!" But Samson woke up, pulled back the loom shuttle, and yanked his hair away from the loom and the fabric.
verses.textEnNasb: So while he slept, Delilah wove the seven locks of his hair with the web]. And she fastened it with the pin and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he awoke from his sleep and pulled out the pin of the loom and the web.
verses.textEn: and tightened it with the pin. Again she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and pulled up the pin and the loom, with the fabric.

verses.textZh: 大利拉对参孙说："你既然对我不真心，你怎能说：‘我爱你’？你这三次作弄我，没有告诉我你这么大的力气是哪里来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉对参孙说："你既然对我不真心，你怎能说：‘我爱你’？你这三次作弄我，没有告诉我你这么大的力气是哪里来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉对参孙说：「你既不与我同心，怎么说你爱我呢？你这三次欺哄我，没有告诉我，你因何有这么大的力气。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when you won’t confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven’t told me the secret of your great strength."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and you have not told me where your great strength lies."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Delilah pouted, "How can you tell me, ‘I love you,’ when you don’t share your secrets with me? You’ve made fun of me three times now, and you still haven’t told me what makes you so strong!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have toyed with me these three times and have not told me where your great strength is."
verses.textEn: Then she said to him, "How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when you won’t confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven’t told me the secret of your great strength."

verses.textZh: 大利拉天天用话逼他，催他，以致他的心烦得要死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉天天用话逼他，催他，以致他的心烦得要死。
verses.textZhCuv: 大利拉天天用话催逼他，甚至他心里烦闷要死。
verses.textEnNiv: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was sick to death of it.
verses.textEnEsv: And when she pressed him hard with her words day after day, and urged him, his soul was vexed to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when she pestered him daily with her words and pressed him, so that his soul was vexed to death,
verses.textEnNlt: She tormented him with her nagging day after day until he was sick to death of it.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, that his soul was annoyed to death.
verses.textEn: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was sick to death of it.

verses.textZh: 参孙就把他心中的一切告诉了她，对她说："向来没有人用剃刀剃过我的头，因为我自出母胎就归神作拿细耳人，如果人剃去我的头发，我的力气就离开了我，我就软弱无力，像所有人一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙就把他心中的一切告诉了她，对她说："向来没有人用剃刀剃过我的头，因为我自出母胎就归神作拿细耳人，如果人剃去我的头发，我的力气就离开了我，我就软弱无力，像所有人一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙就把心中所藏的都告诉了她，对她说：「向来人没有用剃头刀剃我的头，因为我自出母胎就归神作拿细耳人；若剃了我的头发，我的力气就离开我，我便软弱像别人一样。」

verses.textEnEsv: And he told her all his heart, and said to her, "A razor has never come upon my head, for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If my head is shaved, then my strength will leave me, and I shall become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNkjv: that he told her all his heart, and said to her, "No razor has ever come upon my head, for I havebeen a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaven, then my strength will leave me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Samson shared his secret with her. "My hair has never been cut," he confessed, "for I was dedicated to God as a Nazirite from birth. If my head were shaved, my strength would leave me, and I would become as weak as anyone else."
verses.textEnNasb: So he told her all that was in his heart and said to her, "A razor has never come on my head, for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will leave me and I will become weak and be like any other man."
verses.textEn: So he told her everything. "No razor has ever been used on my head," he said, "because I have been a Nazirite dedicated to God from my mother’s womb. If my head were shaved, my strength would leave me, and I would become as weak as any other man."

verses.textZh: 大利拉见参孙把心中的一切都告诉了她，就派人去请非利士人的领袖来，说："这一次你们上来吧！因为他已经把心中的一切都告诉了我。"于是非利士人的领袖上到妇人那里，手里带着银子上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利拉见参孙把心中的一切都告诉了她，就派人去请非利士人的领袖来，说："这一次你们上来吧！因为他已经把心中的一切都告诉了我。"于是非利士人的领袖上到妇人那里，手里带着银子上去。

verses.textEnNkjv: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, "Come up once more, for he has told me all his heart." So the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Delilah realized he had finally told her the truth, so she sent for the Philistine rulers. "Come back one more time," she said, "for he has finally told me his secret." So the Philistine rulers returned with the money in their hands.
verses.textEnNasb: When Delilah saw that he had told her all that was in his heart, she sent word and called the governors of the Philistines, saying, "Come up once more, for he has told me all that is in his heart." Then the governors of the Philistines came up to her and brought up the money in their hands.
verses.textEn: When Delilah saw that he had told her everything, she sent word to the rulers of the Philistines, "Come back once more; he has told me everything." So the rulers of the Philistines returned with the silver in their hands.

verses.textZh: 大利拉使参孙睡在自己的膝上，又叫了一个人来，把参孙头上的七条发辫都剃去；大利拉就克制了他，因他的力气离开了他。

verses.textEn: After putting him to sleep on her lap, she called for someone to shave off the seven braids of his hair, and so began to subdue him. And his strength left him.

verses.textZh: 大利拉说："参孙哪，非利士人上来捉你了！"参孙从睡梦中醒来，心里说："我要像前几次一样挣扎出去，必能脱身。"但他不知道耶和华已经离开他了。

verses.textEnNiv: Then she called, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and thought, "I’ll go out as before and shake myself free." But he did not know that the Lord had left him.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" And he awoke from his sleep and said, "I will go out as at other times and shake myself free." But he did not know that the Lord had left him.

verses.textEnNlt: Then she cried out, "Samson! The Philistines have come to capture you!" When he woke up, he thought, "I will do as before and shake myself free." But he didn’t realize the Lord had left him.

verses.textZh: 众人看见了参孙，就赞美他们的神，说："我们的神把我们的仇敌，就是那毁坏我们的地，又杀死我们很多人的，交在我们手中了。"

verses.textEnEsv: And when the people saw him, they praised their god. For they said, "Our god has given our enemy into our hand, the ravager of our country, who has killed many of us."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said: "Our god has delivered into our hands our enemy, The destroyer of our land, And the one who multiplied our dead."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people saw him, they praised their god, saying, "Our god has delivered our enemy to us! The one who killed so many of us is now in our power!"

verses.textZh: 参孙的众兄弟和他父亲的全家都下来，收殓他的尸体，把他抬上去，埋葬在琐拉和以实陶之间，在他父亲玛挪亚的坟墓里。参孙治理了以色列人二十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 参孙的众兄弟和他父亲的全家都下来，收殓他的尸体，把他抬上去，埋葬在琐拉和以实陶之间，在他父亲玛挪亚的坟墓里。参孙治理了以色列人二十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 参孙的弟兄和他父的全家都下去取他的尸首，抬上来葬在琐拉和以实陶中间，在他父玛挪亚的坟墓里。参孙作以色列的士师二十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Then his brothers and his father’s whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.
verses.textEnEsv: Then his brothers and all his family came down and took him and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had judged Israel twenty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his brothers and all his father’s household came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. He had judged Israel twenty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Later his brothers and other relatives went down to get his body. They took him back home and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol, where his father, Manoah, was buried. Samson had judged Israel for twenty years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his brothers and all his father’s household came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. So he had judged Israel for twenty years.
verses.textEn: Then his brothers and his father’s whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.

verses.textZh: 以法莲山地有一个人，名叫米迦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲山地有一个人，名叫米迦。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲山地有一个人名叫米迦。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
verses.textEnEsv: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a man from the mountains of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a man named Micah, who lived in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man of the hill country of Ephraim whose name was Micah.
verses.textEn: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

verses.textZh: 他对自己的母亲说："你那十二公斤银子被人拿去了，关于这事你曾说了咒诅的话，我也亲自听见了。看哪！那些银子在我这里，是我拿去了。"他母亲说："愿我儿蒙耶和华赐福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对自己的母亲说："你那十二公斤银子被人拿去了，关于这事你曾说了咒诅的话，我也亲自听见了。看哪！那些银子在我这里，是我拿去了。"他母亲说："愿我儿蒙耶和华赐福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对母亲说：「你那一千一百舍客勒银子被人拿去，你因此咒诅，并且告诉了我。看哪，这银子在我这里，是我拿去了。」他母亲说：「我儿啊，愿耶和华赐福与你！」
verses.textEnNiv: said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse—I have that silver with me; I took it." Then his mother said, "The Lord bless you, my son!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his mother, "The 1,100 pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it." And his mother said, "Blessed be my son by the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you, and on which you put a curse, even saying it in my ears—here is the silver with me; I took it." And his mother said, "Mayyoube blessed by the Lord, my son!"
verses.textEnNlt: One day he said to his mother, "I heard you place a curse on the person who stole 1,100 pieces of silver from you. Well, I have the money. I was the one who took it." "The Lord bless you for admitting it," his mother replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to his mother, "The 1,100 pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse and also spoke it in my hearing, behold, the silver is with me; I took it." And his mother said, "Blessed be my son by the Lord."
verses.textEn: said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse—I have that silver with me; I took it." Then his mother said, "The Lord bless you, my son!"

verses.textZh: 米迦就把那十二公斤银子归还给他母亲；他母亲说："我把这些银子从我手中分别为圣，为我的儿子归给耶和华，好做一个雕像，一个铸像；现在，我要还给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦就把那十二公斤银子归还给他母亲；他母亲说："我把这些银子从我手中分别为圣，为我的儿子归给耶和华，好做一个雕像，一个铸像；现在，我要还给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦就把这一千一百舍客勒银子还他母亲。他母亲说：「我分出这银子来为你献给耶和华，好雕刻一个像，铸成一个像。现在我还是交给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, "I solemnly consecrate my silver to the Lord for my son to make an image overlaid with silver. I will give it back to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And he restored the 1,100 pieces of silver to his mother. And his mother said, "I dedicate the silver to the Lord from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a metal image. Now therefore I will restore it to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, "I had wholly dedicated the silver from my hand to the Lord for my son, to make a carved image and a molded image; now therefore, I will return it to you."
verses.textEnNlt: He returned the money to her, and she said, "I now dedicate these silver coins to the Lord . In honor of my son, I will have an image carved and an idol cast."
verses.textEnNasb: He then returned the 1,100 pieces of silver to his mother, and his mother said, "I wholly consecrate the silver from my hand to the Lord for my son to make a carved image and a cast metal image; so now I will return them to you."
verses.textEn: When he returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, "I solemnly consecrate my silver to the Lord for my son to make an image overlaid with silver. I will give it back to you."

verses.textZh: 米迦把银子还给他母亲以后，他母亲取出二千三百克银子交给银匠，制造一个雕像和一个铸像，都放在米迦的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦把银子还给他母亲以后，他母亲取出二千三百克银子交给银匠，制造一个雕像和一个铸像，都放在米迦的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦将银子还他母亲，他母亲将二百舍客勒银子交给银匠，雕刻一个像，铸成一个像，安置在米迦的屋内。
verses.textEnNiv: So after he returned the silver to his mother, she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who used them to make the idol. And it was put in Micah’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: So when he restored the money to his mother, his mother took 200 pieces of silver and gave it to the silversmith, who made it into a carved image and a metal image. And it was in the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus he returned the silver to his mother. Then his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to the silversmith, and he made it into a carved image and a molded image; and they were in the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNlt: So when he returned the money to his mother, she took 200 silver coins and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into an image and an idol. And these were placed in Micah’s house.
verses.textEnNasb: So when he returned the silver to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver and gave them to the silversmith, who made them into a carved image and a cast metal image, and they were in the house of Micah.
verses.textEn: So after he returned the silver to his mother, she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who used them to make the idol. And it was put in Micah’s house.

verses.textZh: 米迦这人有一间神庙，又制造以弗得和家中的神像，并且立了他的一个儿子作祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦这人有一间神庙，又制造以弗得和家中的神像，并且立了他的一个儿子作祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 这米迦有了神堂，又制造以弗得和家中的神像，分派他一个儿子作祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household gods and installed one of his sons as his priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and household gods, and ordained one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man Micah had a shrine, and made an ephod and household idols; and he consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.textEnNlt: Micah set up a shrine for the idol, and he made a sacred ephod and some household idols. Then he installed one of his sons as his personal priest.
verses.textEnNasb: And the man Micah had a shrine and he made an ephod and household idols, and consecrated one of his sons, so that he might become his priest.
verses.textEn: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household gods and installed one of his sons as his priest.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王，各人都行自己看为对的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王，各人都行自己看为对的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel; everyone did whatwas right in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days Israel had no king; all the people did whatever seemed right in their own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
verses.textEn: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

verses.textZh: 有一个犹大伯利恒的青年人，是属犹大家族的；他本是个利未人，在那里寄居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个犹大伯利恒的青年人，是属犹大家族的；他本是个利未人，在那里寄居。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的伯利恒有一个少年人，是犹大族的利未人，他在那里寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a young man of Bethlehem in Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a young man from Bethlehem in Judah, of the family of Judah; he was a Levite, and was staying there.
verses.textEnNlt: One day a young Levite, who had been living in Bethlehem in Judah, arrived in that area.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a young man from Bethlehem in Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he was staying there.
verses.textEn: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,

verses.textZh: 这人离开犹大的伯利恒城，要找一个可以寄居的地方；途中，他到了以法莲山地，米迦的家那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人离开犹大的伯利恒城，要找一个可以寄居的地方；途中，他到了以法莲山地，米迦的家那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人离开犹大的伯利恒城，要找一个可住的地方。行路的时候，到了以法莲山地，走到米迦的家。
verses.textEnNiv: left that town in search of some other place to stay. On his way he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man departed from the town of Bethlehem in Judah to sojourn where he could find a place. And as he journeyed, he came to the hill country of Ephraim to the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man departed from the city of Bethlehem in Judah to stay wherever he could find aplace. Then he came to the mountains of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
verses.textEnNlt: He had left Bethlehem in search of another place to live, and as he traveled, he came to the hill country of Ephraim. He happened to stop at Micah’s house as he was traveling through.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man left the city, Bethlehem in Judah, to stay wherever he would find a place; and as he made his journey, he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah.
verses.textEn: left that town in search of some other place to stay. On his way he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: 米迦问他："你是从哪里来的？"他回答米迦："我是个利未人，是从犹大的伯利恒来的，我来要找一个可以寄居的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦问他："你是从哪里来的？"他回答米迦："我是个利未人，是从犹大的伯利恒来的，我来要找一个可以寄居的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦问他说：「你从哪里来？」他回答说：「从犹大的伯利恒来。我是利未人，要找一个可住的地方。」
verses.textEnNiv: Micah asked him, "Where are you from?" "I’m a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah," he said, "and I’m looking for a place to stay."
verses.textEnEsv: And Micah said to him, "Where do you come from?" And he said to him, "I am a Levite of Bethlehem in Judah, and I am going to sojourn where I may find a place."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Micah said to him, "Where do you come from?" So he said to him, "I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, and I am on my way to find aplace to stay."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where are you from?" Micah asked him. He replied, "I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, and I am looking for a place to live."
verses.textEnNasb: Micah said to him, "Where do you come from?" And he said to him, "I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, and I am going to stay wherever I may find a place."
verses.textEn: Micah asked him, "Where are you from?" "I’m a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah," he said, "and I’m looking for a place to stay."

verses.textZh: 米迦对他说："你与我住在一起吧，作我的师父和祭司；我每年给你一百一十四克银子、一套衣服和食用。"利未人就进了米迦的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦对他说："你与我住在一起吧，作我的师父和祭司；我每年给你一百一十四克银子、一套衣服和食用。"利未人就进了米迦的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦说：「你可以住在我这里，我以你为父、为祭司。我每年给你十舍客勒银子，一套衣服和度日的食物。」利未人就进了他的家。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Micah said to him, "Live with me and be my father and priest, and I’ll give you ten shekels of silver a year, your clothes and your food."
verses.textEnEsv: And Micah said to him, "Stay with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year and a suit of clothes and your living." And the Levite went in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Micah said to him, "Dwell with me, and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver per year, a suit of clothes, and your sustenance." So the Levite went in.
verses.textEnNlt: "Stay here with me," Micah said, "and you can be a father and priest to me. I will give you ten pieces of silver a year, plus a change of clothes and your food."
verses.textEnNasb: Micah then said to him, "Stay with me and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year, a supply of clothing, and your sustenance." So the Levite went in.
verses.textEn: Then Micah said to him, "Live with me and be my father and priest, and I’ll give you ten shekels of silver a year, your clothes and your food."

verses.textZh: 他同意与那人同住；那人看待这青年人好象自己的一个儿子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他同意与那人同住；那人看待这青年人好象自己的一个儿子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人情愿与那人同住；那人看这少年人如自己的儿子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man, and the young man became to him like one of his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man became like one of his sons to him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levite agreed to this, and the young man became like one of Micah’s sons.
verses.textEnNasb: The Levite agreed to live with the man, and the young man became to him like one of his sons.
verses.textEn: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.

verses.textZh: 米迦立了这利未青年作他的祭司，住在米迦的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦立了这利未青年作他的祭司，住在米迦的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦分派这少年的利未人作祭司，他就住在米迦的家里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
verses.textEnEsv: And Micah ordained the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and lived in the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Micah installed the Levite as his personal priest, and he lived in Micah’s house.
verses.textEnNasb: So Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in the house of Micah.
verses.textEn: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.

verses.textZh: 米迦说："现在我知道耶和华必善待我，因为有一个利未人作我的祭司。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦说："现在我知道耶和华必善待我，因为有一个利未人作我的祭司。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦说：「现在我知道耶和华必赐福与我，因我有一个利未人作祭司。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since this Levite has become my priest."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will prosper me, because I have a Levite as priest."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since I have a Levite as priest!"
verses.textEnNlt: "I know the Lord will bless me now," Micah said, "because I have a Levite serving as my priest."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will prosper me, because I have a Levite as a priest."
verses.textEn: And Micah said, "Now I know that the Lord will be good to me, since this Levite has become my priest."

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王。那时，但支派还在寻找可居住的地业，因为直到那一天，在以色列的众支派中，但支派仍没有得着地业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王。那时，但支派还在寻找可居住的地业，因为直到那一天，在以色列的众支派中，但支派仍没有得着地业。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以色列中没有王。但支派的人仍是寻地居住；因为到那日子，他们还没有在以色列支派中得地为业。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Israel had no king. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking a place of their own where they might settle, because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days there was no king in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the people of Dan was seeking for itself an inheritance to dwell in, for until then no inheritance among the tribes of Israel had fallen to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking an inheritance for itself to dwell in; for until that day their inheritance among the tribes of Israel had not fallen to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now in those days Israel had no king. And the tribe of Dan was trying to find a place where they could settle, for they had not yet moved into the land assigned to them when the land was divided among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days there was no king of Israel; and in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking an inheritance for themselves to live in, for until that day an inheritance had not been allotted to them as a possession among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: In those days Israel had no king. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking a place of their own where they might settle, because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 于是但人从琐拉和以实陶，差派他们家族中的五个勇士，去窥探查察那地，对他们说："你们去查察那地吧。"他们来到以法莲山地，进了米迦的家，就在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是但人从琐拉和以实陶，差派他们家族中的五个勇士，去窥探查察那地，对他们说："你们去查察那地吧。"他们来到以法莲山地，进了米迦的家，就在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人从琐拉和以实陶打发本族中的五个勇士，去仔细窥探那地，吩咐他们说：「你们去窥探那地。」他们来到以法莲山地，进了米迦的住宅，就在那里住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Danites sent five of their leading men from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all the Danites. They told them, "Go, explore the land." So they entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Dan sent five able men from the whole number of their tribe, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to explore it. And they said to them, "Go and explore the land." And they came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Dan sent five men of their family from their territory, men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol, to spy out the land and search it. They said to them, "Go, search the land." So they went to the mountains of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men of Dan chose from their clans five capable warriors from the towns of Zorah and Eshtaol to scout out a land for them to settle in. When these warriors arrived in the hill country of Ephraim, they came to Micah’s house and spent the night there.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Dan sent from their family five men out of their whole number, valiant men from Zorah and Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to explore it; and they said to them, "Go, explore the land." And they came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and stayed overnight there.
verses.textEn: So the Danites sent five of their leading men from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all the Danites. They told them, "Go, explore the land." So they entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.

verses.textZh: 他们在米迦的家附近，认出那青年利未人的口音来，就过去他那里问他："谁带你到这里来？你在这里作甚么？你在这里有甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在米迦的家附近，认出那青年利未人的口音来，就过去他那里问他："谁带你到这里来？你在这里作甚么？你在这里有甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们临近米迦的住宅，听出那少年利未人的口音来，就进去问他说：「谁领你到这里来？你在这里做什么？你在这里得什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they were near Micah’s house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"
verses.textEnEsv: When they were by the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young Levite. And they turned aside and said to him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? What is your business here?"
verses.textEnNkjv: While they were at the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young Levite. They turned aside and said to him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? What do you have here?"
verses.textEnNlt: While at Micah’s house, they recognized the young Levite’s accent, so they went over and asked him, "Who brought you here, and what are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"
verses.textEnNasb: When they were near the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young man, the Levite; and they turned aside there and said to him, "Who brought you here? And what are you doing in this place? And what do you have here?"
verses.textEn: When they were near Micah’s house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"

verses.textZh: 他回答他们："米迦如此这般待我；他雇了我，我就作了他的祭司。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答他们："米迦如此这般待我；他雇了我，我就作了他的祭司。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「米迦待我如此如此，请我作祭司。」
verses.textEnNiv: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "This is how Micah dealt with me: he has hired me, and I have become his priest."
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to them, "Thus and so Micah did for me. He has hired me, and I have become his priest."
verses.textEnNlt: He told them about his agreement with Micah and that he had been hired as Micah’s personal priest.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "Micah has done this and that for me, and he has hired me and I have become his priest."
verses.textEn: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："请你求问神，使我们知道我们要走的道路是否顺利。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："请你求问神，使我们知道我们要走的道路是否顺利。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对他说：「请你求问神，使我们知道所行的道路通达不通达。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said to him, "Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "Inquire of God, please, that we may know whether the journey on which we are setting out will succeed."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to him, "Please inquire of God, that we may know whether the journey on which we go will be prosperous."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they said, "Ask God whether or not our journey will be successful."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "Inquire of God, please, that we may know whether our way on which we are going will be successful."
verses.textEn: Then they said to him, "Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful."

verses.textZh: 祭司对他们说："你们平安地去吧，你们要走的道路是蒙耶和华悦纳的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司对他们说："你们平安地去吧，你们要走的道路是蒙耶和华悦纳的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司对他们说：「你们可以平平安安地去，你们所行的道路是在耶和华面前的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The priest answered them, "Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval."
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest said to them, "Go in peace. The journey on which you go is under the eye of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priest said to them, "Go in peace. The presence of the Lordbe with you on your way."
