verses.textEnNlt: "Go in peace," the priest replied. "For the Lord is watching over your journey."
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest said to them, "Go in peace; your way in which you are going has the Lord’s approval."
verses.textEn: The priest answered them, "Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval."

verses.textZh: 于是那五个人离开了，来到拉亿，看见那里的人民安然居住，好象西顿人一样，生活平静安稳；在那地又没有人掌权，使他们受屈辱 ；他们离西顿人也很远，也没有与别人来往。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那五个人离开了，来到拉亿，看见那里的人民安然居住，好象西顿人一样，生活平静安稳；在那地又没有人掌权，使他们受屈辱 ；他们离西顿人也很远，也没有与别人来往。
verses.textZhCuv: 五人就走了，来到拉亿，见那里的民安居无虑，如同西顿人安居一样。在那地没有人掌权扰乱他们；他们离西顿人也远，与别人没有来往。
verses.textEnNiv: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, at peace and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in security, after the manner of the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting, lacking nothing that is in the earth and possessing wealth, and how they were far from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anyone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the five men departed and went to Laish. They saw the people who were there, how they dwelt safely, in the manner of the Sidonians, quiet and secure. Therewere no rulers in the land who might put them to shame for anything. They were far from the Sidonians, and they had no ties with anyone.
verses.textEnNlt: So the five men went on to the town of Laish, where they noticed the people living carefree lives, like the Sidonians; they were peaceful and secure. The people were also wealthy because their land was very fertile. And they lived a great distance from Sidon and had no allies nearby.
verses.textEnNasb: So the five men departed and came to Laish, and saw the people who were in it living in security, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and unsuspecting; for there was no oppressive ruler humiliating them for anything in the land, and they were far from the Sidonians and had no dealings with anyone.
verses.textEn: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, at peace and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.

verses.textZh: 他们回到琐拉和以实陶自己的族人那里去；族人问他们："你们有甚么话说？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回到琐拉和以实陶自己的族人那里去；族人问他们："你们有甚么话说？"
verses.textZhCuv: 五人回到琐拉和以实陶，见他们的弟兄；弟兄问他们说：「你们有什么话？」
verses.textEnNiv: When they returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their fellow Danites asked them, "How did you find things?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol, their brothers said to them, "What do you report?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then thespies came back to their brethren at Zorah and Eshtaol, and their brethren said to them, "What is your report?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the men returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their relatives asked them, "What did you find?"
verses.textEnNasb: When they came back to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol, their brothers said to them, "What do you say?"
verses.textEn: When they returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, their fellow Danites asked them, "How did you find things?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答："起来，我们上去攻击他们吧。因为我们已经看过那地，见那地十分美好，你们还静坐不动吗？不可再迟延，要赶快去取得那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："起来，我们上去攻击他们吧。因为我们已经看过那地，见那地十分美好，你们还静坐不动吗？不可再迟延，要赶快去取得那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「起来，我们上去攻击他们吧！我们已经窥探那地，见那地甚好。你们为何静坐不动呢？要急速前往得那地为业，不可迟延。
verses.textEnNiv: They answered, "Come on, let’s attack them! We have seen the land, and it is very good. Aren’t you going to do something? Don’t hesitate to go there and take it over.
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "Arise, and let us go up against them, for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. And will you do nothing? Do not be slow to go, to enter in and possess the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "Arise, let us go up against them. For we have seen the land, and indeed it is very good. Would you do nothing? Do not hesitate to go, and enter to possess the land.
verses.textEnNlt: The men replied, "Come on, let’s attack them! We have seen the land, and it is very good. What are you waiting for? Don’t hesitate to go and take possession of it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. And will you sit still? Do not hesitate to go, to enter, to take possession of the land.
verses.textEn: They answered, "Come on, let’s attack them! We have seen the land, and it is very good. Aren’t you going to do something? Don’t hesitate to go there and take it over.

verses.textZh: 你们到了那里的时候，你们必遇见安然居住的人民；那地的两边宽阔，神已经把那地交在你们手里；那地百物俱全，一无所缺。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们到了那里的时候，你们必遇见安然居住的人民；那地的两边宽阔，神已经把那地交在你们手里；那地百物俱全，一无所缺。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们到了那里，必看见安居无虑的民，地也宽阔。神已将那地交在你们手中；那地百物俱全，一无所缺。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you get there, you will find an unsuspecting people and a spacious land that God has put into your hands, a land that lacks nothing whatever."
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people. The land is spacious, for God has given it into your hands, a place where there is no lack of anything that is in the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: When you go, you will come to a secure people and a large land. For God has given it into your hands, a place where thereis no lack of anything that is on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: When you get there, you will find the people living carefree lives. God has given us a spacious and fertile land, lacking in nothing!"
verses.textEnNasb: When you enter, you will come to an unsuspecting people with a spacious land; for God has handed it over to you, a place where there is no lack of anything that is on the earth."
verses.textEn: When you get there, you will find an unsuspecting people and a spacious land that God has put into your hands, a land that lacks nothing whatever."

verses.textZh: 于是但人的家族中有六百人，带着兵器从那里出发，就是从琐拉和以实陶出发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是但人的家族中有六百人，带着兵器从那里出发，就是从琐拉和以实陶出发。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是但族中的六百人，各带兵器，从琐拉和以实陶前往，
verses.textEnNiv: Then six hundred men of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnEsv: So 600 men of the tribe of Dan, armed with weapons of war, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol,
verses.textEnNkjv: And six hundred men of the family of the Danites went from there, from Zorah and Eshtaol, armed with weapons of war.
verses.textEnNlt: So 600 men from the tribe of Dan, armed with weapons of war, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.textEnNasb: Then from the family of the Danites, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, six hundred men armed with weapons of war set out.
verses.textEn: Then six hundred men of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.textZh: 他们上去，在犹大的基列．耶琳安营；因此人把那地方叫作玛哈尼．但 ，直到现在；这地方是在基列．耶琳的西边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上去，在犹大的基列．耶琳安营；因此人把那地方叫作玛哈尼．但 ，直到现在；这地方是在基列．耶琳的西边。
verses.textZhCuv: 上到犹大的基列‧耶琳，在基列‧耶琳后边安营。因此那地方名叫玛哈尼‧但，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: and went up and encamped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. On this account that place is called Mahaneh-dan to this day; behold, it is west of Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went up and encamped in Kirjath Jearim in Judah. (Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. There itis, west of Kirjath Jearim.)
verses.textEnNlt: They camped at a place west of Kiriath-jearim in Judah, which is called Mahaneh-dan to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: They went up and camped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. Therefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan to this day; behold, it is west of Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEn: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.

verses.textZh: 他们从那里经过，往以法莲山地去，来到米迦的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从那里经过，往以法莲山地去，来到米迦的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从那里往以法莲山地去，来到米迦的住宅。
verses.textEnNiv: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: And they passed on from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they passed from there to the mountains of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they went on from there into the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.
verses.textEnNasb: And they passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.
verses.textEn: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.

verses.textZh: 从前去窥探拉亿地的五个人，对他们的族人说："这些屋子里有以弗得、神像、雕像和铸像，你们知道吗？现在你们要考虑一下应该怎样行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前去窥探拉亿地的五个人，对他们的族人说："这些屋子里有以弗得、神像、雕像和铸像，你们知道吗？现在你们要考虑一下应该怎样行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前窥探拉亿地的五个人对他们的弟兄说：「这宅子里有以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像与铸成的像，你们知道吗？现在你们要想一想当怎样行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the five men who had spied out the land of Laish said to their fellow Danites, "Do you know that one of these houses has an ephod, some household gods and an image overlaid with silver? Now you know what to do."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the five men who had gone to scout out the country of Laish said to their brothers, "Do you know that in these houses there are an ephod, household gods, a carved image, and a metal image? Now therefore consider what you will do."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brethren, "Do you know that there are in these houses an ephod, household idols, a carved image, and a molded image? Now therefore, consider what you should do."
verses.textEnNlt: The five men who had scouted out the land around Laish explained to the others, "These buildings contain a sacred ephod, as well as some household idols, a carved image, and a cast idol. What do you think you should do?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish said to their kinsmen, "Do you know that there are in these houses an ephod and household idols, and a carved image and a cast metal image? Now then, consider what you should do."
verses.textEn: Then the five men who had spied out the land of Laish said to their fellow Danites, "Do you know that one of these houses has an ephod, some household gods and an image overlaid with silver? Now you know what to do."

verses.textZh: 于是他们五人转身，进入米迦的家，来到那青年利未人的屋里，向他问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们五人转身，进入米迦的家，来到那青年利未人的屋里，向他问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 五人就进入米迦的住宅，到了那少年利未人的房内问他好。
verses.textEnNiv: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they turned aside there and came to the house of the young Levite, at the home of Micah, and asked him about his welfare.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they turned aside there, and came to the house of the young Levite man—to the house of Micah—and greeted him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the five men turned off the road and went over to Micah’s house, where the young Levite lived, and greeted him kindly.
verses.textEnNasb: So they turned aside there and came to the house of the young man, the Levite, to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.
verses.textEn: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.

verses.textZh: 那六百但人，带着兵器，都站在门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那六百但人，带着兵器，都站在门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 那六百但人各带兵器，站在门口。
verses.textEnNiv: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the 600 men of the Danites, armed with their weapons of war, stood by the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: As the 600 armed warriors from the tribe of Dan stood at the entrance of the gate,
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile, the six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the sons of Dan, were positioned at the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEn: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance of the gate.

verses.textZh: 从前去窥探那地的五个人上前，进入里面，把雕像、以弗得、神像和铸像都拿去了；祭司和带着兵器的六百人都站在门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前去窥探那地的五个人上前，进入里面，把雕像、以弗得、神像和铸像都拿去了；祭司和带着兵器的六百人都站在门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 窥探地的五个人走进去，将雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，并铸成的像，都拿了去。祭司和带兵器的六百人，一同站在门口。
verses.textEnNiv: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance of the gate.
verses.textEnEsv: And the five men who had gone to scout out the land went up and entered and took the carved image, the ephod, the household gods, and the metal image, while the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the 600 men armed with weapons of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the land went up. Entering there, they took the carved image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molded image. The priest stood at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men whowere armed with weapons of war.
verses.textEnNlt: the five scouts entered the shrine and removed the carved image, the sacred ephod, the household idols, and the cast idol. Meanwhile, the priest was standing at the gate with the 600 armed warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the five men who went to spy out the land went up and entered there; they took the carved image, the ephod, the household idols, and the cast metal image, while the priest was standing at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
verses.textEn: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance of the gate.

verses.textZh: 当那五个人进了米迦的家，拿走雕像、以弗得、神像和铸像的时候，祭司就问他们："你们作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当那五个人进了米迦的家，拿走雕像、以弗得、神像和铸像的时候，祭司就问他们："你们作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那五个人进入米迦的住宅，拿出雕刻的像、以弗得、家中的神像，并铸成的像，祭司就问他们说：「你们做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the five men went into Micah’s house and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when these went into Micah’s house and took the carved image, the ephod, the household gods, and the metal image, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When these went into Micah’s house and took the carved image, the ephod, the household idols, and the molded image, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
verses.textEnNlt: When the priest saw the men carrying all the sacred objects out of Micah’s shrine, he said, "What are you doing?"
verses.textEnNasb: When these men entered Micah’s house and took the carved image, the ephod, household idols, and the cast metal image, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"
verses.textEn: When the five men went into Micah’s house and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods, the priest said to them, "What are you doing?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答他："不要出声，用手掩着你的嘴，跟我们走吧，好作我们的师父和祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？还是作以色列中一个支派一个家族的祭司好呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答他："不要出声，用手掩着你的嘴，跟我们走吧，好作我们的师父和祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？还是作以色列中一个支派一个家族的祭司好呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「不要作声，用手捂口，跟我们去吧！我们必以你为父、为祭司。你作一家的祭司好呢？还是作以色列一族一支派的祭司好呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: They answered him, "Be quiet! Don’t say a word. Come with us, and be our father and priest. Isn’t it better that you serve a tribe and clan in Israel as priest rather than just one man’s household?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "Keep quiet; put your hand on your mouth and come with us and be to us a father and a priest. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and clan in Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "Be quiet, put your hand over your mouth, and come with us; be a father and a priest to us. Isit better for you to be a priest to the household of one man, or that you be a priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Be quiet and come with us," they said. "Be a father and priest to all of us. Isn’t it better to be a priest for an entire tribe and clan of Israel than for the household of just one man?"
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "Be silent, put your hand over your mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest. Is it better for you to be a priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?"
verses.textEn: They answered him, "Be quiet! Don’t say a word. Come with us, and be our father and priest. Isn’t it better that you serve a tribe and clan in Israel as priest rather than just one man’s household?"

verses.textZh: 祭司心里高兴，就拿着以弗得、神像和雕像，来到众人中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司心里高兴，就拿着以弗得、神像和雕像，来到众人中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司心里喜悦，便拿着以弗得和家中的神像，并雕刻的像，进入他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest was very pleased. He took the ephod, the household gods and the idol and went along with the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest’s heart was glad. He took the ephod and the household gods and the carved image and went along with the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priest’s heart was glad; and he took the ephod, the household idols, and the carved image, and took his place among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The young priest was quite happy to go with them, so he took along the sacred ephod, the household idols, and the carved image.
verses.textEnNasb: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the household idols, and the carved image, and went among the people.
verses.textEn: The priest was very pleased. He took the ephod, the household gods and the idol and went along with the people.

verses.textZh: 他们就转身离去，把妇孺和牲畜，以及财物，都放在前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就转身离去，把妇孺和牲畜，以及财物，都放在前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就转身离开那里，妻子、儿女、牲畜、财物都在前头。
verses.textEnNiv: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.
verses.textEnEsv: So they turned and departed, putting the little ones and the livestock and the goods in front of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods in front of them.
verses.textEnNlt: They turned and started on their way again, placing their children, livestock, and possessions in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they turned and left, and put the children, the livestock, and the valuables in front of them.
verses.textEn: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.

verses.textZh: 他们离开米迦的家很远的时候，在米迦的家附近各家的人，都被召集出来，去追赶但人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离开米迦的家很远的时候，在米迦的家附近各家的人，都被召集出来，去追赶但人。
verses.textZhCuv: 离米迦的住宅已远，米迦的近邻都聚集来，追赶但人，
verses.textEnNiv: When they had gone some distance from Micah’s house, the men who lived near Micah were called together and overtook the Danites.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had gone a distance from the home of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house were called out, and they overtook the people of Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people from the tribe of Dan were quite a distance from Micah’s house, the people who lived near Micah came chasing after them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had distanced themselves from Micah’s house, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house assembled by command and overtook the sons of Dan.
verses.textEn: When they had gone some distance from Micah’s house, the men who lived near Micah were called together and overtook the Danites.

verses.textZh: 他们呼叫但人；但人转过脸来，问米迦："你召集了这么多人出来作甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们呼叫但人；但人转过脸来，问米迦："你召集了这么多人出来作甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 呼叫但人。但人回头问米迦说：「你聚集这许多人来做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, "What’s the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they shouted to the people of Dan, who turned around and said to Micah, "What is the matter with you, that you come with such a company?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they called out to the children of Dan. So they turned around and said to Micah, "What ails you, that you have gathered such a company?"
verses.textEnNlt: They were shouting as they caught up with them. The men of Dan turned around and said to Micah, "What’s the matter? Why have you called these men together and chased after us like this?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they called out to the sons of Dan, who turned around and said to Micah, "What is the matter with you, that you have assembled together?"
verses.textEn: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, "What’s the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?"

verses.textZh: 米迦回答："你们把我所做的神像和我的祭司都带走了，我还有甚么呢？你们怎么还问我：‘你作甚么’呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米迦回答："你们把我所做的神像和我的祭司都带走了，我还有甚么呢？你们怎么还问我：‘你作甚么’呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 米迦说：「你们将我所做的神像和祭司都带了去，我还有所剩的吗？怎么还问我说『做什么』呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, ‘What’s the matter with you?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "You take my gods that I made and the priest, and go away, and what have I left? How then do you ask me, ‘What is the matter with you?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you have gone away. Now what more do I have? How can you say to me, ‘What ails you?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you mean, ‘What’s the matter?’" Micah replied. "You’ve taken away all the gods I have made, and my priest, and I have nothing left!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "You have taken my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away; what more do I have? So how can you say to me, ‘What is the matter with you?’ "
verses.textEn: He replied, "You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, ‘What’s the matter with you?’ "

verses.textZh: 但人对米迦说："不要再让我们听见你的声音，恐怕有暴躁的人攻击你们，以致你和你全家尽都丧失性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但人对米迦说："不要再让我们听见你的声音，恐怕有暴躁的人攻击你们，以致你和你全家尽都丧失性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但人对米迦说：「你不要使我们听见你的声音，恐怕有性暴的人攻击你，以致你和你的全家尽都丧命。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Danites answered, "Don’t argue with us, or some of the men may get angry and attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Dan said to him, "Do not let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall upon you, and you lose your life with the lives of your household."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Dan said to him, "Do not let your voice be heard among us, lest angry men fall upon you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household!"
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Dan said, "Watch what you say! There are some short-tempered men around here who might get angry and kill you and your family."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Dan said to him, "Do not let your voice be heard among us, or else fierce men will attack you, and you will lose your life and the lives of your household."
verses.textEn: The Danites answered, "Don’t argue with us, or some of the men may get angry and attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives."

verses.textZh: 但人继续走他们的路；米迦见他们比自己强，就转身回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但人继续走他们的路；米迦见他们比自己强，就转身回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人还是走他们的路。米迦见他们的势力比自己强盛，就转身回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Dan went their way. And when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Dan went their way. And when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men of Dan continued on their way. When Micah saw that there were too many of them for him to attack, he turned around and went home.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Dan went on their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.
verses.textEn: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.

verses.textZh: 但人把米迦所做的神像和他的祭司都带走，他们来到拉亿，去到平静安居的人民那里，就用刀剑击杀了他们，又用火烧了那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但人把米迦所做的神像和他的祭司都带走，他们来到拉亿，去到平静安居的人民那里，就用刀剑击杀了他们，又用火烧了那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人将米迦所做的神像和他的祭司都带到拉亿，见安居无虑的民，就用刀杀了那民，又放火烧了那城，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a people at peace and secure. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Dan took what Micah had made, and the priest who belonged to him, and they came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took thethings Micah had made, and the priest who had belonged to him, and went to Laish, to a people quiet and secure; and they struck them with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, with Micah’s idols and his priest, the men of Dan came to the town of Laish, whose people were peaceful and secure. They attacked with swords and burned the town to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they took what Micah had made and the priest who had belonged to him, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; and they burned the city with fire.
verses.textEn: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a people at peace and secure. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.

verses.textZh: 没有人搭救，因为离西顿很远，他们又与别人没有来往。这城位于靠近伯．利合的山谷中。但人重建那城，住在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人搭救，因为离西顿很远，他们又与别人没有来往。这城位于靠近伯．利合的山谷中。但人重建那城，住在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 并无人搭救；因为离西顿远，他们又与别人没有来往。城在平原，那平原靠近伯‧利合。但人又在那里修城居住，
verses.textEnNiv: There was no one to rescue them because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The city was in a valley near Beth Rehob. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was no deliverer because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone. It was in the valley that belongs to Beth-rehob. Then they rebuilt the city and lived in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no ties with anyone. It was in the valley that belongs to Beth Rehob. So they rebuilt the city and dwelt there.
verses.textEnNlt: There was no one to rescue the people, for they lived a great distance from Sidon and had no allies nearby. This happened in the valley near Beth-rehob. Then the people of the tribe of Dan rebuilt the town and lived there.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was no one to save them, because it was far from Sidon and they had no dealings with anyone, and it was in the valley which is near Beth-rehob. So they rebuilt the city and lived in it.
verses.textEn: There was no one to rescue them because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The city was in a valley near Beth Rehob. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there.

verses.textZh: 按着他们的祖宗，以色列所生的儿子但的名字，给那城起名叫但；其实那城原先的名字叫拉亿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着他们的祖宗，以色列所生的儿子但的名字，给那城起名叫但；其实那城原先的名字叫拉亿。
verses.textZhCuv: 照着他们始祖以色列之子但的名字，给那城起名叫但；原先那城名叫拉亿。
verses.textEnNiv: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city used to be called Laish.
verses.textEnEsv: And they named the city Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor, who was born to Israel; but the name of the city was Laish at the first.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel. However, the name of the city formerly was Laish.
verses.textEnNlt: They renamed the town Dan after their ancestor, Israel’s son, but it had originally been called Laish.
verses.textEnNasb: And they named the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father who was born to Israel; however, the name of the city was previously Laish.
verses.textEn: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan, who was born to Israel—though the city used to be called Laish.

verses.textZh: 但人就为自己把那雕像立起来；摩西的孙子、革顺的儿子约拿单和他的子孙，都作了但支派的祭司，直到那地遭受掳掠的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但人就为自己把那雕像立起来；摩西的孙子、革顺的儿子约拿单和他的子孙，都作了但支派的祭司，直到那地遭受掳掠的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人就为自己设立那雕刻的像。摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子约拿单，和他的子孙作但支派的祭司，直到那地遭掳掠的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: There the Danites set up for themselves the idol, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Dan set up the carved image for themselves, and Jonathan the son of Gershom, son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Dan set up for themselves the carved image; and Jonathan the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they set up the carved image, and they appointed Jonathan son of Gershom, son of Moses, as their priest. This family continued as priests for the tribe of Dan until the Exile.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Dan set up for themselves the carved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.textEn: There the Danites set up for themselves the idol, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.

verses.textZh: 神的殿在示罗有多少日子，但人为自己设立米迦所做的雕像也有多少日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的殿在示罗有多少日子，但人为自己设立米迦所做的雕像也有多少日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的殿在示罗多少日子，但人为自己设立米迦所雕刻的像也在但多少日子。
verses.textEnNiv: They continued to use the idol Micah had made, all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.
verses.textEnEsv: So they set up Micah’s carved image that he made, as long as the house of God was at Shiloh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they set up for themselves Micah’s carved image which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
verses.textEnNlt: So Micah’s carved image was worshiped by the tribe of Dan as long as the Tabernacle of God remained at Shiloh.
verses.textEnNasb: So they set up for themselves Micah’s carved image which he had made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
verses.textEn: They continued to use the idol Micah had made, all the time the house of God was in Shiloh.

verses.textZh: 在以色列中没有王的日子，有一个利未人寄居在以法莲山地的偏远地区；他从犹大的伯利恒给自己娶了一个女子作妾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列中没有王的日子，有一个利未人寄居在以法莲山地的偏远地区；他从犹大的伯利恒给自己娶了一个女子作妾。
verses.textZhCuv: 当以色列中没有王的时候，有住以法莲山地那边的一个利未人，娶了一个犹大伯利恒的女子为妾。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Israel had no king. Now a Levite who lived in a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, a certain Levite was sojourning in the remote parts of the hill country of Ephraim, who took to himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in those days, when therewas no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite staying in the remote mountains of Ephraim. He took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Now in those days Israel had no king. There was a man from the tribe of Levi living in a remote area of the hill country of Ephraim. One day he brought home a woman from Bethlehem in Judah to be his concubine.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite staying in the remote part of the hill country of Ephraim, who took a concubine for himself from Bethlehem in Judah.
verses.textEn: In those days Israel had no king. Now a Levite who lived in a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

verses.textZh: 他的妾背夫行淫，离开丈夫，回到犹大的伯利恒她父亲的家那里去了，在那里住了四个月的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的妾背夫行淫，离开丈夫，回到犹大的伯利恒她父亲的家那里去了，在那里住了四个月的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 妾行淫离开丈夫，回犹大的伯利恒，到了父家，在那里住了四个月。
verses.textEnNiv: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her parents’ home in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,
verses.textEnEsv: And his concubine was unfaithful to him, and she went away from him to her father’s house at Bethlehem in Judah, and was there some four months.
verses.textEnNkjv: But his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him to her father’s house at Bethlehem in Judah, and was there four whole months.
verses.textEnNlt: But she became angry with him and returned to her father’s home in Bethlehem. After about four months,
verses.textEnNasb: But his concubine found him repugnant, and she left him and went to her father’s house in Bethlehem in Judah, and remained there for a period of four months.
verses.textEn: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her parents’ home in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,

verses.textZh: 她的丈夫起来，带着一个仆人和两头驴去追她，用话打动她的心，叫她回来。她把丈夫带到自己父家，那少女的父亲见了那人，就欢欢喜喜迎接他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的丈夫起来，带着一个仆人和两头驴去追她，用话打动她的心，叫她回来。她把丈夫带到自己父家，那少女的父亲见了那人，就欢欢喜喜迎接他。
verses.textZhCuv: 她丈夫起来，带着一个仆人、两匹驴去见她，用好话劝她回来。女子就引丈夫进入父家。她父见了那人，便欢欢喜喜地迎接。
verses.textEnNiv: her husband went to her to persuade her to return. He had with him his servant and two donkeys. She took him into her parents’ home, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then her husband arose and went after her, to speak kindly to her and bring her back. He had with him his servant and a couple of donkeys. And she brought him into her father’s house. And when the girl’s father saw him, he came with joy to meet him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then her husband arose and went after her, to speak kindly to her and bring her back, having his servant and a couple of donkeys with him. So she brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young woman saw him, he was glad to meet him.
verses.textEnNlt: her husband set out for Bethlehem to speak personally to her and persuade her to come back. He took with him a servant and a pair of donkeys. When he arrived at her father’s house, her father saw him and welcomed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then her husband set out and went after her to speak gently to her in order to bring her back, taking with him his servant and a pair of donkeys. And she brought him into her father’s house, and when the girl’s father saw him, he was glad to meet him.
verses.textEn: her husband went to her to persuade her to return. He had with him his servant and two donkeys. She took him into her parents’ home, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.

verses.textZh: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，强留那人，那人就与他同住了三天；他们一起吃喝，在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，强留那人，那人就与他同住了三天；他们一起吃喝，在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，将那人留下住了三天。于是二人一同吃喝、住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: His father-in-law, the woman’s father, prevailed on him to stay; so he remained with him three days, eating and drinking, and sleeping there.
verses.textEnEsv: And his father-in-law, the girl’s father, made him stay, and he remained with him three days. So they ate and drank and spent the night there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now his father-in-law, the young woman’s father, detained him; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank and lodged there.
verses.textEnNlt: Her father urged him to stay awhile, so he stayed three days, eating, drinking, and sleeping there.
verses.textEnNasb: His father-in-law, the girl’s father, prevailed upon him, and he remained with him for three days. So they ate and drank and stayed there.
verses.textEn: His father-in-law, the woman’s father, prevailed on him to stay; so he remained with him three days, eating and drinking, and sleeping there.

verses.textZh: 到了第四天，他们清早起来，那人起身要走；那女子的父亲对女婿说："请吃点饼增添心力，然后再走。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第四天，他们清早起来，那人起身要走；那女子的父亲对女婿说："请吃点饼增添心力，然后再走。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到第四天，利未人清早起来要走，女子的父亲对女婿说：「请你吃点饭，加添心力，然后可以行路。」
verses.textEnNiv: On the fourth day they got up early and he prepared to leave, but the woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh yourself with something to eat; then you can go."
verses.textEnEsv: And on the fourth day they arose early in the morning, and he prepared to go, but the girl’s father said to his son-in-law, "Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and after that you may go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass on the fourth day that they arose early in the morning, and he stood to depart; but the young woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way."
verses.textEnNlt: On the fourth day the man was up early, ready to leave, but the woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Have something to eat before you go."
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the fourth day they got up early in the morning, and he prepared to go; but the girl’s father said to his son-in-law, "Strengthen yourself with a piece of bread, and afterward you may go."
verses.textEn: On the fourth day they got up early and he prepared to leave, but the woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh yourself with something to eat; then you can go."

verses.textZh: 于是二人坐下，一起吃喝；女子的父亲对那人说："请你答应再过一夜，畅快你的心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是二人坐下，一起吃喝；女子的父亲对那人说："请你答应再过一夜，畅快你的心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父亲对那人说：「请你再住一夜，畅快你的心。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the woman’s father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: So the two of them sat and ate and drank together. And the girl’s father said to the man, "Be pleased to spend the night, and let your heart be merry."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sat down, and the two of them ate and drank together. Then the young woman’s father said to the man, "Please be content to stay all night, and let your heart be merry."
verses.textEnNlt: So the two men sat down together and had something to eat and drink. Then the woman’s father said, "Please stay another night and enjoy yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: So both of them sat down and ate and drank together; and the girl’s father said to the man, "Please be so kind as to spend the night, and let your heart be cheerful."
verses.textEn: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the woman’s father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."

verses.textZh: 那人起来要走，他的岳父强留他，他又在那里过了一夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人起来要走，他的岳父强留他，他又在那里过了一夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人起来要走，他岳父强留他，他又住了一宿。
verses.textEnNiv: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the man rose up to go, his father-in-law pressed him, till he spent the night there again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the man stood to depart, his father-in-law urged him; so he lodged there again.
verses.textEnNlt: The man got up to leave, but his father-in-law kept urging him to stay, so he finally gave in and stayed the night.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the man got up to go; but his father-in-law urged him, and he spent the night there again.
verses.textEn: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.

verses.textZh: 到了第五天，他清早起来要走；那女子的父亲说："请吃点饼增添心力，等到日头西斜再走吧。"于是他们耽延，直到日头西斜；二人一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第五天，他清早起来要走；那女子的父亲说："请吃点饼增添心力，等到日头西斜再走吧。"于是他们耽延，直到日头西斜；二人一同吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第五天，他清早起来要走，女子的父亲说：「请你吃点饭，加添心力，等到日头偏西再走。」于是二人一同吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the woman’s father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the fifth day he arose early in the morning to depart. And the girl’s father said, "Strengthen your heart and wait until the day declines." So they ate, both of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart, but the young woman’s father said, "Please refresh your heart." So they delayed until afternoon; and both of them ate.
verses.textEnNlt: On the morning of the fifth day he was up early again, ready to leave, and again the woman’s father said, "Have something to eat; then you can leave later this afternoon." So they had another day of feasting.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the fifth day he got up to go early in the morning, but the girl’s father said, "Please strengthen yourself, and wait until late afternoon"; so both of them ate.
verses.textEn: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the woman’s father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.

verses.textZh: 那人和他的妾，以及他的仆人起来要走的时候，他的岳父，就是那女子的父亲，对他说："看哪，天快晚了！请再住一夜。看哪，日头西斜了！请在这里再住一夜，畅快你的心；明天可以清早起来，上路回家去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人和他的妾，以及他的仆人起来要走的时候，他的岳父，就是那女子的父亲，对他说："看哪，天快晚了！请再住一夜。看哪，日头西斜了！请在这里再住一夜，畅快你的心；明天可以清早起来，上路回家去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人同他的妾和仆人起来要走，他岳父，就是女子的父亲，对他说：「看哪，日头偏西了，请你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在这里住宿，畅快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the woman’s father, said, "Now look, it’s almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the man and his concubine and his servant rose up to depart, his father-in-law, the girl’s father, said to him, "Behold, now the day has waned toward evening. Please, spend the night. Behold, the day draws to its close. Lodge here and let your heart be merry, and tomorrow you shall arise early in the morning for your journey, and go home."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the man stood to depart—he and his concubine and his servant—his father-in-law, the young woman’s father, said to him, "Look, the day is now drawing toward evening; please spend the night. See, the day is coming to an end; lodge here, that your heart may be merry. Tomorrow go your way early, so that you may get home."
verses.textEnNlt: Later, as the man and his concubine and servant were preparing to leave, his father-in-law said, "Look, it’s almost evening. Stay the night and enjoy yourself. Tomorrow you can get up early and be on your way."
verses.textEnNasb: When the man got up to go, along with his concubine and servant, his father-in-law, the girl’s father, said to him, "Behold now, the day has drawn to a close; please spend the night. Behold, the day is coming to an end; spend the night here so that your heart may be cheerful. Then tomorrow you may arise early for your journey and go home."
verses.textEn: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the woman’s father, said, "Now look, it’s almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."

verses.textZh: 那人不愿再住一夜，就带着自己的妾和两头备好了的驴，起来走了，来到耶布斯对面；耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人不愿再住一夜，就带着自己的妾和两头备好了的驴，起来走了，来到耶布斯对面；耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人不愿再住一夜，就备上那两匹驴，带着妾起身走了，来到耶布斯的对面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）
verses.textEnNiv: But, unwilling to stay another night, the man left and went toward Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
verses.textEnEsv: But the man would not spend the night. He rose up and departed and arrived opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem). He had with him a couple of saddled donkeys, and his concubine was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, the man was not willing to spend that night; so he rose and departed, and came opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem). With him were the two saddled donkeys; his concubine was also with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But this time the man was determined to leave. So he took his two saddled donkeys and his concubine and headed in the direction of Jebus (that is, Jerusalem).
verses.textEnNasb: But the man was unwilling to spend the night, so he got up and left, and came to a place opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem). And with him was a pair of saddled donkeys; his concubine also was with him.
verses.textEn: But, unwilling to stay another night, the man left and went toward Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.

verses.textZh: 他们走近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了；仆人对主人说："来，让我们转到这耶布斯人的城去，好在那里住宿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了；仆人对主人说："来，让我们转到这耶布斯人的城去，好在那里住宿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 临近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了，仆人对主人说：「我们不如进这耶布斯人的城里住宿。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, "Come, let’s stop at this city of the Jebusites and spend the night."
verses.textEnEsv: When they were near Jebus, the day was nearly over, and the servant said to his master, "Come now, let us turn aside to this city of the Jebusites and spend the night in it."
verses.textEnNkjv: They were near Jebus, and the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, "Come, please, and let us turn aside into this city of the Jebusites and lodge in it."
verses.textEnNlt: It was late in the day when they neared Jebus, and the man’s servant said to him, "Let’s stop at this Jebusite town and spend the night there."
verses.textEnNasb: When they were near Jebus, the day was almost gone; and the servant said to his master, "Please come, and let’s turn aside into this city of the Jebusites and spend the night in it."
verses.textEn: When they were near Jebus and the day was almost gone, the servant said to his master, "Come, let’s stop at this city of the Jebusites and spend the night."

verses.textZh: 主人对他说："我们不可转到这座不是以色列人居住的外族人的城里去，我们过到基比亚去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主人对他说："我们不可转到这座不是以色列人居住的外族人的城里去，我们过到基比亚去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主人回答说：「我们不可进不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如过到基比亚去」；
verses.textEnNiv: His master replied, "No. We won’t go into any city whose people are not Israelites. We will go on to Gibeah."
verses.textEnEsv: And his master said to him, "We will not turn aside into the city of foreigners, who do not belong to the people of Israel, but we will pass on to Gibeah."
verses.textEnNkjv: But his master said to him, "We will not turn aside here into a city of foreigners, who are not of the children of Israel; we will go on to Gibeah."
verses.textEnNlt: "No," his master said, "we can’t stay in this foreign town where there are no Israelites. Instead, we will go on to Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: However, his master said to him, "We will not turn aside into a city of foreigners who are not of the sons of Israel; instead, we will go on as far as Gibeah."
verses.textEn: His master replied, "No. We won’t go into any city whose people are not Israelites. We will go on to Gibeah."

verses.textZh: 又对他的仆人说："来吧，我们可以到这些地方其中一个去投宿，或在基比亚或在拉玛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又对他的仆人说："来吧，我们可以到这些地方其中一个去投宿，或在基比亚或在拉玛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对仆人说：「我们可以到一个地方，或住在基比亚，或住在拉玛。」
verses.textEnNiv: He added, "Come, let’s try to reach Gibeah or Ramah and spend the night in one of those places."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his young man, "Come and let us draw near to one of these places and spend the night at Gibeah or at Ramah."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to his servant, "Come, let us draw near to one of these places, and spend the night in Gibeah or in Ramah."
verses.textEnNlt: Come on, let’s try to get as far as Gibeah or Ramah, and we’ll spend the night in one of those towns."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to his servant, "Come, and let’s approach one of these places; and we will spend the night in Gibeah or Ramah."
verses.textEn: He added, "Come, let’s try to reach Gibeah or Ramah and spend the night in one of those places."

verses.textZh: 于是他们走路过去；他们走近便雅悯人的基比亚的时候，日头已经落了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们走路过去；他们走近便雅悯人的基比亚的时候，日头已经落了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就往前走。将到便雅悯的基比亚，日头已经落了；
verses.textEnNiv: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: So they passed on and went their way. And the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they passed by and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went on. The sun was setting as they came to Gibeah, a town in the land of Benjamin,
verses.textEnNasb: So they passed along and went their way, and the sun set on them near Gibeah which belongs to Benjamin.
verses.textEn: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 他们从那里转身，要进基比亚去住宿；他们进去，坐在城里的广场上，因为没有人接待他们到家里去住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从那里转身，要进基比亚去住宿；他们进去，坐在城里的广场上，因为没有人接待他们到家里去住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进入基比亚要在那里住宿，就坐在城里的街上，因为无人接他们进家住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: There they stopped to spend the night. They went and sat in the city square, but no one took them in for the night.
verses.textEnEsv: and they turned aside there, to go in and spend the night at Gibeah. And he went in and sat down in the open square of the city, for no one took them into his house to spend the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: They turned aside there to go in to lodge in Gibeah. And when he went in, he sat down in the open square of the city, for no one would take them into his house to spend the night.
verses.textEnNlt: so they stopped there to spend the night. They rested in the town square, but no one took them in for the night.
verses.textEnNasb: They turned aside there to enter and spend the night in Gibeah. When they entered, they sat down in the public square of the city, for no one took them into his house to spend the night.
verses.textEn: There they stopped to spend the night. They went and sat in the city square, but no one took them in for the night.

verses.textZh: 到晚上，有一个老年人从田间工作回来；那人原是以法莲山地的人，寄居在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到晚上，有一个老年人从田间工作回来；那人原是以法莲山地的人，寄居在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。
verses.textZhCuv: 晚上，有一个老年人从田间做工回来。他原是以法莲山地的人，住在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。
verses.textEnNiv: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was living in Gibeah (the inhabitants of the place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, an old man was coming from his work in the field at evening. The man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he was sojourning in Gibeah. The men of the place were Benjaminites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Just then an old man came in from his work in the field at evening, who also was from the mountains of Ephraim; he was staying in Gibeah, whereas the men of the place were Benjamites.
verses.textEnNlt: That evening an old man came home from his work in the fields. He was from the hill country of Ephraim, but he was living in Gibeah, where the people were from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, an old man was coming out of the field from his work at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he was staying in Gibeah, but the men of the place were Benjaminites.
verses.textEn: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was living in Gibeah (the inhabitants of the place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the fields.

verses.textZh: 那老年人举目，看见那个旅客在城里的广场上，就问他："你要到哪里去？你从哪里来？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那老年人举目，看见那个旅客在城里的广场上，就问他："你要到哪里去？你从哪里来？"
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人举目看见客人坐在城里的街上，就问他说：「你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」
verses.textEnNiv: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, "Where are you going? Where did you come from?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he lifted up his eyes and saw the traveler in the open square of the city. And the old man said, "Where are you going? And where do you come from?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he raised his eyes, he saw the traveler in the open square of the city; and the old man said, "Where are you going, and where do you come from?"
verses.textEnNlt: When he saw the travelers sitting in the town square, he asked them where they were from and where they were going.
verses.textEnNasb: And he raised his eyes and saw the traveler in the public square of the city; and the old man said, "Where are you going, and where do you come from?"
verses.textEn: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, "Where are you going? Where did you come from?"

verses.textZh: 利未人回答他："我们是从犹大的伯利恒过来的，要到以法莲山地的偏远地区去，我原是那地方的人；我去过犹大的伯利恒，现在我要到我的家去 ，但没有人接待我到家里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人回答他："我们是从犹大的伯利恒过来的，要到以法莲山地的偏远地区去，我原是那地方的人；我去过犹大的伯利恒，现在我要到我的家去 ，但没有人接待我到家里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「我们从犹大的伯利恒来，要往以法莲山地那边去。我原是那里的人，到过犹大的伯利恒，现在我往耶和华的殿去，在这里无人接我进他的家。
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "We are on our way from Bethlehem in Judah to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim where I live. I have been to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the Lord . No one has taken me in for the night.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "We are passing from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote parts of the hill country of Ephraim, from which I come. I went to Bethlehem in Judah, and I am going to the house of the Lord , but no one has taken me into his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to him, "We are passing from Bethlehem in Judah toward the remote mountains of Ephraim; I am from there. I went to Bethlehem in Judah; now I am going to the house of the Lord. But there is no one who will take me into his house,
verses.textEnNlt: "We have been in Bethlehem in Judah," the man replied. "We are on our way to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim, which is my home. I traveled to Bethlehem, and now I’m returning home. But no one has taken us in for the night,
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "We are passing from Bethlehem in Judah to the remote part of the hill country of Ephraim, for I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem in Judah. But I am now going to my house, and no one will take me into his house.
verses.textEn: He answered, "We are on our way from Bethlehem in Judah to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim where I live. I have been to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the Lord . No one has taken me in for the night.

verses.textZh: 其实我有粮草、有饲料，可以喂驴；我和我的妾，以及与你的仆人在一起的那个青年人，都有饼和酒吃喝，一无所缺。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实我有粮草、有饲料，可以喂驴；我和我的妾，以及与你的仆人在一起的那个青年人，都有饼和酒吃喝，一无所缺。"
verses.textZhCuv: 其实我有粮草可以喂驴，我与我的妾，并我的仆人，有饼有酒，并不缺少什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: We have both straw and fodder for our donkeys and bread and wine for ourselves your servants—me, the woman and the young man with us. We don’t need anything."
verses.textEnEsv: We have straw and feed for our donkeys, with bread and wine for me and your female servant and the young man with your servants. There is no lack of anything."
verses.textEnNkjv: although we have both straw and fodder for our donkeys, and bread and wine for myself, for your female servant, and for the young man whois with your servant; thereis no lack of anything."
verses.textEnNlt: even though we have everything we need. We have straw and feed for our donkeys and plenty of bread and wine for ourselves."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys, and also bread and wine for me, and your female slave, and the young man who is with your servants; there is no lack of anything."
verses.textEn: We have both straw and fodder for our donkeys and bread and wine for ourselves your servants—me, the woman and the young man with us. We don’t need anything."

verses.textZh: 那老年人说："愿你平安，你所缺乏的，由我负责好了；只是不可在广场上过夜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那老年人说："愿你平安，你所缺乏的，由我负责好了；只是不可在广场上过夜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人说：「愿你平安！你所需用的我都给你，只是不可在街上过夜。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You are welcome at my house," the old man said. "Let me supply whatever you need. Only don’t spend the night in the square."
verses.textEnEsv: And the old man said, "Peace be to you; I will care for all your wants. Only, do not spend the night in the square."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the old man said, "Peace be with you! However, let all your needs be my responsibility; only do not spend the night in the open square."
verses.textEnNlt: "You are welcome to stay with me," the old man said. "I will give you anything you might need. But whatever you do, don’t spend the night in the square."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the old man said, "Peace to you. Only let me take care of all your needs; however, do not spend the night in the public square."
verses.textEn: "You are welcome at my house," the old man said. "Let me supply whatever you need. Only don’t spend the night in the square."

verses.textZh: 于是把他领到自己的家里，用饲料喂了驴，他们洗了脚，就吃喝起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是把他领到自己的家里，用饲料喂了驴，他们洗了脚，就吃喝起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领他们到家里，喂上驴，他们就洗脚吃喝。
verses.textEnNiv: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.
verses.textEnEsv: So he brought him into his house and gave the donkeys feed. And they washed their feet, and ate and drank.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought him into his house, and gave fodder to the donkeys. And they washed their feet, and ate and drank.
verses.textEnNlt: So he took them home with him and fed the donkeys. After they washed their feet, they ate and drank together.
verses.textEnNasb: So he took him into his house and fed the donkeys, and they washed their feet and ate and drank.
verses.textEn: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.

verses.textZh: 他们心里正畅快的时候，忽然城里有些无赖之徒，围绕房子，不住地敲门，对老房主说："把进入你家的那个人带出来，我们要与他交合。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里正畅快的时候，忽然城里有些无赖之徒，围绕房子，不住地敲门，对老房主说："把进入你家的那个人带出来，我们要与他交合。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心里正欢畅的时候，城中的匪徒围住房子，连连叩门，对房主老人说：「你把那进你家的人带出来，我们要与他交合。」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were enjoying themselves, some of the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they shouted to the old man who owned the house, "Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have sex with him."
verses.textEnEsv: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, worthless fellows, surrounded the house, beating on the door. And they said to the old man, the master of the house, "Bring out the man who came into your house, that we may know him."
verses.textEnNkjv: As they were enjoying themselves, suddenly certain men of the city, perverted men, surrounded the house and beat on the door. They spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, "Bring out the man who came to your house, that we may know him carnally!"
verses.textEnNlt: While they were enjoying themselves, a crowd of troublemakers from the town surrounded the house. They began beating at the door and shouting to the old man, "Bring out the man who is staying with you so we can have sex with him."
verses.textEnNasb: While they were celebrating, behold, the men of the city, certain worthless men, surrounded the house, pushing one another at the door; and they spoke to the owner of the house, the old man, saying, "Bring out the man who entered your house that we may have relations with him."
verses.textEn: While they were enjoying themselves, some of the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they shouted to the old man who owned the house, "Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have sex with him."

verses.textZh: 那房主出来见他们，对他们说："我的众兄弟啊，不可这样，请你们不要作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要作这羞耻的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那房主出来见他们，对他们说："我的众兄弟啊，不可这样，请你们不要作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要作这羞耻的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那房主出来对他们说：「弟兄们哪，不要这样作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要行这丑事。
verses.textEnNiv: The owner of the house went outside and said to them, "No, my friends, don’t be so vile. Since this man is my guest, don’t do this outrageous thing.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, "No, my brothers, do not act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, do not do this vile thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the man, the master of the house, went out to them and said to them, "No, my brethren! I beg you, do not act so wickedly! Seeing this man has come into my house, do not commit this outrage.
verses.textEnNlt: The old man stepped outside to talk to them. "No, my brothers, don’t do such an evil thing. For this man is a guest in my house, and such a thing would be shameful.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man, the owner of the house, went out to them and said to them, "No, my brothers, please do not act so wickedly. Since this man has come into my house, do not commit this vile sin.
verses.textEn: The owner of the house went outside and said to them, "No, my friends, don’t be so vile. Since this man is my guest, don’t do this outrageous thing.

verses.textZh: 这里有我的女儿，还是处女，并且有这人的妾，我把她们领出来，让你们污辱她们；你们看怎样好，就怎样待她们吧。只是对这个人，你们却不要作这羞耻的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这里有我的女儿，还是处女，并且有这人的妾，我把她们领出来，让你们污辱她们；你们看怎样好，就怎样待她们吧。只是对这个人，你们却不要作这羞耻的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我有个女儿，还是处女，并有这人的妾，我将她们领出来任凭你们玷辱她们，只是向这人不可行这样的丑事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. I will bring them out to you now, and you can use them and do to them whatever you wish. But as for this man, don’t do such an outrageous thing."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, here are my virgin daughter and his concubine. Let me bring them out now. Violate them and do with them what seems good to you, but against this man do not do this outrageous thing."
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, hereis my virgin daughter and theman’s concubine; let me bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them as you please; but to this man do not do such a vile thing!"
verses.textEnNlt: Here, take my virgin daughter and this man’s concubine. I will bring them out to you, and you can abuse them and do whatever you like. But don’t do such a shameful thing to this man."
verses.textEnNasb: Here is my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine. Please let me bring them out, then rape them and do to them whatever you wish. But do not commit this act of vile sin against this man."
verses.textEn: Look, here is my virgin daughter, and his concubine. I will bring them out to you now, and you can use them and do to them whatever you wish. But as for this man, don’t do such an outrageous thing."

verses.textZh: 那些人却不肯听从他的话，那人就抓住自己的妾，拉出外边去交给他们，他们就与她交合，整夜污辱她；直到早晨，天色破晓的时候，才放她走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人却不肯听从他的话，那人就抓住自己的妾，拉出外边去交给他们，他们就与她交合，整夜污辱她；直到早晨，天色破晓的时候，才放她走。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些人却不听从他的话。那人就把他的妾拉出去交给他们，他们便与她交合，终夜凌辱她，直到天色快亮才放她去。
verses.textEnNiv: But the men would not listen to him. So the man took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.
verses.textEnEsv: But the men would not listen to him. So the man seized his concubine and made her go out to them. And they knew her and abused her all night until the morning. And as the dawn began to break, they let her go.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the men would not heed him. So the man took his concubine and brought her out to them. And they knew her and abused her all night until morning; and when the day began to break, they let her go.
verses.textEnNlt: But they wouldn’t listen to him. So the Levite took hold of his concubine and pushed her out the door. The men of the town abused her all night, taking turns raping her until morning. Finally, at dawn they let her go.
verses.textEnNasb: But the men would not listen to him. So the man seized his concubine and brought her outside to them; and they raped her and abused her all night until morning, then let her go at the approach of dawn.
verses.textEn: But the men would not listen to him. So the man took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.

verses.textZh: 天快亮的时候，那女子回到留她主人住宿的那人的房子门口，就仆倒在那里，直到天亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天快亮的时候，那女子回到留她主人住宿的那人的房子门口，就仆倒在那里，直到天亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 天快亮的时候，妇人回到她主人住宿的房门前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。
verses.textEnNiv: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.
verses.textEnEsv: And as morning appeared, the woman came and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her master was, until it was light.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman came as the day was dawning, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her master was, till it was light.
verses.textEnNlt: At daybreak the woman returned to the house where her husband was staying. She collapsed at the door of the house and lay there until it was light.
verses.textEnNasb: As the day began to dawn, the woman came and fell down at the doorway of the man’s house where her master was, until full daylight.
verses.textEn: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.

verses.textZh: 到早晨，她的主人起来，开了房门，出去要上路的时候，就看见那妇人，就是他的妾，仆倒在门口，她的双手搭在门槛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到早晨，她的主人起来，开了房门，出去要上路的时候，就看见那妇人，就是他的妾，仆倒在门口，她的双手搭在门槛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨，她的主人起来开了房门，出去要行路，不料那妇人仆倒在房门前，两手搭在门槛上；
verses.textEnNiv: When her master got up in the morning and opened the door of the house and stepped out to continue on his way, there lay his concubine, fallen in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
verses.textEnEsv: And her master rose up in the morning, and when he opened the doors of the house and went out to go on his way, behold, there was his concubine lying at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.
verses.textEnNkjv: When her master arose in the morning, and opened the doors of the house and went out to go his way, there was his concubine, fallen at the door of the house with her hands on the threshold.
verses.textEnNlt: When her husband opened the door to leave, there lay his concubine with her hands on the threshold.
verses.textEnNasb: When her master got up in the morning and opened the doors of the house and went out to go on his way, then behold, his concubine was lying at the doorway of the house with her hands on the threshold.
verses.textEn: When her master got up in the morning and opened the door of the house and stepped out to continue on his way, there lay his concubine, fallen in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

verses.textZh: 他对那妇人说："起来，我们走吧！"可是却没有回答。那人就把她驮在驴上，起程回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对那妇人说："起来，我们走吧！"可是却没有回答。那人就把她驮在驴上，起程回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对妇人说：「起来，我们走吧！」妇人却不回答。那人便将她驮在驴上，起身回本处去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to her, "Get up; let’s go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to her, "Get up, let us be going." But there was no answer. Then he put her on the donkey, and the man rose up and went away to his home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to her, "Get up and let us be going." But there was no answer. So the man lifted her onto the donkey; and the man got up and went to his place.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "Get up! Let’s go!" But there was no answer. So he put her body on his donkey and took her home.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to her, "Get up and let’s go," but there was no answer. Then he put her on the donkey; and the man set out and went to his home.
verses.textEn: He said to her, "Get up; let’s go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.

verses.textZh: 他到了家里，就拿起刀来，抓住自己的妾，把她的肢体切成十二块，叫人送到以色列的全境去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到了家里，就拿起刀来，抓住自己的妾，把她的肢体切成十二块，叫人送到以色列的全境去。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了家里，用刀将妾的尸身切成十二块，使人拿着传送以色列的四境。
verses.textEnNiv: When he reached home, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, limb by limb, into twelve parts and sent them into all the areas of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he entered his house, he took a knife, and taking hold of his concubine he divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he entered his house he took a knife, laid hold of his concubine, and divided her into twelve pieces, limb by limb, and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When he got home, he took a knife and cut his concubine’s body into twelve pieces. Then he sent one piece to each tribe throughout all the territory of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: When he entered his house, he took a knife and seized his concubine, and cut her in twelve pieces, limb by limb. Then he sent her throughout the territory of Israel.
verses.textEn: When he reached home, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, limb by limb, into twelve parts and sent them into all the areas of Israel.

verses.textZh: 看见的人都说："自从以色列人从埃及地上来的日子，直到今日，这样的事并没有发生过，也没有看见过；你们要思想，要商议，要讨论。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见的人都说："自从以色列人从埃及地上来的日子，直到今日，这样的事并没有发生过，也没有看见过；你们要思想，要商议，要讨论。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡看见的人都说：「从以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，这样的事没有行过，也没有见过。现在应当思想，大家商议当怎样办理。」
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone who saw it was saying to one another, "Such a thing has never been seen or done, not since the day the Israelites came up out of Egypt. Just imagine! We must do something! So speak up!"
verses.textEnEsv: And all who saw it said, "Such a thing has never happened or been seen from the day that the people of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt until this day; consider it, take counsel, and speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was that all who saw it said, "No such deed has been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up from the land of Egypt until this day. Consider it, confer, and speak up!"
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who saw it said, "Such a horrible crime has not been committed in all the time since Israel left Egypt. Think about it! What are we going to do? Who’s going to speak up?"
verses.textEnNasb: All who saw it said, "Nothing like this has ever happened or been seen from the day when the sons of Israel came up from the land of Egypt to this day. Consider it, make a plan, and speak up!"
verses.textEn: Everyone who saw it was saying to one another, "Such a thing has never been seen or done, not since the day the Israelites came up out of Egypt. Just imagine! We must do something! So speak up!"

verses.textZh: 于是以色列众人都出来，从但到别是巴，以及基列地的众人，都在米斯巴耶和华面前聚集起来如同一人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列众人都出来，从但到别是巴，以及基列地的众人，都在米斯巴耶和华面前聚集起来如同一人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列从但到别是巴，以及住基列地的众人都出来，如同一人，聚集在米斯巴耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all Israel from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came together as one and assembled before the Lord in Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people of Israel came out, from Dan to Beersheba, including the land of Gilead, and the congregation assembled as one man to the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the children of Israel came out, from Dan to Beersheba, as well as from the land of Gilead, and the congregation gathered together as one man before the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the Israelites were united as one man, from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, including those from across the Jordan in the land of Gilead. The entire community assembled in the presence of the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the sons of Israel from Dan to Beersheba, including the land of Gilead, came out, and the congregation assembled as one person to the Lord at Mizpah.
verses.textEn: Then all Israel from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came together as one and assembled before the Lord in Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 全民的领袖，就是以色列众支派的领袖，都站在神子民的会中；拿刀的步兵共有四十万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全民的领袖，就是以色列众支派的领袖，都站在神子民的会中；拿刀的步兵共有四十万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列民的首领，就是各支派的军长，都站在神百姓的会中；拿刀的步兵共有四十万。
verses.textEnNiv: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of God’s people, four hundred thousand men armed with swords.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chiefs of all the people, of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, 400,000 men on foot that drew the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the leaders of all the people, all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand foot soldiers who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of all the people and all the tribes of Israel—400,000 warriors armed with swords—took their positions in the assembly of the people of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the leaders of all the people, all the tribes of Israel, took their stand in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand foot soldiers who drew the sword.
verses.textEn: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of God’s people, four hundred thousand men armed with swords.

verses.textZh: 以色列人说："这件恶事是怎样发生的？你们说吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人说："这件恶事是怎样发生的？你们说吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人上到米斯巴，便雅悯人都听见了。以色列人说：「请你将这件恶事的情由对我们说明。」
verses.textEnNiv: (The Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the Israelites said, "Tell us how this awful thing happened."
verses.textEnEsv: (Now the people of Benjamin heard that the people of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) And the people of Israel said, "Tell us, how did this evil happen?"
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the children of Israel said, "Tell us, how did this wicked deed happen?"
verses.textEnNlt: (Word soon reached the land of Benjamin that the other tribes had gone up to Mizpah.) The Israelites then asked how this terrible crime had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now the sons of Benjamin heard that the sons of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) And the sons of Israel said, "Tell us, how did this wickedness take place?"
verses.textEn: (The Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) Then the Israelites said, "Tell us how this awful thing happened."

verses.textZh: 那利未人，就是被害的妇人的丈夫，回答说："我和我的妾到了便雅悯的基比亚，要在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那利未人，就是被害的妇人的丈夫，回答说："我和我的妾到了便雅悯的基比亚，要在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 那利未人，就是被害之妇人的丈夫，回答说：「我和我的妾到了便雅悯的基比亚住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, "I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said, "I came to Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said, "My concubine and I went into Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin, to spend the night.
verses.textEnNlt: The Levite, the husband of the woman who had been murdered, said, "My concubine and I came to spend the night in Gibeah, a town that belongs to the people of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered and said, "I came with my concubine to spend the night at Gibeah which belongs to Benjamin.
verses.textEn: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, "I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.

verses.textZh: 基比亚人民起来攻击我，在夜间包围我住的房子攻击我，有意杀害我；他们把我的妾污辱致死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基比亚人民起来攻击我，在夜间包围我住的房子攻击我，有意杀害我；他们把我的妾污辱致死。
verses.textZhCuv: 基比亚人夜间起来，围了我住的房子，想要杀我，又将我的妾强奸致死。
verses.textEnNiv: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the leaders of Gibeah rose against me and surrounded the house against me by night. They meant to kill me, and they violated my concubine, and she is dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house at night because of me. They intended to kill me, but instead they ravished my concubine so that she died.
verses.textEnNlt: That night some of the leading citizens of Gibeah surrounded the house, planning to kill me, and they raped my concubine until she was dead.
verses.textEnNasb: But the citizens of Gibeah rose up against me and surrounded the house at night, threatening me. They intended to kill me; instead, they raped my concubine so that she died.
verses.textEn: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.

verses.textZh: 我就把我的妾切成块子，送到以色列的各地业，因为基比亚人在以色列中行了极羞耻的恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就把我的妾切成块子，送到以色列的各地业，因为基比亚人在以色列中行了极羞耻的恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就把我妾的尸身切成块子，使人拿着传送以色列得为业的全地，因为基比亚人在以色列中行了凶淫丑恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces and sent one piece to each region of Israel’s inheritance, because they committed this lewd and outrageous act in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So I took hold of my concubine and cut her in pieces and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel, for they have committed abomination and outrage in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I took hold of my concubine, cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the territory of the inheritance of Israel, because they committed lewdness and outrage in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: So I cut her body into twelve pieces and sent the pieces throughout the territory assigned to Israel, for these men have committed a terrible and shameful crime.
verses.textEnNasb: And I took hold of my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout the land of Israel’s inheritance; for they have committed an outrageous sin and vile act in Israel.
verses.textEn: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces and sent one piece to each region of Israel’s inheritance, because they committed this lewd and outrageous act in Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人哪，你们都要说出你们的意见，也要在这里提出你们的对策。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人哪，你们都要说出你们的意见，也要在这里提出你们的对策。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们以色列人都当筹划商议。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and tell me what you have decided to do."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you people of Israel, all of you, give your advice and counsel here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Look! All of you are children of Israel; give your advice and counsel here and now!"
verses.textEnNlt: Now then, all of you—the entire community of Israel—must decide here and now what should be done about this!"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, all you sons of Israel, give your response and advice here."
verses.textEn: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and tell me what you have decided to do."

verses.textZh: 于是众人都起来如同一人，说："我们当中谁都不回自己的帐棚，谁都不回自己的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众人都起来如同一人，说："我们当中谁都不回自己的帐棚，谁都不回自己的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民都起来如同一人，说：「我们连一人都不回自己帐棚、自己房屋去。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men rose up together as one, saying, "None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people arose as one man, saying, "None of us will go to his tent, and none of us will return to his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the people arose as one man, saying, "None ofus will go to his tent, nor will any turn back to his house;
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people rose to their feet in unison and declared, "None of us will return home! No, not even one of us!
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people rose up as one person, saying, "Not one of us will go to his tent, nor will any of us go home.
verses.textEn: All the men rose up together as one, saying, "None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.

verses.textZh: 现在我们要这样对待基比亚人：我们要照着所抽的签上去攻打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我们要这样对待基比亚人：我们要照着所抽的签上去攻打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们向基比亚人必这样行，照所掣的签去攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.
verses.textEnEsv: But now this is what we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot,
verses.textEnNkjv: but now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: Wewillgoup against it by lot.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, this is what we will do to Gibeah; we will draw lots to decide who will attack it.
verses.textEnNasb: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up against it by lot.
verses.textEn: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.

verses.textZh: 我们要从以色列各支派中，每百人抽取十人，每千人抽取百人，每万人抽取千人，好为人民运送粮食；等他们到了便雅悯的基比亚的时候，就可以照着他们在以色列中所行的一切羞耻的事惩罚他们。"
