verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要从以色列各支派中，每百人抽取十人，每千人抽取百人，每万人抽取千人，好为人民运送粮食；等他们到了便雅悯的基比亚的时候，就可以照着他们在以色列中所行的一切羞耻的事惩罚他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要在以色列各支派中，一百人挑取十人，一千人挑取百人，一万人挑取千人，为民运粮，等大众到了便雅悯的基比亚，就照基比亚人在以色列中所行的丑事征伐他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: We’ll take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred from a thousand, and a thousand from ten thousand, to get provisions for the army. Then, when the army arrives at Gibeah in Benjamin, it can give them what they deserve for this outrageous act done in Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: and we will take ten men of a hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred of a thousand, and a thousand of ten thousand, to bring provisions for the people, that when they come they may repay Gibeah of Benjamin for all the outrage that they have committed in Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: We will take ten men out of every hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, a hundred out of every thousand, and a thousand out of every ten thousand, to make provisions for the people, that when they come to Gibeah in Benjamin, they may repay all the vileness that they have done in Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: One-tenth of the men from each tribe will be chosen to supply the warriors with food, and the rest of us will take revenge on Gibeah of Benjamin for this shameful thing they have done in Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And we will take ten men out of a hundred throughout the tribes of Israel, and a hundred out of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to supply provisions for the people, so that when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, they may punish them for all the vile sin that they have committed in Israel."
verses.textEn: We’ll take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred from a thousand, and a thousand from ten thousand, to get provisions for the army. Then, when the army arrives at Gibeah in Benjamin, it can give them what they deserve for this outrageous act done in Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是以色列众人彼此联合，如同一人，聚集起来攻击那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列众人彼此联合，如同一人，聚集起来攻击那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列众人彼此连合如同一人，聚集攻击那城。
verses.textEnNiv: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the men of Israel gathered against the city, united as one man.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, united together as one man.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the Israelites were completely united, and they gathered together to attack the town.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, united as one man.
verses.textEn: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.

verses.textZh: 以色列各支派打发人到便雅悯的各家去，说："你们中间怎么发生了这样的恶事呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列各支派打发人到便雅悯的各家去，说："你们中间怎么发生了这样的恶事呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众支派打发人去，问便雅悯支派的各家说：「你们中间怎么做了这样的恶事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The tribes of Israel sent messengers throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What about this awful crime that was committed among you?
verses.textEnEsv: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What evil is this that has taken place among you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What is this wickedness that has occurred among you?
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites sent messengers to the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What a terrible thing has been done among you!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the tribes of Israel sent men through the entire tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What is this wickedness that has taken place among you?
verses.textEn: The tribes of Israel sent messengers throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What about this awful crime that was committed among you?

verses.textZh: 现在你们要把那些人，基比亚的无赖之徒，交出来，我们好处死他们，从以色列中除掉这恶。"只是便雅悯人却不肯听从他们的兄弟以色列人的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要把那些人，基比亚的无赖之徒，交出来，我们好处死他们，从以色列中除掉这恶。"只是便雅悯人却不肯听从他们的兄弟以色列人的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要将基比亚的那些匪徒交出来，我们好治死他们，从以色列中除掉这恶。」便雅悯人却不肯听从他们弟兄以色列人的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Now turn those wicked men of Gibeah over to us so that we may put them to death and purge the evil from Israel." But the Benjamites would not listen to their fellow Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore give up the men, the worthless fellows in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and purge evil from Israel." But the Benjaminites would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, deliver up the men, the perverted men who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and remove the evil from Israel!" But the children of Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brethren, the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Give up those evil men, those troublemakers from Gibeah, so we can execute them and purge Israel of this evil." But the people of Benjamin would not listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, turn over the men, the worthless men who are in Gibeah, so that we may put them to death and remove this wickedness from Israel." But the sons of Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Now turn those wicked men of Gibeah over to us so that we may put them to death and purge the evil from Israel." But the Benjamites would not listen to their fellow Israelites.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人从各城出来聚集，往基比亚去，要与以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人从各城出来聚集，往基比亚去，要与以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人从他们的各城里出来，聚集到了基比亚，要与以色列人打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Benjamin came together out of the cities to Gibeah to go out to battle against the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead, the children of Benjamin gathered together from their cities to Gibeah, to go to battle against the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they came from their towns and gathered at Gibeah to fight the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, the sons of Benjamin gathered from the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 那时便雅悯人，从各城里被数点的，共有二万六千拿刀的，另外被数点的，还有基比亚的居民，共有七百精兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时便雅悯人，从各城里被数点的，共有二万六千拿刀的，另外被数点的，还有基比亚的居民，共有七百精兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时便雅悯人从各城里点出拿刀的，共有二万六千；另外还有基比亚人点出七百精兵。
verses.textEnNiv: At once the Benjamites mobilized twenty-six thousand swordsmen from their towns, in addition to seven hundred able young men from those living in Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Benjamin mustered out of their cities on that day 26,000 men who drew the sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who mustered 700 chosen men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And from their cities at that time the children of Benjamin numbered twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who numbered seven hundred select men.
verses.textEnNlt: In all, 26,000 of their warriors armed with swords arrived in Gibeah to join the 700 elite troops who lived there.
verses.textEnNasb: From the cities on that day the sons of Benjamin were counted, twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah who were counted, seven hundred choice men.
verses.textEn: At once the Benjamites mobilized twenty-six thousand swordsmen from their towns, in addition to seven hundred able young men from those living in Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 在这些人中，还有七百精兵是善用左手的，个个都能用机弦拋石，毫发不差。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这些人中，还有七百精兵是善用左手的，个个都能用机弦拋石，毫发不差。
verses.textZhCuv: 在众军之中有拣选的七百精兵，都是左手便利的，能用机弦甩石打人，毫发不差。
verses.textEnNiv: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred select troops who were left-handed, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
verses.textEnEsv: Among all these were 700 chosen men who were left-handed; every one could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
verses.textEnNkjv: Among all this people were seven hundred select men whowere left-handed; every one could sling a stone at a hair’s breadth and not miss.
verses.textEnNlt: Among Benjamin’s elite troops, 700 were left-handed, and each of them could sling a rock and hit a target within a hairsbreadth without missing.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of all these people seven hundred choice men were left-handed; each one could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.
verses.textEn: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred select troops who were left-handed, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

verses.textZh: 除了便雅悯人以外，以色列人被数点的，共有四十万拿刀的，个个都是战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了便雅悯人以外，以色列人被数点的，共有四十万拿刀的，个个都是战士。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人之外，点出以色列人拿刀的，共有四十万，都是战士。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fit for battle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered 400,000 men who drew the sword; all these were men of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now besides Benjamin, the men of Israel numbered four hundred thousand men who drew the sword; all of these were men of war.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel had 400,000 experienced soldiers armed with swords, not counting Benjamin’s warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Israel besides Benjamin were counted, four hundred thousand men who drew the sword; all of these were men of war.
verses.textEn: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fit for battle.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就起来，上伯特利去求问神，说："我们之中谁应首先上去，与便雅悯人交战呢？"耶和华说："犹大应首先上去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就起来，上伯特利去求问神，说："我们之中谁应首先上去，与便雅悯人交战呢？"耶和华说："犹大应首先上去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人就起来，到伯特利去求问神说：「我们中间谁当首先上去与便雅悯人争战呢？」耶和华说：「犹大当先上去。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites went up to Bethel and inquired of God. They said, "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Benjamites?" The Lord replied, "Judah shall go first."
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel arose and went up to Bethel and inquired of God, "Who shall go up first for us to fight against the people of Benjamin?" And the Lord said, "Judah shall go up first."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel arose and went up to the house of God to inquire of God. They said, "Which of us shall go up first to battle against the children of Benjamin?" The Lord said, "Judah first!"
verses.textEnNlt: Before the battle the Israelites went to Bethel and asked God, "Which tribe should go first to attack the people of Benjamin?" The Lord answered, "Judah is to go first."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel set out, went up to Bethel, and inquired of God and said, "Who shall go up first for us to battle against the sons of Benjamin?" Then the Lord said, "Judah shall go up first."
verses.textEn: The Israelites went up to Bethel and inquired of God. They said, "Who of us is to go up first to fight against the Benjamites?" The Lord replied, "Judah shall go first."

verses.textZh: 以色列人早晨起来，对着基比亚安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人早晨起来，对着基比亚安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人早晨起来，对着基比亚安营。
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel rose in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel rose in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites left early the next morning and camped near Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel got up in the morning and camped against Gibeah.
verses.textEn: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 以色列人出来，要与便雅悯人交战；以色列人在基比亚面前列阵等待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人出来，要与便雅悯人交战；以色列人在基比亚面前列阵等待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人出来，要与便雅悯人打仗，就在基比亚前摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites went out to fight the Benjamites and took up battle positions against them at Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin, and the men of Israel drew up the battle line against them at Gibeah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin, and the men of Israel put themselves in battle array to fight against them at Gibeah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they advanced toward Gibeah to attack the men of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: The men of Israel went to battle against Benjamin, and the men of Israel lined up for battle against them at Gibeah.
verses.textEn: The Israelites went out to fight the Benjamites and took up battle positions against them at Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人从基比亚出来，那一天使二万二千以色列人倒地身亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人从基比亚出来，那一天使二万二千以色列人倒地身亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人就从基比亚出来，当日杀死以色列人二万二千。
verses.textEnNiv: The Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelites on the battlefield that day.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Benjamin came out of Gibeah and destroyed on that day 22,000 men of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day cut down to the ground twenty-two thousand men of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNlt: But Benjamin’s warriors, who were defending the town, came out and killed 22,000 Israelites on the battlefield that day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Benjamin came out of Gibeah and struck to the ground on that day twenty-two thousand men of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelites on the battlefield that day.

verses.textZh: 众民，就是以色列人，都奋勇起来，又在头一天列阵的地方列阵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民，就是以色列人，都奋勇起来，又在头一天列阵的地方列阵。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人彼此奋勇，仍在头一日摆阵的地方又摆阵。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites encouraged one another and again took up their positions where they had stationed themselves the first day.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people, the men of Israel, took courage, and again formed the battle line in the same place where they had formed it on the first day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people, that is, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves and again formed the battle line at the place where they had put themselves in array on the first day.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites encouraged each other and took their positions again at the same place they had fought the previous day.
verses.textEnNasb: But the people, the men of Israel, showed themselves courageous and lined up for battle again in the place where they had lined themselves up on the first day.
verses.textEn: But the Israelites encouraged one another and again took up their positions where they had stationed themselves the first day.

verses.textZh: 事前，以色列人上伯特利去，在耶和华面前哀哭直到晚上，然后求问耶和华，说："我们再去与我们的兄弟便雅悯人交战，可以不可以？"耶和华说："你们可以上去攻打他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 事前，以色列人上伯特利去，在耶和华面前哀哭直到晚上，然后求问耶和华，说："我们再去与我们的兄弟便雅悯人交战，可以不可以？"耶和华说："你们可以上去攻打他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 未摆阵之先，以色列人上去，在耶和华面前哭号，直到晚上，求问耶和华说：「我们再去与我们弟兄便雅悯人打仗可以不可以？」耶和华说：「可以上去攻击他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and they inquired of the Lord . They said, "Shall we go up again to fight against the Benjamites, our fellow Israelites?" The Lord answered, "Go up against them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until the evening. And they inquired of the Lord , "Shall we again draw near to fight against our brothers, the people of Benjamin?" And the Lord said, "Go up against them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and asked counsel of the Lord, saying, "Shall I again draw near for battle against the children of my brother Benjamin?" And the Lord said, "Go up against him."
verses.textEnNlt: For they had gone up to Bethel and wept in the presence of the Lord until evening. They had asked the Lord , "Should we fight against our relatives from Benjamin again?" And the Lord had said, "Go out and fight against them."
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and inquired of the Lord, saying, "Shall we again advance for battle against the sons of my brother Benjamin?" And the Lord said, "Go up against him."
verses.textEn: The Israelites went up and wept before the Lord until evening, and they inquired of the Lord . They said, "Shall we go up again to fight against the Benjamites, our fellow Israelites?" The Lord answered, "Go up against them."

verses.textZh: 第二天，以色列人就前去攻打便雅悯人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，以色列人就前去攻打便雅悯人。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二日，以色列人就上前攻击便雅悯人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people of Israel came near against the people of Benjamin the second day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel approached the children of Benjamin on the second day.
verses.textEnNlt: So the next day they went out again to fight against the men of Benjamin,
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel came against the sons of Benjamin on the second day.
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人第二天也从基比亚出来，迎战以色列人，又使一万八千以色列人倒地身亡，都是拿刀的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人第二天也从基比亚出来，迎战以色列人，又使一万八千以色列人倒地身亡，都是拿刀的。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人也在这日从基比亚出来，与以色列人接战，又杀死他们一万八千，都是拿刀的。
verses.textEnNiv: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.
verses.textEnEsv: And Benjamin went against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed 18,000 men of the people of Israel. All these were men who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Benjamin went out against them from Gibeah on the second day, and cut down to the ground eighteen thousand more of the children of Israel; all these drew the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: but the men of Benjamin killed another 18,000 Israelites, all of whom were experienced with the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: And Benjamin went out against them from Gibeah the second day and struck to the ground again eighteen thousand men of the sons of Israel; all of these drew the sword.
verses.textEn: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人，就是全体人民，又上到伯特利，坐在耶和华面前哀哭，那日禁食直到晚上，然后在耶和华面前献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人，就是全体人民，又上到伯特利，坐在耶和华面前哀哭，那日禁食直到晚上，然后在耶和华面前献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人就上到伯特利，坐在耶和华面前哭号，当日禁食直到晚上；又在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the Israelites, the whole army, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the Lord . They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the people of Israel, the whole army, went up and came to Bethel and wept. They sat there before the Lord and fasted that day until evening, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the children of Israel, that is, all the people, went up and came to the house of God and wept. They sat there before the Lord and fasted that day until evening; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the Israelites went up to Bethel and wept in the presence of the Lord and fasted until evening. They also brought burnt offerings and peace offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the sons of Israel and all the people went up and came to Bethel, and they wept and remained there before the Lord, and fasted that day until evening. And they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then all the Israelites, the whole army, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the Lord . They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那时，亚伦的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，侍立在约柜前供职。以色列人求问耶和华，说："我们应再出去与我们的兄弟便雅悯人交战呢？还是休战呢？"耶和华说："你们应上去，因为明天我必把他们交在你们手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚伦的孙子、以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈，侍立在约柜前供职。以色列人求问耶和华，说："我们应再出去与我们的兄弟便雅悯人交战呢？还是休战呢？"耶和华说："你们应上去，因为明天我必把他们交在你们手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 第三日，以色列人又上去攻击便雅悯人，在基比亚前摆阵，与前两次一样。
verses.textEnNiv: with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, ministering before it.) They asked, "Shall we go up again to fight against the Benjamites, our fellow Israelites, or not?" The Lord responded, "Go, for tomorrow I will give them into your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, son of Aaron, ministered before it in those days), saying, "Shall we go out once more to battle against our brothers, the people of Benjamin, or shall we cease?" And the Lord said, "Go up, for tomorrow I will give them into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, "Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of my brother Benjamin, or shall I cease?" And the Lord said, "Go up, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand."

verses.textZh: 以色列人在基比亚四周设下伏兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在基比亚四周设下伏兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人也出来迎敌，就被引诱离城；在田间两条路上，一通伯特利，一通基比亚，像前两次，动手杀死以色列人约有三十个。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Israel set men in ambush around Gibeah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel set men in ambush all around Gibeah.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites set an ambush all around Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel set men in ambush around Gibeah.
verses.textEn: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 第三天，以色列人又上去攻打便雅悯人，在基比亚前面列阵，像前两次一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，以色列人又上去攻打便雅悯人，在基比亚前面列阵，像前两次一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人说：「他们仍旧败在我们面前。」但以色列人说：「我们不如逃跑，引诱他们离开城到路上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel went up against the people of Benjamin on the third day and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in battle array against Gibeah as at the other times.
verses.textEnNlt: They went out on the third day and took their positions at the same place as before.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel went up against the sons of Benjamin on the third day and lined up against Gibeah as at other times.
verses.textEn: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人也出来迎敌，他们被引出城外，在两条大路上，一条通往伯特利，一条通往基比亚，像前两次一样，动手杀敌，在田间杀死以色列人约有三十个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人也出来迎敌，他们被引出城外，在两条大路上，一条通往伯特利，一条通往基比亚，像前两次一样，动手杀敌，在田间杀死以色列人约有三十个。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人都起来，在巴力‧他玛摆阵，以色列的伏兵从马利‧迦巴埋伏的地方冲上前去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Benjamites came out to meet them and were drawn away from the city. They began to inflict casualties on the Israelites as before, so that about thirty men fell in the open field and on the roads—the one leading to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Benjamin went out against the people and were drawn away from the city. And as at other times they began to strike and kill some of the people in the highways, one of which goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, and in the open country, about thirty men of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city. They began to strike down and kill some of the people, as at the other times, in the highways (one of which goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah) and in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When the men of Benjamin came out to attack, they were drawn away from the town. And as they had done before, they began to kill the Israelites. About thirty Israelites died in the open fields and along the roads, one leading to Bethel and the other leading back to Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sons of Benjamin went out against the people, they were lured away from the city, and they began to strike and kill some of the people as at other times, on the roads (one of which goes up to Bethel, and the other to Gibeah), and in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Benjamites came out to meet them and were drawn away from the city. They began to inflict casualties on the Israelites as before, so that about thirty men fell in the open field and on the roads—the one leading to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人说："他们仍像前一次一样，败在我们面前了。"以色列人却说："我们逃跑吧，引他们离开城市出到大路上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人说："他们仍像前一次一样，败在我们面前了。"以色列人却说："我们逃跑吧，引他们离开城市出到大路上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有以色列人中的一万精兵，来到基比亚前接战，势派甚是凶猛；便雅悯人却不知道灾祸临近了。
verses.textEnNiv: While the Benjamites were saying, "We are defeating them as before," the Israelites were saying, "Let’s retreat and draw them away from the city to the roads."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Benjamin said, "They are routed before us, as at the first." But the people of Israel said, "Let us flee and draw them away from the city to the highways."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Benjamin said, "They are defeated before us, as at first." But the children of Israel said, "Let us flee and draw them away from the city to the highways."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the warriors of Benjamin shouted, "We’re defeating them as we did before!" But the Israelites had planned in advance to run away so that the men of Benjamin would chase them along the roads and be drawn away from the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Benjamin said, "They are defeated before us, like the first time." But the sons of Israel said, "Let’s flee, so that we may draw them away from the city to the roads."
verses.textEn: While the Benjamites were saying, "We are defeating them as before," the Israelites were saying, "Let’s retreat and draw them away from the city to the roads."

verses.textZh: 以色列众人都从自己的地方起来，在巴力．他玛列阵；以色列的伏兵，从基比亚西边埋伏的地方冲出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人都从自己的地方起来，在巴力．他玛列阵；以色列的伏兵，从基比亚西边埋伏的地方冲出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使以色列人杀败便雅悯人。那日，以色列人杀死便雅悯人二万五千一百，都是拿刀的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men of Israel moved from their places and took up positions at Baal Tamar, and the Israelite ambush charged out of its place on the west of Gibeah.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal-tamar, and the men of Israel who were in ambush rushed out of their place from Maareh-geba.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the men of Israel rose from their place and put themselves in battle array at Baal Tamar. Then Israel’s men in ambush burst forth from their position in the plain of Geba.
verses.textEnNlt: When the main group of Israelite warriors reached Baal-tamar, they turned and took up their positions. Meanwhile, the Israelites hiding in ambush to the west of Gibeah jumped up to fight.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the men of Israel rose from their place and lined up at Baal-tamar; and the men of Israel in ambush charged from their place, from Maareh-geba.
verses.textEn: All the men of Israel moved from their places and took up positions at Baal Tamar, and the Israelite ambush charged out of its place on the west of Gibeah.

verses.textZh: 全以色列中的精兵，有一万人前来攻打基比亚，战争非常激烈；便雅悯人还不知道灾祸快要临到他们的身上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全以色列中的精兵，有一万人前来攻打基比亚，战争非常激烈；便雅悯人还不知道灾祸快要临到他们的身上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是便雅悯人知道自己败了。先是以色列人；因为靠着在基比亚前所设的伏兵，就在便雅悯人面前诈败。
verses.textEnNiv: Then ten thousand of Israel’s able young men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.
verses.textEnEsv: And there came against Gibeah 10,000 chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was hard, but the Benjaminites did not know that disaster was close upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And ten thousand select men from all Israel came against Gibeah, and the battle was fierce. But theBenjamites did not know that disaster was upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: There were 10,000 elite Israelite troops who advanced against Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that Benjamin didn’t realize the impending disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: When ten thousand choice men from all Israel came against Gibeah, the battle became fierce; but Benjamin did not know that disaster was close to them.
verses.textEn: Then ten thousand of Israel’s able young men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在以色列人面前击败了便雅悯人；那天以色列人消灭便雅悯人，共二万五千一百名，都是拿刀的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在以色列人面前击败了便雅悯人；那天以色列人消灭便雅悯人，共二万五千一百名，都是拿刀的。
verses.textZhCuv: 伏兵急忙闯进基比亚，用刀杀死全城的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel, and on that day the Israelites struck down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel, and the people of Israel destroyed 25,100 men of Benjamin that day. All these were men who drew the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel. And the children of Israel destroyed that day twenty-five thousand one hundred Benjamites; all these drew the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord helped Israel defeat Benjamin, and that day the Israelites killed 25,100 of Benjamin’s warriors, all of whom were experienced swordsmen.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord struck Benjamin before Israel, so that the sons of Israel destroyed 25,100 men of Benjamin that day, all who drew the sword.
verses.textEn: The Lord defeated Benjamin before Israel, and on that day the Israelites struck down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.

verses.textZh: 这样，便雅悯人就看出自己被击败了。原来以色列人倚靠在基比亚前面设下的伏兵，就对便雅悯人诈败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，便雅悯人就看出自己被击败了。原来以色列人倚靠在基比亚前面设下的伏兵，就对便雅悯人诈败。

verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were defeated. The men of Israel had given ground to the Benjamites, because they relied on the men in ambush whom they had set against Gibeah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men of Benjamin saw that they were beaten. The Israelites had retreated from Benjamin’s warriors in order to give those hiding in ambush more room to maneuver against Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Benjamin saw that they were defeated. When the men of Israel gave ground to Benjamin because they relied on the men in ambush whom they had set against Gibeah,
verses.textEn: Then the Benjamites saw that they were beaten. Now the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, because they relied on the ambush they had set near Gibeah.

verses.textEnEsv: Then the men in ambush hurried and rushed against Gibeah; the men in ambush moved out and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men in ambush quickly rushed upon Gibeah; the men in ambush spread out and struck the whole city with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: Then those who were hiding rushed in from all sides and killed everyone in the town.
verses.textEnNasb: the men in ambush hurried and rushed against Gibeah; the men in ambush also deployed and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: Those who had been in ambush made a sudden dash into Gibeah, spread out and put the whole city to the sword.

verses.textZh: 以色列人与伏兵预先约定，就是从城里放火，以烟气上升为号。

verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were terrified; for they saw that disaster was close to them.
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites counterattacked, and the Benjamites were terrified, because they realized that disaster had come on them.

verses.textZh: 他们在以色列人面前转身，向旷野的路上逃走，战争却紧随着他们；那些从各城里出来的人也在他们中间消灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在以色列人面前转身，向旷野的路上逃走，战争却紧随着他们；那些从各城里出来的人也在他们中间消灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人死了的有一万八千，都是勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: So they fled before the Israelites in the direction of the wilderness, but they could not escape the battle. And the Israelites who came out of the towns cut them down there.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel in the direction of the wilderness, but the battle overtook them. And those who came out of the cities were destroying them in their midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they turned theirbacks before the men of Israel in the direction of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them, and whoever came out of the cities they destroyed in their midst.
verses.textEnNlt: So they turned around and fled before the Israelites toward the wilderness. But they couldn’t escape the battle, and the people who came out of the nearby towns were also killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, they turned their backs before the men of Israel to flee in the direction of the wilderness, but the battle overtook them while those who attacked from the cities were annihilating them in the midst of them.
verses.textEn: So they fled before the Israelites in the direction of the wilderness, but they could not escape the battle. And the Israelites who came out of the towns cut them down there.

verses.textZh: 以色列人包围了便雅悯人，从挪哈 追赶他们，践踏他们，直到基比亚 对面日出之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人包围了便雅悯人，从挪哈 追赶他们，践踏他们，直到基比亚 对面日出之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的人转身向旷野逃跑，往临门磐去。以色列人在道路上杀了他们五千人，如拾取遗穗一样，追到基顿又杀了他们二千人。
verses.textEnNiv: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.
verses.textEnEsv: Surrounding the Benjaminites, they pursued them and trod them down from Nohah as far as opposite Gibeah on the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and easily trampled them down as far as the front of Gibeah toward the east.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites surrounded the men of Benjamin and chased them relentlessly, finally overtaking them east of Gibeah.
verses.textEnNasb: They surrounded Benjamin, pursued them without rest, and trampled them down opposite Gibeah toward the east.
verses.textEn: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯人中倒毙的共有一万八千人，全都是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯人中倒毙的共有一万八千人，全都是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日便雅悯死了的共有二万五千人，都是拿刀的勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.
verses.textEnEsv: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell, all of them men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: That day 18,000 of Benjamin’s strongest warriors died in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: So eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all of these were valiant men.
verses.textEn: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.

verses.textZh: 其余的人转身，向着旷野逃跑，到了临门的盘石那里；以色列人在大路上除灭了他们五千人，追赶他们直到基顿，又击杀了他们二千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的人转身，向着旷野逃跑，到了临门的盘石那里；以色列人在大路上除灭了他们五千人，追赶他们直到基顿，又击杀了他们二千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 只剩下六百人，转身向旷野逃跑，到了临门磐，就在那里住了四个月。
verses.textEnNiv: As they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites cut down five thousand men along the roads. They kept pressing after the Benjamites as far as Gidom and struck down two thousand more.
verses.textEnEsv: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. Five thousand men of them were cut down in the highways. And they were pursued hard to Gidom, and 2,000 men of them were struck down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon; and they cut down five thousand of them on the highways. Then they pursued them relentlessly up to Gidom, and killed two thousand of them.
verses.textEnNlt: The survivors fled into the wilderness toward the rock of Rimmon, but Israel killed 5,000 of them along the road. They continued the chase until they had killed another 2,000 near Gidom.
verses.textEnNasb: The rest turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, but they caught five thousand of them on the roads and overtook them at Gidom, and killed two thousand of them.
verses.textEn: As they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites cut down five thousand men along the roads. They kept pressing after the Benjamites as far as Gidom and struck down two thousand more.

verses.textZh: 所以那一天便雅悯人倒毙的，共有二万五千人，都是拿刀的，全部是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以那一天便雅悯人倒毙的，共有二万五千人，都是拿刀的，全部是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人又转到便雅悯地，将各城的人和牲畜，并一切所遇见的，都用刀杀尽，又放火烧了一切城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.
verses.textEnEsv: So all who fell that day of Benjamin were 25,000 men who drew the sword, all of them men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all who fell of Benjamin that day were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword; all these were men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: So that day the tribe of Benjamin lost 25,000 strong warriors armed with swords,
verses.textEnNasb: So all those of Benjamin who fell that day were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword; all of these were valiant men.
verses.textEn: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.

verses.textZh: 剩下的六百人转身，向着旷野逃跑，到了临门的盘石那里，就在临门的盘石那里住了四个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 剩下的六百人转身，向着旷野逃跑，到了临门的盘石那里，就在临门的盘石那里住了四个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 剩下的六百人转身，向着旷野逃跑，到了临门的盘石那里，就在临门的盘石那里住了四个月。
verses.textEnNiv: But six hundred of them turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.
verses.textEnEsv: But 600 men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon and remained at the rock of Rimmon four months.
verses.textEnNkjv: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and they stayed at the rock of Rimmon for four months.
verses.textEnNlt: leaving only 600 men who escaped to the rock of Rimmon, where they lived for four months.
verses.textEnNasb: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon; and they remained at the rock of Rimmon for four months.
verses.textEn: But six hundred of them turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又回到便雅悯人那里，把全城的人和牲畜，以及一切遇见的，都用刀杀尽；又把他们碰见的一切城市放火烧毁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又回到便雅悯人那里，把全城的人和牲畜，以及一切遇见的，都用刀杀尽；又把他们碰见的一切城市放火烧毁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人又回到便雅悯人那里，把全城的人和牲畜，以及一切遇见的，都用刀杀尽；又把他们碰见的一切城市放火烧毁了。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Israel went back to Benjamin and put all the towns to the sword, including the animals and everything else they found. All the towns they came across they set on fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Israel turned back against the people of Benjamin and struck them with the edge of the sword, the city, men and beasts and all that they found. And all the towns that they found they set on fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Israel turned back against the children of Benjamin, and struck them down with the edge of the sword—from every city, men and beasts, all who were found. They also set fire to all the cities they came to.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Israelites returned and slaughtered every living thing in all the towns—the people, the livestock, and everything they found. They also burned down all the towns they came to.
verses.textEnNasb: The men of Israel then turned back against the sons of Benjamin and struck them with the edge of the sword, both the entire city with the cattle and all that they found; they also set on fire all the cities which they found.
verses.textEn: The men of Israel went back to Benjamin and put all the towns to the sword, including the animals and everything else they found. All the towns they came across they set on fire.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在米斯巴曾经起誓说："我们中间不可有人把自己的女儿嫁给便雅悯人作妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在米斯巴曾经起誓说："我们中间不可有人把自己的女儿嫁给便雅悯人作妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在米斯巴曾起誓说：「我们都不将女儿给便雅悯人为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: "Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the men of Israel had sworn at Mizpah, "No one of us shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men of Israel had sworn an oath at Mizpah, saying, "None of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife."
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites had vowed at Mizpah, "We will never give our daughters in marriage to a man from the tribe of Benjamin."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, "None of us shall give his daughter to Benjamin in marriage."
verses.textEn: The men of Israel had taken an oath at Mizpah: "Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite."

verses.textZh: 众人来到伯特利，在那里坐在神面前直到晚上，放声大哭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人来到伯特利，在那里坐在神面前直到晚上，放声大哭，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人来到伯特利，坐在神面前直到晚上，放声痛哭，
verses.textEnNiv: The people went to Bethel, where they sat before God until evening, raising their voices and weeping bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people came to Bethel and sat there till evening before God, and they lifted up their voices and wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people came to the house of God, and remained there before God till evening. They lifted up their voices and wept bitterly,
verses.textEnNlt: Now the people went to Bethel and sat in the presence of God until evening, weeping loudly and bitterly.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening, and raised their voices and wept profusely.
verses.textEn: The people went to Bethel, where they sat before God until evening, raising their voices and weeping bitterly.

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华以色列的神啊，今日以色列中缺少了一个支派，为甚么在以色列中发生这事呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华以色列的神啊，今日以色列中缺少了一个支派，为甚么在以色列中发生这事呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「耶和华－以色列的神啊，为何以色列中有这样缺了一支派的事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: " Lord , God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "O Lord , the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that today there should be one tribe lacking in Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "O Lord God of Israel, why has this come to pass in Israel, that today there should be one tribe missing in Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord , God of Israel," they cried out, "why has this happened in Israel? Now one of our tribes is missing from Israel!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "Why, Lord, God of Israel, has this happened in Israel, that one tribe is missing today from Israel?"
verses.textEn: " Lord , God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?"

verses.textZh: 次日，众人清早起来，在那里筑了一座祭坛，献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，众人清早起来，在那里筑了一座祭坛，献上燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日清早，百姓起来，在那里筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: And the next day the people rose early and built there an altar and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, on the next morning, that the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning the people built an altar and presented their burnt offerings and peace offerings on it.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about the next day that the people got up early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.textEn: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: 以色列人彼此说："以色列各支派中，谁没有与会众上到耶和华面前来呢？"因为他们曾经起过很严厉的誓，说："不上米斯巴到耶和华面前的，必把他处死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人彼此说："以色列各支派中，谁没有与会众上到耶和华面前来呢？"因为他们曾经起过很严厉的誓，说："不上米斯巴到耶和华面前的，必把他处死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人彼此问说：「以色列各支派中，谁没有同会众上到耶和华面前来呢？」先是以色列人起过大誓说，凡不上米斯巴到耶和华面前来的，必将他治死。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Israelites asked, "Who from all the tribes of Israel has failed to assemble before the Lord ?" For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah was to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel said, "Which of all the tribes of Israel did not come up in the assembly to the Lord ?" For they had taken a great oath concerning him who did not come up to the Lord to Mizpah, saying, "He shall surely be put to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Israel said, "Who isthere among all the tribes of Israel who did not come up with the assembly to the Lord?" For they had made a great oath concerning anyone who had not come up to the Lord at Mizpah, saying, "He shall surely be put to death."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they said, "Who among the tribes of Israel did not join us at Mizpah when we held our assembly in the presence of the Lord ?" At that time they had taken a solemn oath in the Lord ’s presence, vowing that anyone who refused to come would be put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel said, "Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who did not go up to the Lord in the assembly?" For they had taken a solemn oath concerning anyone who did not go up to the Lord at Mizpah, saying, "He shall certainly be put to death."
verses.textEn: Then the Israelites asked, "Who from all the tribes of Israel has failed to assemble before the Lord ?" For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah was to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 以色列人为他们的兄弟便雅悯难过，说："今天以色列中有一个支派被剪除了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人为他们的兄弟便雅悯难过，说："今天以色列中有一个支派被剪除了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人为他们的弟兄便雅悯后悔，说：「如今以色列中绝了一个支派了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Israelites grieved for the tribe of Benjamin, their fellow Israelites. "Today one tribe is cut off from Israel," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel had compassion for Benjamin their brother and said, "One tribe is cut off from Israel this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, "One tribe is cut off from Israel today.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites felt sorry for their brother Benjamin and said, "Today one of the tribes of Israel has been cut off.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel were sorry for their brother Benjamin, and said, "Today one tribe is cut off from Israel!
verses.textEn: Now the Israelites grieved for the tribe of Benjamin, their fellow Israelites. "Today one tribe is cut off from Israel," they said.

verses.textZh: 我们曾经指着耶和华起过誓，必不把我们的女儿给便雅悯人作妻子，那么现在我们当怎样办理，使他们剩下的人有妻子呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们曾经指着耶和华起过誓，必不把我们的女儿给便雅悯人作妻子，那么现在我们当怎样办理，使他们剩下的人有妻子呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既在耶和华面前起誓说，必不将我们的女儿给便雅悯人为妻，现在我们当怎样办理、使他们剩下的人有妻呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "How can we provide wives for those who are left, since we have taken an oath by the Lord not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"
verses.textEnEsv: What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them any of our daughters for wives?"
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall we do for wives for those who remain, seeing we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them our daughters as wives?"
verses.textEnNlt: How can we find wives for the few who remain, since we have sworn by the Lord not to give them our daughters in marriage?"
verses.textEnNasb: What are we to do for wives for those who are left, since we have sworn by the Lord not to give them any of our daughters as wives?"
verses.textEn: "How can we provide wives for those who are left, since we have taken an oath by the Lord not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"

verses.textZh: 他们又彼此问："以色列各支派中，有谁没有上米斯巴到耶和华面前来的呢？"他们就发现基列．雅比中没有一人去到营中会众那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又彼此问："以色列各支派中，有谁没有上米斯巴到耶和华面前来的呢？"他们就发现基列．雅比中没有一人去到营中会众那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又彼此问说：「以色列支派中谁没有上米斯巴到耶和华面前来呢？」他们就查出基列‧雅比没有一人进营到会众那里；

verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "What one is there of the tribes of Israel that did not come up to the Lord to Mizpah?" And behold, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh-gilead, to the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "What one isthere from the tribes of Israel who did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord?" And, in fact, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh Gilead to the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: So they asked, "Who among the tribes of Israel did not join us at Mizpah when we assembled in the presence of the Lord ?" And they discovered that no one from Jabesh-gilead had attended the assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "What one is there of the tribes of Israel that did not go up to the Lord at Mizpah?" And behold, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
verses.textEn: Then they asked, "Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to assemble before the Lord at Mizpah?" They discovered that no one from Jabesh Gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.

verses.textZhCuv: 因为百姓被数的时候，没有一个基列‧雅比人在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.
verses.textEnEsv: For when the people were mustered, behold, not one of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was there.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when the people were counted, indeed, not one of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead was there.
verses.textEnNlt: For after they counted all the people, no one from Jabesh-gilead was present.
verses.textEnNasb: For when the people were counted, behold, not one of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead was there.
verses.textEn: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.

verses.textZh: 因此会众从勇士中差派一万二千人到那里去，吩咐他们说："你们去用刀击杀基列．雅比的居民，连妇女与孩子都要杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此会众从勇士中差派一万二千人到那里去，吩咐他们说："你们去用刀击杀基列．雅比的居民，连妇女与孩子都要杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众就打发一万二千大勇士，吩咐他们说：「你们去用刀将基列‧雅比人连妇女带孩子都击杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.
verses.textEnEsv: So the congregation sent 12,000 of their bravest men there and commanded them, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword; also the women and the little ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the congregation sent out there twelve thousand of their most valiant men, and commanded them, saying, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, including the women and children.
verses.textEnNlt: So the assembly sent 12,000 of their best warriors to Jabesh-gilead with orders to kill everyone there, including women and children.
verses.textEnNasb: And the congregation sent twelve thousand of the valiant warriors there, and commanded them, saying, "Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, along with the women and the children.
verses.textEn: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.

verses.textZh: 你们要这样行，你们要把所有的男子，和所有与男子同过房的女子，完全毁灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要这样行，你们要把所有的男子，和所有与男子同过房的女子，完全毁灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所当行的就是这样：要将一切男子和已嫁的女子尽行杀戮。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin."
verses.textEnEsv: This is what you shall do: every male and every woman that has lain with a male you shall devote to destruction."
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the thing that you shall do: You shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has known a man intimately."
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Completely destroy all the males and every woman who is not a virgin."
verses.textEnNasb: And this is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has slept with a male."
verses.textEn: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin."

verses.textZh: 他们在基列．雅比的居民中，找到了四百个未曾与人同房，也未曾与男子同寝的年轻少女，就把她们带到迦南地的示罗营那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在基列．雅比的居民中，找到了四百个未曾与人同房，也未曾与男子同寝的年轻少女，就把她们带到迦南地的示罗营那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在基列‧雅比人中，遇见了四百个未嫁的处女，就带到迦南地的示罗营里。
verses.textEnNiv: They found among the people living in Jabesh Gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they took them to the camp at Shiloh in Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead 400 young virgins who had not known a man by lying with him, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known a man intimately; and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: Among the residents of Jabesh-gilead they found 400 young virgins who had never slept with a man, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known a man by sleeping with him; and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: They found among the people living in Jabesh Gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they took them to the camp at Shiloh in Canaan.

verses.textZh: 全体会众又派人到临门的盘石那里，对便雅悯人说话，向他们宣告和平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众又派人到临门的盘石那里，对便雅悯人说话，向他们宣告和平。
verses.textZhCuv: 全会众打发人到临门磐的便雅悯人那里，向他们说和睦的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the whole congregation sent word to the people of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon and proclaimed peace to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the whole congregation sent word to the children of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon, and announced peace to them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite assembly sent a peace delegation to the remaining people of Benjamin who were living at the rock of Rimmon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the whole congregation sent word and spoke to the sons of Benjamin who were at the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
verses.textEn: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

verses.textZh: 那时便雅悯人回来了，以色列人就把他们保留的基列．雅比的女子给他们作妻子，但还是不够。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时便雅悯人回来了，以色列人就把他们保留的基列．雅比的女子给他们作妻子，但还是不够。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时便雅悯人回来了，以色列人就把所存活基列‧雅比的女子给他们为妻，还是不够。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Benjamin returned at that time. And they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead, but they were not enough for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Benjamin came back at that time, and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead; and yet they had not found enough for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men of Benjamin returned to their homes, and the 400 women of Jabesh-gilead who had been spared were given to them as wives. But there were not enough women for all of them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the tribe of Benjamin returned at that time, and they gave them the women whom they had allowed to live from the women of Jabesh-gilead; but they were not enough for them.
verses.textEn: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

verses.textZh: 众人为便雅悯人难过，因为耶和华使以色列众支派中有了缺口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人为便雅悯人难过，因为耶和华使以色列众支派中有了缺口。
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓为便雅悯人后悔，因为耶和华使以色列人缺了一个支派 。
verses.textEnNiv: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people had compassion on Benjamin because the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a void in the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The people felt sorry for Benjamin because the Lord had made this gap among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people were sorry for Benjamin, because the Lord had created a gap in the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 会众中的长老说："便雅悯的女子既然都被除灭了，我们应怎样行，使那些余下的人有妻子呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 会众中的长老说："便雅悯的女子既然都被除灭了，我们应怎样行，使那些余下的人有妻子呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 会中的长老说：「便雅悯中的女子既然除灭了，我们当怎样办理、使那余剩的人有妻呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And the elders of the assembly said, "With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?
verses.textEnEsv: Then the elders of the congregation said, "What shall we do for wives for those who are left, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the elders of the congregation said, "What shall we do for wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?"
verses.textEnNlt: So the elders of the assembly asked, "How can we find wives for the few who remain, since the women of the tribe of Benjamin are dead?
verses.textEnNasb: Then the elders of the congregation said, "What are we to do for wives for those who are left, since the women have been eliminated from Benjamin?"
verses.textEn: And the elders of the assembly said, "With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?

verses.textZh: 又说："便雅悯逃脱的人应有地业，免得有个支派从以色列中被消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："便雅悯逃脱的人应有地业，免得有个支派从以色列中被消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「便雅悯逃脱的人当有地业，免得以色列中涂抹了一个支派。
verses.textEnNiv: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs," they said, "so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "There must be an inheritance for the survivors of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Theremustbe an inheritance for the survivors of Benjamin, that a tribe may not be destroyed from Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There must be heirs for the survivors so that an entire tribe of Israel is not wiped out.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "There must be an inheritance for the survivors of Benjamin, so that a tribe will not be wiped out from Israel.
verses.textEn: The Benjamite survivors must have heirs," they said, "so that a tribe of Israel will not be wiped out.

verses.textZh: 但是我们不能把我们自己的女儿给他们作妻子。"因为以色列人曾经起誓说："把女儿给便雅悯人作妻子的，是可咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我们不能把我们自己的女儿给他们作妻子。"因为以色列人曾经起誓说："把女儿给便雅悯人作妻子的，是可咒诅的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我们不能将自己的女儿给他们为妻；因为以色列人曾起誓说，有将女儿给便雅悯人为妻的，必受咒诅。」
verses.textEnNiv: We can’t give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: ‘Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.’
verses.textEnEsv: Yet we cannot give them wives from our daughters." For the people of Israel had sworn, "Cursed be he who gives a wife to Benjamin."
verses.textEnNkjv: However, we cannot give them wives from our daughters, for the children of Israel have sworn an oath, saying, ‘Cursed be the one who gives a wife to Benjamin.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But we cannot give them our own daughters in marriage because we have sworn with a solemn oath that anyone who does this will fall under God’s curse."
verses.textEnNasb: But we cannot give them wives from our daughters." For the sons of Israel had sworn, saying, "Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin!"
verses.textEn: We can’t give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: ‘Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.’

verses.textZh: 他们又说："看哪，每年在示罗都举行耶和华的节期；示罗就是在伯特利的北面，从伯特利上示剑的大路的东面，在利波拿的南面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又说："看哪，每年在示罗都举行耶和华的节期；示罗就是在伯特利的北面，从伯特利上示剑的大路的东面，在利波拿的南面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又说：「在利波拿以南，伯特利以北，在示剑大路以东的示罗，年年有耶和华的节期」；
verses.textEnNiv: But look, there is the annual festival of the Lord in Shiloh, which lies north of Bethel, east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
verses.textEnEsv: So they said, "Behold, there is the yearly feast of the Lord at Shiloh, which is north of Bethel, on the east of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said, "In fact, thereis a yearly feast of the Lord in Shiloh, which is north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they thought of the annual festival of the Lord held in Shiloh, south of Lebonah and north of Bethel, along the east side of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: So they said, "Behold, there is a feast of the Lord from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the road that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south side of Lebonah."
verses.textEn: But look, there is the annual festival of the Lord in Shiloh, which lies north of Bethel, east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."

verses.textZh: 于是他们吩咐便雅悯人说："你们去在葡萄园中设下埋伏；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们吩咐便雅悯人说："你们去在葡萄园中设下埋伏；
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐便雅悯人说：「你们去，在葡萄园中埋伏。
verses.textEnNiv: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, "Go and hide in the vineyards
verses.textEnEsv: And they commanded the people of Benjamin, saying, "Go and lie in ambush in the vineyards
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they instructed the children of Benjamin, saying, "Go, lie in wait in the vineyards,
verses.textEnNlt: They told the men of Benjamin who still needed wives, "Go and hide in the vineyards.
verses.textEnNasb: And they commanded the sons of Benjamin, saying, "Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,
verses.textEn: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, "Go and hide in the vineyards

verses.textZh: 在那里观看，示罗的女子出来跳舞的时候，你们就从葡萄园出来，从示罗的女子中，各抢一个作妻子，然后回便雅悯地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里观看，示罗的女子出来跳舞的时候，你们就从葡萄园出来，从示罗的女子中，各抢一个作妻子，然后回便雅悯地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 若看见示罗的女子出来跳舞，就从葡萄园出来，在示罗的女子中各抢一个为妻，回便雅悯地去。
verses.textEnNiv: and watch. When the young women of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, rush from the vineyards and each of you seize one of them to be your wife. Then return to the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: and watch. If the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards and snatch each man his wife from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: and watch; and just when the daughters of Shiloh come out to perform their dances, then come out from the vineyards, and every man catch a wife for himself from the daughters of Shiloh; then go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: When you see the young women of Shiloh come out for their dances, rush out from the vineyards, and each of you can take one of them home to the land of Benjamin to be your wife!
verses.textEnNasb: and watch; and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to take part in the dances, then you shall come out of the vineyards, and each of you shall seize his wife from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: and watch. When the young women of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, rush from the vineyards and each of you seize one of them to be your wife. Then return to the land of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 如果她们的父亲或是兄弟来与我们争论，我们就对他们说：‘求你们恩待他们吧，因为我们在战场上没有给他们留下女子作妻子，而且这次又不是你们把女儿给他们；若是你们给的，你们就有罪了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果她们的父亲或是兄弟来与我们争论，我们就对他们说：‘求你们恩待他们吧，因为我们在战场上没有给他们留下女子作妻子，而且这次又不是你们把女儿给他们；若是你们给的，你们就有罪了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的父亲或是弟兄若来与我们争竞，我们就说：『求你们看我们的情面，施恩给这些人，因我们在争战的时候没有给他们留下女子为妻。这也不是你们将女子给他们的；若是你们给的，就算有罪。』」
verses.textEnNiv: When their fathers or brothers complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Do us the favor of helping them, because we did not get wives for them during the war. You will not be guilty of breaking your oath because you did not give your daughters to them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we did not take for each man of them his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them, else you would now be guilty.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to us to complain, that we will say to them, ‘Be kind to them for our sakes, because we did not take a wife for any of them in the war; for itis not asthough you have given the women to them at this time, making yourselves guilty of your oath.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And when their fathers and brothers come to us in protest, we will tell them, ‘Please be sympathetic. Let them have your daughters, for we didn’t find wives for all of them when we destroyed Jabesh-gilead. And you are not guilty of breaking the vow since you did not actually give your daughters to them in marriage.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, we shall say to them, ‘ Give them to us voluntarily, because we did not take for each man of Benjamin a wife in battle, nor did you give them to them, otherwise you would now be guilty.’ "
verses.textEn: When their fathers or brothers complain to us, we will say to them, ‘Do us the favor of helping them, because we did not get wives for them during the war. You will not be guilty of breaking your oath because you did not give your daughters to them.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是便雅悯人照样行了：按着他们的数目，从跳舞的女子中强抢她们作妻子，然后离开那里，回到自己的地业去，重建城市，住在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是便雅悯人照样行了：按着他们的数目，从跳舞的女子中强抢她们作妻子，然后离开那里，回到自己的地业去，重建城市，住在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是便雅悯人照样而行，按着他们的数目从跳舞的女子中抢去为妻，就回自己的地业去，又重修城邑居住。
verses.textEnNiv: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the young women were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Benjamin did so and took their wives, according to their number, from the dancers whom they carried off. Then they went and returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and lived in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Benjamin did so; they took enough wives for their number from those who danced, whom they caught. Then they went and returned to their inheritance, and they rebuilt the cities and dwelt in them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men of Benjamin did as they were told. Each man caught one of the women as she danced in the celebration and carried her off to be his wife. They returned to their own land, and they rebuilt their towns and lived in them.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Benjamin did so, and took wives according to their number from those who danced, whom they seized. And they went and returned to their inheritance, and rebuilt the cities and lived in them.
verses.textEn: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the young women were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列人离开那里，各人回到自己的支派和自己的家族去；他们离开那里，各人回到自己的地业去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列人离开那里，各人回到自己的支派和自己的家族去；他们离开那里，各人回到自己的地业去。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时以色列人离开那里，各归本支派、本宗族、本地业去了。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and family, and they went out from there every man to his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and family; they went out from there, every man to his inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Israel departed by tribes and families, and they returned to their own homes.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and family, and each one departed from there to his inheritance.
verses.textEn: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王，各人都行自己看为对的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，以色列中没有王，各人都行自己看为对的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以色列中没有王，各人任意而行。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days therewas no king in Israel; everyone did whatwas right in his own eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days Israel had no king; all the people did whatever seemed right in their own eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
verses.textEn: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
